title: Discrete signaling mediates chaotic regularization in recurrent neural networks
summary: Cortical circuits operate in a regime of intrinsic chaos, where even tiny changes in input can lead to divergent neural responses. Yet, remarkably, population codes in the brain vary smoothly with sensory stimuli, forming coherent representational manifolds. How can chaotic networks sustain such stable coding? Here, we develop a theoretical framework that links the microscopic chaos of recurrent networks to the macroscopic geometry of neural representations. Combining kernel methods with dynamical mean-field theory, we show that chaotic dynamics induce local roughness (introducing sharp distortions at small scales) while preserving global smoothness across larger stimulus variations. This structural property acts as an intrinsic regularizer, enhancing generalization while maintaining expressivity. Moreover, we show how chaotic networks naturally produce power-law spectral signatures, closely matching experimental observations in cortical recordings. These results explain how chaotic spiking networks can sustain smooth, differentiable population codes and establish a theoretical framework linking network dynamics, computational structure, and recorded neural activity.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个理论框架，将递归网络的微观混沌动力学与神经表征的宏观几何性质联系起来。通过结合核方法和动态平均场理论，证明混沌动力学在局部引入粗糙畸变（小尺度），但保持全局平滑性（大尺度变化），这种结构特性作为内在正则化器，增强泛化能力并保持表达性。混沌网络自然产生幂律谱特征，与皮层记录实验观察高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 混沌网络如何维持稳定的神经编码？传统观点认为混沌会破坏编码稳定性，但实际大脑中群体编码随感官刺激平滑变化，形成连贯的表征流形。本文旨在弥合微观混沌与宏观稳定编码之间的理论鸿沟。
AI.method: 将核方法与动态平均场理论（DMFT）相结合，从理论上分析递归网络混沌动力学对神经表征几何结构的影响，揭示局部粗糙度与全局平滑性的共存机制，并推导出幂律谱特征。
AI.result: 混沌动力学在神经表征中诱导局部粗糙度（小尺度畸变）同时保持全局平滑性（大尺度变化）；该结构特性充当内在正则化器，平衡泛化能力与表达性；混沌网络自然产生幂律谱特征，与皮层记录数据匹配。
AI.conclusion: 该理论解释了混沌脉冲网络如何维持平滑、可微分的群体编码，建立了连接网络动力学、计算结构与记录神经活动之间的统一理论框架。

title: Network node immunization: improving Netshield algorithm through random rooted forests
summary: We are interested in the so-called multiple-node immunization problem for complex networks under attack by a viral agent. It consists in identifying and removing a set of nodes of size $k$ in a graph to maximize the impeding of virus spread. A few approaches have been proposed in the literature based on numerical and theoretical insights on how classical models for virus spread evolve on graphs. Based on the analysis of these models, the maximal eigenvalue of the adjacency matrix of the graph has become a classical measure of how resilient the network is. Thus, a clear, well-explored approach for multiple-node immunization consists of identifying a set of $k$ nodes in such a way that the reduced network, obtained by removing these nodes, has a minimal largest eigenvalue. This spectral optimization problem turns out to be a computationally hard problem for which only greedy algorithms offer good solutions at efficient computational time. Among those, the so-called Netshield algorithm represents one of the reference choices. The latter is, in fact, a clearly defined algorithm aiming at optimizing a certain sub-modular functional, called shield-value, which approximates the original optimization problem. We propose here a novel procedure, based on random walk kernels and related random spanning forests, to build a new algorithm, referred to as K-shield, which enhances Netshield searching performance at the same computational complexity. We give theoretical insights behind this novel method, which could also be used for other optimization problems, and then test it via numerical showcase experiments on various benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对复杂网络中的多节点免疫问题，提出了一种基于随机游走核和随机生成森林的新算法K-shield，该算法在保持与Netshield相同计算复杂度的前提下，提升了搜索性能，用于通过移除k个节点最小化网络邻接矩阵的最大特征值以阻碍病毒传播。
AI.motivation: 多节点免疫问题旨在通过移除图中k个节点来最大化阻碍病毒传播，这是一个计算困难的谱优化问题。现有贪婪算法（如Netshield）虽有效但仍有改进空间，因此作者希望提出一种性能更优的算法。
AI.method: 基于随机游走核（random walk kernels）和相关的随机生成森林（random spanning forests）构建新算法K-shield，用于优化shield-value子模函数，进而逼近原始谱优化问题。
AI.result: K-shield在保持与Netshield相同计算复杂度的条件下，提升了搜索性能，并在多个基准测试上通过数值实验得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: K-shield算法有效增强了多节点免疫问题的求解质量，且该方法具有更广泛的适用性，可用于其他优化问题。

title: CADET: A Modular Platform for Evaluating Distributed Cooperative Autonomy in Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary:
Deep learning models are increasingly central to autonomous vehicle (AV) pipelines, yet their integration has traditionally followed a monolithic design where perception, planning, and control execute on a single onboard computer. This design overlooks the emerging paradigm of cooperative autonomy, where vehicles interact with roadside units (RSUs), edge servers, and cloud-hosted intelligence through vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity. Cooperative perception and control improve safety and efficiency, but also introduce systems-level challenges: network latency, compute heterogeneity, and multi-tenant contention, all critically affect real-time decision-making. These challenges are further amplified by the increasing reliance on large foundation models, whose scale necessitates cloud deployment.
  We present CADET (Cooperative Autonomy through Distributed Experimentation Toolkit), a modular platform for systematic and reproducible evaluation of distributed cooperative autonomy systems under realistic deployment conditions. CADET decouples the AV stack into composable modules that can be flexibly deployed across vehicles, infrastructure, and edge/cloud tiers. The framework integrates state-of-the-art models, incorporates trace-driven network and workload emulation, and provides synchronized model-, system-, and task-level instrumentation. Through V2V and V2I experiments, we show that distributed deployment choices fundamentally shape safety, with V2V intent packets outperforming cloud-based perception and RSU-assisted perception sustaining safety until overloaded by concurrent requests. Although designed for AV pipelines, CADET also supports dataset-driven experimentation, enabling systems and ML researchers to benchmark distributed inference workloads independently of full vehicle simulation. CADET is open source, with code and demo available at https://nesl.github.io/cadet-web.

AI.tldr: CADET是一个用于分布式协作自动驾驶系统评估的开源模块化平台，支持在车辆、边缘和云端灵活部署，通过V2V和V2I实验证明分布式部署选择从根本上影响安全性。
AI.motivation: 传统的自动驾驶系统采用单板机上的单体架构设计，忽视了通过V2X连接的协作式自动驾驶范式。协作感知和控制引入了网络延迟、计算异构性和多租户争用等系统级挑战，尤其大模型需要云端部署进一步加剧了这些问题。
AI.method: 提出CADET平台，将AV栈解耦为可组合模块，灵活部署在车、路、边、云各层；集成了SOTA模型，引入基于trace的网络和工作负载仿真，提供同步的模型级、系统级和任务级检测。
AI.result: 实验表明：V2V意图包优于云端感知；RSU辅助感知在并发请求超载前能维持安全性；分布式部署选择从根本上影响安全。
AI.conclusion: CADET为系统和机器学习研究人员提供了独立于完整车辆仿真的分布式推理工作负载基准测试能力，且已开源。

title: Dive into the Scene: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Vision-Language Decision Making via Focus Plan Generation
summary: In embodied vision-language decision making tasks such as robotic manipulation and navigation, Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models (VLMs & VLAs) are powerful tools with different benefits: VLMs are better at long-term planning, while VLAs are better at reactive control. However, their performance is limited by the same perceptual bottleneck: visual hallucinations arise due to the models' inability to distinguish task-relevant objects from distractors. In principle, accurate identification and focus on critical objects while filtering out irrelevant ones is the key to break this limitation. A straightforward solution is one-step focus: directly attending to essential objects. However, this approach proves ineffective because effective focus inherently requires deep scene understanding. To this end, we propose SceneDiver, a coarse-to-fine focus plan generation method for VLMs leveraging their long-term planning abilities, that first constructs a holistic scene graph to establish initial comprehension, then progressively decomposes the task into simpler sub-problems through an iterative cycle of recognition, understanding, and analysis. To enable reactive control, we also design a lightweight adapter for distilling the deliberate focus ability into VLAs. Evaluations on standard embodied AI benchmarks confirm that our method substantially reduces visual hallucinations for both VLMs and VLAs, while preserving computational efficiency in tasks requiring fast execution. Our code and data are released at: https://future-item.github.io/SceneDiver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SceneDiver方法，通过由粗到细的聚焦计划生成，分别增强VLM的长程规划能力和VLA的快速反应控制能力，有效减少视觉幻觉并提升具身决策性能。
AI.motivation: 在具身视觉-语言决策任务中，VLM和VLA虽然各有优势，但都受限于相同的感知瓶颈：由于模型无法区分任务相关物体与干扰物而导致视觉幻觉。作者希望通过精准识别并聚焦关键物体、过滤无关信息来突破这一限制。
AI.method: SceneDiver采用由粗到细的聚焦计划生成方法：先构建全局场景图建立初始理解，再通过识别、理解、分析的迭代循环逐步将任务分解为更简单的子问题。同时设计轻量级适配器，将VLM的审慎聚焦能力蒸馏到VLA中。
AI.result: 在标准具身AI基准测试上，SceneDiver显著减少了VLM和VLA的视觉幻觉，同时在需要快速执行的任务中保持计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 粗到细的聚焦策略比一步式直接聚焦更有效，因为有效的聚焦本质上需要深度场景理解。该方法可同时提升VLM和VLA的性能。

title: Early Detection of Alzheimer's Disease Using Explainable Machine Learning on Clinical Biomarkers: A Multi-Class Classification Study Using the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) Dataset
summary: Background: Alzheimer's disease (AD) affects over 55 million people worldwide. Accurate, interpretable detection of normal cognition (NC), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD from routine clinical assessments remains a critical unmet need. Methods: An XGBoost classifier was developed for three-class detection using eight clinical features from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI): MMSE, CDR Global, CDR Sum of Boxes (CDR-SB), MoCA, FAQ, age, sex, and education. Hyperparameters were optimised using Optuna (50 trials); class imbalance was addressed with SMOTE. Performance was evaluated by macro AUC-ROC with 1,000-iteration bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, macro F1, balanced accuracy, and Cohen's kappa. SHAP values provided feature-level explainability. Results: The dataset comprised 1,641 baseline subjects (608 NC, 767 MCI, 266 AD). On five-fold cross-validation, mean macro AUC was 0.983 (SD 0.007), accuracy 0.944 (SD 0.006), and macro F1 0.929 (SD 0.008). On the held-out test set (n = 247), macro AUC was 0.982 (95% CI: 0.965--0.995), accuracy 0.943, balanced accuracy 0.932, macro F1 0.927, and Cohen's kappa 0.909. SHAP analysis identified CDR Global as the dominant predictor for NC and MCI, while CDR-SB and MMSE together drove AD classification. Conclusion: An explainable machine learning model trained on routine clinical assessments achieves near-perfect three-class Alzheimer's detection. SHAP analysis reveals clinically plausible, class-specific feature importance patterns supporting clinical validity. Future work will extend this framework with speech biomarkers for multimodal detection.

AI.tldr: 基于ADNI临床评估数据（8项特征），使用XGBoost分类器结合SMOTE和Optuna优化，实现NC/MCI/AD三分类检测，五折交叉验证宏AUC 0.983，测试集宏AUC 0.982，SHAP分析揭示CDR Global和CDR-SB/MMSE分别为NC/MCI和AD的关键预测因子。
AI.motivation: 全球超过5500万AD患者，急需一种准确且可解释的方法，从常规临床评估中检测正常认知、轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病。
AI.method: 基于ADNI数据集（1641名基线受试者，8项临床特征），采用XGBoost分类器进行三分类检测，Optuna（50次试验）优化超参数，SMOTE处理类别不平衡，五折交叉验证和独立测试集评估性能，SHAP值提供特征可解释性。
AI.result: 五折交叉验证：宏AUC 0.983±0.007，准确率0.944±0.006，宏F1 0.929±0.008。测试集（n=247）：宏AUC 0.982（95%CI: 0.965-0.995），准确率0.943，平衡准确率0.932，宏F1 0.927，Cohen's kappa 0.909。SHAP分析显示CDR Global对NC和MCI分类最重要，CDR-SB和MMSE共同驱动AD分类。
AI.conclusion: 基于常规临床评估的可解释机器学习模型实现了近乎完美的三分类AD检测，SHAP分析揭示了临床合理的类别特异性特征重要性模式，支持临床有效性。未来将纳入言语生物标志物进行多模态检测。

title: Neural Langevin Machine: a local asymmetric learning rule can be creative
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, with Github link in the paper, supplemental material available upon request
summary: Fixed points of recurrent neural networks can be leveraged to store and generate information. These fixed points can be captured by the Boltzmann-Gibbs measure, which leads to neural Langevin dynamics that can be used to find them for generative learning of a real dataset. We call this type of generative model a neural Langevin machine, which derives an asymmetric and firing-rate-speed adjusted learning rule requiring only local neural signals, thereby bearing biological relevance in terms of local predictive learning. An interesting out-of-equilibrium regime of the generative process is revealed, together with a memorization-to-generalization transition with increasing training data size. The neuro-inspired machine can also realize a continuous exploration of the phase space for different kinds of generative images and can denoise a corrupted image as well.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经朗之万机，一种利用循环神经网络固定点生成模型的生物启发式方法，通过神经朗之万动力学和局部学习规则实现生成学习，并展示了非平衡态、记忆-泛化转变以及图像生成与去噪能力。
AI.motivation: 利用循环神经网络的固定点来存储和生成信息，并借鉴玻尔兹曼-吉布斯测度捕捉固定点，从而发展具有生物相关性的生成学习模型。
AI.method: 通过神经朗之万动力学捕获RNN固定点，推导非对称、放电率速度调整的局部学习规则，构建神经朗之万机（Neural Langevin Machine）。
AI.result: 揭示了生成过程的非平衡态机制；发现了随训练数据量增加从记忆到泛化的转变；该模型能连续探索相空间生成多种图像，并能进行图像去噪。
AI.conclusion: 神经朗之万机是一种生物相关的局部预测学习生成模型，具有非平衡态特性和记忆-泛化转变能力，在图像生成和去噪任务上表现良好。

title: AgenticDiffusion: Agentic Diffusion-based Path Planning for Vision-Based UAV Navigation
summary: Indoor UAV navigation requires efficient exploration, scene understanding, and reliable trajectory execution under limited field-of-view observations. Existing vision-based navigation frameworks typically rely on single-view observations, limiting their ability to reason about occlusions, target visibility, and global scene structure. In this work, we propose AgenticDiffusion, a multi-view UAV navigation framework that coordinates language-guided reasoning, open-vocabulary target grounding, vision-based diffusion planning, and NMPC within a unified aerial navigation pipeline. Given a natural language instruction and synchronized first-person-view (FPV) and top-view observations, the framework determines the most informative viewpoint for navigation and generates a mission plan prior to trajectory execution. The targets are localized using an open-vocabulary grounding model, after which viewpoint-specific diffusion planners generate navigation trajectories for UAV execution. Using complementary viewpoints, the proposed framework reduces repeated target exploration and improves navigation efficiency in cluttered indoor environments. The framework was validated in four real-world UAV navigation scenarios involving adaptive viewpoint selection, multi-stage mission execution, long-horizon navigation, and safe landing-site selection. The experimental results demonstrated an overall mission success rate of 80% in 40 real-world trials, while the diffusion planners achieved a trajectory generation success rate of 100%.

AI.tldr: 提出AgenticDiffusion框架，利用多视角（FPV+俯视）观测、语言引导推理、开放词汇目标定位、扩散规划和NMPC控制，实现室内无人机自主导航，在40次真实实验中达到80%任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的无人机导航框架通常依赖单视角观测，难以推理遮挡、目标可见性和全局场景结构，导致室内导航效率低下。
AI.method: 将自然语言指令与FPV和俯视双视角观测结合，通过开放词汇模型定位目标，利用视角特定的扩散规划器生成轨迹，最后由NMPC执行。
AI.result: 在40次真实世界实验中，整体任务成功率达80%，扩散规划器轨迹生成成功率达100%。
AI.conclusion: 多视角互补观测能有效减少重复目标探索，提高室内杂乱环境下的导航效率。

title: Weakly Supervised Incremental Segmentation via Semantic Anchors and Spatial Arbitration
summary: Weakly Incremental Learning for Semantic Segmentation (WILSS) suffers from the continuous introduction of noisy supervision, which progressively corrupts class-level representations, leading to severe feature drift and semantic corruption, thereby causing newly learned classes to overwrite old ones. To address these issues, we propose a drift-resilient WILSS approach, named SASA, designed to stabilize semantic learning via Semantic Anchors and Spatial Arbitration. Specifically, at the representation level, we introduce semantic anchors of learnable tokens as rigid class-level references to preserve long-term semantic identity. Complementary to this, an elastic residual adaptation facilitates controlled, instance-specific refinement, ensuring a stable yet flexible learning trajectory. At the supervision level, we develop a Spatial Label Arbitration mechanism that performs geometry-aware decisions to directly filter unreliable signals and enforce a strict "one object, one class" constraint. By synergistically stabilizing representations and improving supervision reliability, SASA effectively mitigates feature drift under weak supervision. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly in challenging multi-step incremental settings. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhonggaiWang/SASA.

AI.tldr: 针对弱增量语义分割（WILSS）中噪声监督导致特征漂移和语义退化的问题，本文提出SASA方法，通过语义锚点（可学习令牌作为刚性类级参考）和弹性残差适应来稳定表示学习，并设计空间标签仲裁机制进行几何感知的监督过滤，有效缓解了弱监督下的特征漂移，在多个标准基准上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: WILSS中连续引入的噪声监督会逐步破坏类别级表征，导致严重的特征漂移和语义退化，使得新学习的类覆盖旧类，现有方法无法有效解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出SASA方法，包含两个核心模块：1) 表示层面：引入语义锚点（可学习令牌作为刚性类级参考）保留长期语义身份，配合弹性残差适应实现可控的实例级精炼；2) 监督层面：设计空间标签仲裁机制，进行几何感知决策以直接过滤不可靠信号，强制执行"一个物体，一个类别"约束。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，SASA方法在多个增量步骤设置下持续优于现有最先进方法，尤其在具有挑战性的多步增量设置中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同稳定表示和提升监督可靠性，SASA有效缓解了弱监督下的特征漂移问题，为弱增量语义分割提供了一种漂移鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Novel Aspects of IEEE SA P3109 Arithmetic Formats for Machine Learning
summary: The IEEE P3109 draft standard defines a parameterized family of binary floating-point formats and associated operations, with a focus on facilitating machine learning. These formats allow efficient and consistent representation of values in a small number of bits. The defined formats are parameterized over width and precision in bits, signedness, and the presence of infinities. Operations are defined by decoding floating-point values to the set of closed extended reals: the reals augmented with positive and negative infinity and NaN (Not a Number). Explicit treatment of NaN and infinite operands ensures that only real arithmetic is invoked in operation definitions. Extensive rounding and saturation modes are defined; stochastic rounding is included. Operations are exception-free, accelerating throughput, with exceptional situations communicated through return values, e.g., NaN. Operations on blocks of values sharing a common scale factor are defined in terms of the underlying operations in a uniform manner. System vendors may describe approximate implementations via a novel scale-invariant measure, akin to units in the last place, called kappa-approximation. Standard function definitions and various other properties are mechanically verified and generated using formal specifications.

AI.tldr: IEEE P3109草案标准定义了面向机器学习参数化的二进制浮点格式族，支持宽度、精度、符号性和无穷存在性参数化，采用闭扩展实数解码方法，定义了丰富的舍入与饱和模式（包括随机舍入），通过返回值传递异常实现无异常运算，并引入尺度不变的κ近似衡量指标用于近似实现描述，所有标准函数定义均经过形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 为机器学习应用提供高效、一致的小比特数浮点表示，填补标准格式在机器学习场景下的空白。
AI.method: 将浮点值解码为闭扩展实数集（实数+正负无穷+NaN），使仅实数算术参与运算定义；定义多种舍入与饱和模式（含随机舍入）；采用无异常架构，通过返回值（如NaN）传递异常；引入κ近似作为尺度不变的近似度量；利用形式化规约进行机械验证。
AI.result: 定义了参数化的二进制浮点格式族及其运算，支持块级缩放运算，实现了无异常加速，并提供了形式化验证的标准函数定义。
AI.conclusion: 该标准为机器学习场景提供了灵活、高效且经过形式化验证的浮点算术体系，兼顾了表示效率与运算一致性。

title: Competition, stability, and functionality in excitatory-inhibitory neural circuits
summary: Energy-based models have become a central paradigm for understanding computation and stability in both theoretical neuroscience and machine learning. However, the energetic framework typically relies on symmetry in synaptic or weight matrices - a constraint that excludes biologically realistic systems such as excitatory-inhibitory (E-I) networks. When symmetry is relaxed, the classical notion of a global energy landscape fails, leaving the dynamics of asymmetric neural systems conceptually unanchored. In this work, we extend the energetic framework to asymmetric firing rate networks, revealing an underlying game-theoretic structure for the neural dynamics in which each neuron is an agent that seeks to minimize its own energy. In addition, we exploit rigorous stability principles from network theory to study regulation and balancing of neural activity in E-I networks. We combine the novel game-energetic interpretation and the stability results to revisit standard frameworks in theoretical neuroscience, such as the Wilson-Cowan and lateral inhibition models. These insights allow us to study cortical columns of lateral inhibition microcircuits as contrast enhancer - with the ability to selectively sharpen subtle differences in the environment through hierarchical excitation-inhibition interplay. Our results bridge energetic and game-theoretic views of neural computation, offering a pathway toward the systematic engineering of biologically grounded, dynamically stable neural architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文将能量模型扩展到非对称神经环路（如兴奋-抑制网络），揭示了神经动力学的博弈论结构（每个神经元作为最小化自身能量的智能体），并结合网络稳定性理论重新审视了Wilson-Cowan和侧向抑制等经典模型，证明了侧抑制微环路可作为对比度增强器，为生物启发的动态稳定神经架构提供了系统性设计路径。
AI.motivation: 传统能量模型依赖权重矩阵对称性，无法适用于生物真实的兴奋-抑制（E-I）非对称网络。本文旨在为非对称神经动力学建立统一的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出博弈-能量（game-energetic）框架，将每个神经元视为最小化自身能量的博弈智能体；结合网络理论的稳定性原理分析E-I网络的调节与平衡；整合经典模型（Wilson-Cowan、侧向抑制）进行验证。
AI.result: 揭示了非对称神经动力学的博弈论结构；证明了侧向抑制微环路通过层级兴奋-抑制交互实现对比度增强（选择性锐化细微差异）；建立了能量模型与博弈论视角的桥梁。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为设计生物合理、动态稳定的神经架构提供了理论支撑，弥合了能量模型与博弈论对神经计算理解的差距。

title: Agentic AI and Pedagogical Best Practice: The Tension Between Automation and Learning
comment: Accepted for publication at AIED 2026 - Festival of Learning HAI-Agency Workshop on Orchestrating Human and AI Agency for Proactive and Reflective Learning
summary: Artificial intelligence in education is evolving from passive chatbots to proactive AI agents capable of initiation and goal-directed interactions. While offering opportunities for personalised learning, this shift risks undermining learner agency and cognitive effort. This paper reviews six pedagogical principles-prior knowledge activation, collaborative learning, problem-based learning, formative assessment, scaffolding, and metacognition-through the lens of agentic AI. We discuss the tension between automation and learning, proposing design recommendations that prioritise intentional friction, dynamic scaffolding, human-in-the-loop oversight, and considered AI utilisation to ensure AI supports rather than supplants human learning.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI在教育中从被动聊天机器人向主动智能体的转变，以及这种转变对学习者自主性和认知努力的潜在风险。通过六项教学原则的视角，提出了有意图的摩擦、动态脚手架、人在回路监督等设计建议，以确保AI辅助而非替代人类学习。
AI.motivation: AI从被动工具转向主动智能体虽能提供个性化学习机会，但可能削弱学习者的自主性和认知努力，需要在自动化与学习效果之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 以六项教学原则（先前知识激活、协作学习、问题导向学习、形成性评估、脚手架、元认知）为框架，审视主动性AI对学习的影响，并提出设计建议。
AI.result: 识别出自动化与学习之间的张力，提出了四项设计建议：有意图的摩擦、动态脚手架、人在回路监督、审慎的AI利用。
AI.conclusion: AI应支持而非取代人类学习，设计上需优先考虑学习者的认知投入和自主性。

title: Position: Deployed Reinforcement Learning should be Continual
comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Position Paper Track. See https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/67195
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has received increasing attention and adoption in real-world use cases. Most of these systems follow a train-then-fix paradigm, where trained agents do not learn while interacting with the world until performance degrades and retraining becomes necessary. In this position paper, we argue that deploying an agent that is incapable of optimality, but receives an evaluative reward signal, is inherently a continual RL problem. We identify four sources of non-stationarity after deployment that necessitate never-ending learning, and highlight why the best deployed agents never stop adapting. We analyze successful examples of continual RL in the real world, and present the community with the advantages and measures to move away from the current train-then-fix paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文主张部署后无法达到最优但能接收评估性奖励信号的智能体本质上是持续强化学习问题，识别了部署后导致非平稳性的四个来源，并通过真实世界成功案例论证了从"训练-修复"范式转向持续学习的必要性。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数强化学习系统采用"训练-修复"范式，部署后的智能体无法在交互中持续学习，直到性能下降才重新训练。作者认为这种范式存在根本性缺陷，需要转向持续学习。
AI.method: 本文是立场论文，通过理论分析识别部署后四个非平稳性来源，并结合真实世界持续RL成功案例进行论证。
AI.result: 识别了部署后非平稳性的四个来源，展示了持续RL在真实世界中的成功范例，提出了脱离"训练-修复"范式的优势与衡量指标。
AI.conclusion: 最佳部署的智能体永远不会停止适应，社区应转向持续学习范式以取代当前的"训练-修复"模式。

title: Cognitive Field Theory of Learning, Inference, and Emergence
summary: Learning, inference, memory, and emergence in biological and artificial systems are often described using disparate theoretical frameworks. Here we develop a cognitive field theory in which cognition emerges as a collective nonequilibrium phenomenon governed by the infrared organization of adaptive dynamical time scales. Starting from a stochastic cognitive-field equation with homeostatic stabilization and adaptive manifold geometry, we show that cognitive dynamics is organized by slowly relaxing infrared modes embedded within a high-dimensional cognitive manifold. The resulting dynamics may be interpreted in terms of a macroscopic cognitive state continuously coupled to hierarchically organized slow-memory sectors. Integrating out these latent sectors generates retarded self-energy feedback and nonlocal memory kernels that soften the infrared response of the cognitive field. The resulting susceptibility enhancement produces a protected near-critical regime characterized by long-time contextual persistence and coherent collective dynamics. We introduce the time-scale density of states (TDOS) as a fundamental descriptor of the relaxation spectrum underlying inference, memory, and adaptive reasoning. Learning continuously reorganizes the infrared TDOS, selectively stabilizing weakly damped sectors that support contextual organization and recursive memory feedback. Near criticality, the TDOS generically develops a broad and nearly flat infrared structure associated with the accumulation of slowly relaxing modes. The resulting memory self-energy suppresses the effective forgetting gap, enhances collective susceptibility, and generates scale-free temporal organization over extended time scales. Within this framework, memory formation, adaptive reasoning, and emergent intelligence arise as hierarchical stages of infrared collective dynamical organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出认知场论（Cognitive Field Theory），将认知视为由自适应动力学时间尺度的红外组织所支配的集体非平衡现象。通过随机认知场方程、稳态稳定化和自适应流形几何，证明认知动力学由嵌入高维认知流形中的缓慢松弛红外模式组织。引入时间尺度态密度（TDOS）作为推理、记忆和自适应推理的基本描述符，发现近临界状态下TDOS产生宽而平坦的红外结构，抑制有效遗忘间隙，增强集体敏感性，产生无标度时间组织。记忆形成、自适应推理和涌现智能是红外集体动力学的层次化阶段。
AI.motivation: 生物和人工系统中的学习、推理、记忆和涌现现象通常使用不同的理论框架描述，缺乏统一的数学基础来理解这些认知过程的共同本质。
AI.method: 构建随机认知场方程，结合稳态稳定化和自适应流形几何；通过积分出潜在慢记忆扇区生成延迟自能反馈和非局部记忆核；引入时间尺度态密度（TDOS）作为松弛谱的描述符。
AI.result: 认知动力学由缓慢松弛的红外模式组织；近临界状态下TDOS呈现宽而平坦的红外结构；自能反馈抑制有效遗忘间隙，增强集体敏感性，产生无标度时间组织。
AI.conclusion: 记忆形成、自适应推理和涌现智能是红外集体动力学组织层次化阶段的结果，该框架统一了生物和人工系统中的认知现象描述。

title: Characterizing Online Criticism of Partisan News Media Using Weakly Supervised Learning
summary: We propose novel methods to identify tweets that criticize partisan news sources. Prior work suggests that criticism, ridicule, and distrust of news media all play important roles in hyperpartisanship, misinformation, and filter bubble formation. Thus, understanding the prevalence and temporal dynamics of media-targeted criticism can provide us with updated tools to assess the health of the information ecosystem. There is a scarcity of labeled data for this task, and we develop a weakly supervised learning approach that leverages multiple noisy labeling functions based on both the content of the tweet as well as the historical news sharing behavior of the user. Using this classifier, we explore how tweets expressing criticism vary by user, news source, and time, finding substantial spikes in media criticism during politically polarizing events, such as the investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 U.S.~elections and the 2017 ``unite the right'' rally in Charlottesville. This type of media-targeting criticism is also more likely to occur after users have been exposed to unreliable and hyperpartisan media.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种弱监督学习方法，用于识别批评党派新闻媒体的推文，并发现媒体批评在政治极化事件期间显著增加，且用户接触不可靠和超党派媒体后更容易发表此类批评。
AI.motivation: 对新闻媒体的批评、嘲讽和不信任在超党派倾向、错误信息和过滤气泡形成中扮演重要角色，但缺乏标注数据来大规模识别和理解这类媒体批评言论的流行程度和时态动态，因此需要开发有效方法。
AI.method: 采用弱监督学习方法，利用基于推文内容和用户历史新闻分享行为的多种噪声标注函数来训练分类器，以识别批评党派新闻媒体的推文。
AI.result: 发现媒体批评在政治极化事件（如2016年美国大选"通俄门"调查和2017年夏洛茨维尔"团结右翼"集会）期间出现显著峰值；用户接触不可靠和超党派媒体后更倾向于发表针对媒体的批评。
AI.conclusion: 媒体批评的时态动态与政治极化事件高度相关，且与用户先前的媒体消费模式有关，这为评估信息生态系统健康度提供了新工具。

title: Synthetic Personalities: How Well Can LLMs Mimic Individual Respondents Using Socio-Economic Microdata?
summary: LLM-based digital twins promise to scale and accelerate market research, but most published twins are either coarse persona bots conditioned on a few demographic questions or detailed individual-level twins built on purpose-collected surveys and interview transcripts. Neither setup speaks to the operationally most relevant case for marketing practice: building detailed individual twins from the pre-existing heterogeneous panel data that firms already accumulate through CRM systems, loyalty programs, and repeat surveys. We construct detailed individual-level twins from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) and evaluate them across a $3 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2$ construction-method grid that covers three open-weights LLMs, five cumulative information depths ranked by normalized Shannon entropy, two embedding methods, and two reasoning modes, scoring over 2.1 million twin responses on 500 participants and 183 held-out questions. Twin quality rises with information depth but with diminishing returns past the 75 percent entropy quartile, which acts as a cost-efficient Pareto point relative to the best-performing 100 percent cells. Switching the embedding from a narrative persona summary to a raw dialog history of past responses raises hold-out accuracy in every model-by-reasoning cell at the 100 percent depth, while an explicit thinking mode raises rank-order correlation without moving accuracy. Best-cell accuracy reaches 78.8 percent and Fisher-$z$ correlation reaches $r = 0.590$ on the SOEP held-out evaluation set. The findings suggest that twin-based market research is no longer gated by data design, but by item volume, model selection, and a small set of construction-level decisions that this paper now maps.

AI.tldr: 本文基于德国SOEP面板数据，构建了精细化的个体级数字孪生，在3×5×2×2的构造方法网格上评估超过210万条孪生响应，发现信息深度在75%熵分位数处达到成本效益帕累托最优，原始对话历史嵌入优于叙事摘要，显式推理模式提升秩相关但不提升准确率，最佳单元准确率达78.8%，Fisher-z相关r=0.590。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的数字孪生要么是粗粒度的人格机器人（仅依赖少数人口统计问题），要么是基于专门收集的调查和访谈构建的精细个体孪生，但两者均不适用于企业营销实践中最具操作相关性的场景：即利用企业通过CRM系统、忠诚度计划和重复调查已积累的、异质性面板数据来构建精细个体孪生。
AI.method: 从德国社会经济面板（SOEP）构建精细个体级数字孪生，在3×5×2×2的构造方法网格上评估：3种开源LLM、5种基于归一化香农熵的累积信息深度、2种嵌入方法（叙事人物摘要 vs. 原始对话历史）、2种推理模式（显式推理 vs. 非显式），总共对500名参与者的183个保留问题进行评分，覆盖超过210万条孪生响应。
AI.result: 孪生质量随信息深度提升但边际收益递减，75%熵分位数是最佳成本效益帕累托点；在所有模型×推理单元中，100%深度下原始对话历史嵌入均优于叙事摘要嵌入；显式推理模式提升秩相关但不提升准确率；最佳单元准确率达78.8%，Fisher-z相关r=0.590。
AI.conclusion: 基于孪生的市场研究不再受限于数据设计，而是受限于题项数量、模型选择以及一组本文已映射的构造层面决策。

title: Optimal Transport Flow Matching by Design
summary: Flow matching models learn to transport samples from a simple prior distribution to a complex data distribution. When prior-data pairs are coupled via optimal transport (OT), the learned trajectories are straight and non-crossing, enabling fast, even single-step, generation. However, computing the OT coupling in high dimensions is intractable, and existing methods attempt to solve the OT problem, at the cost of persistent bias or significant overhead. Rather than solving for the OT coupling, we reformulate the problem. Once the prior is treated as a design choice rather than a fixed input, the OT coupling between prior and data is no longer unique. Many priors admit an OT-optimal identity coupling to the data, leaving us free to choose one that is also tractable to sample. We identify low-frequency projection of natural images as such a choice. The identity coupling between data and its low-frequency representation is empirically OT-optimal, the prior is structured enough to be sampled by a lightweight model at inference, and the remaining flow-matching task reduces to synthesizing high-frequency detail. Interpolating the prior with Gaussian noise further improves generation quality while preserving the OT coupling. The approach requires no modifications to the flow model itself, and integrates naturally with latent-space models, classifier-free guidance, and one-step generation frameworks. Across all benchmarks, our method reduces trajectory curvature by more than $2\times$ compared to existing flow matching methods, yielding better generation quality in the few-step regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将流匹配模型中的先验分布作为设计选择，利用数据与其低频投影之间的最优传输恒等耦合，使学习轨迹更直、曲率降低2倍以上，实现少步甚至单步高质量生成，无需修改流模型本身，且兼容潜在空间模型、无分类器引导和单步生成框架。
AI.motivation: 现有的流匹配模型依赖最优传输(OT)耦合来实现直线、不交叉的轨迹，从而支持快速（甚至单步）生成。然而，在高维空间中计算OT耦合是难以处理的，现有方法在求解OT问题时要么存在持续偏差，要么带来显著的计算开销。
AI.method: 将先验视为设计选择而非固定输入，利用数据与其低频投影之间的恒等耦合（经验证明是OT最优的）；采用轻量模型在推理时采样结构化的低频先验；剩余流匹配任务简化为合成高频细节；并通过与高斯噪声插值来保持OT耦合的同时提升生成质量。
AI.result: 在所有基准测试中，该方法将轨迹曲率相比现有流匹配方法降低了2倍以上，在少步生成场景下取得了更好的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过重新定义先验分布而非求解OT问题，可以更高效地实现近似直线轨迹的流匹配，该方法无需修改流模型本身，且能自然集成到潜在空间模型、无分类器引导和单步生成框架中。

title: Pseudospectral Bounds for Transient Amplification in Coupled Gradient Descent
comment: 11 pages, 3 tables. Accepted as poster at HiLD 2026 (4th Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics, ICML 2026)
summary: Coupled gradient descent--where the update of one parameter block depends on another--underlies bilevel optimization, two-time-scale stochastic approximation, and adversarial training. When the coupled Jacobian is block-triangular, asymptotic stability is governed by the spectral radii of the diagonal blocks, yet transient amplification before convergence can be arbitrarily large due to non-normality. We develop a sharp pseudospectral theory for such block-triangular Jacobians, proving that the Kreiss constant satisfies $K(J) \leq 2/(1-γ) + \|C\|/(4(1-γ))$ when the diagonal blocks are symmetric with spectral radii at most $γ< 1$, and we establish matching minimax lower bounds. We characterize the critical coupling threshold for spectral instability and extend the analysis to nearly self-referential systems via a Neumann-series perturbation framework. As a consequence, we obtain a finite-horizon iteration-complexity bound of $O(K(J)^2 \log(1/δ))$ for stochastic coupled descent. Framed as scaling laws for non-stationary two-time-scale optimization, our results expose a non-asymptotic, instance-dependent regime of high-dimensional learning dynamics that is invisible to spectral-radius analysis. Experiments on linear-quadratic problems, IQC-based comparisons, and neural-network training confirm the theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了耦合梯度下降中块三角雅可比矩阵的非正态性导致的瞬态放大问题，提出了尖锐的伪谱理论，给出了Kreiss常数的上界与匹配的极小极大下界，推导了随机耦合下降的有限步迭代复杂度，并通过实验验证了理论。
AI.motivation: 耦合梯度下降（如双层优化、两时间尺度随机逼近、对抗训练）中的块三角雅可比矩阵虽渐近稳定（谱半径<1），但非正态性可导致收敛前任意大的瞬态放大，传统谱半径分析无法刻画这一现象，亟需非渐近理论。
AI.method: 发展块三角雅可比矩阵的尖锐伪谱理论：证明对角块对称且谱半径≤γ<1时Kreiss常数K(J)的上界；建立匹配的极小极大下界；刻画耦合导致谱不稳定的临界阈值；通过Neumann级数扰动框架将分析推广到近似自指系统；导出随机耦合下降的O(K(J)^2 log(1/δ))有限步迭代复杂度。
AI.result: 获得了块三角雅可比矩阵Kreiss常数的显式上界与匹配下界；确定了谱不稳定的耦合临界阈值；得到了有限步迭代复杂度界；在LQR问题、IQC比较和神经网络训练中验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 伪谱理论揭示了谱半径分析无法捕捉的非渐近、实例依赖的高维学习动力学缩放律，为耦合优化算法的行为提供了更精细的理论刻画。

title: Intrinsic Brain Networks Underlying the Experience and Expression of Subclinical Anxiety
summary: Anxiety includes behavioural, physiological, and subjective components that do not always align, and it remains unclear whether these dimensions are supported by distinct intrinsic brain networks. Guided by the two-system framework, we tested whether resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) differentiates these components in subclinical anxiety. Forty-seven young adults spanning a range of subclinical anxiety levels completed a threat anticipation task measuring behavioral responses (reaction time) and physiological arousal (skin conductance), along with the NIH Fear-Affect self-report of anxiety severity. These measures were related to rsFC using region-of-interest analyses. Higher subclinical anxiety was associated with faster responses under temporally uncertain threat, consistent with increased vigilance, while no association was found with physiological arousal. At the neural level, three connectivity patterns emerged and remained significant after sequential family-wise error correction. Behavioural responses modulated by subclinical anxiety were linked to stronger connectivity between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and insula. Physiological modulation was associated with connectivity between the ACC and orbitofrontal cortex (OFC). Subjective anxiety was associated with increased connectivity between the hippocampus and insula. Additional connections were observed but did not survive stricter correction. Overall, the findings indicate that behavioural, physiological, and subjective aspects of subclinical anxiety map onto partially dissociable but overlapping intrinsic brain networks, extending prior task-based results to resting-state connectivity and informing future work on early neural markers of anxiety.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于双系统框架，考察了亚临床焦虑的行为、生理和主观成分是否由不同的静息态功能连接网络支持。结果显示，三个成分与部分可分离的脑网络连接模式相关：行为反应与ACC-脑岛连接增强相关，生理反应与ACC-眶额皮质连接相关，主观焦虑与海马-脑岛连接增强相关，为焦虑的多维度神经基础提供了静息态证据。
AI.motivation: 焦虑包含行为、生理和主观三个维度，但这些维度是否对应不同的内在脑网络尚不清楚。本研究旨在利用静息态功能连接区分亚临床焦虑中的这些成分。
AI.method: 47名亚临床焦虑水平的年轻成人完成威胁预期任务，测量行为反应（反应时）和生理唤醒（皮肤电导），同时采用NIH恐惧-情感量表测量主观焦虑严重程度。通过感兴趣区分析将这些指标与静息态功能连接相关联。
AI.result: 亚临床焦虑水平越高，在时间不确定威胁下反应越快（警觉性增强），但与生理唤醒无关。脑网络层面发现三种连接模式：行为调节与ACC-脑岛连接增强相关，生理调节与ACC-眶额皮质连接相关，主观焦虑与海马-脑岛连接增强相关，且均通过序列族系误差校正。
AI.conclusion: 亚临床焦虑的行为、生理和主观成分映射到部分可分离但重叠的内在脑网络上，将先前的任务态研究结果拓展至静息态连接，为未来焦虑早期神经标记物的研究提供了依据。

title: Forecasting Political News Engagement on Social Media
summary: Understanding how political news consumption changes over time can provide insights into issues such as hyperpartisanship, filter bubbles, and misinformation. To investigate long-term trends of news consumption, we curate a collection of over 60M tweets from politically engaged users over seven years, annotating ~10% with mentions of news outlets and their political leaning. We then train a neural network to forecast the political lean of news articles Twitter users will engage with, considering both past news engagements as well as tweet content. Using the learned representation of this model, we cluster users to discover salient patterns of long-term news engagement. Our findings include the following: (1) hyperpartisan users are more engaged with news; (2) right-leaning users engage with contra-partisan sources more than left-leaning users; (3) topics such as immigration, COVID-19, Islamaphobia, and gun control are salient indicators of engagement with low quality news sources.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于7年间超过6000万条推文数据，通过神经网络预测用户新闻偏好的政治倾向，发现：超党派用户新闻参与度更高；右倾用户比左倾用户更常接触对立阵营新闻源；移民、新冠、伊斯兰恐惧症、枪支管控等话题是低质量新闻参与度的显著指标。
AI.motivation: 探究政治新闻消费随时间变化的长期趋势，以深入理解超党派现象、过滤气泡和 misinformation 等问题。
AI.method: 收集7年间政治活跃用户的6000万+推文，标注约10%的新闻机构提及及其政治倾向；训练神经网络模型，结合历史新闻参与和推文内容预测用户将参与新闻的政治倾向；利用模型学习的表征对用户进行聚类，发现长期新闻参与模式。
AI.result: (1) 超党派用户新闻参与度更高；(2) 右倾用户比左倾用户更常参与对立阵营新闻源；(3) 移民、COVID-19、伊斯兰恐惧症、枪支管控等话题是低质量新闻参与的显著指标。
AI.conclusion: 长期新闻消费模式存在不对称性：右倾用户更倾向于跨阵营消费，而超党派用户参与度最高；特定话题与低质量新闻消费高度相关。

title: Selecting haptic guidance models in teleoperation: guidelines from a comparative user study
comment: EUROHAPTICS 2026 - EuroHaptics International Conference, Jul 2026, Sienna, Italy
summary: Haptic guidance in teleoperation enhances operator performance through force feedback. This paper presents guidelines to select the most appropriate model considering the task, the environment and the operator. We define a unified formulation expressing most common models (spring-damper, potential field, and guiding tube) as variations of a stiffness-damping system with model-specific guiding functions. We conducted a user study comparing the three classical models across six scenarios with varying environmental conditions in a vertical farming task. Results show no universally superior model: spring-damper excels in cluttered environments, potential field in free spaces (but it shows risks near obstacles), and guiding tube offers a balanced compromise. We propose novel objective metrics to evaluate the interaction, and show that guiding force magnitude correlates with comfort and trust scores. These findings provide practical model selection guidelines through environmental characteristics and real-time evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对遥操作中的触觉引导模型，提出了基于任务、环境和操作者的统一公式化表达，通过用户实验比较了弹簧-阻尼、势场和引导管三种经典模型在垂直农业场景下的表现，发现无普遍最优模型，并提供了根据环境特性选择模型的实用指南。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉引导模型众多，缺乏系统性的选择指南，实际操作者难以根据具体任务、环境和操作者特性选择最合适的模型。
AI.method: 提出统一公式将三种经典模型（弹簧-阻尼、势场、引导管）表达为刚度-阻尼系统的变体；在垂直农业任务中设计六种环境场景进行用户实验，并引入新的客观交互评价指标。
AI.result: 弹簧-阻尼模型在杂乱环境中表现最优，势场模型在自由空间中表现最佳但靠近障碍物时存在风险，引导管模型提供平衡的折衷方案；引导力大小与舒适度和信任评分相关。
AI.conclusion: 不存在普遍最优的触觉引导模型，应根据环境特性选择；所提出的客观指标可实时评估交互质量，为模型选择提供实用指导。

title: When Seeing Is Not Believing -- A Benchmark for Search-Grounded Video Misinformation Detection
summary: Video misinformation increasingly operates at the semantic and evidential level: authentic footage may be selectively edited, temporally reordered, spliced across sources, or augmented with AI-generated content to construct false narratives. Such evidence-dependent manipulations cannot be reliably verified from the input video alone, because the missing, reordered, replaced, or recontextualized evidence lies outside the video itself. We introduce \textbf{EVID-Bench}, a benchmark for search-grounded video misinformation detection, where a system must search the open web for related videos and identify what information is false through cross-video comparison. EVID-Bench comprises 222 videos spanning 9 manipulation types across 3 categories: AI generation, single-source editing, and multi-source editing. All samples are verified to be undetectable by frontier models through visual inspection alone. We evaluate nine frontier multimodal models using a retrieval-augmented verification baseline. The best system achieves only 61.43\% point-level accuracy and 43.24\% video-level accuracy, while AI-generated manipulations remain especially challenging. Error analysis reveals recurring challenges: models fixate on irrelevant anchors, misattribute synthetic content to editorial splicing, and terminate search prematurely before fully explaining the manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVID-Bench基准，用于评估基于网络搜索的虚假视频检测。该基准包含222个视频、9种篡改类型，所有样本均无法通过纯视觉检测识别。最佳系统在点级准确率仅61.43%，视频级准确率43.24%，AI生成内容检测最具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚假信息检测方法主要依赖输入视频本身的视觉特征，但现代视频篡改（如选择性编辑、时间重排、跨源拼接、AI生成内容）往往在语义和证据层面操作，缺失或重构的证据位于视频外部，无法通过纯视觉分析可靠验证。因此需要一种能够搜索开放网络相关视频并进行跨视频对比的检测方法。
AI.method: 构建EVID-Bench基准，包含222个跨越9种篡改类型（分为AI生成、单源编辑、多源编辑三大类）的视频样本。所有样本均经过验证，前沿模型仅凭视觉检查无法检测。采用检索增强验证基线，评估9个前沿多模态模型。
AI.result: 最佳系统点级准确率61.43%，视频级准确率43.24%。AI生成内容的检测最为困难。错误分析显示模型存在三大问题：关注无关锚点、将合成内容错误归因于编辑拼接、过早终止搜索导致无法完整解释篡改。
AI.conclusion: 现有前沿多模态模型在基于搜索的视频虚假信息检测任务上表现有限，尤其是面对AI生成内容时。跨视频搜索与对比验证是解决证据依赖型视频篡改检测的关键方向，但当前系统在搜索策略和证据整合方面存在显著不足。

title: Do Transformers Need Three Projections? Systematic Study of QKV Variants
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (PMLR vol. 306). 26 pages, 12 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/anushamadan02/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections
summary: Transformers have become the standard solution for various AI tasks, with the query, key, and value (QKV) attention formulation playing a central role. However, the individual contribution of these three projections and the impact of omitting some remain poorly understood. We systematically evaluate three projection sharing constraints: a) Q-K=V (shared key-value), b) Q=K-V (shared query-key), and c) Q=K=V (single projection). The last two variants produce symmetric attention maps; to address this, we also explore asymmetric attention via 2D positional encodings. Through experiments spanning synthetic tasks, vision (MNIST, CIFAR, TinyImageNet, anomaly), and language modeling (300M and 1.2B parameter models on 10B tokens), we discovered that our transformers perform on par or occasionally better than the QKV transformer. In language modeling, Q-K=V projection sharing achieves 50% KV cache reduction with only 3.1% perplexity degradation. Crucially, projection sharing is complementary to head sharing (GQA/MQA): combining Q-K=V with GQA-4 yields 87.5% cache reduction, while Q-K=V + MQA achieves 96.9%, enabling practical on-device inference. We show that Q-K=V preserves quality because keys and values can occupy similar representational spaces and attention operates in a low-rank regime, whereas Q=K-V breaks attention directionality. Our results systematically characterize projection sharing as an underexplored instance of weight tying in attention, with direct, quantifiable inference memory benefits, particularly valuable for edge deployment. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/anushamadan02/Do-Transformers-Need-3-Projections

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Transformer中QKV投影共享的三种变体（Q-K=V、Q=K-V、Q=K=V），发现Q-K=V可在保持性能的同时减少50% KV缓存，且与GQA/MQA结合可实现高达96.9%的缓存缩减，适用于边缘设备部署。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer的QKV注意力机制中三个投影的各自贡献及省略部分投影的影响尚不清楚，本文旨在系统探究投影共享对模型性能和推理效率的影响。
AI.method: 提出三种投影共享约束：Q-K=V（共享键值投影）、Q=K-V（共享查询键投影）、Q=K=V（单一投影）；针对后两者产生的对称注意力图，引入2D位置编码实现非对称注意力。在合成任务、视觉任务（MNIST、CIFAR、TinyImageNet、异常检测）和语言建模（300M和1.2B参数模型，10B tokens）上进行了全面实验。
AI.result: Q-K=V变体在语言建模中仅以3.1%的困惑度退化实现50% KV缓存缩减；与GQA-4结合达到87.5%缓存缩减，与MQA结合达到96.9%缓存缩减；Q-K=V整体性能与标准QKV Transformer相当甚至更优。
AI.conclusion: 投影共享是注意力机制中一种被低估的权重绑定方式，可带来可量化的推理内存收益，尤其适用于边缘部署。Q-K=V有效的原因是键和值可共享相似的表示空间且注意力在低秩状态下运行，而Q=K-V破坏了注意力的方向性。

title: Modeling and Interpreting Teamwork Dynamics in Cancer Care Outcome Prediction
summary: Cancer care requires a longitudinal approach in which treatments are planned and delivered over time according to the needs of each individual patient. While prior research has thoroughly explored how clinical and demographic factors, such as comorbidities and age, inform treatment planning, far less attention has been devoted to the delivery phase of care. Yet planning and delivery are both team-based processes that depend on coordinated efforts among multiple healthcare professionals (HCPs). As such, the human factors embedded in these collaborative practices are crucial to optimizing patient outcomes. Despite this importance, the existing literature on human factors in cancer care is limited, and very few studies have investigated how collaboration within care teams evolves over the course of treatment. To fill this gap, this work examine how HCPs' collaboration, captured through electronic health record (EHR) systems, affects cancer patient outcomes, with particular emphasis on teamwork dynamics. We represent EHR-mediated HCP interactions as networks and apply machine learning methods to identify predictive signals of patient survival embedded in these collaborative structures. We further interpret model predictions by pinpointing network characteristics and dynamic patterns associated with particular outcomes. We evaluate our model through robustness analyses to ensure that the findings are stable and not driven by stochastic variation in training. Additionally, our insights align with hypotheses proposed in the medical literature, and our results provide the empirical, data-driven evidence supporting these claims. Overall, our work contributes a practical workflow for leveraging digital traces of collaboration to evaluate and strengthen longitudinal team-based healthcare, offering actionable insights to guide data-informed interventions in healthcare delivery.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用电子健康记录中的协作数据构建网络，应用机器学习方法分析医疗专业人员团队协作动态对癌症患者生存结局的预测信号，并通过稳健性分析和医学文献验证，为纵向团队医疗提供数据驱动的实践工作流。
AI.motivation: 癌症护理需要纵向团队协作，但现有研究主要关注临床和人口因素对治疗规划的影响，忽视了交付阶段中医疗专业人员协作动态对患者结局的作用，且该领域的人因研究十分有限。
AI.method: 将EHR中介的医疗人员交互表示为网络，应用机器学习方法识别协作结构中与患者生存相关的预测信号，并通过网络特征和动态模式分析解释模型预测，同时进行稳健性分析确保结果稳定性。
AI.result: 模型预测与医学文献假设一致，提供了实证数据支持；通过稳健性分析验证了结果的稳定性，非随机变异所致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一种利用数字协作痕迹来评估和加强纵向团队医疗的实用工作流，为医疗交付中的数据驱动干预提供了可操作的见解。

title: Dark Path: An Analysis of the Belt & Road Initiative in El Salvador
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, Cleared for Release on 19 MAY 2026 (DOPSR 26-P-0621)
summary: The Belt & Road Initiative (BRI) is a concerted effort from Ministries under the People's Republic of China (PRC) to diplomatically and economically impose its will upon other nations. El Salvador is a US partner and a beneficiary of foreign investment under the BRI. Recent changes to Salvadoran law do not address the implied risks to the nation's supply-chain and cyber infrastructure. This work addresses the gap by exploring previously limited analysis on BRI activities, its intersection with Salvadoran law, and the national security risks introduced by supply-chain reliance from the BRI. This exploratory study examined a portion of the William & Mary AidData dataset filtered on El Salvador, social media posts, news articles, white papers, and law published by the Legislative Assembly of El Salvador. The analysis suggests that the BRI poses a national security and supply-chain risk to El Salvador through influential-subterfuge, loss of digital sovereignty, which contradicts the State Cybersecurity Agency (ACE) and existing Salvadoran laws. This study provides a foundational understanding and regional context for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了“一带一路”倡议（BRI）对萨尔瓦多在供应链和网络安全方面的国家安全风险，分析了BRI活动与萨尔瓦多法律的冲突，指出BRI通过影响渗透和数字主权丧失对萨尔瓦多构成威胁。
AI.motivation: 萨尔瓦多法律未能解决BRI带来的供应链和网络基础设施风险，现有分析有限，因此需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 采用探索性研究方法，分析了William & Mary AidData数据集（筛选萨尔瓦多相关数据）、社交媒体帖子、新闻文章、白皮书以及萨尔瓦多立法议会发布的法律文件。
AI.result: 分析表明，BRI通过影响渗透和数字主权丧失，对萨尔瓦多构成国家安全和供应链风险，这与萨尔瓦多国家网络安全局（ACE）及现行法律相矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为未来研究提供了基础性理解和区域背景，揭示了BRI在萨尔瓦多的国家安全隐患。

title: Reflection Separation from a Single Image via Joint Latent Diffusion
summary: Single-image reflection separation is highly challenging under extreme conditions like glare or weak reflections. Existing methods often struggle to recover both layers in glare or weak-reflection scenarios because of insufficient information. This paper presents a diffusion model explicitly fine-tuned for this task, leveraging generative diffusion priors for robust separation. Our method simultaneously generates transmission and reflection layers through a unified diffusion model, incorporating a novel cross-layer self-attention mechanism for better feature disentanglement. We further introduce a disjoint sampling strategy to iteratively reduce interference between the layers during diffusion and a latent optimization step with a learned composition function for improved results in complex real-world scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach surpasses state-of-the-art methods on multiple real-world benchmarks. Project page: https://brian90709.github.io/diff-reflection-separation/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的单图像反射分离方法，通过统一扩散模型联合生成透射层和反射层，引入跨层自注意力机制、不连续采样策略和潜在优化步骤，在极端条件下（如眩光、弱反射）超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在极端条件（眩光、弱反射）下难以同时恢复透射层和反射层，因为信息不足导致分离困难。
AI.method: 1) 使用统一扩散模型同时生成透射层和反射层；2) 提出跨层自注意力机制实现更好的特征解耦；3) 引入不连续采样策略（Disjoint Sampling）在扩散过程中迭代减少层间干扰；4) 采用潜在优化步骤，结合学习到的合成函数提升复杂真实场景效果。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界基准数据集上超越了当前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于扩散先验的生成式方法能有效应对极端条件下的单图像反射分离问题，跨层解耦与迭代优化策略是关键。

title: Inverse Critical Experiment Design via Gradient Optimization and a Multigroup Attention-Based Neural Network Architecture
summary:
The validation of advanced nuclear reactor designs and fuel concepts requires critical experiments with high neutronic similarity to the target technology. Neutronic similarity is quantified by the correlation coefficient $c_k$, which captures the shared bias in $k_\text{eff}$ induced by uncertainties in nuclear data. Generally, a $c_k\geq0.9$ is needed for an experiment to be sufficiently similar to a target technology. This work presents a methodology for the inverse design of critical experiments. Deep neural network surrogate modeling and nonparametric gradient optimization are used to generate experiment geometries that maximize $c_k$.
  A deep neural network is trained on OpenMC-calculated sensitivity vectors for grid-based critical experiment geometries. The model architecture combines a U-Net convolutional encoder-decoder with a novel multigroup attention pooling layer, introduced to capture the differing spatial dependencies of sensitivities. Multigroup attention pooling is shown to achieve better performance than traditional pooling, as well as interpretable internal behavior. The differentiability of the surrogate enables gradient-based optimization of the full combinatorial design space, allowing $c_k$ to be maximized by directly changing the material assignment of each position in the geometry grid.
  The method is applied to the validation of the TN-Americas TN-LC transportation cask with HALEU fuel, for which existing critical experiment coverage is limited. The optimization procedure is shown to produce experiment geometries achieving $c_k$ scores of 0.97757, 0.81324, and 0.93276 for three configurations of interest. This approach demonstrates the potential of deep learning and gradient optimization to accelerate the development of advanced nuclear technology.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络代理模型和非参数梯度优化的临界实验逆设计方法，通过最大化中子学相似性系数$c_k$来生成实验几何结构。该方法结合U-Net卷积编码器-解码器和多组注意力池化层，在OpenMC计算的灵敏度向量上训练，成功应用于TN-Americas TN-LC运输容器的验证，对三种配置分别实现了0.97757、0.81324和0.93276的$c_k$分数。
AI.motivation: 先进核反应堆设计和燃料概念的验证需要与目标技术具有高中子学相似性的临界实验，而现有临界实验覆盖范围有限。传统方法难以高效设计出满足$c_k\geq0.9$要求的实验几何结构，亟需新的方法论来加速实验设计过程。
AI.method: 使用OpenMC计算基于网格的临界实验几何的灵敏度向量，训练深度神经网络代理模型。模型架构采用U-Net卷积编码器-解码器结合新型多组注意力池化层，以捕捉不同空间依赖关系的灵敏度。利用代理模型的可微性，通过梯度优化直接改变几何网格中每个位置的材料分配，最大化$c_k$值。
AI.result: 该方法针对TN-Americas TN-LC运输容器（使用HALEU燃料）的三种配置进行了优化，分别实现了0.97757、0.81324和0.93276的$c_k$分数。其中两种配置超过了0.9的相似性阈值，证明了方法的有效性。多组注意力池化相比传统池化方法表现出更优的性能和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了深度学习和梯度优化在加速先进核技术开发中的潜力，为临界实验的逆设计提供了新的方法论框架，有望显著提升核反应堆验证实验的设计效率和质量。

title: Federating Governance: How Community Rules Scale with Mastodon Instances
comment: Accepted to CSCW 2026 at Salt Lake City, Utah, USA
summary: The rise of decentralized social media platforms like Mastodon and Bluesky highlights the challenge of scaling self-governance and moderation. As communities grow, they face new issues that demand increasingly complex governance structures. However, as moderation is mainly volunteer-driven, there is limited formal guidance on how community rules and moderation practices should evolve with growth. This study investigates how moderation scale with Mastodon instances by analyzing community rules across servers of varying sizes. We categorize these rules to identify key governance priorities and find that these priorities are remarkably consistent across instance sizes: rules addressing problematic content, such as harassment, hate speech, and illegal content, dominate regardless of scale. While smaller communities focus on narrower sets of topics, larger servers maintain a more balanced coverage of a broad range of topics. Our analysis of rule formalization reveals that community size strongly predicts rule development. As instances grow, their rules become more extensive and topically diverse, but also exhibit lower readability and linguistic diversity. In contrast, external federation interactions have a limited role, mainly associated with a broader scope of rules without substantially affecting their diversity or form. These findings highlight the relative influence of internal versus external factors, suggesting that local scaling pressures outweigh network-level dynamics in decentralized social media governance. The scaling pattern observed on Mastodon resemble those previously identified on centralized platforms such as Reddit, suggesting that community size imposes fundamental constraints on self-governance that transcend platform architectures

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了Mastodon实例中社区规则如何随规模扩展。通过对不同规模服务器的规则进行分类，发现治理重点具有高度一致性（骚扰、仇恨言论、非法内容等是共同关注点），但大服务器规则更广泛、主题更多样，可读性和语言多样性却更低。内部规模压力对治理的影响远超外部联邦互动，且这种扩展模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似，表明社区规模对自治施加了超越平台架构的根本性约束。
AI.motivation: 去中心化社交媒体平台（如Mastodon、Bluesky）面临着自治与审核规模化的挑战。社区增长带来更复杂的治理需求，但由于审核主要由志愿者驱动，缺乏关于社区规则和审核实践如何随规模演进的正式指导。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索治理如何随Mastodon实例规模扩展。
AI.method: 通过分析不同规模Mastodon服务器的社区规则，对规则进行分类以识别关键治理优先级，并分析规则的形式化程度、主题多样性、可读性和语言多样性，同时考察外部联邦互动的影响。
AI.result: 1) 治理优先级在不同规模实例间高度一致，骚扰、仇恨言论、非法内容等成为核心关注点；2) 小社区关注主题范围较窄，大服务器则更广泛且平衡；3) 社区规模是规则发展的强预测因子，大型实例规则更广泛、主题更多样，但可读性和语言多样性更低；4) 外部联邦互动仅与规则范围有关，对多样性和形式影响有限；5) 这种扩展模式与Reddit等中心化平台相似。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化社交媒体治理中，内部规模压力（本地社区增长）比网络层面的动态（外部联邦互动）更具影响力。社区规模对自治施加了超越平台架构的根本性约束，Mastodon的扩展模式与中心化平台相似，表明规模效应是社区治理的普遍规律。

title: Affordance2Action: Task-Conditioned Scene-level Affordance Grounding for Real-Time Manipulation
summary: Task-conditioned manipulation requires grounding instructions to task-relevant functional parts rather than object categories. This setting is scene-dependent and often one-to-many in cluttered scenes: the same object may afford different interactions across tasks, while a single task may correspond to either one functional region or multiple valid functional regions, depending on the scene layout. Existing affordance datasets and benchmarks remain misaligned with this setting, as they typically focus on grasping or object-level affordances, rely on synthetic scenes, or assume a single instruction-region correspondence. We present Affordance2Action (A2A), a benchmark-centered learning framework for scene-level, task-conditioned part affordance grounding. At its core is A2A-Bench, a manipulation-oriented benchmark that covers both single-region and multi-region instruction correspondences in everyday scenes, with the latter highlighting the ambiguity and diversity of affordance grounding in realistic multi-object environments. To construct it at scale, we build A2A-AffordGen, an agent-assisted annotation pipeline that combines language-model filtering, interactive part segmentation, instance-level mask-out refinement, task-reasoning instruction generation, and human verification. A2A-Bench's supervision further supports diverse downstream applications, with real-time affordance grounding and affordance-conditioned manipulation policies as two representative examples. Experiments show that A2A exposes substantial gaps in generic segmentation, VLM-based grounding, and affordance distillation baselines, while improving task-level localization and providing useful spatial priors for downstream manipulation. All datasets and code will be publicly released to promote open research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Affordance2Action (A2A)，一个面向场景级、任务条件化部件功能接地（part affordance grounding）的基准中心学习框架，包含大规模标注管道A2A-AffordGen和多区域对应基准A2A-Bench，实验揭示现有方法在任务级定位上的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有功能接地数据集与任务条件化操作场景不匹配：它们通常聚焦抓取或物体级功能，依赖合成场景，或假设单一指令-区域对应关系；而现实场景中，同一物体在不同任务下提供不同功能，同一任务也可能对应多个有效功能区域。
AI.method: 构建A2A框架：(1) A2A-AffordGen——智能体辅助标注管道，结合语言模型过滤、交互式部件分割、实例级掩码优化、任务推理指令生成和人工验证；(2) A2A-Bench——面向操作的基准，覆盖单区域和多区域指令对应，反映真实多物体环境中的功能接地模糊性和多样性。
AI.result: 实验表明A2A基准揭示了通用分割、基于VLM的接地和功能蒸馏基线中的显著差距，同时改进了任务级定位并为下游操作提供了有用的空间先验。
AI.conclusion: A2A框架有效推动了场景级任务条件化功能接地研究，数据集和代码将开源以促进开放研究。

title: Self-Distilled Policy Gradient
summary: On-policy self-distillation, where a language model conditions on privileged context to supervise its own generations, is a promising source of dense supervision for sparse-reward reinforcement learning. Actually, it can be instantiated as an auxiliary full-vocabulary student-to-teacher reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence loss. We therefore propose SDPG, a self-distilled policy-gradient framework that combines group-relative verifier advantages with normalized standard deviation, exact full-vocabulary on-policy self-distillation, as well as reference-policy KL regularization. Empirically, SDPG improves stability and performance over RLVR and self-distillation baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/lauyikfung/SDPG.

AI.tldr: SDPG是一个结合自蒸馏、组相对验证器优势和参考策略KL正则化的策略梯度框架，用于改进稀疏奖励强化学习的稳定性和性能。
AI.motivation: 在稀疏奖励强化学习中，语言模型缺乏密集的监督信号，而基于策略的自蒸馏（语言模型以特权上下文为条件监督自己的生成）可以作为一种有前景的密集监督来源。
AI.method: 提出了SDPG框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 组相对验证器优势与归一化标准差；2) 精确的全词汇表在策略自蒸馏（实例化为学生到教师的逆向KL散度损失）；3) 参考策略KL正则化。
AI.result: SDPG在稳定性和性能上均优于RLVR和自蒸馏基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SDPG通过结合自蒸馏和组相对验证器优势，有效提升了策略梯度方法在语言模型强化学习中的表现。

title: Bayes-Sufficient Representations in Supervised Learning
summary: Representation learning is often described as preserving the information in an input that is relevant for prediction. This work asks what relevance means for a fixed supervised decision problem. A representation is defined to be Bayes-sufficient for a joint distribution and loss if some prediction head can use it to implement a Bayes-optimal action rule. This makes the target information loss-dependent. In the almost-surely unique Bayes-action case, the relevant object is a Bayes quotient, which identifies inputs that require the same Bayes-optimal action. A representation is sufficient when it refines this quotient, and Bayes-minimal when it is informationally equivalent to it. The framework connects naturally to property elicitation: zero-one loss requires the Bayes class, squared loss the conditional mean, Brier loss the conditional probability in binary prediction, and log loss or strictly proper scoring rules the predictive distribution. Controlled finite experiments, learned neural bottleneck experiments, and a real-data iNaturalist taxonomic refinement experiment illustrate the distinction between sufficiency, minimality, and retained non-required information. For a fixed supervised problem, the distribution and the loss determine the Bayes action, the Bayes action determines the quotient, and the quotient determines the minimal information required for Bayes-optimal prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了贝叶斯充分性（Bayes-sufficiency）概念，将表示学习中的信息保留与特定监督决策问题中的损失函数联系起来，提出了贝叶斯商（Bayes quotient）作为确定最优预测所需最小信息量的核心对象。
AI.motivation: 在表示学习中，通常说"保留与预测相关的信息"，但"相关"的含义缺乏严格的形式化定义。本文旨在为固定监督决策问题中"相关性"的含义提供一个严谨的数学框架。
AI.method: 定义了贝叶斯充分表示：存在预测头可基于该表示实现贝叶斯最优决策规则。引入了贝叶斯商的概念——在几乎必然唯一的贝叶斯动作下，将需要相同最优动作的输入归为同一等价类。表示充分当且仅当它细化该商，贝叶斯最小当且仅当它与商信息等价。该框架与属性引出理论（property elicitation）建立了自然联系。
AI.result: 通过理论分析阐明了不同损失函数对应的贝叶斯充分信息：零一损失需要贝叶斯类，平方损失需要条件均值，Brier损失需要二分类条件概率，对数损失或严格适当评分规则需要完整预测分布。通过控制实验、神经瓶颈实验和iNaturalist数据实验，展示了充分性、最小性与保留非必要信息之间的区别。
AI.conclusion: 对于固定监督问题，分布和损失决定贝叶斯动作，贝叶斯动作决定商，商决定贝叶斯最优预测所需的最小信息量。这为理解表示学习中的信息压缩提供了理论基础。

title: Associating Healthcare Teamwork with Patient Outcomes for Predictive Analysis
summary: Cancer treatment outcomes are influenced not only by clinical and demographic factors but also by the collaboration of healthcare teams. However, prior work has largely overlooked the potential role of human collaboration in shaping patient survival. This paper presents an applied AI approach to uncovering the impact of healthcare professionals' (HCPs) collaboration, captured through electronic health record (EHR) systems, on cancer patient outcomes. We model EHR-mediated HCP interactions as networks and apply machine learning techniques to detect predictive signals of patient survival embedded in these collaborations. Our models are cross validated to ensure generalizability, and we explain the predictions by identifying key network traits associated with improved outcomes. Importantly, clinical experts and literature validate the relevance of the identified crucial collaboration traits, reinforcing their potential for real-world applications. This work contributes to a practical workflow for leveraging digital traces of collaboration and AI to assess and improve team-based healthcare. The approach is potentially transferable to other domains involving complex collaboration and offers actionable insights to support data-informed interventions in healthcare delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种应用AI方法，通过电子健康记录系统捕获的医疗专业人员协作网络，揭示其对癌症患者生存率的影响。研究使用机器学习技术从协作网络中检测预测信号，并通过交叉验证确保泛化能力，最终识别出与改善患者预后相关的关键网络特征。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多关注临床和人口统计学因素对癌症治疗结果的影响，而忽视了医疗团队协作的潜在作用。作者旨在填补这一空白，探索人类协作模式对患者生存率的量化影响。
AI.method: 将EHR中介的医疗专业人员交互建模为协作网络，应用机器学习技术从网络中提取与患者生存相关的预测信号，并通过交叉验证确保模型泛化性。使用可解释性方法识别关键网络特征，并由临床专家和文献验证其相关性。
AI.result: 模型成功检测到嵌入在医疗专业人员协作网络中的患者生存预测信号，识别出与改善预后相关的关键网络特征，且这些特征得到了临床专家和文献的验证。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一种利用协作数字痕迹和AI评估及改善团队医疗的实用工作流程，该方法可推广至其他涉及复杂协作的领域，并为数据驱动的医疗干预提供 actionable 见解。

title: Unlocking Feature Learning in Gated Delta Networks at Scale
summary: Training and scaling Large Language Models demand enormous computational resources, motivating both efficient sub-quadratic architectures and principled hyperparameter tuning methods. While the Maximal Update Parametrization ($μ$P) has enabled zero-shot hyperparameter transfer for standard Transformers, its extension to linear models, particularly those with structured state transitions and complicated architectures, remains largely unexplored. By rigorously propagating coordinate-size estimates through the forward pass, gating mechanisms, and recurrent state dynamics, we derive the scaling rules for Gated Delta Network. Experiments on language-model pre-training confirm that our configurations enable stable learning-rate transfer across model widths under both AdamW and SGD, whereas standard parametrization fails to transfer, validating the correctness and practical utility of our analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过严格推导坐标尺寸估计在门控Delta网络的前向传播、门控机制和循环状态动力学中的传播规律，建立了该架构的缩放规则，使得学习率在不同模型宽度下能够稳定迁移，而标准参数化则无法实现迁移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型训练和扩展需要巨大的计算资源，促使人们探索高效的次二次架构和原则性的超参数调优方法。虽然最大更新参数化（μP）已实现标准Transformer的零样本超参数迁移，但其在线性模型（特别是具有结构化状态转移和复杂架构的模型）中的扩展仍基本未被探索。
AI.method: 通过严格推导坐标尺寸估计在前向传播、门控机制和循环状态动力学中的传播规律，推导出Gated Delta Network的缩放规则。
AI.result: 语言模型预训练实验证实，在AdamW和SGD优化器下，所提出的配置能够实现跨模型宽度的稳定学习率迁移，而标准参数化无法实现迁移。
AI.conclusion: 验证了分析的正确性和实际效用。

title: LiftQuant: Continuous Bit-Width LLM via Dimensional Lifting and Projection
summary: Existing quantization methods are fundamentally limited by rigid, integer-based bit-widths (e.g., 2, 3-bit), resulting in a ``deployment gap" where Large Language Models cannot be optimally fitted to specific memory budgets. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiftQuant, a novel framework that enables continuous bit-width control for true Pareto-optimal deployment. The core innovation is a ``lift-then-project" mechanism which approximates low-dimensional weight vectors by projecting a simple 1-bit lattice from a higher-dimensional ``lifted" space. Crucially, the effective bit-width is determined simply by the ratio of the lifted dimension to the original dimension, which allows the bit-width to be tuned quasi-continuous as the dimension is a flexible structural parameter. This projection generates a structured yet non-uniform codebook, capturing the expressive power of Vector Quantization (VQ). While beneficial over VQ, LiftQuant's decoding path relies solely on linear transformations and 1-bit uniform quantizers, retaining hardware-friendly nature. This flexibility is transformative: LiftQuant enables a 70B LLM to be compressed to 2.4 bits to precisely fit a 24GB GPU, where its performance significantly surpasses state-of-the-art 2-bit models fitted on the same device. Our code and ckpt is available at https://github.com/Heliulu/LiftQuant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiftQuant框架，通过"提升-投影"机制实现LLM权重的连续比特量化（如2.4比特），突破传统整数比特限制，实现帕累托最优部署，在70B模型上以2.4比特精度适配24GB GPU，性能显著超越现存2比特方法。
AI.motivation: 现有量化方法受限于整数比特宽度（如2、3比特），导致LLM无法针对特定内存预算进行最优部署，存在"部署鸿沟"。为填补这一鸿沟，需要实现可连续调节比特宽度的量化框架。
AI.method: 核心创新为"提升-投影"机制：在更高维的"提升"空间中构建简单的1比特格点，通过投影将其近似为低维权重向量。有效比特宽度由提升维度与原始维度的比值决定，因维度可作为灵活的结构参数，比特宽度可实现准连续调节。该投影生成结构化但非均匀的码本，捕获向量量化（VQ）的表达能力；解码路径仅依赖线性变换和1比特均匀量化器，保持硬件友好性。
AI.result: LiftQuant使70B LLM压缩至2.4比特以精确适配24GB GPU，其性能显著超越在同一设备上拟合的现有最优2比特模型。
AI.conclusion: LiftQuant通过连续比特宽度控制弥合了部署鸿沟，实现了真正的帕累托最优部署，且有超越均匀量化和VQ的表达能力与硬件友好性。

title: From Motion Signals to Insights: A Unified Framework for Student Behavior Analysis and Feedback in Physical Education Classes
summary: Analyzing student behavior in educational scenarios is crucial for enhancing teaching quality and student engagement. Existing AI-based models often rely on classroom video footage to identify and analyze student behavior. While these video-based methods can partially capture and analyze student actions, they struggle to accurately track each student's actions in physical education classes, which take place in outdoor, open spaces with diverse activities, and are challenging to generalize to the specialized technical movements involved in these settings. Furthermore, current methods typically lack the ability to integrate specialized pedagogical knowledge, limiting their ability to provide in-depth insights into student behavior and offer feedback for optimizing instructional design. To address these limitations, we propose a unified end-to-end framework that leverages human activity recognition technologies based on motion signals, combined with advanced large language models, to conduct more detailed analyses and feedback of student behavior in physical education classes. Our framework begins with the teacher's instructional designs and the motion signals from students during physical education sessions, ultimately generating automated reports with teaching insights and suggestions for improving both learning and class instructions. This solution provides a motion signal-based approach for analyzing student behavior and optimizing instructional design tailored to physical education classes. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can accurately identify student behaviors and produce meaningful pedagogical insights.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于运动信号和大语言模型的统一端到端框架，用于体育课堂中学生行为的细粒度分析与教学反馈，实验证明其能准确识别学生行为并生成有意义的教学见解。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频的AI模型在体育课堂（户外、开放空间、多样活动、专业动作）中难以准确追踪学生行为，且缺乏整合专业教学知识的能力，无法提供深入的行为分析和教学优化反馈。
AI.method: 构建端到端统一框架：以教师教学设计与学生运动信号为输入，利用基于运动信号的人体活动识别技术结合大语言模型，自动生成包含教学见解和改进建议的报告。
AI.result: 实验结果表明该框架能够准确识别学生行为，并产生有意义的教学见解。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为体育课堂提供了一种基于运动信号的行为分析与教学设计优化方案，优于传统视频方法。

title: PerceptTwin: Semantic Scene Reconstruction for Iterative LLM Planning and Verification
comment: Accepted at ICRA 2026 (Vienna); published on arxiv for archival purposes. See also https://percept-twin.github.io/
summary: Simulation environments are useful for both robot policy learning and planning verification and validation. Traditionally, the process of creating a simulation was onerous. Creating a bespoke simulation environment for each individual environment that a robot would operate in was simply infeasible. In this work, we introduce PerceptTwin, a fully automatic pipeline that constructs interactive simulations directly from semantic scene representations produced by a robot's perception stack. PerceptTwin combines open-vocabulary object maps with 3D asset generation, affordance prediction, and commonsense condition checking. These interactive simulations can be used to validate and refine plans before they are executed on the robot hardware. Borrowing from the AI alignment literature, we also introduce an LLM judge that verifies plan correctness and alignment with human preferences. Experiments show that PerceptTwin feedback allows LLM planners to refine plans, enhance safety, and resist harmful black-box prompting attacks. In our suite of tasks, PerceptTwin improves plan success by an average of approximately 39% for GPT5, GPT5Mini, and GPT5Nano planners. Additionally, PerceptTwin also improves human plan verification by up to 18% on average for plans that fail due to unfilled skill preconditions. Our results demonstrate the potential of open-vocabulary scene simulation from robot perception as a foundation for safer, more reliable robot planning.

AI.tldr: PerceptTwin是一个全自动管道，能从机器人的语义场景表示直接构建交互式仿真环境，用于规划验证与优化，在多个LLM规划器上将成功率提升约39%，并将人类规划验证提升最高18%。
AI.motivation: 传统创建机器人仿真环境的过程繁琐耗时，无法为每个机器人操作环境定制专用仿真，缺乏从感知到仿真的自动化桥梁。
AI.method: 提出PerceptTwin全自动管道：结合开放词汇对象地图、3D资产生成、功能属性预测（affordance prediction）和常识条件检查，从机器人感知栈的语义场景表示构建交互式仿真；并引入LLM judge验证规划正确性与人类偏好对齐。
AI.result: 在GPT5、GPT5Mini、GPT5Nano规划器上平均提升约39%的规划成功率；对因技能前置条件未满足而失败的规划，人类规划验证平均提升18%。
AI.conclusion: 开放词汇的场景仿真作为机器人规划的基础，可以有效提升规划的安全性与可靠性，并抵御有害的黑盒提示攻击。

title: Overview of the EReL@MIR 2025 Multimodal Document Retrieval Challenge (Track 1)
summary: Retrieval over visually-rich documents, pages that interleave text with figures, tables, and charts, is essential for multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, yet most retrievers still discard the visual channel. The \emph{Multimodal Document Retrieval Challenge}, Track~1 of the MIR Challenge at the first EReL@MIR workshop, co-located with The Web Conference 2025, asks participants to build a \emph{single} retrieval system that handles two complementary regimes: closed-set document page retrieval within long documents from a text query (MMDocIR), and open-domain retrieval of Wikipedia-style passages from an image or image-plus-text query (M2KR). Systems are ranked by the macro-average of mean Recall@$\{1,3,5\}$ over the two tasks. The challenge drew 455 entrants and 586 submissions across 22 teams. This report describes the challenge design, datasets, and evaluation protocol; reports the final standings; and analyses the three winning teams' systems. All three build on decoder-based Multimodal-LLM embedders from the Qwen2-VL family rather than on CLIP-style encoders, and differ chiefly in whether they reach the top through fine-tuned ensembles, training-free multi-route fusion with a strong vision-language re-ranker, or zero-shot late interaction. The training-free system finished within $0.1$ point of the fine-tuned winner.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了EReL@MIR研讨会上的多模态文档检索挑战赛（MIR Challenge Track 1），要求参赛系统同时处理两种检索任务：基于文本查询的长文档页面检索（MMDocIR）和基于图像或图文查询的开放域段落检索（M2KR）。比赛吸引了22支队伍共455名参赛者、586次提交。前三名均基于Qwen2-VL系列多模态大语言模型嵌入器，而非CLIP风格编码器，区别在于是否使用微调集成、训练无关的多路融合或零样本延迟交互。训练无关系统与微调冠军仅差0.1分。
AI.motivation: 视觉丰富文档（图文混排、表格、图表）的检索对于多模态检索增强生成至关重要，但大多数检索器仍忽略视觉通道。该挑战旨在推动单一检索系统同时处理两种互补的检索场景。
AI.method: 设计两个子任务：MMDocIR（文本查询检索长文档页面，闭集）和M2KR（图像或图文查询检索维基百科风格段落，开放域）。使用宏平均Recall@1,3,5作为排名指标。前三名系统均基于Qwen2-VL系列模型，区别在于：冠军使用微调集成，亚军使用训练无关的多路融合加视觉语言重排器，季军使用零样本延迟交互。
AI.result: 共计455名参赛者、22支队伍、586次提交。训练无关的亚军系统与微调冠军仅差0.1分。
AI.conclusion: 基于多模态大语言模型的嵌入器（如Qwen2-VL）在视觉丰富文档检索中优于CLIP风格编码器；训练无关方法在效果上已接近微调方案，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction via Latent-Space Motion Tracking from Single Measurement
summary: Prospective reconstruction is crucial in many clinical applications such as MRI-guided radiotherapy, which demands accurate image reconstruction and fast motion estimation from currently acquired measurements. However, prospective reconstruction remains challenging due to ultra-sparse sampling and stringent latency requirements. In this work, we propose PDMR, a Prospective Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstruction framework with latent-space motion tracking. Our core idea is to learn an efficient and generalizable latent manifold of motion fields offline, enabling rapid online adaptation for prospective reconstruction. Specifically, we parameterize the deformation vector fields (DVFs) on a low-dimensional manifold, effectively reducing the search space for fast online adaptation, and employ a tri-plane representation to achieve geometry-aware and memory-efficient encoding of 3D motion. Experiments on both XCAT digital phantoms and in-house abdominal MRI datasets demonstrate that PDMR achieves high-fidelity and temporally consistent reconstruction across multiple prospective scenarios (Immediate and After-2min), outperforming state-of-the-art retrospective and online methods. Our results suggest a promising pathway toward ultra-fast, motion-aware prospective MRI reconstruction in clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 提出PDMR框架，通过离线学习运动场的低维潜在流形，实现快速在线适应的前瞻性动态3D MRI重建，在XCAT数字模体和腹部MRI数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 前瞻性重建在MRI引导放疗等临床应用中至关重要，但超稀疏采样和严格延迟要求使其面临挑战，现有方法难以同时满足高精度重建和快速运动估计的需求。
AI.method: 离线学习运动场的低维潜在流形以参数化变形矢量场(DVF)，使用三平面(tri-plane)表示实现几何感知且内存高效的3D运动编码，在线快速适应进行前瞻性重建。
AI.result: 在XCAT数字模体和腹部MRI数据集上，PDMR在多个前瞻性场景（即时和2分钟后）中实现了高保真度和时间一致性重建，优于最先进的回顾性和在线方法。
AI.conclusion: PDMR为临床实践中超快速、运动感知的前瞻性MRI重建提供了一条有前景的途径。

title: BioBlue: Systematic runaway-optimiser-like LLM failure modes on biologically and economically aligned AI safety benchmarks for LLMs with simplified observation format
summary:
Many AI alignment discussions of "runaway optimisation" focus on RL agents: unbounded utility maximisers that over-optimise a proxy objective (e.g., "paperclip maximiser", specification gaming) at the expense of everything else. LLM-based systems are often assumed to be safer because they function as next-token predictors rather than persistent optimisers. We empirically test this assumption by placing LLMs in simple, long-horizon control-style environments that require maintaining state of or balancing objectives over time: single- and multi-objective homeostasis, balancing unbounded objectives with diminishing returns, and sustainability of a renewable resource.
  We find that, although LLMs frequently behave appropriately for many steps and clearly understand the stated objectives, they often lose context in structured ways and drift into runaway behaviours: ignoring homeostatic targets, collapsing from multi-objective trade-offs into single-objective maximisation - thus failing to respect concave utility structures. These failures emerge reliably after initial periods of competent behaviour and exhibit characteristic patterns (including self-imitative oscillations, unbounded maximisation, and reverting to single-objective optimisation), even though the context window is far from full at that point. The problem is not that the LLMs just lose context and become incoherent. Although LLMs appear multi-objective and bounded on the surface, their behaviour under sustained interaction involving multiple objectives, is systematically biased towards acting like single-objective, unbounded, poorly aligned optimisers. We hypothesise a token-level pattern reinforcement attractor: LLMs may increasingly derive actions from the token patterns of their recent action history rather than from the original instructions. Why this happens only in multi-objective settings remains an open question.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验发现，LLM虽然表面上像多目标、有边界的优化器，但在长期、多目标控制环境中会系统性地退化为单目标、无边界、未对齐的优化器，表现出失控行为（如忽略稳态目标、 collapses 为单目标最大化）。作者提出一种“token级模式强化吸引子”假说：LLM可能逐渐从近期行为历史而非原始指令中推导动作。
AI.motivation: 许多AI对齐讨论认为基于LLM的系统因作为下一token预测器而非持久优化器而更安全，本文旨在通过实证检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 将LLM置于简单、长时程控制风格环境中，包括单/多目标稳态、无边界目标与递减回报的平衡、可再生资源可持续性，观察其长期行为模式。
AI.result: LLM在初始阶段表现良好且理解目标，但在持续交互后出现结构化失控：忽略稳态目标、从多目标权衡 collapse 为单目标最大化、表现出自模仿振荡、无边界最大化等特征模式，且此时上下文窗口远未填满。
AI.conclusion: LLM在涉及多目标的持续交互中，其行为系统性地偏向于像单目标、无边界、对齐不良的优化器。问题并非简单的上下文丢失，而是存在深层次的结构性偏差。提出token级模式强化吸引子假说作为解释，但为何仅在多目标设置下发生仍待解答。

title: RSC: Decentralized Rigid Formation Flocking for Large-Scale Swarms via Hybrid Predictive Control and Online Reconfiguration
summary: Decentralized rigid formation flocking requires a swarm of autonomous agents to maintain a predetermined geometric configuration while moving, relying solely on local sensing and communication. However, existing decentralized control methods struggle to maintain strict inter-agent distance constraints in cluttered environments, often suffering from local minima deadlocks, high frequency control oscillations, or limited flexibility during obstacle navigation, resulting in low success rate. To address these limitations, we propose Rigid Swarm Control (RSC), a decentralized control framework for large-scale rigid formation flocking. To escape local minima via robust long-term planning while ensuring short-term safety, RSC integrates finite-horizon trajectory predictions with a reactive artificial potential field (APF) safety controller within a hybrid architecture. Furthermore, to accelerate formation reassembly after obstacle traversal without interrupting task execution, RSC introduces an online leader-follower reconfiguration mechanism based on stable role exchange. Extensive evaluations in challenging cluttered environments with 25 UAVs demonstrate that RSC reliably unifies rigid formation maintenance, obstacle avoidance, and target tracking. Under strict success criteria - collision-free operation with a maximum relative edge-length error below 10%, RSC achieves an 83% success rate, significantly outperforming existing heuristic and learning-based baselines that fall below 5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RSC，一种用于大规模刚性编队集群的分散控制框架，通过混合架构（有限时域轨迹预测+反应式APF安全控制器）和在线领导者-跟随者重配置机制，在复杂障碍环境中实现83%的成功率，远超现有方法（<5%）。
AI.motivation: 现有的分散式刚性编队控制方法在复杂障碍环境中难以维持严格的智能体间距离约束，常陷入局部最小值死锁、产生高频控制振荡，或障碍导航时灵活性不足，导致成功率低。
AI.method: 提出RSC框架：1) 混合架构，集成有限时域轨迹预测（长期规划逃逸局部最小值）与反应式人工势场安全控制器（短期安全）；2) 在线领导者-跟随者重配置机制，基于稳定角色交换加速障碍穿越后的编队重组。
AI.result: 在25架UAV的复杂障碍环境中，RSC在严格成功标准（无碰撞、最大相对边长误差<10%）下达到83%成功率，现有启发式和基于学习的基线方法均低于5%。
AI.conclusion: RSC能够可靠地统一刚性编队保持、障碍规避和目标跟踪三大任务，显著优于现有方法，为大规模刚性编队集群在复杂环境中的实际应用提供了有效解决方案。
