Functional evaluation showed that active exoskeleton assistance reduced muscular effort during isolated finger flexion and object grasping. During weighted grasping, assistance reduced muscular effort across all tested loads, with a 92.6% reduction at the highest load. These results demonstrate the potential of SoftPINCH for intuitive, low-effort pinch assistance using real-time EMG-driven soft robotic control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoftPINCH，一种基于肌电信号(EMG)驱动的软体可穿戴外骨骼，用于拇指-食指捏合辅助。系统结合了 tendon-driven 软体外骨骼、指尖磁接触传感和神经EMG解码。评估了三种主体无关的解码架构，其中CNN+LSTM达到99.4%的留一受试者交叉验证准确率。功能评估表明主动外骨骼辅助可降低肌肉用力，在最大负载下肌肉用力减少92.6%。
AI.motivation: 表面肌电信号(sEMG)为检测手部运动意图和控制可穿戴辅助设备提供了非侵入式接口，但EMG信号受噪声、运动伪影、电极放置、肌肉疲劳和受试者间差异影响，可靠性不足。同时，许多手部外骨骼机械上仍存在限制或笨重，影响舒适性和自然手部运动。
AI.method: 系统由三部分组成：tendon-driven软体外骨骼、指尖磁接触传感、神经EMG解码。采集前臂肌肉EMG信号，评估三种主体无关解码架构（LSTM、CNN+LSTM、CNN+LSTM+Attention），选择CNN+LSTM模型进行实时部署。
AI.result: CNN+LSTM和CNN+LSTM-Attention模型均达到99.4%的留一受试者测试准确率，优于LSTM的97.8%。Attention机制未带来显著提升。功能评估显示主动辅助降低孤立手指屈曲和物体抓取时的肌肉用力，加权抓取时最大负载下肌肉用力减少92.6%。
AI.conclusion: SoftPINCH展示了基于实时EMG驱动的软体机器人控制实现直观、低用力捏合辅助的潜力。CNN+LSTM因其高精度和较低架构复杂度被选为实时部署模型。

title: Multi-Granularity 3D Kidney Lesion Characterization from CT Volumes
summary: Radiology reports describe kidney lesions by type, size, enhancement, and attenuation, yet existing 3D methods predict only at the patient or organ level. We reformulate kidney CT characterization as a per-lesion set-prediction task: one model emits a variable number of lesions per kidney, each with four clinical attributes. We curated 2,619 CT volumes from 788 patients at one academic medical center, with multi-granularity side- and per-lesion labels, and used KiTS23 (489 cases) for zero-shot external validation. We propose \textbf{LesionDETR}, a DETR-style architecture with size-distance Hungarian matching and a hierarchical loss that aggregates per-slot outputs to side-level objectives. Across four input representations and six encoder initializations, two design choices dominate: a segmentation mask as an input channel, and same-domain abdominal pretraining (SuPreM); generic large-corpus pretraining is no better than random initialization. LesionDETR reaches bilateral side-level abnormality AUC $0.799 \pm 0.009$ on UF-Health and $0.817 \pm 0.072$ on KiTS23. A count-conditioned variant reaches per-lesion mAP $0.190 \pm 0.083$ on cystic lesions; rare solid-lesion AP stays at the noise floor, pointing to targeted data collection, not architecture, as the next bottleneck. The framework yields verified per-lesion predictions for downstream structured report generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LesionDETR，将肾脏CT表征重构为每病灶集合预测任务，能同时预测每个肾脏中可变数量的病灶及其四种临床属性。在2,619个CT体积上训练，使用KiTS23进行零样本验证。核心发现包括：分割掩码作为输入通道和同域腹部预训练(SuPreM)是关键设计选择；大型通用预训练效果不优于随机初始化。模型在双侧侧别异常检测上达到AUC 0.799-0.817，但罕见实性病灶检测仍是瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有放射学报告描述肾脏病灶的类型、大小、增强和衰减等属性，但已有的3D方法仅在患者或器官层面进行预测，无法实现病灶级别的细粒度表征。本文旨在将肾脏CT表征重构为**每病灶集合预测任务**，以输出每个肾脏中可变数量的病灶及其多种临床属性。
AI.method: 提出LesionDETR——一种DETR风格架构，包含(1) 基于尺寸距离的匈牙利匹配，用于病灶-槽位对齐；(2) 层次化损失函数，将每个槽位的输出聚合并侧别级目标。实验对比了4种输入表示和6种编码器初始化方式。
AI.result: (1) 分割掩码作为输入通道、同域腹部预训练(SuPreM)是两大关键设计；通用大规模预训练不优于随机初始化。(2) 双侧侧别异常检测AUC：UF-Health数据集0.799±0.009，KiTS23零样本验证0.817±0.072。(3) 计数条件变体在囊性病灶上达mAP 0.190±0.083；实性病灶AP处于噪声水平，表明瓶颈在于数据收集而非架构设计。
AI.conclusion: LesionDETR框架能产生经过验证的每病灶预测，可用于下游结构化报告生成。实性病灶检测的低性能指向了未来工作的关键方向——针对性数据收集，而非架构改进。

title: ADAPTOOD: Uncertainty-Aware Fine-Tuning for Out-of-Distribution ECG Time Series Models
summary: Data samples used for training often differ from those encountered during fine-tuning and deployment, and while ML models show promise, their performance remains limited when only small annotated datasets are available. Performance often degrades under distribution shifts caused by diverse sensors, populations, and application settings. Although pre-training helps, models frequently encounter out-of-distribution (OOD) data in real-world settings, leading to reduced robustness. Existing adaptation methods usually assume fixed distribution shifts and struggle when multiple types or severities occur. In particular, they overlook shift severity, for example treating adaptation to a large familiar dataset the same as adaptation to a small dataset with a new task, which limits generalisation. To address this, we propose ADAPTOOD, a novel framework that leverages data uncertainty to quantify distribution shift severity and guide fine-tuning for time series. This uncertainty measures how strongly samples from the target deployment distribution deviate from the pre-training distribution, providing a direct signal of OOD severity. Our framework combines this uncertainty with low-rank model updates and adaptive hyperparameter optimisation to improve adaptation. We show that ADAPTOOD achieves up to 7% higher accuracy and 12.9% higher precision than existing methods in OOD tasks, maintaining strong performance as distribution shift severity increases.

AI.tldr: 提出ADAPTOOD框架，利用数据不确定性量化分布偏移严重程度，指导时间序列模型的微调，在OOD任务上相比现有方法提升高达7%准确率和12.9%精确率。
AI.motivation: 现有适应方法通常假设固定分布偏移，无法处理多种类型或严重程度的偏移，且忽略了偏移严重性（如将大规模熟悉数据集的适应与少量新任务数据集的适应等同处理），限制了泛化能力。
AI.method: 利用数据不确定性量化目标部署分布与预训练分布之间的偏离程度，作为OOD严重性的直接信号；结合低秩模型更新和自适应超参数优化来改进适应过程。
AI.result: 在OOD任务中，ADAPTOOD相比现有方法准确率提升高达7%，精确率提升12.9%，且在分布偏移严重程度增加时仍能保持强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: ADAPTOOD通过量化偏移严重性指导微调，有效提升了模型在真实世界分布偏移场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: Real-World Deployment of a 5G-Connected Edge-Controlled Aerial Robot in Industrial Subterranean Mines
summary: This article presents the first real-world autonomous flight of a 5G-connected aerial robot controlled by an edge-offloaded controller, and aims to bridge the gap between controlled and factual setups. The robot operates within an active industrial subterranean mine, while the high-level controller is deployed in a nearby Kubernetes-based edge cluster. Communication between the robot and the edge is enabled via a 5G New Radio (NR) Standalone (SA) network. The chosen controller is a Model Predictive Controller (MPC), which generates control actions to allow the robot to navigate seamlessly through the mining environment. A human operator selects waypoints for the aerial robot, and the MPC generates smooth, collision-free paths for autonomous executions. The proposed 5G edge-based closed-loop system is evaluated in a real industrial setting and demonstrates the potential of edge-controlled robotic systems toward time-critical, safe and efficient future deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实现了5G连接、边缘卸载控制器控制的无人机在工业地下矿井中的真实自主飞行，验证了5G边缘闭环系统在时间关键型应用中的可行性。
AI.motivation: 弥合受控实验与实际部署之间的差距，探索5G边缘计算在时间关键型机器人控制中的实际应用可行性。
AI.method: 采用5G NR SA网络连接无人机与Kubernetes边缘集群，部署模型预测控制器(MPC)接收人工操作员选择的航点，生成平滑无碰撞路径，实现自主导航。
AI.result: 在真实工业地下矿井环境中成功完成5G连接边缘控制无人机的首次自主飞行，验证了系统的可行性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: 5G边缘闭环控制框架在时间关键型、安全高效的实际机器人部署中展现出巨大潜力。

title: VT-3DAD: Cross-Category 3D Anomaly Detection via Visual-Text Normal Space Alignment
summary: Few-shot cross-category 3D anomaly detection aims to determine whether an unknown point cloud belongs to a target normal category using only a few normal references. Existing training-based methods usually require category-wise optimization, while recent training-free methods based on multi-view CLIP visual features mainly rely on visual similarity and may be confused by geometrically similar categories. In this paper, we propose VT-3DAD, a training-free framework for cross-category 3D anomaly detection via Visual-Text Normal Space Alignment. Given few-shot normal references and a test point cloud, VT-3DAD first generates realistic multi-view depth maps and extracts view-wise features using a frozen CLIP visual encoder. The visual branch measures reference-test deviation in the multi-view feature space. In parallel, depth-aware and 3D-aware prompts are encoded by the frozen CLIP text encoder to construct textual normal anchors, which provide semantic normality constraints for the target category. The final anomaly score is obtained by fusing visual deviation from normal references and semantic deviation from the textual normal space. Experiments on the ShapeNetPart dataset demonstrate that VT-3DAD achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, VT-3DAD improves the one-shot average AUC-ROC from 92.49% to 94.80% compared with the visual-only baseline, while also reducing the average standard deviation from 5.64 to 3.41.

AI.tldr: VT-3DAD是一种无需训练的三维异常检测框架，通过视觉-文本正态空间对齐，利用少样本参考点云和冻结的CLIP模型，融合多视图深度特征与文本语义锚点，在ShapeNetPart数据集上达到SOTA性能（one-shot AUC-ROC从92.49%提升至94.80%，标准差从5.64降至3.41）。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本跨类别3D异常检测方法中，基于训练的方法需要逐类别优化，而基于多视图CLIP视觉特征的无训练方法主要依赖视觉相似性，容易被几何相似但类别不同的样本混淆。
AI.method: 1) 利用少样本正常参考和测试点云生成逼真多视图深度图，通过冻结的CLIP视觉编码器提取视图特征，计算参考-测试偏差；2) 通过CLIP文本编码器编码深度感知和3D感知提示，构建文本正态锚点，提供语义正态约束；3) 融合视觉偏差和语义偏差得到最终异常分数。
AI.result: 在ShapeNetPart数据集上，VT-3DAD在one-shot设置下将平均AUC-ROC从92.49%提升至94.80%，平均标准差从5.64降至3.41，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入文本语义锚点为视觉特征提供互补的正态约束，有效缓解了视觉相似性导致的混淆问题，提升了跨类别3D异常检测的准确性和稳定性。

title: Smart Transportation Without Neurons -- Fair Metro Network Expansion with Tabular Reinforcement Learning
summary: We tackle the Metro Network Expansion Problem (MNEP), a subset of the Transport Network Design Problem (TNDP), which focuses on expanding metro systems to satisfy travel demand. Traditional methods rely on exact and heuristic approaches that require expert-defined constraints to reduce the search space. Recently, deep reinforcement learning (Deep RL) has emerged due to its effectiveness in complex sequential decision-making processes-it remains, however, computationally expensive, environmentally costly, and requires additional engineering to interpret. We show that MNEP problems are small enough to not require Deep RL methods. Reformulating the MNEP as a Non-Markovian Rewards Decision Process (NMRDP), we use tabular RL to achieve similar performance with significantly fewer training episodes, additionally offering greater interpretability. Additionally, we incorporate social equity criteria into the reward functions, focusing on efficiency and fairness, highlighting the versatility of our method. Evaluated in real-world settings-Xi'an and Amsterdam-our method reduces total episodes by a factor of 18 and total carbon emissions by a factor of 12 on average, while remaining competitive with Deep RL. This approach offers a replicable, modular, interpretable, and resource-efficient solution with potential applications to other combinatorial optimization problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将地铁网络扩展问题(MNEP)重新表述为非马尔可夫奖励决策过程(NMRDP)，使用表格型强化学习替代深度强化学习，在现实数据集(西安和阿姆斯特丹)上实现了与Deep RL相当的性能，同时训练回合数减少18倍，碳排放减少12倍，并具备更强的可解释性和公平性考量。
AI.motivation: 传统解决地铁网络扩展问题(MNEP)的方法依赖精确算法和启发式方法，需要专家定义约束来缩小搜索空间；而深度强化学习方法虽有效但计算昂贵、环境成本高且缺乏可解释性。作者发现MNEP问题规模较小，无需使用Deep RL方法。
AI.method: 将MNEP重新表述为非马尔可夫奖励决策过程(NMRDP)，采用表格型强化学习(而非深度强化学习)进行求解；在奖励函数中融入社会公平性标准，兼顾效率与公平；在西安和阿姆斯特丹真实场景中进行评估。
AI.result: 与Deep RL相比，表格型RL方法训练回合数减少18倍，碳排放减少12倍，同时性能与Deep RL相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种可复现、模块化、可解释且资源高效的解决方案，并具有推广到其他组合优化问题的潜力。

title: HapTile: A Haptic-Informed Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning
summary: Despite the importance of tactile sensing for reliable manipulation, most existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets remain vision-only, and those that do incorporate tactile information typically lack the joint combination of task diversity, language conditioning, and action trajectories. Furthermore, existing teleoperation pipelines rarely provide haptic feedback to the operator, despite its established role in demonstration quality and manipulation stability. In this work, we present HapTile, a contact-grounded visuotactile manipulation dataset that advances beyond vision-only trajectory datasets by embedding physical interaction sensing at two levels: fingertip tactile feedback at the robot end-effector, and haptic-informed demonstrations at the teleoperator side. The data collection platform integrates haptic feedback directly into the teleoperation controller, enabling the operator to perceive contact interactions in real time. It is built around a standard and reproducible robotic system equipped with custom-designed fingertip tactile sensors. The dataset comprises everyday manipulation tasks spanning a broad range of contact-rich skills, including pick-and-place, folding, pressing, stacking, and other routine activities. Each task is paired with language instructions that condition the policy on the manipulation objective, together with synchronized visuotactile observations and action trajectories. In addition, we provide a benchmarking study on contact-rich policy learning using two baseline models to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed contact-grounded dataset. The dataset and additional details are available on our website: haptile-dataset.github.io.

AI.tldr: HapTile是一个接触引导的视觉触觉操作数据集，在机器人末端执行器提供 fingertip 触觉反馈，在遥操作端提供触觉感知演示，涵盖多种日常操作任务并配有语言指令、同步视觉触觉观测和动作轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA数据集大多仅依赖视觉信息，缺乏触觉传感器的联合任务多样性、语言条件和动作轨迹组合；同时遥操作系统很少为操作员提供触觉反馈，影响了演示质量和操作稳定性。
AI.method: 构建了集成触觉反馈的遥操作数据采集平台，配备定制 fingertip 触觉传感器；采集涵盖pick-and-place、折叠、按压、堆叠等接触密集型日常操作任务，每项任务配有语言指令、同步视觉触觉观测和动作轨迹。
AI.result: 提供了一个接触引导的视觉触觉操作数据集HapTile，并通过两种基线模型在接触密集型策略学习上进行基准测试，验证了该数据集的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HapTile通过嵌入物理交互感知（末端触觉反馈和操作员侧触觉演示），弥补了现有VLA数据集中触觉信息的缺失，为接触密集型操作策略学习提供了有价值的基准。

title: Selective Coupling of Decoupled Informative Regions: Masked Attention Alignment for Data-Free Quantization of Vision Transformers
comment: Accepted to appear at ICML 2026, Seoul, Korea
summary: Data-Free Quantization (DFQ) addresses data security concerns by synthesizing samples, without accessing real data. It has garnered increasing attention in the context of Vision Transformers (ViTs), owing to the superiority of the self-attention mechanism compared to classical convolutional operation. However, previous DFQ arts for ViTs often suffer from a distribution mismatch between synthetic samples and input distribution expected by quantized models Q, resulting in the suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose a novel Masked Attention Alignment approach for Data-Free Quantization of ViTs, named MaskAQ, revealing that: 1) the semantics in the self-attention mechanism is predominantly localized to a sparse subset of patches, called informative regions; 2) the informative regions dominate the mutual information between synthetic samples and Q's outputs. To these ends, we incorporate differential entropy maximum over patch similarity of synthetic samples, to decouple informative regions from noisy background. To couple with varied Q, the informative regions are selected to align full-precision models with Q via a masked attention alignment objective, thus yielding high-quality synthetic samples. Furthermore, a periodic sample refreshing strategy comes up to endow MaskAQ with the capacity to continually adapt to the evolving state of Q throughout the training process, to preserve desirable mutual information with synthetic samples. Extensive experiments verify the merits of MaskAQ over state-of-the-art approaches across multiple backbones and downstream tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/hfutqian/MaskAQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MaskAQ方法，通过掩码注意力对齐解决ViT数据-free量化中合成样本与量化模型分布不匹配问题。该方法利用自注意力机制中语义集中在稀疏信息区域的特点，通过差分熵最大化解耦信息区域，并采用掩码注意力对齐目标和对样本周期性刷新策略，持续保持合成样本与量化模型间的互信息，在多个骨干网络和下游任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有ViT数据-free量化方法存在合成样本与量化模型Q期望输入分布之间的分布不匹配问题，导致量化后性能次优。本文旨在解决这一核心缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 通过差分熵最大化补丁相似度，将信息区域与噪声背景解耦；2) 选择信息区域通过掩码注意力对齐目标对齐全精度模型与量化模型Q；3) 采用周期性样本刷新策略，使合成样本持续适应Q的训练状态变化，保持与合成样本的互信息。
AI.result: 实验结果表明MaskAQ在多个骨干网络和下游任务上均优于最先进的DFQ方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了自注意力机制中语义集中在稀疏信息区域，且该区域主导合成样本与Q输出之间的互信息。MaskAQ通过解耦信息区域、注意力对齐和周期性刷新，有效解决了分布不匹配问题，提升了ViT数据-free量化的性能。

title: When Autoregressive Consistency Hurts Safety Alignment
summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) is fragile in part because it is often shallow: fine-tuning mainly reshapes the model's behavior near the first few output tokens. We argue that this phenomenon can be understood through autoregressive consistency, the tendency of next-token prediction to preserve and extend the current response trajectory consistently. By analyzing the learning dynamics of safety alignment, we show that autoregressive consistency can concentrate alignment updates on early tokens, offering a mechanistic explanation for shallow safety alignment. The same mechanism also predicts a broader class of attacks on LLMs: attacks that induce harmful continuation states at arbitrary positions in the output trajectory. As a concrete example, we introduce random insertion attack, which inserts a short harmful span into an otherwise safe refusal trajectory and exploits autoregressive consistency to sustain the resulting harmful branch, thereby bypassing safety alignment. Notably, a short harmful span can redirect the generation to be harmful even after a long refusal prefix, highlighting autoregressive consistency as a potential broader failure mechanism. This suggests that safety alignment should also break harmful autoregressive consistency throughout the output trajectory. We therefore propose adversarial safety alignment, an initial framework based on worst-case harmful continuation states, and instantiate it with random worst-insertion training. Overall, our results suggest that autoregressive consistency should be treated as a central consideration in both safety alignment and attack design.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大型语言模型安全对齐脆弱性的深层原因——自回归一致性（autoregressive consistency）导致安全对齐主要影响早期输出token，而后期token容易受到攻击。作者提出随机插入攻击（random insertion attack）作为实例，并引入对抗性安全对齐（adversarial safety alignment）框架作为防御方案。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐（如RLHF）在大语言模型中容易被绕过，但具体机制尚不明确。作者试图从自回归一致性的角度解释安全对齐为何"浅层"且脆弱，并基于该机制预测和设计更广泛的攻击方法。
AI.method: 1. 通过分析安全对齐的学习动态，证明自回归一致性将安全对齐更新主要集中在早期token上。2. 提出随机插入攻击：在安全拒绝轨迹中插入短的有害span，利用自回归一致性维持有害分支。3. 提出对抗性安全对齐框架，实例化为随机最差插入训练（random worst-insertion training），在输出轨迹的任意位置打破有害的自回归一致性。
AI.result: 1. 揭示了安全对齐"浅层"的机制原因：自回归一致性使对齐集中在早期token。2. 随机插入攻击成功绕过安全对齐——短的有害span即使在长拒绝前缀后仍能引导生成有害内容。3. 对抗性安全对齐作为初步框架，通过训练模型应对最坏情况下的有害连续状态来提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自回归一致性应被视为安全对齐和攻击设计的核心考量因素。安全对齐不仅需要在早期token上对齐，还需要在整个输出轨迹中打破有害的自回归一致性。对抗性安全对齐为此提供了初步框架。

title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
summary: Building a general-purpose whole-body controller is essential for enabling diverse motion capabilities in humanoid robots across a wide range of downstream tasks, including locomotion and loco-manipulation. Different tasks rely on distinct motion reference modalities: locomotion primarily depends on coordinated robot joint trajectories, whereas manipulation requires precise end-effector trajectory tracking. Existing methods often overlook the representational mismatch between dense robot joint angles and sparse end-effector poses. To address this, we propose Multi-Modal Mimic (M3imic), a versatile multi-modal whole-body control framework that unifies heterogeneous motion reference modalities, including robot joint angles, human pose trajectories, and end-effector poses, using modality-specific encoders to map them into a shared latent space. Leveraging large-scale reinforcement learning in the simulator, we train a single policy that achieves sim-to-real transfer across multiple motion reference modalities without modality-specific retraining. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 robot are conducted to evaluate the proposed framework. In simulation, the policy achieves a peak success rate of 98.42\% on an unseen test dataset, demonstrating its exceptional generalization capability. The code is available at https://github.com/Renforce-Dynamics/MultiModalWBC

AI.tldr: 提出M3imic，一种多模态全身控制框架，通过模态特定编码器将异构运动参考模态（关节角度、人体姿态、末端执行器位姿）映射到共享潜在空间，采用大规模强化学习训练单一策略，在Unitree G1机器人上实现sim-to-real迁移，仿真测试集成功率高达98.42%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法忽视了密集机器人关节角度与稀疏末端执行器位姿之间的表征不匹配问题，不同下游任务依赖不同的运动参考模态，亟需一个统一的全身控制框架来处理多种异构运动参考模态。
AI.method: 采用多模态模仿学习框架M3imic，使用模态特定编码器将机器人关节角度、人体姿态轨迹和末端执行器位姿三种异构运动参考模态映射到共享潜在空间，通过大规模强化学习在仿真器中训练单一策略，实现无需模态特定重新训练的sim-to-real迁移。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1机器人上进行的仿真和真实世界实验中，该策略在未见测试数据集上达到98.42%的峰值成功率，展现出卓越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: M3imic框架成功统一了多种运动参考模态，通过单一策略实现了跨模态的全身控制，并且在sim-to-real迁移中表现出色，为通用人形机器人全身控制提供了有效方案。

title: Geometry-Preserving Unsupervised Alignment for Heterogeneous Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models have driven rapid progress in computer vision, yet the two dominant paradigms, vision-language foundation models (VLMs) and vision-only foundation models (VFMs), remain only partially compatible. VLMs offer language-grounded semantic alignment but are often visually coarse, while VFMs learn discriminative perceptual geometry but lack semantic grounding. We propose GPUA (Geometry-Preserving Unsupervised Alignment), a framework that integrates the complementary strengths of VFMs and VLMs. Inspired by cross-lingual alignment, GPUA treats VFM features as a visual language and learns an orthogonal mapping that translates the VFM space into the VLM semantic space, preserving geometry and narrowing the modality gap without labels or model parameter updates. GPUA is task-agnostic and requires only feature-level access to pretrained models. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate improved cross-model compatibility and strong gains in downstream zero-shot recognition and segmentation with negligible overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/Yuteam14/GPUA

AI.tldr: GPUA提出了一种无需标签的无监督几何保持对齐框架，通过正交映射将视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征空间对齐到视觉语言基础模型（VLM）的语义空间，实现跨模型兼容性和零样本识别/分割性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有两大类基础模型——视觉语言基础模型（VLM）和纯视觉基础模型（VFM）各具优势但互不兼容：VLM具备语言驱动的语义对齐能力但视觉特征粗糙，VFM能学习判别性感知几何但缺乏语义锚定。二者互补但缺乏有效的融合方案。
AI.method: 受跨语言对齐启发，将VFM特征视为一种"视觉语言"，学习一个正交映射矩阵将VFM空间转换到VLM语义空间，在保持几何结构的同时缩小模态差距。该方法无需标签、无需更新模型参数，仅需特征级访问，且任务无关。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上验证了跨模型兼容性提升，并在零样本识别与分割下游任务中取得显著增益，同时计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: GPUA有效融合了VFM和VLM的互补优势，以极低代价实现性能提升，为两大主流视觉范式提供了通用的对齐桥梁。

title: Low-rank Distributional Matrix Completion
summary: We study a distributional generalization of the matrix completion problem in which each entry of the target matrix is a probability distribution rather than a scalar. In this setting, only a subset of matrix entries is observed, and even for observed entries, the underlying distributions are not directly accessible; instead, we observe finitely many samples drawn from them. To represent distributional entries, we employ kernel mean embeddings and introduce a notion of Tucker rank for distribution-valued matrices to capture their low-rank structure. The infinite-dimensional nature of kernel embeddings poses significant methodological challenges. To address this, we introduce functional unfolding operators that link the proposed distributional low-rank structure to the classical Tucker rank for finite-dimensional tensors. Based on this framework, we propose a novel estimator for distributional matrix completion. We establish non-asymptotic error bounds that characterize the statistical performance of the estimator. Extensive experiments on synthetic data and a real-world application demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分布化矩阵补全问题，其中矩阵条目为概率分布而非标量。通过核均值嵌入和Tucker秩捕捉低维结构，引入函数展开算子将分布低秩结构转化为经典张量Tucker秩，提出新估计器并建立非渐近误差界，实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统矩阵补全处理标量值，但实际数据常以分布形式出现（如群体数据、不确定性数据），且观测值仅为分布的有限样本。需要一种能直接处理分布条目的矩阵补全框架。
AI.method: 将分布条目表示为核均值嵌入，定义分布值矩阵的Tucker秩；引入函数展开算子将无限维的分布低秩结构映射到有限维张量的经典Tucker秩，从而设计估计器。
AI.result: 建立了所提估计器的非渐近误差界，在合成数据和真实应用上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分布化矩阵补全方法能够有效处理条目为概率分布且仅观测有限样本的场景，理论保证和实验表现良好。

title: Teaching Robots to Say 'I Don't Know' : SENTINEL for Uncertainty-Aware SLAM
comment: 6 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables, This paper was accepted at Uncertainty in Open-World Robotics Workshop in conjunction with Internation conference of robotics and automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: Low-cost 2D LiDARs lack the intensity channel that higher-end sensors use to diagnose measurement failures, yet they are widely used on educational and budget robotics platforms. We present SENTINEL, a training - free, label - free reliability estimation framework that gives range - only LiDAR an effective diagnostic signal. SENTINEL combines geometry-based scan statistics with cross - modal depth consistency between LiDAR and an RGB - D camera to compute a per - scan reliability score between 0 and 1. When the score falls below a threshold, corrupted scans are rejected and the robot falls back to calibrated wheel odometry, preventing silent SLAM corruption. We evaluate SENTINEL on a GEFIER R1 four - wheel skid-steer robot equipped with an RPLidar A2M12 and an Intel RealSense D435i in a 185 cm by 245 cm arena containing controlled transparent and reflective failure elements on a central obstacle. Spatial reliability maps across five surface conditions, including glass, mirror, shiny paper, and a mixed mirror and shiny-paper condition, show clear separation between clean and failure cases, allowing affected regions to be identified as reject or noise. Because these failure modes are absent in simulation, validation is performed entirely on real hardware.

AI.tldr: SENTINEL是一个无需训练和标签的可靠性评估框架，通过几何扫描统计和跨模态深度一致性，为低成本2D LiDAR生成每帧可靠性分数（0-1），低于阈值时拒绝损坏扫描并回退到轮式里程计，防止SLAM损坏。在真实机器人平台上验证了其对玻璃、镜子等反射/透明表面的检测能力。
AI.motivation: 低成本2D LiDAR缺乏高端传感器中的强度通道来诊断测量故障，但广泛用于教育和预算机器人平台，导致SLAM在遇到透明或反射表面时出现静默损坏。
AI.method: 结合基于几何的扫描统计与LiDAR和RGB-D相机之间的跨模态深度一致性，计算每帧可靠性分数（0-1），低于阈值时拒绝损坏扫描并回退到校准的轮式里程计。
AI.result: 在GEFIER R1机器人（搭载RPLidar A2M12和Intel RealSense D435i）上，于185cm×245cm场地中测试五种表面条件（玻璃、镜子、亮面纸、混合镜面+亮面纸），空间可靠性图清晰区分了干净和故障情况。
AI.conclusion: SENTINEL有效为低成本2D LiDAR提供了类似高端传感器强度通道的诊断能力，且无需训练或标签，完全在真实硬件上验证了其实用性。

title: An Empirical Study of Data Scale, Model Complexity, and Input Modalities in Visual Generalization
summary: Modern deep neural networks usually have large parameter scales and nonlinear hierarchical structures, and they have achieved strong performance in computer vision. However, the source of their generalization performance remains difficult to explain using traditional statistical learning theory. Among the factors that may affect visual generalization, data scale, model complexity, and input modalities are fundamental and controllable variables. This study empirically analyzes how these three factors influence model generalization performance. Specifically, in a preliminary experiment, we construct a one-dimensional nonlinear function and vary the number of training samples and the polynomial degree to observe the effects of data scale and model complexity on model performance. In the main experiments, we compare model performance on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 under different training data scales, model architectures, and input modalities. The experimental results show that increasing the training data scale consistently improves generalization performance, whereas changes in model complexity do not provide stable gains. In addition, removing color information degrades model performance, while explicit prior features such as gradients, edges, and wavelets have inconsistent effects across different model architectures. Overall, this study provides an empirical analysis of the relationships among data scale, model complexity, input modalities, and visual generalization performance. Code and experimental logs are available at: https://github.com/zlyd-CV/DeepLearning-Empirical-Studies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验系统分析了数据规模、模型复杂度和输入模态对深度神经网络视觉泛化性能的影响。实验结果表明：增加训练数据规模能稳定提升泛化性能，而模型复杂度变化带来的收益不稳定；去除颜色信息会降低性能，而梯度、边缘、小波等显式先验特征在不同模型架构下效果不一致。
AI.motivation: 现代深度神经网络虽然取得了优异的视觉性能，但其泛化能力的来源难以用传统统计学习理论解释。数据规模、模型复杂度和输入模态是影响视觉泛化的基础且可控的因素，本研究旨在实证分析这三者如何影响模型泛化性能。
AI.method: 初步实验中，构建一维非线性函数，改变训练样本数量和多项式阶数，观察数据规模和模型复杂度的影响。主实验在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，比较不同训练数据规模、模型架构和输入模态下的模型性能。
AI.result: 增加训练数据规模一致提升泛化性能；模型复杂度变化无法提供稳定增益；去除颜色信息降低模型性能；梯度、边缘、小波等显式先验特征在不同模型架构下效果不一致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了数据规模、模型复杂度、输入模态与视觉泛化性能之间关系的实证分析。

title: KODA: Contrastive Representation Comparison and Alignment for Vision-Language Foundation Models
summary: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP and SigLIP provide widely used representations for multimodal learning systems. While these models are typically compared through downstream performance, such evaluations often do not explain how their representations differ structurally. In this work, we study this problem through the task of Contrastive Embedding Clustering: identifying sample subsets that are weakly clustered under one representation but strongly clustered under another. We propose \emph{Kernel Optimization for Discrepancy Analysis (KODA)}, a kernel-based framework for contrastive representation comparison and alignment. KODA constructs unified multimodal kernels through modality-wise kernel composition and formulates discrepancy discovery as a constrained optimization problem that searches for coherent structures in one representation while suppressing coherence in a reference representation. This yields interpretable discrepancy directions associated with specific sample subsets and modality interactions. To scale KODA to large vision-language datasets, we develop randomized low-dimensional approximations of joint kernels using random projections, including Random Fourier Features for shift-invariant kernels. Empirically, KODA identifies consistent and interpretable discrepancy structures across vision-language representations and provides sample subsets for representation alignment. The code is available at https://github.com/yokiwuuu/KODA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KODA框架，通过核方法对比分析CLIP和SigLIP等视觉-语言基础模型表示的结构差异，发现可解释的聚类差异方向并实现表示对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型通常仅通过下游任务性能比较，未能解释其表示在结构上的本质差异。
AI.method: 提出KODA（Kernel Optimization for Discrepancy Analysis），构建统一多模态核，通过约束优化搜索在一个表示中强聚类而在另一表示中弱聚类的样本子集，并采用随机傅里叶特征等随机投影技术实现大规模数据扩展。
AI.result: KODA能够识别视觉-语言表示间一致且可解释的差异结构，并提供用于表示对齐的样本子集。
AI.conclusion: KODA为对比分析多模态表示的结构差异提供了有效且可解释的框架，有助于理解不同视觉-语言模型的内在特性。

title: D$^3$-MoE:Dual Disentangled Diffusion Mixture-of-Experts for Style-Controllable End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Traditional end-to-end autonomous driving frameworks frequently suffer from the "style-averaging" dilemma when trained on high-variance human demonstrations, yielding homogenized, style-uncontrollable, and even kinematically unsafe policies. To overcome this limitation, we present D$^3$-MoE (Dual Disentangled Diffusion Mixture-of-Experts), which disentangles trajectory modeling along two complementary axes. On the behavioral axis, generation is decoupled from selection: a style-conditioned diffusion process synthesizes multi-style candidate trajectories in parallel within a single scene, allowing a downstream module to select the optimal trajectory based on user preference or an evaluation score. On the physical axis, decoupled longitudinal and lateral routers activate their respective experts during inference time, trained without manual labels using self-supervised targets from orthogonal ground-truth kinematics. These activated experts, architected as Diffusion Transformers (DiT) and equipped with style-conditioned AdaLN and asymmetric lateral-fusion cross-attention, independently predict their corresponding physical state before being reassembled into a unified, kinematically coherent trajectory. Extensive evaluations on the challenging NAVSIM benchmark demonstrate that D$^3$-MoE achieves state-of-the-art planning performance, reaching 88.2 PDMS and 84.3 EPDMS by default. Moreover, our Best-of-Three ensemble strategy effectively broadens the multi-modal solution space, raising performance to 91.3 PDMS and 87.5 EPDMS. Both quantitative and qualitative analyses jointly confirm the framework's advantages in planning quality and style controllability.

AI.tldr: 提出D³-MoE框架，通过行为轴（生成与选择解耦）和物理轴（纵向/横向路由解耦）的双重解耦，结合扩散Transformer和专家混合，实现了高质量、风格可控的自动驾驶轨迹规划，在NAVSIM基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 传统端到端自动驾驶框架在高方差人类示范数据训练时面临"风格平均化"困境，产生同质化、风格不可控甚至运动学上不安全的策略。
AI.method: 行为轴上，将轨迹生成与选择解耦，利用风格条件扩散过程并行合成多风格候选轨迹，再由下游模块根据用户偏好或评分选择最优轨迹。物理轴上，解耦的纵向和横向路由器在推理时激活各自的专家（基于自监督学习，无需人工标注），这些专家采用扩散Transformer架构，配备风格条件AdaLN和非对称横向融合交叉注意力，独立预测对应物理状态后重新组合为运动学一致的轨迹。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM基准上，默认配置达到88.2 PDMS和84.3 EPDMS；Best-of-Three集成策略将性能提升至91.3 PDMS和87.5 EPDMS，实现了SOTA规划性能。
AI.conclusion: 定量和定性分析共同证实了该框架在规划质量和风格可控性方面的优势。

title: Ultra-Fast Neural Video Compression
summary: While neural video codecs (NVCs) have demonstrated superior compression ratio, their prohibitive computational complexity remains a critical barrier to real-world deployment. This paper introduces a chunk-based coding framework designed to significantly improve the rate-distortion-complexity trade-off. Instead of processing frames sequentially, our approach encodes a chunk of multiple frames into a single compact latent representation and decodes them simultaneously. This is enabled by cross-frame interaction modules for joint spatial-temporal modeling and frame-specific decoders for parallel reconstruction. This paradigm not only dramatically enhances coding throughput but also facilitates more effective modeling of long-term temporal correlations. To further boost speed, we propose a streamlined entropy coding mechanism that consolidates bit-stream interactions into a single step, substantially reducing decoding overhead. Building on these innovations, we present DCVC-UF (Ultra-Fast), a new NVC that sets a new SOTA in performance. Our experiments show that DCVC-UF can achieve ultra-fast encoding and decoding speeds, significantly outperforming previous leading codecs. DCVC-UF serves as a notable landmark in the journey of NVC evolution. The code is at https://github.com/microsoft/DCVC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DCVC-UF，一种基于块编码的新型神经视频编解码器，通过将多帧编码为单一紧凑潜在表示并并行解码，大幅改善了率失真-复杂度权衡，实现了超高速编码/解码速度，达到了新的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管神经视频编解码器(NVC)具有优越的压缩比，但其过高的计算复杂度严重阻碍了实际部署，亟需一种能显著改善率失真-复杂度权衡的方法。
AI.method: 提出基于块(chunk)的编码框架：将一组帧编码为单个紧凑潜在表示并同时解码；引入跨帧交互模块实现联合时空建模；设计帧特定解码器支持并行重建；提出简化熵编码机制，将比特流交互合并为单步操作以减少解码开销。
AI.result: DCVC-UF在编码和解码速度上均显著超越先前的领先编解码器，实现了超高速性能，并在率失真-复杂度权衡上达到新的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: DCVC-UF是NVC发展历程中的一个重要里程碑，为神经视频编解码器的实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Exact Unlearning in Reinforcement Learning
summary: We formulate the problem of \emph{exact unlearning} in reinforcement learning, where the goal is to design an efficient framework that enables the removal of any user's data upon deletion request, i.e., the online learner's output after unlearning is \emph{indistinguishable} from what would have been produced had the deleted user never interacted with the learner. For any $ρ>0$, we show that there exists a reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that is $ρ$-TV-stable and supports an exact unlearning procedure whose expected computational cost is only a $ρ\sqrt{\ln T}$ fraction of the computational cost of retraining from scratch. We construct such a $ρ$-TV-stable RL algorithm for tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs), which achieves a regret bound of $\mathcal{O}(H^2 \sqrt{SAT} + H^3 S^2 A + {H^{2.5} S^2 A}/ρ)$, where $S, A, H$, and $T$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, the episode horizon, and the number of episodes, respectively. We also establish a lower bound of $Ω(H\sqrt{\!SAT}\! +\! {SAH}/ρ)$ for $ρ$-TV-stable RL algorithms, showing that our algorithm is nearly minimax optimal.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了强化学习中的精确遗忘问题，提出一种ρ-TV稳定的RL算法，支持用户数据的高效删除，其预期计算成本仅为从头重新训练的ρ√lnT倍，并在表格型MDP上实现了近乎最优的遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 为了满足用户数据删除请求（即被遗忘权），需要设计一种高效的强化学习框架，使得删除数据后的在线学习输出与用户从未参与学习时的输出不可区分，同时避免高成本的重新训练。
AI.method: 提出一种ρ-TV稳定的强化学习算法，用于表格型马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）。该算法支持精确遗忘，其预期计算成本仅为从头重新训练的ρ√lnT倍，并给出了遗憾界上界。
AI.result: 算法达到的遗憾界为O(H²√(SAT) + H³S²A + H²·⁵S²A/ρ)，并证明了Ω(H√(SAT) + SAH/ρ)的下界，表明算法近乎是最小极大最优的。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次在强化学习中形式化了精确遗忘问题，并提供了计算高效且理论上近乎最优的解决方案。

title: WAM-Nav: Asymmetric Latent World-Action Modeling for Unified Visual Navigation
summary: Visual navigation requires generating smooth and collision-free trajectories under complex geometric and physical constraints. Existing reactive policies that directly map observations to actions lack anticipatory reasoning, limiting their ability to proactively avoid obstacles. While visual imagination offers predictive foresight, conventional modular approaches separate scene prediction from policy learning, often leading to error accumulation and inefficient inference. To address these limitations, we propose WAM-Nav, a Latent World-Action Model for embodied visual navigation that jointly learns action generation and latent visual foresight, enabling more robust and foresighted navigation decisions without compromising inference efficiency. Specifically, WAM-Nav utilizes a shared Diffusion Transformer for asymmetric joint diffusion to concurrently generate long-horizon actions and short-horizon visual foresight, reducing the inference latency and visual error accumulation inherent in multi-step autoregressive rollouts. To further encourage smooth and consistent trajectory generation, we introduce a dual-stream contextual conditioning mechanism that integrates episode-level ego-motion history with sequential visual observations. Combined with a unified goal alignment module that preserves balanced representations across goal types, WAM-Nav naturally supports Image-Goal, Point-Goal, and No-Goal exploration within a single policy. Extensive experiments on the challenging ClutterScenes and InternScenes benchmarks demonstrate strong generalization of WAM-Nav, particularly on Image-Goal and Point-Goal navigation, where it improves success rates by 15.7% and 3.3%, respectively. Real-world deployment further validates effective zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving an average 85% task success rate across diverse indoor and outdoor environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WAM-Nav，一个基于潜在世界-动作模型的具身视觉导航框架，通过共享扩散Transformer联合学习动作生成与潜视觉预见，并在单策略中统一支持图像目标、点目标和无目标导航，在多个基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有反应式策略缺乏前瞻推理能力，难以主动避障；而传统模块化方法将场景预测与策略学习分离，导致误差累积和推理效率低下。为同时实现稳健的前瞻性导航和高推理效率，需将视觉预见与动作生成联合学习。
AI.method: 提出共享扩散Transformer进行非对称联合扩散，同时生成长时域动作和短时域潜视觉预见；引入双流上下文条件机制，融合运动历史与视觉观测序列；设计统一目标对齐模块，在单一策略中支持图像目标、点目标和无目标导航。
AI.result: 在ClutterScenes和InternScenes基准上，图像目标导航成功率提升15.7%，点目标导航提升3.3%；真实世界零样本迁移平均任务成功率达85%。
AI.conclusion: WAM-Nav通过联合学习动作生成与潜视觉预见，有效缓解了误差累积和推理延迟问题，实现了高效、鲁棒的前瞻性导航，并具备良好的跨场景泛化与零样本仿真到现实迁移能力。

title: Motion-Guided Causal Disentanglement for Robust Multi-View Cine Cardiac MRI Diagnosis
summary: Multi-view cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging provides complementary anatomical information and is widely used for noninvasive disease assessment. Recent transformer-based models have demonstrated strong representation learning capabilities for CMR analysis; however, they typically learn unified latent embeddings that entangle view-specific anatomical variations with disease-related features. Such entanglement biases classifiers toward structural attributes rather than view-invariant pathological patterns. This issue is exacerbated in low-data regimes, particularly for underrepresented cardiac conditions, where limited samples increase the susceptibility to shortcut learning and view-dependent decision boundaries. To address this, we propose a Motion-Guided View--Disease Disentanglement framework MoViD built upon a ViT-MAE backbone. The model explicitly factorizes latent representations into view-specific and disease-discriminative components using dual-branch supervised contrastive objectives and a gradient-reversal adversarial constraint that minimizes disease leakage into the view embedding. Additionally, an annotation-free temporal motion feature, derived from inter-frame difference maps, is introduced to localize the beating heart region and suppress background artifacts. A focal reweighting mechanism is incorporated into the contrastive loss to mitigate class imbalance. We evaluate the framework on a private clinical venous thrombosis dataset and two public benchmarks (M&Ms, M&Ms2). Across disease classification and cardiac segmentation tasks, our approach consistently outperforms standard transformer baselines and demonstrates competitive performance against large-scale pretrained foundation models, validating the efficacy of structural disentanglement in medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoViD框架，基于ViT-MAE骨干网络，通过解耦视图特定特征和疾病判别特征，并引入无标注时序运动特征和焦点重加权机制，解决多视图CMR成像中视图-疾病特征纠缠和类别不平衡问题。在静脉血栓数据集和两个公开基准上，该方法在疾病分类和心脏分割任务中优于标准Transformer基线，性能可媲美大规模预训练基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的CMR分析方法学习统一的潜在嵌入，将视图特定的解剖变异与疾病相关特征纠缠在一起，导致分类器偏向结构属性而非视图不变的病理模式。在低数据场景下（尤其是少数心脏疾病），这一问题因有限样本导致的捷径学习和视图依赖决策边界而加剧。
AI.method: 基于ViT-MAE骨干构建MoViD框架：(1) 使用双分支监督对比目标和梯度反转对抗约束，将潜在表示显式分解为视图特定和疾病判别组件；(2) 引入基于帧间差分图的无标注时序运动特征，定位跳动心脏区域并抑制背景伪影；(3) 在对比损失中融入焦点重加权机制以缓解类别不平衡。
AI.result: 在私有临床静脉血栓数据集和两个公开基准（M&Ms, M&Ms2）上，该方法在疾病分类和心脏分割任务中一致优于标准Transformer基线，并与大规模预训练基础模型性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 验证了结构解耦在医学图像分析中的有效性，通过显式分离视图特征和疾病特征，能够提升模型在低数据场景下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: Dual Advantage Fields
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning requires both long-horizon reachability estimates and local action comparisons. Dual goal representations provide value fields that capture global goal reachability, but they do not directly specify which action should be preferred at a given state. We propose Dual Advantage Fields, a policy-extraction method that turns a bilinear dual value model into a local advantage signal. Under bilinear dual parameterization, the goal embedding is the gradient of the value field with respect to the state representation. DAF learns an action-effect model that predicts the discounted feature displacement induced by an action and scores actions by the alignment between this displacement and the goal direction. In the realizable case, this score equals the goal-conditioned Bellman advantage, yielding a standard local policy-improvement guarantee. On OGBench locomotion, manipulation, and puzzle tasks, DAF improves aggregate RLiable metrics and performs strongly in settings where locally correct actions differ from direct movement toward the final goal.

AI.tldr: 提出Dual Advantage Fields (DAF)方法，利用双线性对偶值模型中的目标嵌入作为状态表示梯度，通过学习动作效应模型预测折扣特征位移与目标方向的对齐程度来提取局部优势信号，从而解决离线目标条件强化学习中的长程可达性估计与局部动作选择问题。
AI.motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习需要同时处理长程可达性估计和局部动作比较，现有对偶目标表示方法虽能捕捉全局目标可达性，但无法直接指定给定状态下应优先选择哪个动作。
AI.method: DAF方法：1) 利用双线性对偶参数化下目标嵌入是值场关于状态表示的梯度这一特性；2) 学习动作效应模型预测折扣特征位移；3) 通过计算动作引起的位移与目标方向的对齐程度来评分动作；4) 在可实现条件下，该评分等价于目标条件Bellman优势。
AI.result: 在OGBench的 locomotion、manipulation 和 puzzle 任务上，DAF提升了聚合RLiable指标，在局部正确动作与直接趋向最终目标不一致的场景中表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: DAF是一种有效的策略提取方法，将双线性对偶值模型转化为局部优势信号，并具有标准局部策略改进保证。

title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement
summary: Large vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly trained as conditional generative models over action chunks. Yet deployment produces mixed-quality experience-successful demonstrations, partial completions, recoverable mistakes, and failures-that is difficult to use with standard imitation. Full behavior cloning (BC) imitates failures, filtered BC discards useful sub-trajectories, and offline reinforcement learning adds a large critic. We introduce ForesightFlow, a self-guided flow-matching policy that augments each generated action chunk with a learned success-potential trajectory. The same flow proposes and scores candidate actions, enabling best-of-$K$ inference without an external critic. The key issue is that policy improvement and value calibration require different supervision: advantage weighting should emphasize high-quality actions, but applying the same weights to potential coordinates suppresses failure gradients and creates overconfident scores. We address this with decoupled advantage-weighted flow matching, applying exponentiated advantage weights only to action velocities while training potential velocities uniformly. We further derive a one-step boundary estimator for conditional flow matching, allowing advantage computation with a single stop-gradient forward pass. Across five BEHAVIOR-1K simulation tasks and five real-world bimanual tasks, ForesightFlow improves over imitation baselines, matches the strongest separate-critic baseline in simulation success, improves real-world success, and reduces training compute by $38\%$. Ablations show that decoupling prevents value hallucination, the one-step estimator preserves candidate-ranking fidelity, and self-guided sampling improves long-horizon execution.

AI.tldr: ForesightFlow是一种自引导流匹配策略，通过解耦优势加权流匹配和一步边界估计器，在不依赖外部评论家的情况下实现动作生成与评分，在仿真和真实世界任务中优于模仿学习基线，匹配最强分离评论家基线，并减少38%训练计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA策略在部署时会产生混合质量的轨迹（成功、部分完成、可恢复错误和失败），标准行为克隆会模仿失败，过滤式BC会丢弃有用子轨迹，而离线强化学习需要额外的大型评论家模型。需要一种能够自评估动作质量、无需外部评论家且能高效利用各质量级别数据的方法。
AI.method: 提出ForesightFlow：1) 自引导流匹配策略，为每个生成的动作块附加一个学习到的成功潜力轨迹；2) 同一流同时提出和评分候选动作，实现无需外部评论家的最佳K候选推理；3) 解耦优势加权流匹配：指数化优势权重仅作用于动作速度，而潜在速度均匀训练；4) 一步边界估计器用于条件流匹配，通过单次停止梯度前向传播计算优势。
AI.result: 在5个BEHAVIOR-1K仿真任务和5个真实世界双臂任务上，ForesightFlow优于模仿学习基线，在仿真中匹配最强分离评论家基线的成功率，提升真实世界任务成功率，并减少38%训练计算量。消融实验表明解耦防止值幻觉，一步估计器保持候选排序保真度，自引导采样改善长时程执行。
AI.conclusion: ForesightFlow通过解耦优势加权和一步估计器，有效解决了策略改进与值校准之间的监督冲突，实现了无需外部评论家的高效自引导决策，在计算效率和任务性能上均具有显著优势。

title: Implicit Fuzzification via Bounded Noise Injection for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Image segmentation remains fundamentally limited by boundary ambiguity arising from sampling-induced information loss and inherent uncertainty in pixel-wise labeling. Although encoder-decoder architectures such as U-Net achieve strong performance, they often produce overconfident predictions that fail to capture transition-region ambiguity. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{NoiseUNet}, a simple yet effective framework that injects bounded perturbations into skip connections to regularize cross-scale feature fusion. This mechanism enforces robustness to local feature variations and promotes boundary-aware representations. Theoretically, the perturbation induces an implicit fuzzification effect, yielding soft, data-driven memberships without requiring explicit fuzzy modeling. We further introduce \textbf{ThyR}, a real-world thyroid ultrasound dataset with inherently ambiguous boundaries. Experiments demonstrate that NoiseUNet consistently improves both segmentation accuracy and boundary fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出NoiseUNet，通过在跳跃连接中注入有界扰动来正则化跨尺度特征融合，解决图像分割中的边界模糊问题，并在自建甲状腺超声数据集ThyR上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有分割方法（如U-Net）在边界过渡区域产生过自信预测，无法捕获因采样信息损失和像素标注固有不确定性导致的边界模糊问题。
AI.method: 在编码器-解码器架构的跳跃连接中注入有界扰动，正则化跨尺度特征融合，隐式实现模糊化效应，生成数据驱动的软隶属度而不需要显式模糊建模。
AI.result: 在自建甲状腺超声数据集ThyR上，NoiseUNet在分割精度和边界保真度上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 跳跃连接中的有界扰动是一种简单有效的正则化策略，能增强模型对局部特征变化的鲁棒性并促进边界感知表示。

title: Metric-Aware Hybrid Forecasting for the CTF4Science Lorenz Challenge
summary: We describe our approach to the CTF4Science Lorenz challenge, a benchmark that mixes short-horizon forecasting, long-time distribution matching, and trajectory reconstruction across nine task pairs. The key discovery is that no single model family dominated all metrics. Instead, we built a metric-aware hybrid system that assigned a different predictor to each metric family: (1) synthetic-pretrained denoisers for full-trajectory reconstruction, (2) Lorenz ODE fitting and trajectory shooting for the first 20 forecast steps, and (3) histogram-tail substitution using synthetic Lorenz libraries for long-time evaluation. A representative mature submission from this system family scored 83.83551 on the public leaderboard, and a small follow-up stack of the same ideas reached 83.85529. We focus on the cleaner intermediate system because it captures the full method while remaining simple enough to reproduce and analyze, while the final submission can be understood as a conservative extension of the same backbone.

AI.tldr: 针对CTF4Science Lorenz挑战，提出了一种度量感知的混合系统：对完整轨迹重建使用合成预训练去噪器，对前20步预测使用Lorenz ODE拟合与轨迹投射，对长时间评估使用直方图尾部替换与合成Lorenz库。中间系统得分为83.83551，最终堆叠版本得分为83.85529。
AI.motivation: 发现没有单一模型能在所有度量指标上取得最佳表现，因此需要构建一个针对不同度量族分配不同预测器的混合系统。
AI.method: 构建度量感知混合系统：(1) 合成预训练去噪器用于完整轨迹重建；(2) Lorenz ODE拟合与轨迹投射用于前20步预测；(3) 基于合成Lorenz库的直方图尾部替换用于长时间评估。
AI.result: 中间系统公开排行榜得分83.83551，最终堆叠版本得分83.85529。
AI.conclusion: 度量感知的混合系统设计有效，中间系统结构清晰、可复现且易于分析，最终提交可视为同一骨干的保守扩展。

title: Generalization of World Models under Environmental Variability for Vision-based Quadrotor Navigation
summary: World models, learned generative models that predict how an environment evolves, have become a promising tool for sample-efficient robot learning. Yet how robust they are to environmental variability remains poorly understood. To address this, we conduct a systematic study using vision-based quadrotor navigation as a testbed problem, training DreamerV3-based world models under varying levels of environmental randomness and evaluating them across all levels through cross-environment validation, spanning both Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) pretraining and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. We then deploy all world models and associated navigation policies on a real quadrotor in unseen environments, including an open-loop run where the model receives just 2.5s of real sensory input before all sensors are cut off, leaving the system to navigate entirely in imagination over a 12m traverse. Our results show that world model robustness during SSL pretraining is a strong predictor of sim-to-real transfer: every model that generalized well in cross-environment SSL validation deployed successfully in the real world, passing through gaps as narrow as 0.67m, whereas the model that dominated simulation policy evaluation failed on the real platform. We further identify (a) the discrete latent size and (b) the training-sequence length as the dominant factors governing world model quality.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于DreamerV3的世界模型在视觉四旋翼导航中的鲁棒性。通过交叉环境验证和实物部署发现：自监督预训练阶段的鲁棒性是模拟到实物迁移成功的关键预测指标，而离散潜在变量大小和训练序列长度是影响世界模型质量的核心因素。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在样本高效的机器人学习中很有前景，但其对环境变化的鲁棒性尚未得到充分理解，因此有必要进行系统性研究。
AI.method: 以基于视觉的四旋翼导航为测试平台，训练DreamerV3世界模型在不同环境随机性水平下，通过交叉环境验证进行评估涵盖自监督预训练和强化学习微调两个阶段，并在真实四旋翼上部署所有模型，包括传感器切断后的纯想象导航实验。
AI.result: 自监督预训练中鲁棒性强的模型在实物部署中全部成功（穿越最窄0.67m间隙），而在模拟策略评估中表现最佳的模型在实物平台上失败。离散潜在变量大小和训练序列长度是影响世界模型质量的主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型在自监督预训练阶段的鲁棒性是模拟到实物迁移的强预测指标，为评估世界模型泛化能力提供了有效方法。

title: DSA: Dynamic Step Allocation for Fast Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion transformers have achieved state-of-the-art visual quality, but their high inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time applications. Recent distillation frameworks produce autoregressive video diffusion models with reduced latency, yet these models still use a fixed number of denoising steps per frame, wasting computation on predictable frames and under-refining challenging ones. We present DSA, a confidence-guided adaptive computation framework for AR video diffusion. DSA introduces a lightweight confidence head, trained jointly with the generator under a distribution-matching distillation objective, to estimate per-frame denoising reliability. At inference, this confidence signal dynamically adjusts the number of diffusion steps: simple frames terminate early for speed, while complex frames receive additional refinement. Our method requires no extra video data, no heuristics, and little architectural modification. Experiments show that DSA achieves real-time autoregressive video generation, reaching 22.63 FPS with sub-second latency on H100 GPUs, while maintaining competitive or superior VBench quality compared to recent autoregressive and bidirectional video diffusion models. Our results demonstrate that confidence-guided adaptive sampling provides an effective and practical path toward interactive video generation.

AI.tldr: DSA提出了一种置信度引导的自适应计算框架，通过轻量级置信度头动态调整每帧的去噪步数，简单帧提前终止、复杂帧额外精炼，实现了22.63 FPS的实时自回归视频生成，同时保持与最新模型相当的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散Transformer推理成本高，虽通过蒸馏框架降低了延迟，但每帧仍使用固定去噪步数，在可预测帧上浪费计算资源，而对挑战性帧的细化不足，亟需一种自适应计算分配机制。
AI.method: 提出DSA框架：1) 在生成器上联合训练一个轻量级置信度头，基于分布匹配蒸馏目标；2) 置信度信号在推理时动态调整每帧扩散步数，简单帧提前终止，复杂帧增加细化步骤；3) 无需额外视频数据、无需启发式规则、仅需少量架构修改。
AI.result: 在H100 GPU上实现22.63 FPS和亚秒级延迟的实时自回归视频生成，VBench质量指标与最新的自回归和双向视频扩散模型相比具有竞争力或更优。
AI.conclusion: 置信度引导的自适应采样为交互式视频生成提供了一条有效且实用的路径。

title: Training-Free Lexical-Dense Fusion for Conversational-Memory Retrieval
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code, data, and per-table receipts: https://github.com/Chrislysen/opsem
summary: Retrieving the few past turns that answer a new query across long multi-session histories is the retrieval bottleneck behind long-term conversational memory (LoCoMo, LongMemEval). Recent concurrent work, Nano-Memory, shows that scoring a session by the maximum query-turn similarity (late interaction, "Turn Isolation Retrieval") beats mean-pooled session embeddings. We do not claim that effect; we replicate it and ask what a training-free, CPU-only retrieval stage should add around it. We report four findings. (1) Fuse: score-level fusion of the late-interaction dense score with BM25, under a single leave-one-conversation-out weight, adds +8.8 to +17.2 points of LoCoMo Hit@1 over late interaction alone across six encoders (all p<1e-4), reaching Hit@1 0.752 / NDCG@5 0.829 (e5-large-v2), +11.2 pp over BM25. (2) An off-the-shelf web-search cross-encoder reranker over the fused top-10 hurts here, degrading Hit@1 by 6.9 pp (one reranker, one configuration). (3) A pooling-operator ablation shows top-k late interaction matches max-similarity, but a naive smooth-max (log-sum-exp) collapses for half the encoders. (4) The late-minus-early gap is large for all six encoders and tends to be larger for larger ones, while the marginal fusion gain shrinks; on LongMemEval-S, a lexical regime where BM25 saturates, the net fusion gain over BM25 is small and not significant. A per-category analysis frames the gain as a division of labor: dense late interaction helps most on multi-hop and temporal questions but trails BM25 on adversarial ones. The contribution is a controlled, reproducible account of a strong training-free retrieval recipe, not the late-interaction retriever itself (Nano-Memory's). We make no claim to a complete memory architecture; this is a retrieval-stage study.

AI.tldr: 本文在长期对话记忆检索场景中，复现并扩展了Nano-Memory的“晚期交互（Turn Isolation Retrieval）”方法，提出了一个无需训练、仅需CPU的检索方案。主要发现包括：（1）将晚期交互的稠密分数与BM25进行分数级融合（单一留一对话外权重），在六个编码器上Hit@1提升+8.8至+17.2点，达到Hit@1 0.752 / NDCG@5 0.829（e5-large-v2）；（2）现成的网页搜索交叉编码器重排序器在融合top-10上反而降低性能（Hit@1下降6.9pp）；（3）池化算子消融实验表明top-k晚期交互等价于最大相似度，但朴素smooth-max（log-sum-exp）对半数编码器失效；（4）晚期-早期编码差距在所有编码器上都很大，且越大编码器差距越大，但融合边际收益缩小；在LongMemEval-S（BM25饱和的词汇场景）上融合增益不显著。按类别分析表明：稠密晚期交互在多跳和时间问题上帮助最大，但在对抗性问题上不如BM25。本文贡献在于提供了可控、可复现的强无训练检索方案分析，而非提出新的检索器本身。
AI.motivation: 长期多会话对话历史中，检索与查询相关的少数历史轮次是长期对话记忆的检索瓶颈。现有方法（如Nano-Memory）提出基于最大查询-轮次相似度（晚期交互）的会话评分，但如何在此基础上构建一个无需训练、仅需CPU的检索阶段尚不明确。本文旨在系统性地探索和优化这一训练-free检索方案。
AI.method: （1）分数级融合：将晚期交互（最大查询-轮次相似度）与BM25分数进行加权融合，使用单一留一对话外权重。（2）重排序实验：使用现成网页搜索交叉编码器对融合后的top-10结果进行重排序。（3）池化算子消融：比较top-k晚期交互、最大相似度、smooth-max（log-sum-exp）等不同池化策略。（4）编码器规模消融：分析不同规模编码器的晚期-早期差距及其与融合增益的关系。（5）按问题类别（多跳、时间、对抗性等）进行细粒度性能分析。
AI.result: （1）晚期交互+BM25融合在六个编码器上一致显著提升，Hit@1最高达0.752（e5-large-v2），NDCG@5为0.829；（2）交叉编码器重排序导致Hit@1下降6.9pp；（3）top-k晚期交互等价于最大相似度，但smooth-max在半数编码器上失效；（4）晚期-早期差距随编码器规模增大而扩大，但融合边际收益缩小；在BM25饱和的LongMemEval-S上融合增益不显著；（5）稠密晚期交互在多跳和时间问题上优势明显，但在对抗性问题上不如BM25。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一种强健、可复现的无训练检索方案（晚期交互+BM25分数级融合），该方案在长期对话记忆检索任务上显著优于纯晚期交互或纯BM25。但本文强调这是检索阶段研究，非完整记忆架构；交叉编码器重排序在此场景下不适用；不同编码器规模和问题类别下的性能差异为未来研究提供了方向。

title: HORIZON: Recoverability-Governed Curriculum for Physical-Domain Scaling
summary: Scaling robust robot policies requires more than broader randomization, because physical-domain experience must remain organized and learnable throughout training. We study when a policy can benefit from harder physics and identify recoverability as a central constraint in on-policy physical-domain scaling. In on-policy training, new dynamics are useful only insofar as they remain close enough to the current policy to generate corrective on-policy data, rather than collapsing rollouts into unrecoverable failures. Using quadruped locomotion as a physically demanding benchmark for embodied generalization, we introduce HORIZON, a checkpointed frontier curriculum that expands physical domains only within the current policy's recoverable boundary. HORIZON uses rollback and boundary refinement to govern each expansion step, turning fixed randomization into a continual process of physical-domain growth. Experiments reveal three regularities of physical-domain expansion. First, direct domain widening is uneven across physical axes and often unlearnable without staged ordering. Second, domain composition is non-monotonic, and adding more domains beyond a compact core can dilute recoverable joint samples and reduce overall robustness. Third, offline distillation of isolated experts cannot substitute for the joint interaction generated by on-policy curriculum. Together, these results frame physical-domain generalization as a continual growth problem for embodied control, with recoverability as the organizing principle for on-policy expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HORIZON框架，在四足机器人 locomotion 任务中，通过检查点前沿课程（checkpointed frontier curriculum）在策略可恢复边界内逐步扩展物理域，揭示了物理域扩展的三个规律：直接域扩展不均匀且难以学习、域组合非单调且过多域会稀释可恢复样本、离线蒸馏无法替代在线课程产生的联合交互。
AI.motivation: 缩放鲁棒机器人策略需要超越简单的随机化增强，因为物理域经验必须在训练过程中保持组织和可学习性。现有方法缺乏对策略能否从更困难的物理域中受益的机制理解。
AI.method: 提出HORIZON框架，基于检查点前沿课程（checkpointed frontier curriculum），使用回滚（rollback）和边界细化（boundary refinement）控制每个扩展步骤，仅在当前策略的可恢复边界内逐步扩展物理域。
AI.result: 揭示了物理域扩展的三个规律：1) 直接域扩展在不同物理轴上不均匀且无阶段顺序时难以学习；2) 域组合非单调，核心域之外的额外域会稀释可恢复的联合样本并降低鲁棒性；3) 离线蒸馏孤立专家无法替代在线课程产生的联合交互。
AI.conclusion: 物理域泛化是一个持续增长问题，可恢复性（recoverability）是在线策略物理域扩展的组织原则。

title: Stateful Visual Encoders for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in multi-image, multi-turn agentic settings where decisions depend on visual changes. However, in existing open-weight VLMs, visual comparisons happen only inside the language model, while the visual encoder itself remains stateless: each image is encoded independently, without access to the prior visual context. As a result, small but task-critical changes may be attenuated before the language model has a chance to compare them, especially when those changes do not affect the high-level semantics of the scene. We introduce a Stateful Visual Encoder, which conditions each visual representation on prior visual features. Under supervised finetuning, VLMs equipped with stateful encoders achieve consistent improvements on controlled tasks involving cross-image spatial aggregation, multi-object visual differencing, and visual trajectory behavior cloning. These improvements are consistent across input resolutions, language model sizes, and VLM backbones. Finally, we validate our model on real-world tasks, including longitudinal radiology, fine-grained image comparison, and remote sensing, where stateful encoders consistently improve generalist VLM baselines and can match or surpass specialized models in selected domains. Project page: https://statefulvisualencoders.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出Stateful Visual Encoder，通过在视觉编码器中引入跨图像的状态记忆机制，使VLM在多图、多轮对话场景中能感知视觉变化，在跨图像空间聚合、多目标视觉差分、轨迹行为克隆等任务上持续优于基线，并在真实任务（纵向放射学、细粒度图像比较、遥感）中匹配或超越专用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有开源VLM的视觉编码器是无状态的，每张图像独立编码，缺乏对先前视觉上下文的访问。这导致小但关键的任务相关视觉变化在进入语言模型前可能被弱化，尤其当这些变化不影响场景的高层语义时。
AI.method: 提出Stateful Visual Encoder，将先前的视觉特征作为条件输入到当前图像的视觉编码过程中。采用监督微调方式，使VLM在跨图像交互任务中具备视觉状态记忆能力。
AI.result: 在跨图像空间聚合、多目标视觉差分、视觉轨迹行为克隆等任务上取得一致提升；在不同输入分辨率、语言模型规模和VLM骨干网络上均表现稳定；在纵向放射学、细粒度图像比较、遥感等真实任务中，持续提升通用VLM基线，并在部分领域匹配或超越专用模型。
AI.conclusion: Stateful Visual Encoder有效弥补了现有VLM在多图、多轮场景中视觉状态缺失的问题，是一种轻量且通用的改进方案，可显著提升VLM在依赖视觉变化比较的任务中的表现。

title: A Geometric View of Counterfactual Behavior: Interaction of Boundary Proximity and Local Support
summary: Counterfactual explanations seek small, semantically meaningful changes to an input that alter a model's prediction, and are widely used to interpret and audit machine learning systems. In modern vision, language, and multimodal systems, pretrained encoders map inputs to representation spaces, and downstream classifier heads impose decision boundaries within those spaces. As a result, the feasibility and distance of nearby counterfactuals depend on boundary placement relative to the data. Yet models with similar predictive performance can differ substantially in whether such changes are achievable and how far representations must move. This work examines this variation using a standardized local search probe across several pretrained encoders and linear classifier heads. Results show that despite similar predictive performance, models differ substantially in their counterfactual behavior. Under fixed representations, varying only the classifier head alters counterfactual outcomes while leaving predictive performance largely unchanged. This variation is explained by the interaction of decision-boundary proximity and local data support, which jointly determine whether prediction changes are both feasible and lie in regions supported by the data, and can also improve counterfactual search within fixed models. Together, these findings identify counterfactual behavior as a distinct dimension beyond predictive performance and show that it can be altered without changing accuracy, with implications for model selection, robustness, and the reliability of counterfactual methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在预训练编码器+线性分类器架构下，即使模型预测性能相似，不同模型在反事实解释行为上存在显著差异。仅改变分类器头部即可改变反事实结果而几乎不影响预测性能，这种差异由决策边界邻近性与局部数据支撑的交互决定。反事实行为是独立于预测性能的维度，可在不改变准确率的前提下被调整。
AI.motivation: 探究在预测性能相似的视觉、语言和多模态系统中，反事实解释行为是否存在显著差异，以及这种差异的来源和机制。
AI.method: 使用标准化局部搜索探针（local search probe），在多个预训练编码器和线性分类器头上进行系统实验，对比不同模型的反事实行为，分析决策边界与数据分布的关系。
AI.result: 1）预测性能相近的模型在反事实行为上差异显著；2）固定表征仅改变分类器头即可改变反事实结果而预测性能基本不变；3）反事实行为的差异由决策边界邻近性与局部数据支撑的交互作用决定。
AI.conclusion: 反事实行为是独立于预测性能的模型评估维度，可在不改变准确率的前提下被调整，这对模型选择、鲁棒性和反事实方法的可靠性具有重要意义。

title: X4Val: Learning Neural Surrogates for Variance-Reduced Policy Evaluation
summary: Rigorous evaluation of learning-based robotic systems is an essential prerequisite for deployment. However, real-world test data is expensive to gather; moreover, in a typical iterative development context, data gathered from the latest policy is necessarily limited in scale. This motivates evaluation methodologies that make use of heterogeneous data sources, including simulation, historical policy logs, and data collected from related platforms or environments. While such auxiliary data are abundant and inexpensive, they are generally not directly representative of real-world outcomes -- for example, performance in simulation may differ substantially from performance in the real world -- making their principled use for high-confidence performance estimation challenging. In this paper, we introduce X4Val, a general framework for variance-reduced real-world metric estimation in the presence of non-paired, multi-domain data. X4Val embeds samples from real and auxiliary domains into a shared representation space and learns a transferable predictor of real-world metrics; this learned predictor is then incorporated into a control-variates estimator, enabling variance reduction even when paired samples are unavailable. We provide theoretical analysis and empirical evaluations on autonomous driving and real-world robot manipulation tasks, domains across which X4Val achieves up to 38.4% variance reduction and demonstrates consistent improvements over strong baselines. These results show that non-paired, heterogeneous data can be leveraged to substantially improve the sample efficiency of rigorous robotic system validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出X4Val框架，利用非配对的异构辅助数据（仿真、历史日志、相关平台数据）进行方差缩减的真实世界指标估计，在自动驾驶和机器人操作任务上实现高达38.4%的方差缩减。
AI.motivation: 真实世界测试数据昂贵且有限，而辅助数据（仿真、历史日志等）丰富但存在分布偏移，难以直接用于高置信度的性能估计。需要一种能够原则性地利用异构数据源进行高效评估的方法。
AI.method: X4Val将真实域和辅助域样本嵌入共享表示空间，学习可迁移的真实世界指标预测器，然后将该预测器作为控制变量纳入估计器，在无配对样本条件下实现方差缩减。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶和真实机器人操作任务上，X4Val实现高达38.4%的方差缩减，持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 非配对的异构数据可以被有效利用来显著提升机器人系统验证的样本效率，X4Val为在实际部署前利用多源数据提供了一种原则性框架。

title: Hyper-ICL: Attention Calibration with Hyperbolic Anchor Distillation for Multimodal In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Multimodal In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a practical inference paradigm for Multimodal Large Language Models, where a small set of interleaved image-text In-Context Demonstrations (ICDs) conditions the model to solve new tasks. Despite its flexibility, multimodal ICL incurs high inference latency and suffers from instability due to sensitivity to demonstration formatting, ordering, and content. To address these limitations, we propose Hyper-ICL, a lightweight, training-based framework for demonstration-free multimodal ICL that reconstructs demonstration effects directly without requiring ICDs at inference time. Hyper-ICL learns a parameter-efficient low-rank logit-level adapter that calibrates attention distributions to better match demonstration-induced attention redistribution. To capture how demonstration influence varies across queries, we introduce a query-adaptive modulation mechanism that adaptively controls intervention strength at token level across layers and heads based on the current query. Finally, we propose a layer-wise hyperbolic anchor distillation loss that aligns intermediate student features to a demonstration-conditioned teacher via Lorentz geodesic distance. This loss encourages the student to reconstruct the demonstration-query relationships induced by ICDs. Extensive experiments across six different multimodal benchmarks (including VQAv2, OK-VQA, and COCO Caption) demonstrate that Hyper-ICL consistently improves accuracy and stability over vanilla ICL and existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper-ICL，一种无需推理时提供上下文演示(demonstration-free)的多模态上下文学习框架，通过参数高效的logit级低秩适配器、查询自适应调制机制和层间双曲锚点蒸馏损失，在不牺牲性能的前提下消除ICL推理延迟和不稳定性问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态ICL虽灵活，但存在高推理延迟和对演示格式、顺序、内容敏感的稳定性问题，亟需一种无需演示即可重建演示效果的方法。
AI.method: 1) 参数高效的logit级低秩适配器，校准注意力分布以匹配演示诱导的注意力重分布；2) 查询自适应调制机制，在token级别跨层跨头自适应控制干预强度；3) 层间双曲锚点蒸馏损失，通过Lorentz测地距离对齐学生与演示条件教师之间的中间特征。
AI.result: 在VQAv2、OK-VQA、COCO Caption等6个多模态基准上，Hyper-ICL在准确率和稳定性上一致优于标准ICL和现有方法。
AI.conclusion: Hyper-ICL通过训练方式有效消除了推理时对演示的依赖，同时保持甚至提升多模态ICL的性能和稳定性，为高效多模态上下文学习提供了新范式。

title: Edge of Stability Selectively Shapes Learning Across the Data Distribution
summary: Existing analyses of the edge of stability (EoS) treat it as a global property of optimization. We show that it is also selective: the stability constraint redistributes learning across subsets of the training distribution, amplifying progress on some groups while suppressing progress on others. Using a branching intervention that enters or exits the EoS regime from the same training state, we causally demonstrate this trade-off and identify two necessary conditions for a group to benefit. First, its aggregate gradient must align with the top Hessian eigenvector. We isolate this mechanism with a controlled perturbation that preserves distance but randomizes direction, destroying alignment and eliminating the advantage. Second, the group must sustain non-vanishing gradient magnitude over time. Under cross-entropy loss, gradient saturation decouples confidently classified groups, shifting the advantage to output-outliers, whose gradients persist. Together, these results show that EoS functions not only as a stability boundary, but as a mechanism governing the allocation of learning across the data distribution.

AI.tldr: 边缘稳定性（EoS）不仅是优化的全局属性，还是一种选择性机制：它会在数据分布的不同子集之间重新分配学习，放大某些组别的学习进展，同时抑制其他组别。研究发现，一个组别要从中受益需满足两个条件：其聚合梯度需与Hessian矩阵的主特征向量对齐，且其梯度幅值需随时间不消失。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将边缘稳定性（EoS）视为优化过程的全局属性，但作者发现EoS具有选择性——它并非均匀地影响所有训练样本，而是以一种有偏向的方式重新分配学习资源，因此需要揭示其背后的因果机制。
AI.method: 通过分支干预（branching intervention），从同一训练状态进入或退出EoS regime，因果性地展示学习分配中的权衡。通过受控扰动（保持距离但随机化方向）破坏梯度与Hessian主特征向量的对齐，以及分析交叉熵损失下的梯度饱和现象，来验证两个必要条件的因果作用。
AI.result: 1) 聚合梯度与Hessian主特征向量对齐是组别从EoS受益的必要条件；2) 在交叉熵损失下，梯度饱和会使已自信分类的组别与EoS解耦，优势转移到输出异常值（梯度持续存在的组别）。
AI.conclusion: 边缘稳定性不仅是稳定性的边界，更是一种控制学习在数据分布上分配的核心机制，揭示了优化动态中隐含的公平性与选择性权衡。

title: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
summary: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.

AI.tldr: GRAIL提出了一种完全虚拟的数字化生成管线，通过组合3D资产、仿真场景和视频基础模型先验合成人机交互数据，无需物理环境搭建或遥操作，训练的人形机器人策略在真实世界中捡拾物体成功率达84%，爬楼梯成功率达90%。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人操作与移动（loco-manipulation）的规模化扩展需要大量跨物体、全身运动和场景几何的机器人兼容演示数据，但遥操作和动作捕捉受限于物理搭建、演员穿戴和机器人操作，难以规模化扩展。
AI.method: GRAIL构建完全虚拟的生成管线：首先在仿真中指定物体几何、相机参数、度量尺度、环境深度和机器人比例角色等完备3D配置；基于这些先验生成视频并用于4D重建，利用模型化物体跟踪、人体运动估计和交互感知优化重建度量4D人-物交互轨迹；将运动重定向至人形机器人，并训练物体感知潜空间适配器和场景感知跟踪器两种通用任务跟踪器。
AI.result: 生成了超过20,000个序列，涵盖捡拾、物体操作、坐立和地形穿越等任务。仅使用GRAIL生成的数据训练视觉策略，在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现真实世界捡拾物体84%成功率、爬楼梯90%成功率。
AI.conclusion: GRAIL证明了完全虚拟的人机交互数据生成管线能够有效替代物理遥操作数据采集，在零真实世界演示的情况下训练出可部署的人形机器人策略。

title: 3DThinkVLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Latent 3D Priors via 3D-Thinking-Guided Co-training
summary: We propose a 3D-thinking-guided co-training framework that enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to perform 3D spatial reasoning implicitly during action prediction. Our core insight is that 3D geometry perception and 3D spatial reasoning are distinct capabilities that can be disentangled and injected at different feature hierarchies. During training, three tightly coupled components work in concert primarily within the latent space: (1) To gain geometric priors, a latent 3D geometry perception module aligns intermediate visual features with a 3D foundation model, acquiring low-level geometric cues without architectural modifications to the VLM backbone. (2) Complementing this, an online 3D reasoning distillation module mitigates the prompt-induced reasoning gap via a shared reasoning anchor token. During 3D VLM co-training, this anchor is emitted as the first output token to robustly encode spatial priors. During VLA training, it serves as an input token inserted between the task and action instructions, transferring high-level spatial thinking from explicit teacher reasoning prompts to student action prompts without chain-of-thought text generation. (3) These disentangled geometric and reasoning features are then united by a spatially augmented action integration, which jointly injects them into the action-query tokens as hierarchical spatial conditions to prevent action shortcuts. At deployment, our method retains only its lightweight adapters to perform implicit 3D reasoning, discarding the 3D foundation model and the teacher branch used for supervision. Consequently, it operates purely on 2D images without 3D sensors, external models, or explicit text generation while preventing catastrophic forgetting of the pretrained VLM, achieving state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, SimplerEnv, and real-world manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种3D思维引导的协同训练框架，使VLA模型在动作预测时隐式进行3D空间推理。通过解耦3D几何感知和空间推理能力，在不同特征层级注入，在训练时使用三个紧密耦合的组件（潜空间3D几何感知模块、在线3D推理蒸馏模块、空间增强动作集成模块），部署时仅保留轻量适配器，无需3D传感器、外部模型或显式文本生成，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏3D空间推理能力，且3D几何感知与3D空间推理是两种不同的能力，需要在不同特征层级分别注入，同时避免对预训练VLM的灾难性遗忘和显式思维链文本生成的开销。
AI.method: (1) 潜空间3D几何感知模块：将中间视觉特征与3D基础模型对齐，获取底层几何线索；(2) 在线3D推理蒸馏模块：使用共享推理锚点token，在3D VLM协同训练时作为首个输出token编码空间先验，在VLA训练时作为输入token插入任务指令和动作指令之间，传递高阶空间思维；(3) 空间增强动作集成模块：将解耦的几何和推理特征作为层次化空间条件注入动作查询token。部署时仅保留轻量适配器。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、SimplerEnv和真实世界操控任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效赋予VLA模型隐式3D空间推理能力，无需额外传感器或显式文本生成，且不造成预训练VLM的灾难性遗忘。

title: Recover-LoRA for Aggressive Quantization: Reclaiming Accuracy in 2-Bit Language Models via Low-Rank Adaptation with Knowledge Distillation on Synthetic Data
summary: Aggressive weight quantization to 2-bit precision offers substantial throughput and memory gains for large language model (LLM) inference, but typically incurs severe accuracy degradation. These gains are particularly relevant for edge and on-device deployment, where memory capacity and bandwidth are primary constraints. In this work, we extend Recover-LoRA -- a lightweight, data-free accuracy recovery method originally developed for general model weight corruption -- to the setting of ultra-low-bit quantization. We propose a selective mixed-precision strategy in which only gate and up projection layers of the MLP are quantized to 2-bit (W2), while all other linear layers remain at higher precision, yielding a mixed-precision GateUp configuration. We demonstrate via roofline analysis across three model families (4B--20B) and two hardware platforms that a W4/W2-GateUp deployment (4-bit base with 2-bit gate/up) delivers 7.5--23.3\% TPS improvement over uniform W4 depending on model and context length, while confining quantization error to a predictable subset of layers. We then apply Recover-LoRA -- training low-rank adapters on the quantized layers via logit distillation with synthetic data -- to recover accuracy lost from 2-bit quantization of the gate and up layers. In a case study on Qwen3-4B, Recover-LoRA achieves 80--95\% accuracy recovery on 9 of 12 benchmarks, using only 10k synthetic training samples and no labeled data. We further demonstrate that synthetic data performs comparably to curated labeled data for distillation-based recovery, and that recovery generalizes to out-of-distribution evaluation tasks. Our results present Recover-LoRA as a practical post-quantization accuracy recovery tool for aggressive weight compression in deployment settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Recover-LoRA方法，结合选择性混合精度策略（仅量化MLP的gate和up投影层至2-bit），在不使用真实数据的情况下有效恢复超低位量化带来的精度损失，在Qwen3-4B上12个基准中9个达到80-95%的精度恢复，同时W4/W2-GateUp配置相比均匀W4可实现7.5-23.3%的TPS提升。
AI.motivation: 超低位量化（2-bit）虽能大幅提升LLM推理吞吐和内存效率，但通常伴随严重的精度下降。这一矛盾在边缘设备和端侧部署中尤为突出，因为此类场景对存储容量和带宽有严格限制，亟需一种轻量级、无需真实数据的精度恢复方法。
AI.method: 提出选择性混合精度策略GateUp：仅将MLP中的gate和up投影层量化为2-bit（W2），其余线性层保持更高精度。在此基础上应用Recover-LoRA方法，在量化层上训练低秩适配器，通过合成数据的logit蒸馏来恢复精度损失。
AI.result: 在4B-20B三个模型族和两种硬件平台上的roofline分析显示，W4/W2-GateUp配置相比均匀W4带来7.5-23.3%的TPS提升。在Qwen3-4B案例中，Recover-LoRA使用仅10k合成样本在12个基准中的9个上达到80-95%的精度恢复，且合成数据性能与人工标注数据相当，恢复能力可泛化到分布外任务。
AI.conclusion: Recover-LoRA是一种实用、轻量且无需真实数据的后量化精度恢复工具，能够有效支持部署场景下的大规模权重压缩，为超低位量化的实际应用提供了可行方案。

title: INTACT: Ego-Guided Typed Sparse Evidence Retrieval for Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception
summary: Collaborative perception extends the perceptual range of autonomous vehicles by sharing information across agents, but heterogeneous sensors and perception models make intermediate feature fusion difficult to deploy at scale. Existing heterogeneous collaboration methods typically follow a translation-first paradigm: collaborator features must be aligned, adapted, or projected into an ego-compatible space before fusion. Such feature-compatibility contracts improve fixed-system performance, but they couple deployment to collaborator-specific adaptation and make newly joined heterogeneous agents costly to integrate. To address this gap, we propose INTACT, an ego-guided typed sparse evidence retrieval framework for heterogeneous collaborative perception. Instead of translating an entire collaborator feature map, INTACT lets the ego vehicle issue typed evidence queries that express suspected objects and evidence-deficient regions. Collaborators respond only with local evidence at queried locations, and the ego selects useful responses through sparse per-query routing and injects them through gated residual write-back. This changes the compatibility requirement from global feature-map interpretability to local, typed response comparability under ego-issued queries, enabling a zero-training heterogeneous insertion protocol in which the ego interface is trained once and new collaborators join through checkpoint merging. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world heterogeneous collaborative perception benchmarks validate the effectiveness and deployability of INTACT. On OPV2V-H, INTACT achieves 80.1 AP70 with only 0.52M additional parameters and 18.0 $\log_2$ communication volume, corresponding to about 16$\times$ compression over dense feature transmission. On DAIR-V2X, INTACT achieves 43.8 AP50 under challenging real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: INTACT提出了一种基于自我车辆（ego）导向的稀疏证据检索框架，用于异构协同感知。它通过让自我车辆发出类型化证据查询，协作方仅响应局部查询位置，实现了无需训练即可插入异构新代理的协议，在OPV2V-H和DAIR-V2X数据集上取得了优异性能，同时显著降低了参数量和通信开销。
AI.motivation: 现有异构协同感知方法采用"先翻译后融合"范式，要求协作方特征必须对齐到自我车辆兼容的特征空间，导致部署与特定协作方耦合，新加入的异构代理集成成本高昂。
AI.method: INTACT框架：自我车辆发出类型化稀疏证据查询（表达疑似目标和证据不足区域），协作方仅在被查询位置响应局部证据，自我车辆通过稀疏逐查询路由选择有用响应，并通过门控残差回写注入信息。将兼容性要求从全局特征图可解释性降为局部类型化响应可比性，支持零训练异构插入协议。
AI.result: 在OPV2V-H上，INTACT达到80.1 AP70，仅需0.52M额外参数和18.0 log₂通信量（约16倍压缩）。在DAIR-V2X上，在真实挑战条件下达到43.8 AP50。
AI.conclusion: INTACT通过查询-响应范式从根本上改变了异构协同感知的兼容性约束，实现了高效、可部署的零训练异构插入机制，在模拟和真实异构协同感知基准上验证了其有效性和可部署性。

title: RL Excursions during Pre-Training: Re-examining Policy Optimization for LLM training
summary: The standard LLM training pipeline applies reinforcement learning (RL) only after pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We question this status quo by training a LLM from scratch and applying RL, SFT, and SFT followed by RL directly to intermediate pre-training checkpoints. We find that RL is effective very early, and often matches the full SFT$\to$RL pipeline early as well. Through experiments on harder problems, we find that targeted pre-training data composition is a strong lever for RL effectiveness, even more so than model scale. Beyond reasoning accuracy, applying RL directly to base checkpoints expands the model's distribution; the sharpening effect reported in recent work arises only when RL follows SFT. The general capabilities of the model remain essentially unchanged by RL, while they degrade following SFT. Finally, we merge RL and SFT objectives by parallel averaging, which outperforms across all other training methods discussed, across metrics, while preserving general capabilities. Together, these results suggest that LLM training might benefit from an expanded use of RL.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了LLM训练中仅在预训练和SFT之后才应用RL的传统流程，发现早期应用RL同样有效，甚至可与完整SFT→RL流程匹敌；并行融合RL与SFT目标在所有指标上表现最佳，且RL能保持模型通用能力而SFT会导致退化。
AI.motivation: 质疑LLM训练中仅在预训练和SFT之后才应用RL的现状，探索在更早阶段（如预训练中间检查点）直接应用RL的有效性。
AI.method: 从零开始训练LLM，在预训练中间检查点上分别应用RL、SFT、SFT→RL；通过调整预训练数据组成、对比模型规模、并行平均融合RL与SFT目标等方式进行系统实验。
AI.result: RL在早期阶段即有效，常与完整SFT→RL流程匹敌；预训练数据组成比模型规模对RL效果影响更大；RL保持通用能力而SFT导致退化；并行融合RL与SFT目标在所有训练方法和指标上表现最优。
AI.conclusion: LLM训练可能受益于更广泛地使用RL，建议重新考虑RL在训练流程中的位置与角色。

title: Radiomic Feature Selection Using Gradient Loss of Deep Neural Network for Lung Cancer Stage Detection
summary: Radiomics enables extraction of quantitative imaging biomarkers from medical images and has become an important tool for computer-aided cancer diagnosis.
