By utilising multi-task reinforcement learning, we aim to improve the training effectiveness, as well as the reusability of learnt policies to take a step towards more sustainable procedures in autonomous reef monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用上下文多任务强化学习（Contextual Multi-Task RL）来训练自主水下航行器的控制策略，使其能够在高度不确定和非平稳的水下动力学环境中执行多种珊瑚礁监测任务（如检测牡蛎或珊瑚），并在HoloOcean仿真环境中验证了该方法在样本效率、零样本泛化和抗流干扰方面的优势。
AI.motivation: 自主水下航行器在海洋生态系统监测中具有巨大潜力，但由于水下动力学的高度不确定性和非平稳性，其控制非常困难；传统单任务强化学习容易过拟合训练环境，限制了策略的长期实用性。
AI.method: 采用上下文多任务强化学习范式，学习一个依赖于上下文（任务描述）的单一策略，使其能够解决多个相关的监测任务；在HoloOcean仿真环境中进行训练和评估。
AI.result: 实验评估了上下文策略在样本效率、对未见任务的零样本泛化能力以及对变化水流干扰的鲁棒性方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: 利用多任务强化学习可以提高训练效果和学习策略的可重用性，向更可持续的自主珊瑚礁监测流程迈进一步。

title: Real-Time Automatic License Plate Recognition Using YOLOv8, SORT Tracking, and Temporal Data Interpolation
summary: The real-time hardships of video processing seriously limit the usage of Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) with application in dynamic traffic monitoring settings. High-fidelity recognition of unconstrained variables, e.g. drastic variations in illumination, acute camera scans, high vehicle speeds, and harsh physical concealment, is a problem that often leads to disjointed tracking paths and poor Optical Character Recognition (OCR) rates. In order to mitigate these weaknesses, the study proposes a 5 stage, end-to-end algorithmic pipeline, encompassing a smooth transition between deep learning based object detection, multi-object tracking which is kinematic in nature, and geometry temporal data interpolation. The suggested architecture takes advantage of a very powerful YOLOv8 nano model to localize the vehicle at the first stage and then Simple Online and Realtime Tracking (SORT) algorithm is used to build spatial-temporal links between frames. Another, more specific typology of YOLOv8 object detectors the license plate area, channeling the sliced array to an EasyOCR chain under the limitations of positional syntax verification. More importantly, an offline interpolation mechanism of temporal bounding box is initiated to recast fragmented paths.

AI.tldr: 提出一个5阶段端到端算法流水线，结合YOLOv8 nano车辆检测、SORT多目标跟踪、YOLOv8车牌检测、EasyOCR识别和时序边界框插值，以解决动态交通监控中ALPR系统因光照变化、高速运动等导致的识别率低和跟踪不连续问题。
AI.motivation: 视频处理的实时性限制严重影响了ALPR在动态交通监控中的应用，光照剧烈变化、相机扫描角度、车辆高速运动和物理遮挡等非受控变量导致识别精度低、跟踪路径断裂及OCR识别率差。
AI.method: 提出5阶段端到端算法流水线：(1) YOLOv8 nano模型进行车辆定位；(2) SORT算法建立帧间时空链接；(3) 另一YOLOv8分类器检测车牌区域；(4) EasyOCR与位置语法验证进行字符识别；(5) 离线时序边界框插值修复断裂路径。
AI.result: 通过深度学习的物体检测、运动学多目标跟踪和几何时序数据插值的平滑过渡，解决了动态场景下的识别与跟踪问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出的5阶段流水线能够有效缓解复杂交通场景下ALPR系统面临的识别精度差和跟踪不连续问题，提高了整体系统的鲁棒性。

title: Policy Gradient for Continuous-Time Robust Markov Decision Processes
summary: The framework of robust Markov decision processes (RMDPs) allows the design of reinforcement learning agents that satisfy performance guarantees under worst-case transition dynamics. Traditional RMDPs consider discrete-time dynamics and recently, sample-efficient policy gradient algorithms have been considered in this context. This paper investigates policy gradient algorithms within a continuous-time RMDP framework. Policy gradients and adversarial gradients are derived using pathwise and adjoint-based formulas for stochastic and ordinary differential equations. We propose double-loop optimisers to obtain linear convergence in the oracle-based setting and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{ε^2})$ sample complexity in the sample-based setting in an analysis which also derives novel tools for the framework of undiscounted total cost MDPs. Additionally, we propose mean-field optimisers as distributional optimisers with an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{1}{K})$ oracle-based convergence rate and an $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\frac{N^2}ε)$ sample complexity under $N$-particle approximation. The effectiveness of continuous-time policy gradient algorithms is confirmed for both optimisers on continuous-time RMDPs with neural ordinary differential equation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了连续时间鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（RMDP）中的策略梯度算法，提出了双循环优化器和平均场优化器，分别实现了线性收敛和分布优化，并在神经ODE动力学上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统RMDP考虑离散时间动力学，而连续时间RMDP框架尚未被充分探索，本文旨在将策略梯度算法推广到连续时间RMDP中，以应对更广泛的现实应用场景。
AI.method: 利用路径和伴随方法推导随机/常微分方程的策略梯度和对抗梯度；提出双循环优化器（oracle设置下线性收敛）和平均场优化器（分布优化）；在无折扣总成本MDP框架中开发新分析工具。
AI.result: 双循环优化器：oracle下线性收敛，样本复杂度$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/ε^2)$；平均场优化器：oracle收敛率$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/K)$，$N$粒子近似下样本复杂度$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^2/ε)$；在连续时间RMDP（神经ODE动力学）上验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: 连续时间策略梯度算法在RMDP中有效，两种优化器各有优势，为连续时间鲁棒强化学习提供了理论基础和实用算法。

title: DiscreteRTC: Discrete Diffusion Policies are Natural Asynchronous Executors
summary: Unlike chatbots, physical AI must act while the world keeps evolving. Therefore, the inter-chunk pause of synchronous executors are fatal for dynamic tasks regardless of how fast the inference is. Asynchronous execution -- thinking while acting -- is therefore a structural requirement, and real-time chunking (RTC) makes it viable by recasting chunk transitions as inpainting: freezing committed actions and consistently generating the remainder. However, RTC with flow-matching policy is structurally suboptimal: its inpainting comes from inference-time corrections rather than the base policy, yielding little pre-training benefit, specific fine-tuning, heuristic guidance, and extra computation that inflates the latency. In this work, we observe that discrete diffusion policies, which generate actions by iteratively unmasking, are natural asynchronous executors that resolve all limitations at once: they are fine-tuning free since inpainting is their native operation, while early stopping further provides adaptive guidance and reduces inference cost. We propose DiscreteRTC, which replaces external corrections with native unmasking, and show on dynamic simulated benchmarks and real-world dynamic manipulation tasks that it achieves higher success rates than continuous RTC and other baselines. In summary, DiscreteRTC is simpler to implement with 0 lines of additional code to enable async inpainting, faster at inference with only ~0.7 computation compared with generating actions from scratch, and better at execution with 65% higher success rate in real-world hockey defend task compared with flow-matching RTC, and 30% higher compared with training-time flow-matching RTC. More visualizations are on https://outsider86.github.io/DiscreteRTCSite/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiscreteRTC，利用离散扩散策略的原生掩码修复能力替代连续流匹配策略的外部修正，实现异步执行（边思考边行动），在动态物理AI任务中无需微调、减少推理延迟（仅需~0.7计算量），并在仿真和真实动态操作任务中比连续RTC方法成功率提升高达65%。
AI.motivation: 物理AI在动态环境中必须边行动边思考，但现有同步执行器即使推理再快也无法避免帧间暂停带来的致命问题。连续流匹配策略下的实时分块（RTC）虽然通过修复机制实现了异步执行，但其修复依赖于推理时的外部修正而非基础策略，导致预训练收益低、需要特定微调、依赖启发式引导且计算开销大、延迟高。
AI.method: 提出DiscreteRTC，基于离散扩散策略（discrete diffusion policy），利用其原生迭代去掩码（iterative unmasking）能力作为异步修复机制：无需额外代码即可实现异步修复（inpainting），支持早期停止（early stopping）提供自适应引导并降低推理成本，无需专门微调。
AI.result: 在动态仿真基准和真实世界动态操作任务中，DiscreteRTC相比连续RTC及其他基线方法取得更高成功率。具体地，在真实冰球防守任务中，成功率比流匹配RTC高65%，比训练时流匹配RTC高30%，且推理计算量仅为从零生成动作的~0.7。
AI.conclusion: DiscreteRTC实现更简单（无需额外代码启用异步修复）、推理更快（~0.7计算量）、执行更好（成功率显著提升），是物理AI异步执行的结构性更优方案。

title: MeshWeaver: Sparse-Voxel-Guided Surface Weaving for Autoregressive Mesh Generation
summary: Autoregressive mesh generation has gained attention by tokenizing meshes into sequences and training models in a language-modeling fashion. However, existing approaches suffer from two fundamental limitations: (i) low tokenization efficiency, which yields long token sequences and prevents scaling to high-poly meshes, and (ii) absence of geometry-aware guidance, as generation is conditioned only on global shape embeddings rather than local surface cues. We introduce MeshWeaver, an autoregressive framework that treats mesh generation as a surface weaving process by directly predicting the next vertex instead of independent coordinates. At its core is a multi-level sparse-voxel encoder that injects geometric context into the generative process in three complementary ways: providing voxel features as vertex representations, guiding token prediction via cross-attention to voxel features, and serving as a structural scaffold that constrains generation around the input surface. Our hierarchical design enables coarse-to-fine vertex prediction in a single decoding step, while tightly coupling the generative model with 3D geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MeshWeaver achieves a state-of-the-art compression ratio of 18%, can generate meshes with up to 16K faces, and significantly improves geometric fidelity over prior approaches.

AI.tldr: MeshWeaver提出了一种自回归网格生成框架，通过直接预测下一个顶点而非独立坐标，将网格生成视为表面编织过程。其核心是多层级稀疏体素编码器，以三种互补方式注入几何上下文：提供体素特征作为顶点表示、通过交叉注意力引导令牌预测、作为结构支架约束表面生成。该方法实现了18%的最优压缩比，可生成多达16K面的网格，并在几何保真度上显著优于先前方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归网格生成方法存在两个根本限制：(i) 令牌化效率低，导致长序列无法扩展到高多边形网格；(ii) 缺乏几何感知引导，生成仅依赖全局形状嵌入而非局部表面线索。
AI.method: 提出MeshWeaver框架，核心是多层级稀疏体素编码器，以三种方式注入几何上下文：(1) 体素特征作为顶点表示；(2) 通过交叉注意力引导令牌预测；(3) 作为结构支架约束表面生成。采用层级化设计实现在单步解码中完成从粗到细的顶点预测。
AI.result: 实现了18%的最优压缩比，能够生成多达16K面的网格，几何保真度显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将生成模型与3D几何紧密耦合，MeshWeaver有效解决了现有方法在令牌化效率和几何感知方面的局限性，实现了高质量、高分辨率的网格生成。

title: Federated Learning for Multi-Center Sepsis Early Prediction with Privacy-Preserving
summary: Privacy-sensitive and distributed characteristics of multi-center medical data bring severe obstacles to centralized modeling for accurate early prediction of sepsis. Federated learning (FL) has attracted growing attention as a promising framework for collaborative model development, as it allows multiple institutions to jointly train predictive models without directly sharing or centralizing raw data. Nevertheless, its practical performance, robustness, and privacy-preserving benefits remain insufficiently evaluated using real-world clinical datasets. To bridge this gap, this study systematically examines the application of federated learning to multi-center sepsis prediction. The experimental dataset consists of 648 clinically screened samples collected from three tertiary hospitals in China, with rigorous inclusion and exclusion criteria. We establish a centralized training paradigm as the performance baseline, and then implement a horizontal federated learning framework for distributed collaborative modeling. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the federated learning-based model achieves highly comparable prediction accuracy to the centralized counterpart, while fundamentally avoiding privacy leakage. Further privacy security analysis verifies that malicious attackers cannot reconstruct the original patient data from the transmitted model parameters, indicating strong resistance against data reconstruction attacks. This work not only validates the practicality and security of federated learning in clinical sepsis prediction, but also provides a reliable and feasible solution for privacy-preserving multi-center medical collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了联邦学习在多中心脓毒症早期预测中的应用，使用来自三家中国三甲医院的648份临床样本。实验表明，联邦学习模型在预测精度上与集中式模型高度可比，同时从根本上避免了隐私泄露，并能有效抵抗数据重建攻击。
AI.motivation: 多中心医疗数据的隐私敏感性和分布式特性严重阻碍了中心化建模在脓毒症早期精准预测中的应用，现有研究对联邦学习在实际临床数据集上的性能、鲁棒性和隐私保护效果缺乏充分评估。
AI.method: 采用三家三甲医院648份临床筛选样本，建立集中式训练范式作为性能基线，并实现横向联邦学习框架进行分布式协作建模。
AI.result: 联邦学习模型在预测精度上与集中式模型高度可比，且恶意攻击者无法从传输的模型参数中重建原始患者数据，显示出较强的抗数据重建攻击能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了联邦学习在临床脓毒症预测中的实用性和安全性，为隐私保护下的多中心医疗协作提供了可靠且可行的解决方案。

title: Learning While Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Generalist robot policies increasingly benefit from large-scale pretraining, but offline data alone is insufficient for robust real-world deployment. Deployed robots encounter distribution shifts, long-tail failures, task variations, and human correction opportunities that fixed demonstration datasets cannot fully capture. We present Learning While Deploying (LWD), a fleet-scale offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework for continual post-training of generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies. Starting from a pretrained VLA policy, LWD closes the loop between deployment, shared physical experience, policy improvement, and redeployment by using autonomous rollouts and human interventions collected across a robot fleet. To stabilize learning from heterogeneous, sparse-reward fleet data, LWD combines Distributional Implicit Value Learning (DIVL) for robust value estimation with Q-learning via Adjoint Matching (QAM) for policy extraction in flow-based VLA action generators. We validate LWD on a fleet of 16 dual-arm robots across eight real-world manipulation tasks, including semantic grocery restocking and 3--5 minute long-horizon tasks. A single generalist policy improves as fleet experience accumulates, reaching an average success rate of 95%, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出LWD框架，用于通用VLA机器人在部署后进行持续的离线到在线强化学习。通过车队级别的自主rollout和人类干预数据，结合DIVL（分布隐式价值学习）和QAM（伴随匹配Q学习），在16台双臂机器人、8个真实操作任务上实现了95%的平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略虽然受益于大规模预训练，但纯离线数据不足以应对真实部署中的分布偏移、长尾故障、任务变化和人类纠正等场景。需要一种能够在部署后持续学习改进的框架。
AI.method: 提出Learning While Deploying (LWD)框架，包含：(1) 部署-数据收集-策略改进-重新部署的闭环；(2) Distributional Implicit Value Learning (DIVL)用于鲁棒的价值估计；(3) Q-learning via Adjoint Matching (QAM)用于从基于流的VLA动作生成器中提取策略。
AI.result: 在16台双臂机器人的8个真实操作任务（包括语义杂货上架和3-5分钟长时域任务）上验证，单一通用策略随着车队经验积累持续提升，平均成功率95%，长时域任务提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: LWD能够有效利用部署中的异构稀疏奖励车队数据，实现VLA策略的持续后训练，验证了离线预训练+在线持续改进的范式的可行性和有效性。

title: A New Angle on Bones: Robust Pose Estimation in X-Ray and Ultrasound
comment: Code and annotations for fracture angle assessment in radiographs: https://github.com/multimodallearning/RobustBonePoseEstimation
summary: Measuring the angle between bone structures is a routine task in medical image analysis and provides a key quantitative parameter for diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated methods can reduce time and cost while improving reproducibility. In this work, we address automatic bone pose estimation using a learning-based point candidate proposal followed by a line model to extract axis parameters. Since conventional line models such as least squares are sensitive to outliers, we incorporate false-positive reduction strategies and robust fitting techniques, such as RANSAC and Hough transforms, to improve robustness. We evaluate our method on three clinically relevant paediatric angle estimation tasks: fracture fragment assessment in radiographs and ultrasound and developmental dysplasia of the hip evaluation in ultrasound using the Graf method. Our approach achieves mean errors of $4.1^\circ$, $5.4^\circ$, and $5.51^\circ$, respectively, not only remaining within the expected clinical observer variability, but also significantly outperforming landmark-based methods. Our code and annotations for fracture angle assessment in radiographs are publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于学习的关键点候选提议结合线模型（RANSAC/Hough变换）的自动骨骼姿态估计方法，在儿科X光片和超声图像的骨折角度评估及髋关节发育不良诊断中，平均误差分别为4.1°、5.4°和5.51°，优于基于标志点的方法并达到临床观察者一致性水平。
AI.motivation: 骨骼角度测量是医学图像分析中的常规任务，为诊断和治疗规划提供关键定量参数。自动化方法可减少时间和成本并提高可重复性，现有方法对异常值敏感，需要更鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用基于学习的关键点候选提议生成候选点，再通过线模型提取轴线参数；结合假阳性减少策略和鲁棒拟合技术（RANSAC、Hough变换）以克服传统最小二乘法对异常值的敏感性。
AI.result: 在三个儿科临床任务上：骨折碎片评估（X光片和超声）和发育性髋关节发育不良超声评估（Graf法），分别达到4.1°、5.4°和5.51°的平均角度误差，显著优于基于标志点的方法，且误差在临床观察者变异范围内。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自动骨骼姿态估计方法在多个儿科角度估计任务上有效、鲁棒，达到临床可用精度，代码和标注数据已公开。

title: Literature-Guided Minimax Optimization of Virtual Epilepsy Neurostimulation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Code and interactive essay at https://github.com/liuzhitong330/tvb-llm-robust-neurostim
summary: Computational models of epilepsy promise patient-specific treatment design, but most optimization workflows still search for parameters that perform well on average. In neuromodulation, this is a weak target: a protocol that improves the mean response can still fail in the patient whose network is least tolerant to stimulation. We present a literature-guided minimax pipeline that couples PubMed-scale hypothesis extraction, The Virtual Brain (TVB) Epileptor simulations, and large-language-model-guided black-box optimization. The optimizer proposes either intrinsic model-control parameters or clinically interpretable external-stimulation protocols; TVB evaluates each proposal across sampled virtual patients; and the objective maximizes worst-case reward, defined as the negative variance of simulated seizure activity. In the intrinsic model-control experiment, the best archived parameter set improved worst-case reward from -0.5285 to -0.3182, a 39.8% gain over baseline. The clinical-style external-stimulation search produced a much smaller worst-case improvement (1.7%), and a 20-patient virtual cohort showed no aggregate benefit (p=0.9019), despite a 55% responder rate and a positive temporal-lobe subgroup signal. The study should be read as an in silico proof of concept for robust, literature-aware neurostimulation design, not as clinical evidence.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种文献引导的minimax优化流程，结合PubMed级文献挖掘、TVB Epileptor仿真和大语言模型引导的黑箱优化，用于癫痫神经调控中的鲁棒性参数设计。在内在模型控制实验中，最坏情况奖励提升了39.8%；而在临床风格的外部刺激搜索中，最坏情况仅提升1.7%，20人虚拟队列未见显著群体获益（p=0.9019），尽管响应率为55%且颞叶亚组呈现积极信号。本研究仅为硅内概念验证，非临床证据。
AI.motivation: 现有计算癫痫模型中，大多数优化流程搜索的是平均表现良好的参数，但在神经调控中，仅改善平均响应的方案仍可能在网络耐受性最差的患者身上失效，因此需要一种保证最坏情况下性能的鲁棒优化方法。
AI.method: 构建了minimax优化流程，包含：1) PubMed规模的文献假设自动提取；2) TVB Epileptor对虚拟患者队列进行仿真评估；3) 大语言模型引导的黑箱优化器进行参数搜索。优化目标为最大化最坏情况奖励（定义为模拟癫痫活动负方差）。实验分为内在模型控制参数优化和临床可解释的外部刺激协议优化两类。
AI.result: 内在模型控制实验中，最优存档参数集将最坏情况奖励从-0.5285提升至-0.3182（增益39.8%）。外部刺激搜索中，最坏情况仅改善1.7%，20人虚拟队列未见统计显著的整体获益（p=0.9019），但响应率达55%，且颞叶亚组呈现积极信号。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了文献感知的鲁棒性神经调控设计的硅内概念验证，表明minimax优化在内在模型参数控制上有效，但外部刺激协议的鲁棒优化更具挑战性，不能作为临床证据。

title: Right Model, Right Time: Real-Time Cascaded-Fidelity MPC for Bipedal Walking
comment: Presented at IEEE ICRA 2026 Workshop "2cnd Workshop on Frontiers of Optimization for Robotics"
summary: This paper presents a multi-phase whole-body model predictive control (MPC) approach for bipedal walking, combining a detailed whole-body model in the near horizon with a simplified single-rigid-body model in the later prediction steps. This reduces computational complexity while retaining prediction capabilities. The resulting nonlinear optimal control problem is solved entirely within the general-purpose, off-the-shelf nonlinear MPC framework acados, using sequential quadratic programming (SQP). Given a contact schedule and a target walking speed, the controller optimizes joint torques without depending on preselected footstep locations. The controller is validated in MuJoCo simulation on the 18-DoF bipedal robot HyPer-2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多阶段全身模型预测控制方法，用于双足行走。该方法在近时间域使用详细全身模型，在远时间域使用简化单刚体模型，以降低计算复杂度。通过acados框架中的序贯二次规划求解非线性最优控制问题，控制器无需预设足迹位置即可优化关节力矩，并在HyPer-2双足机器人上进行了仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 双足行走的全身模型预测控制通常计算负担重，难以实时实现。现有方法常依赖预设足迹位置或过度简化模型，限制了行走的灵活性和预测能力。本文旨在通过多阶段建模策略，在保持预测能力的同时降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: 提出多阶段MPC：近阶段采用详细全身模型（完整动力学），远阶段采用简化的单刚体模型（SRBM）。整个非线性最优控制问题在通用非线性MPC框架acados中通过序贯二次规划（SQP）求解。控制器根据接触时间表和目标行走速度直接优化关节力矩，无需预选足迹位置。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo仿真环境中，该方法在18自由度双足机器人HyPer-2上成功实现了行走控制，验证了其有效性和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段建模策略有效平衡了模型精度与计算效率，结合通用优化框架使得该控制方法具有良好的可扩展性和实用性，为双足机器人的实时全身控制提供了可行方案。

title: Benchmarking Living-Screen-Native GUI Agents on Short-Video Platforms
summary: GUI agents today assume a static screen, where the world is frozen between two actions. However, real interfaces such as short-video applications violate this assumption, as their content keeps playing, and a competent user must decide what to watch and for how long. We formalize this task as Living-Screen-Native GUI agents and introduce LivingScreen, the first benchmark instantiating it on short-video platforms, with a faithful browser-based environment, a three-tier task suite, and metrics that jointly score accuracy and information efficiency. Evaluating extensive frontier models, we find that none reaches the human cost-accuracy performance, and that their dominant failure mode is over- and under-observation, pointing to observation control as a missing capability axis for future GUI agents. All data and code will be available at https://github.com/BITHLP/LivingScreen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"动态屏幕原生GUI代理"概念，构建了基于短视频平台的LivingScreen基准测试，发现现有模型在成本-准确性方面均不及人类，主要失败模式为过度观察和观察不足，指出观察控制是未来GUI代理缺失的能力轴。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI代理假设屏幕内容是静态的，但真实世界中的交互界面（如短视频应用）内容持续动态变化，用户需要决定看什么内容、看多久，这种观察控制能力是当前代理所缺失的。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义Living-Screen-Native GUI代理任务；2) 构建LivingScreen基准，包含基于浏览器的忠实环境、三层任务套件、联合评估准确性与信息效率的指标；3) 评估主流前沿模型并与人类进行对比。
AI.result: 所有前沿模型均未达到人类成本-准确性表现，主要失败模式是过度观察和观察不足。
AI.conclusion: 观察控制是未来GUI代理需要重点发展的能力维度，目前仍缺乏有效的解决方案。

title: Expectations vs. Realities: The Cost of MSE-Optimal Forecasting Under Conditional Uncertainty
comment: 12 pages, Accepted for KDD 2026 Research track
summary: Multi-step time series forecasting (MSF) is commonly evaluated using point-wise error metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), implicitly treating the conditional mean as a sufficient target. We show that this can be misleading under conditional uncertainty, where the conditional expectation becomes unrepresentative of typical realized values at longer horizons. We formalize this effect through a conditional uncertainty gap and prove that whenever this gap is nonzero, no deterministic predictor can simultaneously minimize MSE and match the marginal distribution of realized futures. This establishes a fundamental, model-agnostic trade-off between point accuracy and marginal realism in MSF evaluation. Using controlled stochastic dynamical systems and nine real-world forecasting benchmarks, we empirically characterize the resulting accuracy--realism frontier and \textbf{quantify the practical cost of MSE-only model selection}. As conditional uncertainty increases with forecast horizon, the attainable set expands into a pronounced Pareto front, separating MSE-optimal but under-dispersed predictors from methods that trade accuracy for realistic marginal variability. \textbf{Across benchmarks, we find that small relaxations in MSE ($\boldsymbol{\le 5\%}$) frequently unlock disproportionate gains in marginal realism, with median improvements of $\mathbf{17.3\%}$ and gains exceeding $\mathbf{30\%}$ in some datasets.} We further show that common forecasting strategies systematically occupy different regions of this frontier: direct multi-output predictors concentrate near the accuracy-optimal extreme, while recursive strategies and sample-based inference favors marginal realism. Together, these results expose a structural failure mode of MSE-based evaluation in long-horizon forecasting and recast strategy and inference selection as navigation of an unavoidable accuracy--realism trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文证明多步时间序列预测中，在条件不确定性下，点预测精度（MSE）与边际分布真实性之间存在不可回避的权衡。通过理论和实验表明，这种权衡会形成帕累托前沿，且小幅牺牲 MSE（≤5%）可带来显著的边际真实性提升（中位数17.3%）。不同预测策略（直接多输出 vs. 递归/样本推断）分布在该前沿的不同区域，揭示了基于MSE评估在长程预测中的结构性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 传统上多步时间序列预测使用点误差指标（如MSE）评估，隐式将条件均值视为足够的目标。本文发现当存在条件不确定性时，条件期望在长预测步长下无法代表真实实现值，这会导致误导性评估结果。
AI.method: 首先形式化条件不确定性差距概念，并证明只要该差距非零，任何确定性预测器都无法同时最小化MSE并匹配实现值的边际分布。随后通过受控随机动力系统和九个真实基准数据集，实证刻画精度-真实性帕累托前沿，并量化仅用MSE进行模型选择的实际代价。
AI.result: 随着预测步长增加，条件不确定性增大，可达集扩展为明显的帕累托前沿。将MSE小幅放松（≤5%）可带来中位数17.3%的边际真实性提升，部分数据集提升超过30%。不同预测策略分布在前沿的不同区域：直接多输出策略靠近精度最优端，递归策略和样本推断方法偏向边际真实性端。
AI.conclusion: MSE评估在长程预测中存在结构性失效模式，应将策略和推断选择视为在不可避免的精度-真实性权衡中的导航。

title: BiPneu: Design and Control of a Bipolar-Pressure Pneumatic System for Soft Robots
comment: Full Version of BiPenu, including the supplementary materials
summary: Positive-negative pressure regulation is critical to soft robotic actuators, enabling large motion ranges and versatile actuation modes. However, achieving high-performance regulation across both pressure polarities remains challenging due to asymmetric inflation-deflation dynamics, valve nonlinearities, and switching-induced flow disturbances. This paper presents BiPneu, a scalable and cost-efficient multi-channel bipolar-pressure pneumatic system for soft robots that enables wide-range, accurate, and responsive pressure regulation while providing seamless compatibility with high-level software ecosystems. A dual-mode sliding-mode controller (DM-SMC) with hysteresis-supervised mode selection is proposed based on a hybrid electro-pneumatic model. Extensive simulation and experiments demonstrate the superior performance of DM-SMC in tracking step and sinusoidal pressure references compared with both advanced model predictive controllers and well-tuned PID controllers. Experimental results show average absolute errors of 1.44 kPa in multi-step tests and 4.23 kPa in sinusoidal tracking, corresponding to reductions of 11.9% and 35.6% relative to PID control, along with improved control effort, valve switching rate, and transient response. Robustness of DM-SMC is further verified on a bellow actuator with pressure-dependent volume. Finally, BiPneu's capability is demonstrated via two soft robotic examples, quick ball-maneuvering with a soft parallel manipulator and real-time finite element method (FEM)-based teleoperation of a soft bellows actuator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiPneu，一种可扩展、低成本的多通道双极性气压软体机器人驱动系统，结合双模滑模控制器（DM-SMC），实现了宽范围、高精度、高响应的正负压调节，显著优于MPC和PID控制器，并通过软体并行操纵器快速控球和基于实时FEM的软体致动器遥操作加以验证。
AI.motivation: 正负压调节对软体机器人致动器至关重要，但现有系统因充放气不对称动力学、阀门非线性和切换流扰动等挑战，难以在两个压力极性上均实现高性能调节。
AI.method: 提出BiPneu多通道双极性气压系统，基于混合机电模型设计双模滑模控制器（DM-SMC），采用滞后监督模式切换策略，实现正负压双极性下的精准调节。
AI.result: DM-SMC在多阶梯测试中平均绝对误差1.44 kPa，正弦跟踪中4.23 kPa，相比PID分别降低11.9%和35.6%；控制努力、阀切换速率和瞬态响应均有改善；在压力依赖体积的波纹管致动器上验证了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: BiPneu系统结合DM-SMC在双极性气压控制中展现出优越性能，并通过软体并行操纵器快速控球和实时FEM遥操作两个应用案例证明了其实用价值。

title: Enhancing MedSAM with a Lightweight Box Predictor for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation in medical imaging is a critical yet challenging task due to data scarcity and high variability across modalities. While foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) show promise, they often struggle with medical images without specific adaptation. Moreover, point prompts, despite being the most natural form of user interaction, provide insufficient spatial context for reliable segmentation, particularly when target structures are irregular or poorly contrasted. In this paper, we propose an enhanced segmentation framework that integrates a lightweight Box Predictor module into the MedSAM architecture. The Box Predictor estimates an approximate bounding box from a single user click using localized image embedding features, providing spatial guidance that reduces the ambiguity of point prompts, while introducing only 1.6M additional parameters and negligible inference overhead. We introduce a two-stage training pipeline where the Box Predictor is trained independently before being integrated into MedSAM. To validate the generalization capability of our method, we conduct extensive evaluations on four diverse datasets (FLARE22, BRISC, BUSI, LungSegDB) spanning distinct imaging modalities, including CT, MRI, and Ultrasound. Our method improves segmentation accuracy and robustness across varied anatomical structures and imaging domains, achieving Dice scores of 0.89 (BUSI), 0.93 (FLARE22), 0.88 (BRISC), and 0.98 (LungSegDB). Code is available at https://github.com/Amirhosseinmovahedi/MedSAM-BoxPredictor

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种集成轻量级Box Predictor模块的MedSAM增强框架，通过单点点击生成边界框以减少点提示的歧义性，仅增加1.6M参数，在CT、MRI、超声四个数据集上取得优异分割性能（Dice: 0.88-0.98）。
AI.motivation: 医学图像语义分割面临数据稀缺和模态差异大的挑战，尽管SAM等基础模型有潜力，但未经特定适配时难以处理医学图像；点提示作为最自然的交互方式，却因空间上下文不足导致分割不可靠，尤其在目标结构不规则或对比度低的情况下。
AI.method: 在MedSAM架构中集成轻量级Box Predictor模块，该模块从单次点击利用局部图像嵌入特征估计近似边界框，提供空间引导来减少点提示的模糊性；采用两阶段训练管线：先独立训练Box Predictor，再集成到MedSAM中。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上评估：FLARE22（CT）、BRISC（MRI）、BUSI（超声）、LungSegDB，Dice分数分别达到0.93、0.88、0.89、0.98；仅引入1.6M额外参数，推理开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不同成像模态和解剖结构中均提升了分割准确性和鲁棒性，验证了良好的泛化能力，代码已开源。

title: MeshTok: Efficient Multi-Scale Tokenization for Scalable PDE Transformers
summary: Conventional patchified Transformers operate on uniform spatial partitions, distributing computational effort evenly across the domain irrespective of local features. This inflexible tokenization scheme is inherently limited in its ability to efficiently represent and process solutions to complex PDEs. To address this, we propose MeshTok, an adaptive mesh refinement (AMR)-inspired tokenization and sequence modeling framework. This method selectively refines spatial regions exhibiting sharp gradients, transient features, or multiscale structures, generating a heterogeneous set of multiscale tokens defined on a fixed simulation grid. These tokens are processed within a unified Transformer sequence, enabling the model to simultaneously capture coarse-grained global context and fine-grained local details without requiring specialized architectural components. Although adaptive refinement moderately increases token count, it promotes a more targeted allocation of computational resources to physically informative regions, which we view as a practical inductive bias rather than a formal optimality guarantee. Experimental evaluations across multiple PDE families and benchmark datasets demonstrate that MeshTok consistently improves the efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to uniform-grid baselines. This suggests adaptive multiscale tokenization as a scalable and generalizable design principle for neural PDE modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/SCAILab-USTC/MeshTok.

AI.tldr: MeshTok提出了一种受自适应网格细化(AMR)启发的自适应标记化框架，通过在不规则空间区域生成多尺度标记，在统一Transformer序列中同时捕捉粗粒度全局上下文和细粒度局部细节，相比均匀网格基线在PDE求解任务上实现了更好的效率-精度权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统基于均匀空间划分的patchified Transformer对复杂PDE解的表示效率低下，无法根据局部特征自适应分配计算资源，需要一种更灵活的标记化方案。
AI.method: 受自适应网格细化(AMR)启发，选择性地细化具有尖锐梯度、瞬态特征或多尺度结构的空间区域，在固定模拟网格上生成异构的多尺度标记集，并将其处理为统一的Transformer序列。
AI.result: 在多个PDE族和基准数据集上，MeshTok相比均匀网格基线持续改善了效率-精度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 自适应多尺度标记化可作为神经PDE建模的可扩展且通用设计原则，自适应细化虽适度增加标记数量，但将计算资源更针对性地分配给物理信息丰富的区域，形成实用的归纳偏置。

title: A Reproducible and Physically Feasible Dynamic Parameter Identification Framework for a Low-Cost Robot Arm
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables, 1 algorithm and 2 appendices
summary: This paper presents a reproducible and physically feasible dynamic parameter identification framework for CRANE-X7, a low-cost robot arm driven by modular smart actuators. To improve practical identifiability, products of inertia are removed according to approximate link symmetry, reducing the rigid-body model from 65 to 39 base parameters. Identification motions are hand-designed from structured single-joint and adjacent-joint primitives under practical joint-range limits. The proposed pipeline combines preprocessing, inverse-dynamics-regressor-based ordinary least squares (OLS), conditional semidefinite-programming (SDP) projection for feasibility recovery, and closed-loop input error (CLIE) refinement. Candidate solutions from 40 structured trajectories are analyzed in a common principal component analysis (PCA) space to select a statistically central representative model. Because statistical centrality alone does not ensure physical acceptability, the selected model is finally screened by an all-pose positive-definiteness audit of the inertia matrix and, when necessary, corrected by a localized post-CLIE SDP rescue step. Experiments show that the parameter cloud becomes progressively more concentrated from OLS to SDP and CLIE, while the final accepted model preserves high predictive accuracy on held-out validation motions. These results demonstrate a practical route to statistically coherent and physically feasible dynamic models for low-cost robot platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低成本机器人臂CRANE-X7，提出了一套可复现且物理可行的动力学参数辨识框架，通过去除惯性积、设计结构化运动、结合OLS/SDP/CLIE方法以及PCA统计选模与全位姿正定校验，实现了从65个参数缩减至39个基参数的高精度物理可行模型。
AI.motivation: 低成本机器人臂（如CRANE-X7）由模块化智能驱动器驱动，其动力学参数辨识面临物理可行性与统计一致性难以兼顾的问题，现有方法难以同时保证参数的可辨识性、物理可接受性与预测精度。
AI.method: 1) 根据近似连杆对称性去除惯性积，将刚体模型从65个参数缩减至39个基参数；2) 设计结构化单关节和相邻关节运动基元；3) 组合预处理、逆动力学回归OLS、条件SDP投影（保证物理可行性）和闭环输入误差（CLIE）精化；4) 在PCA空间分析40条结构化轨迹的候选解，选取统计中心模型；5) 对所有位姿进行惯性矩阵正定审计，必要时用局部后CLIE SDP修正。
AI.result: 实验表明，从OLS到SDP再到CLIE，参数云逐步集中；最终接受的模型在保留验证运动上保持高预测精度，证明了该框架能获得统计一致且物理可行的动力学模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低成本机器人平台提供了一条实践可行的动力学参数辨识路径，兼顾了统计一致性与物理可行性。

title: ReConFuse: Reconstruction-Error Guided Semantic Fusion for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: AI-generated videos are becoming increasingly realistic, raising serious concerns about misinformation, content authenticity, and media trust. Reliable AI-generated video detection is therefore essential for multimedia forensics, yet remains challenging due to the need to capture spatial artifacts, temporal dynamics, and generalize to evolving generative models. In this paper, we explore reconstruction error as a discriminative forensic cue for AI-generated video detection. By reconstructing input videos with a pretrained WF-VAE, we observe that real and generated videos exhibit distinguishable frame-wise reconstruction error patterns, suggesting that reconstruction errors can reveal their distributional discrepancies. However, extending reconstruction-based image detection to videos is non-trivial, since video reconstruction errors are temporally organized across frames and require semantic context for effective interpretation. To address these challenges, we propose ReConFuse, a reconstruction-guided semantic fusion framework for video-level AI-generated video detection. ReConFuse extracts reconstruction error cues from WF-VAE reconstructed videos, aligns them with multi-frame semantic features, and uses a Mamba-based module to model temporal evolution for video-level classification. Experiments across multiple generators and evaluation settings demonstrate the effectiveness and strong generalization ability of ReConFuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReConFuse框架，利用预训练WF-VAE的重建误差作为鉴别线索，结合多帧语义特征和Mamba时序建模，实现有效的AI生成视频检测。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频日益逼真，引发了 misinformation、内容真实性和媒体信任方面的严重担忧，亟需可靠且能泛化到不断演化的生成模型的检测方法。
AI.method: 提出ReConFuse框架：首先利用预训练WF-VAE对输入视频进行重建，提取帧级重建误差；然后将重建误差线索与多帧语义特征对齐；最后通过基于Mamba的模块建模时序演化，进行视频级分类。
AI.result: 在多种生成器和评估设置下的实验表明，ReConFuse具有良好的检测效果和强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 重建误差可作为AI生成视频的有效鉴别线索，结合语义特征和时序建模可提升检测性能与泛化性。

title: When Do Fewer Coordinates Suffice in DP-SGD?
summary: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) injects noise into every updated coordinate, making the injected noise energy scale with the ambient parameter dimension \(d\). We ask when private training can update fewer coordinates without losing the signal needed for optimization. We propose \textsc{TP-TopK} (Two-Phase TopK DP-SGD), a two-phase method for coordinate-sparse private training without public data, in which a private warm-up phase identifies a coordinate support used to guide the main training phase. We give a criterion characterizing when coordinate restriction can be beneficial, show via a nonconvex stationarity bound that under this condition the relevant noise term scales with the active dimension \(k\) rather than the full parameter dimension \(d\), and provide a lower bound on the reliability of warm-up-based coordinate ranking. Experiments on MNIST, FMNIST, and CIFAR-10 show that learned coordinate supports can retain more gradient energy than size-matched random supports, with the largest gains when the active dimension is small and warm-up scores are informative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TP-TopK，一种无需公共数据的双阶段坐标稀疏私有训练方法。通过私有预热阶段识别坐标支撑集，引导主训练阶段仅更新活跃维度k而非全参数维度d，从而降低DP-SGD的噪声能量。实验表明该方法在活跃维度小且预热分数有效时能保留更多梯度能量。
AI.motivation: DP-SGD对所有坐标注入噪声，噪声能量随参数维度d增长。作者探究能否在私有训练中仅更新少量坐标（即坐标稀疏训练），同时不损失优化所需的信号，从而降低噪声对高维模型的影响。
AI.method: 提出TP-TopK（Two-Phase TopK DP-SGD）双阶段方法：1) 私有预热阶段：通过DP-SGD训练少量步数，识别出重要的坐标支撑集（TopK坐标）；2) 主训练阶段：仅在该支撑集上进行梯度更新，其余坐标维持不变。该方法无需公共数据即可实现坐标稀疏的差分隐私训练。
AI.result: 1) 给出了坐标限制何时有益的判定准则；2) 证明了在该条件下噪声项与活跃维度k而非全维度d成比例（非凸平稳性界）；3) 提供了预热阶段坐标排序可靠性的下界；4) MNIST、FMNIST、CIFAR-10实验表明，学习的坐标支撑集比随机选择的同大小支撑集保留更多梯度能量，在活跃维度小且预热分数信息量大时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: TP-TopK有效降低了DP-SGD中噪声能量对参数维度的依赖，将噪声尺度从d缩减至k，为高维模型的差分隐私训练提供了可行的坐标稀疏化策略。该方法的关键前提是存在一个低维的坐标支撑集能够保留足够多的梯度信号。

title: DEFLECT: Temporal Counterfactual Preference Learning for Delay-Robust Asynchronous VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly rely on asynchronous inference to hide large-model latency behind ongoing robot motion. While this avoids the stop-and-go behavior of synchronous action-chunk execution, it creates a prediction-execution mismatch: the next chunk is computed from a stale observation at inference start but executed only after the robot and scene have evolved. As a result, actions that fit the prediction-time state can become misaligned with the execution-time state. Existing runtime repair, behavior-cloning, and preference-alignment approaches do not directly teach the policy to resolve this stale-input mismatch. We propose DEFLECT, an offline post-training framework for delay-robust asynchronous VLAs. DEFLECT converts latency-induced mismatch into counterfactual preference supervision: a frozen reference VLA generates a preferred chunk from the future execution-time observation and a rejected chunk from the stale prediction-time observation. The trainable policy scores both chunks under the same deployment-time input, learning to favor execution-time-aligned actions while a supervised fine-tuning anchor preserves the expert action manifold. DEFLECT requires no human preference labels, reward models, online robot rollouts, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. Across Kinetix, LIBERO, and three real-robot tasks, DEFLECT improves delay robustness over strong asynchronous VLA baselines, raising high-latency success by up to 6.4 percentage points and achieving a 4.6 percentage-point gain at the longest delay on a real-scale VLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEFLECT，一种离线后训练框架，通过将异步VLA策略中的延迟引起的预测-执行不匹配转化为反事实偏好监督，在不依赖人类标注、奖励模型或在线部署的情况下提升延迟鲁棒性，在多个基准和真实机器人任务上显著提高高延迟场景的成功率。
AI.motivation: 异步VLA策略中，由于大模型推理延迟，下一动作块基于过时观测计算，执行时场景已变化，导致预测-执行不匹配。现有方法（运行时修复、行为克隆、偏好对齐）未能直接教会策略解决这种过时输入不匹配问题。
AI.method: DEFLECT将延迟引起的不匹配转化为反事实偏好监督：冻结参考VLA用未来执行时刻的观测生成偏好动作块，用过时预测时刻的观测生成被拒绝动作块。可训练策略在相同的部署时刻输入下对两者评分，学习偏好执行时刻对齐的动作，同时用监督微调锚点保持专家动作流形。
AI.result: 在Kinetix、LIBERO和三个真实机器人任务上，DEFLECT相比强异步VLA基线提升了延迟鲁棒性，高延迟成功率提升最高6.4个百分点，在真实尺度VLA的最长延迟下获得4.6个百分点的增益。
AI.conclusion: DEFLECT是一种无需人类偏好标签、奖励模型、在线机器人部署、架构修改或额外推理计算的有效延迟鲁棒性提升方法。

title: Data Efficient Complex Feature Fusion Network For Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: This work presents a data-efficient variant of the Attention-Based Dual-Branch Complex Feature Fusion Network (CFFN) for hyperspectral image classification. The proposed model, termed DE-CFFN, retains the original two-stream structure: the Real-Valued Neural Network (RVNN) processes standard hyperspectral patches, while the Complex-Valued Neural Network (CVNN) handles their Fourier-transformed counterparts. The main contribution of this work lies in the feature extraction process and architectural enhancement. Factor Analysis is used for dimensionality reduction, offering improved latent feature representation over Principal Component Analysis. Additionally, both the RVNN and CVNN streams are structurally modified by successively halving the number of filters in the 3D convolutional layers to reduce complexity. The outputs of both branches are concatenated and passed through a Squeeze and Excitation (SE) block to enhance joint feature representation. Evaluated on the Pavia University and Salinas datasets, DE-CFFN achieves classification performance comparable to CFFN, while significantly reducing model size, memory consumption, and inference latency, making it suitable for real-time hyperspectral imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DE-CFFN，一种数据高效的注意力双支路复值特征融合网络，用于高光谱图像分类。该方法在保持原CFFN双流结构（实值网络处理标准高光谱块，复值网络处理傅里叶变换版本）的基础上，通过因子分析降维替代PCA、逐次减半3D卷积层滤波器数量、以及引入挤压激励（SE）模块增强联合特征表示，在Pavia University和Salinas数据集上实现了与CFFN相当的分类性能，同时显著减小了模型尺寸、内存消耗和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 原始CFFN模型虽然性能优异，但模型复杂度和计算开销较大，难以满足实时高光谱成像应用的需求。因此，本文旨在设计一种数据高效的变体，在保持分类精度的同时大幅降低模型规模和计算成本。
AI.method: (1) 保留原CFFN双支路结构：RVNN处理标准高光谱图像块，CVNN处理傅里叶变换后的对应物；(2) 使用因子分析（Factor Analysis）代替PCA进行降维，以改善潜在特征表示；(3) 对RVNN和CVNN两支路的3D卷积层逐次减半滤波器数量以降低复杂度；(4) 将两支路输出拼接后通过挤压激励（SE）块增强联合特征表示。
AI.result: 在Pavia University和Salinas数据集上，DE-CFFN实现了与CFFN相当的分類性能，同时显著减少了模型尺寸、内存消耗和推理延迟，适用于实时高光谱成像应用。
AI.conclusion: DE-CFFN通过因子分析降维、逐次减半卷积滤波器数量以及SE模块增强特征融合，成功地在保持分类性能的前提下大幅降低了模型复杂度和计算开销，为高光谱图像的实时分类提供了一种高效的解决方案。

title: From Symbolic to Geometric: Enabling Spatial Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary:
Recent large language models (LLMs) often appear to exhibit spatial reasoning ability; however, this capability is largely \emph{symbolic}, arising from pattern matching over spatial language rather than true \emph{geometric} reasoning over space. Because LLMs operate on discrete tokens, they lack native support for continuous spatial representations, explicit geometric computation, and structured spatial operators. To address this limitation, we introduce the \emph{Spatial Language Model (SLM)}, the first multimodal LLM that treats location information as a first-class modality and enables geometric spatial reasoning within the model's inference process. SLM directly operates on learned spatial representations rather than textual descriptions of spatial relations. To support effective training, we construct a \emph{Spatial Instruction Dataset} that aligns spatial representations, atomic geometric operations, and natural language instructions. We further propose a new benchmark named \emph{SpatialEval}, which is designed to evaluate spatial reasoning across attributes, distance, topology, and relative-position tasks. Extensive experiments show that SLM significantly outperforms existing LLM-based approaches that rely on symbolic reasoning via prompt engineering or textual abstraction, demonstrating the benefits of integrating geometric spatial representations for robust spatial reasoning.
  Our instruction dataset, evaluation benchmark, model training codes, and models' checkpoints can be found at:
  \hyperlink{https://github.com/chuchen2017/SLM}{https://github.com/chuchen2017/SLM}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间语言模型（SLM），将位置信息作为第一类模态，使多模态大语言模型具备几何空间推理能力，而非仅依靠符号模式匹配。通过构建空间指令数据集和新基准SpatialEval，实验证明SLM在空间推理任务上显著优于现有基于符号推理的LLM方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM的空间推理能力本质上是符号化的，仅通过文本模式匹配实现，缺乏对连续空间表示、几何计算和结构化空间算子的原生支持，难以进行真正的几何空间推理。
AI.method: 提出SLM，将位置信息作为独立模态直接操作学习到的空间表示；构建空间指令数据集以对齐空间表示、原子几何操作与自然语言指令；提出SpatialEval基准评估属性、距离、拓扑和相对位置四种空间推理任务。
AI.result: SLM在空间推理任务上显著优于依赖提示工程或文本抽象的现有LLM方法。
AI.conclusion: 集成几何空间表示能够有效提升LLM的鲁棒空间推理能力，超越纯符号推理范式。

title: Lost in Fog: Sensor Perturbations Expose Reasoning Fragility in Driving VLAs
summary: Interpretable autonomous driving planners depend not only on generating explanations, but also on those explanations remaining reliable under real-world sensor degradation. In this paper we present a controlled perturbation study of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robustness in autonomous driving, evaluating Alpamayo R1 (10B parameters) across 1,996 scenarios under eight sensor perturbations (Gaussian noise at four intensities, two lighting extremes, and two fog levels; ${\sim}18{,}000$ inference trials). We find that reasoning consistency is a high-fidelity indicator of trajectory reliability: when Chain-of-Causation (CoC) explanations change after perturbation, trajectory deviation spikes $5.3{\times}$ (21.8m vs 4.1m), with $r\!=\!0.99$ across attack types and $r_{pb}\!=\!0.53$ per-sample (Cohen's $d\!=\!1.12$). A controlled ablation provides evidence that enabling CoC generation is associated with improved trajectory accuracy (11.8% on average across conditions; $p < 0.0001$) under matched inference settings. Over the tested noise range ($σ\in \{10, 30, 50, 70\}$), degradation is approximately linear ($R^2\!=\!0.957$), while standard input preprocessing defenses provide only marginal relief. Together, these results establish CoC consistency as a quantitative proxy for planning safety and motivate reasoning-based runtime monitoring for safer VLA deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控扰动实验（8种传感器扰动、~18,000次推理）评估了VLA规划器Alpamayo R1的鲁棒性，发现因果链解释一致性是轨迹可靠性的高保真指标：解释改变时轨迹偏差飙升5.3倍（21.8m vs 4.1m），r=0.99；启用CoC生成可提升轨迹精度11.8%（p<0.0001）；噪声下退化近似线性（R²=0.957），标准预处理防御效果有限。
AI.motivation: 可解释的自动驾驶规划器不仅需要生成解释，还需要这些解释在真实世界的传感器退化条件下保持可靠，但目前缺乏对VLA模型鲁棒性的系统量化研究。
AI.method: 对Alpamayo R1（10B参数）在1,996个场景下施加8种传感器扰动（4种高斯噪声强度、2种光照极端、2种雾浓度），进行约18,000次推理测试，分析因果链（CoC）解释一致性与轨迹偏差之间的关系，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: 解释改变时轨迹偏差飙升5.3倍（21.8m vs 4.1m），跨攻击类型相关系数r=0.99，每样本点二列相关系数r_pb=0.53（Cohen's d=1.12）；启用CoC生成平均提升轨迹精度11.8%（p<0.0001）；噪声退化近似线性（R²=0.957），标准防御措施效果微弱。
AI.conclusion: CoC一致性可作为规划安全性的定量代理指标，并启发基于推理的运行时监控方法，以实现更安全的VLA部署。

title: StrokeTimer: Robust Representation Learning for Ischemic Stroke Onset-Time Estimation from Non-contrast CT
summary: Ischemic stroke is a major global disease. Treatment decisions are highly time-sensitive, as eligibility for reperfusion therapies relies on the interval between stroke onset and intervention. However, the true onset time is often uncertain in clinical practice, necessitating imaging-based assessment of tissue age as a surrogate marker. Early ischemic changes on routinely acquired non-contrast CT (NCCT) are often subtle, and real-world clinical datasets exhibit pronounced onset-time class imbalance and center-scanner-related heterogeneity. In this work, we propose StrokeTimer, a fully automated framework for onset-time estimation in acute ischemic stroke. StrokeTimer integrates self-supervised disentanglement learning with energy-guided contrastive learning to capture subtle ischemic patterns while addressing long-tailed data distributions under acquisition variability. Onset time is categorized into three clinically relevant windows: <4.5 h, 4.5-6 h, and >6 h. Experimental results on a large multi-center NCCT dataset from two national cohorts, MR CLEAN Registry and MR CLEAN LATE, show that StrokeTimer achieves a macro AUC of 0.69 and a macro F1-score of 0.57, improving the strongest baseline by nearly 50% (p < 0.005). In this realistic, challenging setting, representative baseline approaches exhibit near-chance macro performance. Model explanations further highlight subtle gray-white matter blurring and hypodense regions consistent with established radiological biomarkers. These findings demonstrate the potential of StrokeTimer to support treatment decision-making in acute ischemic stroke. Code is available at https://github.com/BrainVas/StrokeTimer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StrokeTimer框架，利用自监督解耦学习与能量引导对比学习，从非增强CT中估计急性缺血性卒中发病时间（分<4.5h、4.5-6h、>6h三个临床窗口），在两个国家队列的大规模多中心数据集上，macro AUC达0.69，macro F1达0.57，较最强基线提升近50%。
AI.motivation: 缺血性卒中治疗决策高度依赖发病时间，但真实临床中发病时间常不确定。现有方法面临两个挑战：1）非增强CT上早期缺血改变非常细微；2）真实数据集存在严重的发病时间类别不平衡和中心-扫描仪异质性。
AI.method: StrokeTimer框架融合了自监督解耦学习（self-supervised disentanglement learning）与能量引导对比学习（energy-guided contrastive learning），以捕捉细微的缺血模式并处理长尾数据分布及采集变异性。将发病时间划分为三个临床相关窗口：<4.5小时、4.5-6小时、>6小时。
AI.result: 在MR CLEAN Registry和MR CLEAN LATE两个国家队列的大规模多中心NCCT数据集上，StrokeTimer的macro AUC为0.69，macro F1为0.57，较最强基线提升近50%（p<0.005）。基线方法在该具有挑战性的场景中几乎表现为随机水平。模型解释显示与灰白质边界模糊、低密度区域等放射学生物标志物一致。
AI.conclusion: StrokeTimer在极具挑战性的真实临床场景中展现出支持急性缺血性卒中治疗决策的潜力，代码已开源。

title: Revisiting Privacy Amplification by Subsampling in Selective Release DPSGD
summary: Machine learning's reliance on sensitive data necessitates privacy-preserving techniques like Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DPSGD). However, DPSGD suffers from substantial utility degradation and slow convergence due to gradient clipping and noise injection. Prior works have attempted to improve DPSGD from various perspectives; notably, the Differentially Private Selective Update and Release (DPSUR) algorithm has achieved remarkable model utility. However, the privacy accounting in DPSUR overlooks the variation in sampling probability introduced by the selective release mechanism, which compromises the rigor of its privacy guarantees. To address these limitations, we re-evaluate the privacy analysis of the selective release mechanism and propose a novel algorithm: Differentially Private Selective Release based on Clipped Gradients (DPSR-CG). Through a rigorous, newly derived privacy analysis and extensive experiments on multiple datasets (MNIST, CIFAR-10, IMDB, and FMNIST), we demonstrate that our DPSR-CG mechanism maintains strict privacy guarantees while achieving exceptional model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文针对DPSGD的效用和收敛问题，重新分析了选择性释放机制的隐私核算，提出了DPSR-CG算法，在保持严格隐私保证的同时实现了优异的模型性能。
AI.motivation: DPSGD因梯度裁剪和噪声注入导致严重的效用下降和收敛缓慢；DPSUR算法虽取得了显著效用提升，但其隐私核算忽略了选择性释放机制引入的采样概率变化，导致隐私保证不严谨。
AI.method: 重新评估选择性释放机制的隐私分析，提出基于裁剪梯度的差分隐私选择性释放算法（DPSR-CG），并进行了严格的新隐私推导。
AI.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、IMDB和FMNIST等多个数据集上的实验表明，DPSR-CG在保持严格隐私保证的同时实现了优异的模型性能。
AI.conclusion: DPSR-CG通过修正隐私核算缺陷，在隐私保护与模型效用之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: Too Much of a Good Thing: When sim2real Efforts Impede Policy Learning (And What to Do About It)
summary: While sim2real efforts are necessary for effective policy transfer to hardware, there is such a thing as too much of a good thing. We argue that sim2real efforts have led to misaligned incentives with policy learning, resulting in simulator lock in and poor policy exploration due to the unreasonable constraints imposed by the real world. We offer a diagnosis and explanation of the current status of the problem, and propose a potential solution via a sim2sim2real paradigm that leverages the robot's kinematics as the sole design constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文指出 sim2real 迁移中的过度约束会导致策略学习陷入模拟器锁定和探索不足的问题，并提出以机器人运动学为唯一设计约束的 sim2sim2real 范式作为解决方案。
AI.motivation: 当前 sim2real 方法对策略学习造成了不当约束，导致模拟器锁定和策略探索受限，需要重新审视 sim2real 的激励机制。
AI.method: 提出 sim2sim2real 范式，仅以机器人运动学作为设计约束，避免过度 sim2real 带来的负面影响。
AI.result: 尚未给出具体实验结果，但提出了对现有问题的诊断和潜在解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 过度 sim2real 反而有害，sim2sim2real 范式有望在保持物理可行性的同时释放策略学习的自由度。

title: Physics-Informed Video Generation via Mixture-of-Experts Latent Alignment
summary: Large-scale video generation models have made remarkable progress in semantic consistency and visual quality, producing videos that are increasingly coherent and visually convincing. Nevertheless, the dynamics induced by pixel-level fitting do not naturally accommodate the regularities that govern real-world motion and interaction, resulting in persistent shortcomings in physical plausibility. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{PILA} (Physics-Informed Latent Alignment), a framework that injects physics-structured latent guidance into the frozen flow-matching dynamics of pretrained video models. Specifically, PILA first employs anchored field estimation to map frozen-generator latents into an operational physical attribute bank organized by field-proxy slots, using observable motion as a kinematic anchor for constructing less directly observed proxies. To handle the heterogeneity of real-world dynamics, PILA adopts a mixture-of-experts design over physical categories. Label-prior masked expert routing selects category-specific operator experts, whose refinements are regularized by operational residuals abstracted from physical relations. Finally, the refined proxies are fused into the physical attribute bank and decoded into a correction to the flow-matching vector field, injecting physics-aware guidance while preserving the visual prior of the pretrained backbone. With staged adapter training on Wan 2.1-1.3B and direct transfer of the learned adapter to Wan 2.2-14B, PILA achieves state-of-the-art results on VBench-2.0, VideoPhy-2, and PhyGenBench in both visual quality and benchmark-measured physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PILA框架，通过物理信息潜空间对齐方法，在保持预训练视频模型视觉先验的前提下，将物理结构化指导注入冻结的流匹配动态中，采用锚定场估计、物理属性专家混合、操作残差正则化等技术，在多个基准上取得物理合理性与视觉质量的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 大规模视频生成模型在语义一致性和视觉质量上表现优异，但其基于像素级拟合的动态过程无法自然适应真实世界运动和交互的物理规律，导致生成的视频在物理合理性方面存在持续缺陷。
AI.method: PILA框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 锚定场估计（Anchored Field Estimation），将冻结生成器的潜变量映射到由场-代理槽组织的可操作物理属性库，利用可观测运动作为运动学锚点构建间接观测的物理代理；(2) 物理类别上的混合专家设计（Mixture-of-Experts），采用标签先验掩码专家路由选择类别特定的算子专家，并通过物理关系抽象出的操作残差进行正则化；(3) 将精炼后的代理融合回物理属性库，解码为流匹配向量场的校正项，在冻结骨干网络上注入物理感知指导。
AI.result: 在Wan 2.1-1.3B上进行分阶段适配器训练，并将学到的适配器直接迁移到Wan 2.2-14B，在VBench-2.0、VideoPhy-2和PhyGenBench上的视觉质量和基准测量的物理合理性均达到最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理信息潜空间对齐的方法，可以在不修改预训练视频生成模型参数的情况下，有效提升生成的物理合理性，同时保持原有的视觉质量先验。

title: Shortcomings and capacities of real-constrained neural networks in complex spaces
summary: We find the asymptotic ratio between the storage capacities when enforcing real pre-activations in a complex hypothesis class as opposed to complex ones in the same class. Our methods depend on Gardner volume comparisons at critical capacity. Our proof relies on an application of the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ) formula, nonstandard in literature. With the HCIZ formula, we may obtain a more robust approximation for the final asymptotic ratio. This strategy is applicable to our work specifically since we integrate over the unitary and orthogonal compact manifolds, facilitated via the Weyl integration formula and the Haar measure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Gardner体积比较和Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ)公式，导出了在复杂假设类中强制实预激活与复预激活之间的存储容量渐近比。
AI.motivation: 研究在复杂假设类中，强制实预激活与复预激活条件下的存储容量渐近比，以理解不同预激活约束对模型容量的影响。
AI.method: 采用Gardner体积比较方法，在临界容量处进行分析；核心是利用非标准的Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber (HCIZ)公式，结合Weyl积分公式和Haar测度，在酉群和正交群紧流形上进行积分，从而获得更稳健的渐近比近似。
AI.result: 得到了实预激活与复预激活条件下存储容量的渐近比值，且该比值通过HCIZ公式获得了更精确的近似。
AI.conclusion: HCIZ公式在紧流形积分中的应用为容量分析提供了新的理论工具，该方法对于理解实值与复值神经网络的理论容量差异具有重要价值。

title: PerchRL: Vision-Based Agile Perching on Inclined Platforms under Rapid and Irregular Motion
summary: Autonomous vision-based perching of quadrotors on moving inclined platforms is critical for air-ground collaboration but remains challenging due to the limited field of view (FOV). In this paper, we propose PerchRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for vision-based agile perching on inclined platforms under rapid and irregular motion. Specifically, we employ a two-stage learning strategy consisting of state-based pre-training followed by vision-based fine-tuning. To improve generalization across diverse platform motions, we employ randomized platform trajectories to prevent overfitting and temporal augmentation methods to capture latent motion patterns from historical observations. During vision-based fine-tuning, a hybrid learning framework consisting of visibility-aware state augmentation and active perception rewards is presented to improve robustness under intermittent visual loss. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate the feasibility, stability, and real-time performance of PerchRL, while successful deployment across distinct quadrotor platforms further validates its adaptability. The source code will be released to benefit the community.

AI.tldr: PerchRL是一个基于强化学习的视觉四旋翼无人机在运动倾斜平台上敏捷降落框架，采用两阶段学习策略（状态预训练+视觉微调），结合随机化轨迹和时间增强提升泛化性，通过可见性感知状态增强和主动感知奖励应对视觉丢失，在仿真和真实实验中验证了可行性、稳定性和实时性。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼无人机在运动倾斜平台上的自主视觉降落对于空中-地面协同至关重要，但由于视场角有限，这一问题极具挑战性。
AI.method: 采用两阶段学习策略：基于状态的预训练+基于视觉的微调；使用随机化平台轨迹和时序增强方法提升泛化能力；提出混合学习框架，包含可见性感知状态增强和主动感知奖励以应对间歇性视觉丢失。
AI.result: 大量仿真和真实实验证明了PerchRL的可行性、稳定性和实时性，且在多个不同的四旋翼平台上成功部署，验证了其适应性。
AI.conclusion: PerchRL有效解决了视觉受限条件下无人机在快速不规则运动倾斜平台上的自主降落问题，具有较好的泛化性和跨平台适应性。

title: Do Foundation Models See Biology? Evaluating Attention Coherence with Spatial Transcriptomics in Glioblastoma
summary: Whether attention maps from pathology foundation models capture genuine biology remains unknown, yet this question is critical for clinical trust and regulatory approval. We propose a spatial transcriptomics-based framework for orthogonal, hypothesis-free evaluation of attention and apply it to five pathology foundation models (CONCH v1.5, UNI v2, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-1) and a ResNet50 baseline. Using attention-based multiple instance learning, we train single-task and multi-task models to predict five molecular alterations in glioblastoma on the CPTAC cohort, validate on an independent TCGA cohort, and evaluate biological coherence of attention maps against 87 transcriptional signatures using co-registered Visium spatial transcriptomics data from 18 samples. Internally, no single encoder dominates across all tasks, and external validation inverts internal performance rankings. Attention maps show a five-fold enrichment gradient from pathways (Cohen's d=0.329) to individual genes (d=0.055), indicating that attention captures emergent multi-gene transcriptional programs rather than individual molecular events. Spatially smooth attention maps do not imply biological coherence, and different encoders attend to distinct biological compartments. Our framework provides objective, quantitative assessment of what foundation models learn from histopathology, moving the field beyond qualitative saliency map review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于空间转录组学的框架，正交评估病理基础模型的注意力图生物学一致性。对五种病理基础模型和ResNet50基线在胶质母细胞瘤分子改变预测任务中测试，发现：无单一编码器全面占优；外部验证反转内部性能排名；注意力图捕获多基因转录程序而非单个分子事件；空间平滑的注意力图不代表生物学一致性；不同编码器关注不同生物学区域。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型的注意力图是否捕获真实生物学信息尚不清楚，但这一问题对临床信任和监管审批至关重要。现有工作缺乏对注意力图生物学一致性的客观、假设无关的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于空间转录组学（Visium）的假设无关评估框架。使用基于注意力的多实例学习训练单任务和多任务模型，预测胶质母细胞瘤5种分子改变（CPTAC队列训练，TCGA队列验证），用18个样本的共配准空间转录组数据评估注意力图与87个转录特征集的生物学一致性。
AI.result: ①无单一编码器在所有任务中全面占优；②外部验证反转了内部性能排名；③注意力图从通路（Cohen's d=0.329）到单个基因（d=0.055）存在5倍富集梯度，表明捕获的是多基因转录程序；④空间平滑的注意力图不意味着生物学一致性；⑤不同编码器关注不同的生物学区域。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了客观、定量的评估方法，用于判断病理基础模型从组织病理学中学到了什么，推动该领域超越定性的显著性图审查，为临床信任和监管审批提供了可量化的依据。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling of Biodegradable Contaminant Transport through GCL/SL Composite Liners
summary: This study develops a two-domain physics-informed neural network framework for contaminant transport through a GCL/SL composite liner system, in which the thin GCL layer is treated using a steady-state advection-dispersion-biodegradation formulation and the underlying soil liner is modeled as a transient transport domain. Two formulations are evaluated against analytical and finite-element reference solutions under different leachate-head conditions: a standard PINN with soft constraint enforcement (Std-PINN) and a hard-constrained PINN (H-PINN), in which selected boundary and initial conditions are embedded directly into the trial solutions. The Std-PINN captures the overall breakthrough behavior but shows larger errors during the early transport stage, particularly under higher leachate heads where advective transport becomes more pronounced. The H-PINN reduces the optimization burden associated with penalty-based constraint enforcement and provides more accurate and stable concentration predictions, lowering the MAE from approximately 0.058-0.067 for the Std-PINN to about 0.011-0.023 for the H-PINN, while reducing the MRE from approximately 9.10%-19.16% to about 2.08%-3.14%. Parametric analyses confirm that the H-PINN with the tanh activation function and an optimized network structure provides the best predictive accuracy. The H-PINN is further extended to inverse modeling for identifying the SL degradation half-life from limited concentration observations, showing reliable convergence toward prescribed values and acceptable robustness under low-to-moderate observation noise.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种双域物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于模拟通过GCL/SL复合衬里系统的污染物传输。其中，薄GCL层采用稳态平流-扩散-生物降解公式处理，而下层土衬里则建模为瞬态传输域。研究评估了标准PINN（Std-PINN）和硬约束PINN（H-PINN）两种公式，H-PINN通过将边界和初始条件直接嵌入试解中，显著提高了预测精度，将MAE从约0.058-0.067降至0.011-0.023，MRE从约9.10%-19.16%降至2.08%-3.14%。H-PINN还扩展到逆建模，用于从有限的浓度观测数据中识别SL降解半衰期。
AI.motivation: 开发一种高效、准确的数值方法，用于模拟GCL/SL复合衬里系统中污染物传输的复杂过程，特别是解决传统数值方法在处理薄层GCL与厚层SL耦合时的计算挑战，并探索PINN在岩土环境工程中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 提出双域PINN框架：GCL层采用稳态平流-扩散-生物降解方程，SL层采用瞬态传输方程。对比了Std-PINN（软约束，使用损失函数惩罚项）和H-PINN（硬约束，将边界/初始条件嵌入试解）两种方法，并通过参数分析优化激活函数（tanh）和网络结构。
AI.result: H-PINN相比Std-PINN显著提升精度：MAE从0.058-0.067降至0.011-0.023，MRE从9.10%-19.16%降至2.08%-3.14%。在逆建模中，H-PINN能从有限噪声观测数据中可靠收敛到预设的SL降解半衰期值，对低至中等观测噪声具有可接受的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 硬约束PINN（H-PINN）框架在复合衬里污染物传输的正向和逆向建模中均表现出优越的精度和稳定性，为岩土环境工程中的复杂传输问题提供了一种有前景的深度学习求解方案。

title: PHASER: Phase-Aware and Semantic Experience Replay for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, deploying these models in open-ended environments requires continuously acquiring novel skills, a process that inevitably triggers severe catastrophic forgetting of previously learned behaviors. While experience replay (ER) serves as a standard mitigating strategy, naive uniform sampling fundamentally misaligns with the temporal characteristics of manipulation trajectories. It systematically under-samples brief but causally critical sub-skills, leading to phase starvation, and completely overlooks the varying degrees of forgetting across historical tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce PHASER, an architecture-agnostic continual learning framework. PHASER employs a phase-centric capacity allocation to guarantee equal memory support for all sub-skills, coupled with a multi-modal interference routing strategy that dynamically prioritizes historical phases at high risk of forgetting. Furthermore, to enable fully autonomous lifelong adaptation, we integrate Auto-PC, a lightweight pipeline combining unsupervised action-signal change-point detection with VLM-based semantic verification to extract temporal boundaries without intensive manual supervision. Evaluated across three VLA backbones on LIBERO continual learning suites, PHASER yields substantial empirical improvements, increasing Average Success Rate (ASR) by up to 31% over matched-budget ER and achieving an 87.8% final ASR on the LIBERO-Goal CL setting.

AI.tldr: PHASER是一个面向VLA模型的架构无关持续学习框架，通过阶段感知的容量分配和多模态干扰路由策略解决灾难性遗忘问题，在LIBERO基准上最高提升31%平均成功率，达到87.8%的最终ASR。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在开放环境中持续获取新技能时会遭遇严重的灾难性遗忘，而传统的经验回放方法存在两个根本缺陷：均匀采样忽略了操作轨迹的时间特性，导致对短暂但关键的子技能采样不足（阶段饥饿）；同时忽视了不同历史任务遗忘程度的差异。
AI.method: 提出PHASER框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 阶段感知的容量分配，确保对所有子技能提供均等的记忆支持；2) 多模态干扰路由策略，动态优先处理高遗忘风险的历史阶段；3) Auto-PC轻量级流水线，结合无监督动作信号变化点检测与VLM语义验证，自动提取时间边界。
AI.result: 在三个VLA骨干网络和LIBERO持续学习套件上评估，相比同等预算的ER方法，ASR最高提升31%，在LIBERO-Goal CL设置中达到87.8%的最终ASR。
AI.conclusion: PHASER通过阶段感知的持续学习框架有效解决了VLA模型在开放环境中的灾难性遗忘问题，验证了考虑操作轨迹时间特性的重要性，为机器人终身学习提供了可行方案。

title: Coarse-to-fine Hierarchical Architecture with Sequential Mamba for Brain Reconstruction
summary: Understanding the relationship between deep visual representations and the human visual system is a fundamental challenge in computational neuroscience. While modern vision models achieve strong performance in image recognition, their correspondence with the hierarchical organization of the human visual cortex remains an open question. In this study, we propose CHASMBrain, a novel hierarchical two-stage framework for image-to-fMRI encoding. Our architecture leverages a dual-stream Mamba design to explicitly separate and process global semantic tokens and local spatial patches, motivated by the functional organization of the visual cortex. A coarse-to-fine strategy is employed: Stage 1 predicts denoised ROI-level activations, while Stage 2 refines these coarse responses into full voxel-level predictions using a Mamba-VAE. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) demonstrate that our method achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.429 and an MSE of 0.261, outperforming all evaluated baselines including ridge regression and DINOv2 linear probes. Beyond predictive performance, causal branch-ablation experiments reveal an asymmetric specialization: the patch stream is specifically locked to early visual cortex (retinotopic regions), while the CLS stream contributes broader semantic context to higher-order areas -- a correspondence that holds causally, not merely correlationally. Cross-subject transfer experiments further show that the learned backbone generalizes across individuals with minimal per-subject adaptation, suggesting the model captures a shared, subject-agnostic visual representation.

AI.tldr: 提出了CHASMBrain，一种基于双流Mamba的分层图像到fMRI编码框架，在NSD数据集上达到0.429的皮尔逊相关系数，并通过因果消融实验揭示了补丁流与早期视觉皮层的特异性对应关系。
AI.motivation: 深度视觉表征与人脑视觉系统之间的对应关系是计算神经科学的基本挑战，现代视觉模型在图像识别中表现优异，但其与视觉皮层层级组织的对齐程度尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出CHASMBrain两阶段分层框架：采用双流Mamba设计分别处理全局语义token和局部空间补丁；阶段1预测去噪的ROI级激活，阶段2通过Mamba-VAE将粗响应细化为全voxel级预测。
AI.result: 在NSD数据集上达到皮尔逊相关系数0.429、MSE 0.261，优于岭回归和DINOv2线性探针等基线；因果消融实验显示补丁流特异性锁定早期视觉皮层（视网膜拓扑区），CLS流为高阶区域提供更广泛的语义上下文。
AI.conclusion: 跨被试迁移实验表明学习到的骨干网络只需少量个体适配即可泛化，说明模型捕获了共享的、与被试无关的视觉表征。

title: DPDL: Towards Differential Privacy Preservation in Decentralized Stochastic Learning on Non-IID Data
summary: In the paradigm of decentralized learning, a group of agents collaborate to train a global model using distributed datasets without a central server. Although the power of collaboration has been verified by many state-of-the-art studies, it entails extensive gradient information exchanging among the agents and thus induces high risk of privacy leakage for the individual agents. Moreover, in real-world applications, the training data are usually non-identically and independently distributed across the agents, inducing more challenges to enable privacy-preserved decentralized learning. To address these issues, we propose a privacy-preserved decentralized learning algorithm with non-IID data, DPDL, which leverages the notion of Differential Privacy (DP) in cross-gradient aggregation through a similarity-based calibration technique. Specifically, in each round, each agent perturbs the cross-gradients (i.e., the derivatives of its neighbors' local model in its private local data) by Gaussian noise mechanism before sharing them with its neighbors; it then adopt cosine similarity to calibrate the received perturbed cross-gradients such that the aggregation of the calibrated cross-gradients can be utilized to effectively update local model in a momentum-like manner. Our rigorous theoretical analysis not only reveals the minimum noise level required to achieve a specific level of privacy preservation, but also illustrates that our algorithm still achieves a linear speedup in training with non-IID data. We finally conduct extensive experiments on real-world dataset to validate the effectiveness of our algorithm in defending privacy attacks and in training accurate models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DPDL的隐私保护去中心化学习算法，通过差分隐私和基于相似性的校准技术，在非独立同分布数据场景下实现了隐私保护与模型准确性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 去中心化学习中，智能体间大量的梯度信息交换导致隐私泄露风险高；同时实际应用中数据通常是非独立同分布的，进一步增加了隐私保护去中心化学习的挑战。
AI.method: DPDL算法：每轮每个智能体使用高斯噪声机制扰动交叉梯度（即邻居局部模型在自身私有数据上的导数），然后通过余弦相似度校准接收到的扰动交叉梯度，最后以动量方式聚合校准后的交叉梯度来更新局部模型。
AI.result: 理论分析给出了实现特定隐私保护级别所需的最小噪声级别，并证明算法在非IID数据上仍能实现线性加速。实验验证了算法在防御隐私攻击和训练准确模型方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DPDL通过差分隐私与相似性校准技术，在去中心化非IID数据场景下有效实现了隐私保护与模型性能的平衡。

title: A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
summary: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以3D等视域（isovist）——即球形可见性深度图——作为具身导航的预测目标，替代传统的视觉外观或鸟瞰图占用网格。模型仅根据历史等视域和运动动作预测下一时刻的等视域深度残差，采用自滚动调度采样和持久潜变量BEV空间图。意外发现：仅在曼哈顿和巴黎训练的城市盲模型，其时间潜变量中涌现出跨城市空间特征，城市身份可线性解码，且该特征存在于动力学而非外观中。
AI.motivation: 现有具身导航世界模型要么预测外观（受光度信息干扰），要么预测鸟瞰图占用网格（丢失三维和跨层结构），缺乏一种既能捕捉可通行几何、又不压缩三维信息的预测目标。
AI.method: 以3D等视域（球形深度图）为预测目标，构建编码器-解码器结构预测深度残差；使用自滚动调度采样训练以保持几何流形；引入持久潜变量BEV空间图确保跨路径一致性。
AI.result: 城市盲模型在曼哈顿和巴黎训练后，其时间潜变量中涌现出可线性解码的跨城市空间特征，城市身份识别远优于单帧基线，且该特征存在于动力学而非外观中。
AI.conclusion: 3D等视域是一种轻量级、可解释、可复现的几何表示，为具身AI、机器人学和城市分析中的空间推理提供了几何基础。

title: NextMotionQA: Benchmarking and Judging Human Motion Understanding with Vision-Language Models
summary: Reliable evaluation of human motion understanding is fundamental to advancing embodied AI, robotics, and animation. However, existing benchmarks suffer from coarse semantic granularity, undifferentiated difficulty, limited annotation quality, and pervasive answer ambiguity, leaving them unable to diagnose where current models fail. To bridge this gap, we introduce NextMotionQA, a comprehensive benchmark that leverages vision-language models (VLMs) for semi-automated, expert-verified dataset. NextMotionQA features three complementary tasks: multiple-choice question answering, video captioning, and fine-grained error correction. Each task is systematically structured across three core semantic axes and stratified into three task complexity levels. Our extensive evaluation of twelve representative VLMs uncovers critical capability gaps and weakness that remain invisible under conventional, single-task evaluations. In a complementary direction, recent work has begun using VLMs as judges for text-to-motion evaluation; we ask whether they show the same degradation under harder tasks. We find that VLMs align strongly with expert ratings on coarse criteria (Cohen's κ=0.70) but break down on fine-grained, part-level judgment (κ=0.10), validating the paradigm in its strong regime while clarifying its limits.

AI.tldr: NextMotionQA是一个利用视觉语言模型半自动化构建、经专家验证的全面人体运动理解基准，包含多项选择题、视频描述和细粒度纠错三个互补任务，并在三个语义轴和三个复杂度层级上系统构建。评估12个代表性VLM发现其在复杂任务中存在传统单任务评估无法揭示的能力缺陷；同时，VLM作为裁判在粗粒度标准上与专家高度一致（κ=0.70），但在细粒度部位级别判断上一致性极差（κ=0.10）。
AI.motivation: 现有的人体运动理解基准存在语义粒度粗糙、难度无区分、标注质量有限和答案歧义普遍等问题，无法诊断当前模型在哪些具体环节失败，亟需一个更全面、可诊断的基准来揭示模型真实能力边界。
AI.method: 1) 利用VLM半自动化生成候选数据，经专家验证构建NextMotionQA基准；2) 设计三项互补任务（多项选择问答、视频描述、细粒度纠错），按三个语义轴和三个复杂度层级系统组织；3) 评估12个代表性VLM在基准上的表现；4) 额外研究VLM作为裁判在文本到运动评估中的可靠性，比较其与专家评分在不同粒度上的一致性。
AI.result: 1) 12个VLM在NextMotionQA上的评估揭示了传统单任务评估无法发现的关键能力差距和弱点；2) VLM作为裁判在粗粒度标准上与专家评分高度一致（Cohen's κ=0.70），但在细粒度部位级别判断上一致性极低（κ=0.10）。
AI.conclusion: NextMotionQA作为更全面、可诊断的运动理解基准能有效揭示VLM的隐藏缺陷；VLM作为裁判在粗粒度评估上是有效的，但在需要细粒度部位级别判断时存在根本性局限。

title: TANDEM: Bi-Level Data Mixture Optimization with Twin Networks
summary: The capabilities of large language models (LLMs) significantly depend on training data drawn from various domains. Optimizing domain-specific mixture ratios can be modeled as a bi-level optimization problem, which we simplify into a single-level penalized form and solve with twin networks: a proxy model trained on primary data and a dynamically updated reference model trained with additional data. Our proposed method, Twin Networks for bi-level DatA mixturE optiMization (TANDEM), measures the data efficacy through the difference between the twin models and up-weights domains that benefit more from the additional data. TANDEM provides theoretical guarantees and wider applicability, compared to prior approaches. Furthermore, our bi-level perspective suggests new settings to study domain reweighting such as data-restricted scenarios and supervised fine-tuning, where optimized mixture ratios significantly improve the performance. Extensive experiments validate TANDEM's effectiveness in all scenarios.

AI.tldr: TANDEM是一种通过孪生网络（代理模型与参考模型）优化训练数据域混合比例的双层优化方法，利用模型差异衡量数据效能并动态调整权重，在多种场景下显著提升LLM性能。
AI.motivation: LLM的性能高度依赖来自不同领域的训练数据，优化各领域的混合比例至关重要。现有方法缺乏理论保证且适用范围有限，亟需一种更通用且可理论验证的数据混合优化方法。
AI.method: 将域混合比例优化建模为双层优化问题，简化为单层惩罚形式；使用孪生网络：代理模型（主数据训练）与动态更新的参考模型（附加数据训练），通过两模型差异度量数据效能，对获益更大的域赋予更高权重。
AI.result: TANDEM在数据受限场景和 supervised fine-tuning 等多种设置下，优化的混合比率显著提升性能，实验验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: TANDEM提供了理论保证、更广泛的适用性，并揭示了双层优化视角下域重加权的新应用场景（如数据受限和SFT），为LLM数据混合优化提供了可靠框架。

title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
summary: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了最大规模的具身思维链数据集（978,743条轨迹，2.26亿样本），揭示了有效的具身CoT应将高层语义理解转化为具体动作引导（如末端执行器运动描述和图像空间轨迹），而仅依赖高层推理收益甚微。现有显式CoT作为自回归动作前缀存在组合推理错误和不稳定问题，为此提出ERVLA模型，将具身CoT作为表示塑造监督而非强制测试时推理，采用推理丢弃策略在训练时吸收推理轨迹，推理时直接预测动作，在LIBERO-Plus上达86.9%成功率，在VLABench上达53.2%，并在真实机器人任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有具身思维链的有效形式与集成策略尚未被充分探索，显式CoT作为自回归动作前缀时存在推理错误累积和推理-动作耦合不稳定的问题，限制了大规模VLA模型的扩展能力。
AI.method: 构建了最大规模具身CoT数据集；提出ERVLA模型，将具身CoT作为表示塑造监督，采用推理丢弃策略（reasoning-dropout），训练时吸收推理轨迹，推理时直接预测动作，避免自回归解码的不稳定性。
AI.result: LIBERO-Plus上86.9%成功率，VLABench上53.2%成功率，在真实机器人实验中优于竞争基线，尤其在语义消歧和长程执行任务上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 有效的具身CoT应聚焦于具体动作引导而非高层语义推理；显式CoT作为动作前缀不可靠扩展；将CoT作为表示塑造监督的ERVLA方案在可扩展性、分布外泛化和真实场景中均表现出色。

title: Low-Rank Decay for Grokking in Scale-Invariant Transformers: A Spectral-Geometric View
summary: Modern Transformer architectures frequently employ normalization mechanisms such as RMSNorm and Query-Key Normalization, making parts of the model approximately scale-invariant with respect to weight magnitudes. In this regime, standard Frobenius-norm weight decay acts purely along the radial direction of the weight space and cannot directly simplify the function represented by the normalized layer. We study grokking in small algorithmic tasks through this lens and propose \emph{Low-Rank Decay} (LRD), a nuclear-norm-like spectral regularizer whose subgradient -- the polar factor $UV^\top$ -- retains a tangential component even in the scale-invariant setting. This distinction has a concrete dynamical consequence: after the model memorizes the training set and task gradients vanish, L2 decay can no longer reshape the weight spectrum, whereas LRD continues to compress singular values in an $\ell_1$-like fashion. On modular arithmetic tasks, we find that LRD induces rapid effective-rank collapse in Query/Key matrices and expands the data-fraction boundary at which delayed generalization (grokking) occurs. We further provide a spectral-geometric interpretation through the ``needle-to-fan'' expansion of the nuclear-norm subdifferential near low-rank strata.

AI.tldr: 本文提出低秩衰减（LRD）作为核范数谱正则化器，用于在尺度不变（如RMSNorm、QK归一化）的Transformer架构中替代标准Frobenius范数权重衰减。LRD的次梯度（极分解因子UV^⊤）在径向梯度消失后仍保留切向分量，持续压缩奇异值，从而在小算法任务中促进有效秩的快速下降，并扩展泛化延迟（grokking）发生的数据边界。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer使用RMSNorm和QK归一化等机制，使得部分模型对权重幅度近似尺度不变。在此情况下，标准Frobenius范数权重衰减仅沿权重空间的径向方向作用，无法直接简化归一化层所表示的函数。这限制了对grokking现象的理解和模型泛化能力的提升。
AI.method: 提出低秩衰减（LRD），一种类似核范数的谱正则化器。其关键设计是使用极分解因子UV^⊤作为次梯度，该梯度在尺度不变设置中保留切向分量。通过理论分析和模块化算术任务实验，对比LRD与标准L2衰减在权重谱演化、有效秩降低和grokking边界扩展方面的差异。
AI.result: 在模块化算术任务上，LRD能在Query/Key矩阵中诱导快速的有效秩坍塌；在任务梯度消失后（模型记忆训练集后），L2衰减不再能重塑权重谱，而LRD以ℓ1-like方式持续压缩奇异值；LRD扩展了延迟泛化（grokking）发生的数据分数边界。
AI.conclusion: LRD通过核范数次微分的“针到扇”（needle-to-fan）扩展，在低秩流形附近提供了一种谱几何解释，表明在尺度不变归一化层中，使用核范数正则化比Frobenius范数权重衰减更有利于简化模型函数并促进泛化。

title: Transformer-Based Autonomous Driving Models and Deployment-Oriented Compression: A Survey
summary: Transformer-based models are becoming a central paradigm in autonomous driving because they can capture long-range spatial dependencies, multi-agent interactions, and multimodal context across perception, prediction, and planning. At the same time, their deployment in real vehicles remains difficult because high-capacity attention-based architectures impose substantial latency, memory, and energy overhead. This survey reviews representative Transformer-based autonomous driving models and organizes them by task role, sensing configuration, and architectural design. More importantly, it examines these models from a deployment-oriented perspective and analyzes how efficiency constraints reshape model design choices in practice. We further review compression and acceleration strategies relevant to Transformer-based driving systems, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, low-rank approximation, and efficient attention, and discuss their benefits, limitations, and task-dependent applicability. Rather than treating compression as an isolated post-processing step, we highlight it as a system-level design consideration that directly affects deployability, robustness, and safety. Finally, we identify open challenges and future research directions toward standardized, safety-aware, and hardware-conscious evaluation of efficient autonomous driving systems.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统回顾了基于Transformer的自动驾驶模型，从部署视角分析了其效率约束对模型设计的影响，并探讨了量化、剪枝、知识蒸馏、低秩近似和高效注意力等压缩加速策略，强调压缩应作为影响可部署性、鲁棒性和安全性的系统级设计考量。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型在自动驾驶中展现出强大能力（长程依赖、多智能体交互、多模态融合），但其高容量注意力架构带来的延迟、内存和能耗开销严重阻碍了实际车载部署。因此需要系统性地从部署视角审视这些模型，并探索提升效率的方法。
AI.method: 按任务角色、感知配置和架构设计对代表性Transformer自动驾驶模型进行分类整理；从部署导向视角分析效率约束如何影响模型设计选择；综述量化、剪枝、知识蒸馏、低秩近似和高效注意力等压缩加速策略，并讨论其优缺点及任务依赖的适用性。
AI.result: 揭示了Transformer在自动驾驶不同任务中的应用现状和效率瓶颈；明确了各类压缩策略在不同驾驶任务中的适用性和局限性；强调了压缩不应被视为孤立的后期处理步骤，而是直接影响系统可部署性、鲁棒性和安全性的关键设计考量。
AI.conclusion: 指出了未来的开放挑战和研究方向，包括标准化、安全感知和硬件意识的高效自动驾驶系统评估。

title: A Pathology Foundation Model for Gastric Cancer with Real-World Validation
summary: Gastric cancer remains a major cause of cancer mortality, yet its histological and molecular heterogeneity complicates diagnosis and risk stratification. General-purpose pathology foundation models (PFMs) often plateau on fine-grained endpoints central to gastric cancer care, and few have undergone rigorous prospective validation or clinical reader studies. We present GRACE, a Gastric-specific foundation model for Real-world Assessment and Clinical dEcision support. GRACE was developed from multicenter gastric pathology datasets totaling 48,364 primarily HE-stained whole-slide images from 37,493 patients.
