When evaluated on 28 clinically relevant tasks, GRACE consistently outperformed representative pancancer PFMs, achieving a macro-AUC of 0.9188, with strong performance for precancerous lesion diagnosis (macro-AUC 0.9322), tumor histopathological assessment (macro-AUC 0.9119), molecular profiling (macro-AUC 0.8682), and prognostic prediction. Beyond benchmarking, GRACE's translational value was substantiated through a rigorous evidence chain. Under safety-gated criteria requiring 100% NPV for rule-out and 100% PPV for rule-in, GRACE streamlined review for up to 69.6% of malignancy-diagnosis cases and triaged 46.8% of MMR-IHC follow-up requests. This translational feasibility was further strengthened by a randomized crossover reader study of pathologist-AI collaboration. With GRACE assistance, diagnostic accuracy improved from 82.0% to 89.9%, yielding nearly twofold higher adjusted odds of a correct diagnosis (OR 1.987) alongside concurrent gains in sensitivity and specificity. AI assistance also reduced diagnostic time by 14.9%, elevated diagnostic confidence by 9.0%, and markedly improved inter-rater agreement. When calibrated to maintain non-inferior performance to senior pathologists, the AI-assisted workflow could triage 60.7% of atrophy and 82.7% of intestinal metaplasia cases.

AI.tldr: GRACE是一个针对胃癌的专用病理基础模型，基于48,364张全切片图像开发，在28项临床任务中优于通用病理模型，并通过前瞻性验证、读者研究发现其可提升诊断准确率（82.0%→89.9%）、缩短诊断时间14.9%、提高一致性，同时可分流高达69.6%的恶性诊断病例和82.7%的肠化生病例。
AI.motivation: 胃癌的组织学和分子异质性导致诊断和风险分层困难，通用病理基础模型在胃癌细粒度临床任务上性能平台化，且缺乏严格的前瞻性验证和临床读者研究。
AI.method: 收集来自多中心的48,364张HE染色全切片图像（37,493名患者），构建GRACE模型；在28项临床任务上评估，并与通用病理基础模型对比；通过安全门控标准、随机交叉读者研究（人机协作）进行前瞻性验证。
AI.result: GRACE在28项任务中宏观AUC达0.9188，优于通用模型；在安全门控下可分流69.6%恶性诊断病例和46.8% MMR-IHC随访请求；读者研究中AI辅助将准确率从82.0%提升至89.9%（OR 1.987），诊断时间缩短14.9%，置信度提升9.0%，并可分流60.7%萎缩和82.7%肠化生病例。
AI.conclusion: GRACE作为胃癌专用病理基础模型，在多种临床任务中显著优于通用模型，且通过严格的前瞻性验证和读者研究证明了其在实际临床工作流中的可行性和价值，有望提升胃癌诊断的效率和准确性。

title: An Ensembled Latent Factor Model via Differential Evolution and Gradient Descent Optimization
summary: High-dimensional and incomplete (HDI) data are prevalent in many real-world big data scenarios. Latent factor models serve as a common representation learning approach, capable of uncovering informative latent factors from such data. Nevertheless, most existing latent factor models rely solely on gradient descent for optimization, which may lead to insufficient and biased representations, particularly when dealing with heterogeneous HDI data. Thus, this study proposes an Ensembled Latent Factor Model via Differential Evolution and Gradient Descent Optimization (ELFM-DEGDO) with two-fold designed: 1) two diverse latent factor models are independently modeled via differential evolution and gradient descent optimization, respectively, and 2) the two diverse latent factor models are combined via a customized self-adaptive weighting mechanism to effectively fuse their strengths. By leveraging the complementary advantages of both optimization paradigms, ELFM-DEGDO is able to produce more comprehensive and less biased representations for HDI data. Three HDI datasets are tested to show that ELFM-DEGDO consistently performs better than related several latent factor models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合差分进化与梯度下降优化的集成潜因子模型（ELFM-DEGDO），通过两种优化范式分别建模潜因子模型，并利用自适应加权机制融合二者优势，实现对高维不完整数据的更全面、低偏表示，性能优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有潜因子模型大多仅依赖梯度下降优化，在处理异构高维不完整数据时可能导致表示不充分且有偏。
AI.method: 双管齐下：1）分别用差分进化优化和梯度下降优化独立建模两个不同的潜因子模型；2）通过自适应的加权机制融合两个模型，发挥互补优势。
AI.result: 在三个高维不完整数据集上，ELFM-DEGDO一致优于多个相关潜因子模型。
AI.conclusion: 融合差分进化与梯度下降两种优化范式的集成策略，能够有效提升潜因子模型对HDI数据的表示质量，降低表示偏差。

title: Simplicial Embeddings Improve Sample Efficiency in Actor-Critic Agents
summary: Recent works have proposed accelerating the wall-clock training time of actor-critic methods via the use of large-scale environment parallelization; unfortunately, these can sometimes still require large number of environment interactions to achieve a desired level of performance. Noting that well-structured representations can improve the generalization and sample efficiency of deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents, we propose the use of simplicial embeddings: lightweight representation layers that constrain embeddings to simplicial structures. This geometric inductive bias results in sparse and discrete features that stabilize critic bootstrapping and strengthen policy gradients. When applied to FastTD3, FastSAC, and PPO, simplicial embeddings consistently improve sample efficiency and final performance across a variety of continuous- and discrete-control environments, without any loss in runtime speed.

AI.tldr: 提出在演员-评论家方法中使用单纯形嵌入（simplicial embeddings）作为轻量级表示层，通过几何归纳偏置强制嵌入到单纯形结构，产生稀疏离散特征以稳定评论家自举和强化策略梯度，在不损失运行速度的情况下持续提升FastTD3、FastSAC和PPO的样本效率和最终性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模环境并行化加速了演员-评论家方法的训练时钟时间，但仍需要大量环境交互才能达到理想性能，且深度强化学习智能体的泛化能力和样本效率有待提升。
AI.method: 提出单纯形嵌入（simplicial embeddings）作为轻量级表示层，通过几何约束将嵌入限制在单纯形结构上，产生稀疏和离散的特征表示。
AI.result: 在FastTD3、FastSAC和PPO等多种算法以及连续控制和离散控制环境中，单纯形嵌入在不损失运行速度的情况下，持续提升了样本效率和最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 单纯形嵌入作为一种轻量级几何归纳偏置，能有效提升深度强化学习算法的样本效率和性能，且计算开销可忽略不计。

title: Crafting Your Evolving Dreams: Concept-Incremental Versatile Customization
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Custom diffusion models (CDMs) have garnered significant interest owing to their remarkable capacity for generating personalized concepts. However, the majority of CDMs unrealistically presume that the user's collection of personalized concepts is static and incapable of incremental growth over time. Furthermore, they exhibit significant catastrophic forgetting and concept neglect of previously learned concepts when incrementally learning a sequence of new ones. To resolve the above challenges, we develop a novel Continually Customizable Diffusion Model (CCDM), enabling users to perform concept-incremental versatile customization. Specifically, we design an attribute-decoupled LoRA (AD-LoRA) module and a relevance-guided AD-LoRA aggregation strategy to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. They can preserve concept-specific attributes of each task and leverage beneficial inter-task correlations to enhance the continual learning of new customization tasks. Additionally, to address the challenge of concept neglect, we propose a controllable regional context synthesis strategy that performs multi-concept composition in alignment with user-provided conditions. This strategy enhances the overall consistency in multi-concept synthesis by guaranteeing semantic independence between user-defined regions and their smooth boundary transitions. Experiments show our CCDM exhibits significant improvements over baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种持续可定制扩散模型（CCDM），通过属性解耦LoRA模块、相关性引导的AD-LoRA聚合策略和可控区域上下文合成策略，解决了增量学习新概念时的灾难性遗忘和概念忽视问题，实现了概念增量式的多功能定制。
AI.motivation: 现有定制扩散模型假设用户收集的概念集是静态的，无法随时间增量增长；且在增量学习新概念时存在严重的灾难性遗忘和概念忽视问题。
AI.method: 1) 设计属性解耦LoRA (AD-LoRA)模块保留各任务的特定属性；2) 提出相关性引导的AD-LoRA聚合策略利用任务间有益关联增强持续学习；3) 提出可控区域上下文合成策略，通过保证用户定义区域的语义独立性及平滑边界过渡，实现多概念合成的一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明CCDM在持续定制任务上相较于基线方法有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: CCDM通过AD-LoRA及聚合策略有效缓解灾难性遗忘，通过可控区域上下文合成策略解决概念忽视问题，实现了概念增量式的持续定制扩散模型。

title: (Mis)generalization of Helpful-only Fine-tuning
summary: Helpful-only models, that is, models that are trained to always follow user intent, are valuable for dangerous capability evaluations and other areas of AI R&D where refusals would be an obstacle. Little is known about the generalization properties of helpful-only training: helpful-only models refuse less than their harmless counterparts, but previous work has not studied other dimensions of their alignment. We study the shortcomings of existing helpful-only models. We find that some show emergent misalignment, others have residual refusal behaviors, and most show poor steerability, sycophancy, and incoherent character. We show that simple anti-refusal training can cause many of these issues. None of these problems are necessary consequences of helpful-only training, though: we show that synthetic document fine-tuning and adding character-related questions to SFT and RL can mitigate them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了仅训练为有帮助性（helpful-only）的模型，发现它们存在涌现的不对齐（emergent misalignment）、残余拒绝行为、可操纵性差、谄媚（sycophancy）和角色不一致等问题。这些问题源于简单的反拒绝训练，但可通过合成文档微调和在SFT/RL中添加角色相关问题来缓解。
AI.motivation: 探索仅训练为有帮助性的模型在拒绝行为之外的泛化特性，识别其在对齐维度上的不足，并寻找缓解方法。
AI.method: 先分析现有helpful-only模型的缺陷（涌现不对齐、残余拒绝、可操纵性差、谄媚、角色不一致），再通过合成文档微调和在监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）中添加角色相关问题来缓解这些问题。
AI.result: 简单的反拒绝训练会导致上述多种问题；而合成文档微调及在SFT/RL中加入角色相关问题可以有效缓解这些缺陷。
AI.conclusion: Helpful-only训练存在的问题并非必然伴随该训练范式，可以通过特定的训练策略加以改善。

title: DVGT: Driving Visual Geometry Transformer
summary: Perceiving and reconstructing 3D scene geometry from visual inputs is crucial for autonomous driving. However, there still lacks a driving-targeted dense geometry perception model that can adapt to different scenarios and camera configurations. To bridge this gap, we propose a Driving Visual Geometry Transformer (DVGT), which reconstructs a global dense 3D point map from a sequence of unposed multi-view visual inputs. We first extract visual features for each image using a DINO backbone, and employ alternating intra-view local attention, cross-view spatial attention, and cross-frame temporal attention to infer geometric relations across images. We then use multiple heads to decode a global point map in the ego coordinate of the first frame and the ego poses for each frame. Unlike conventional methods that rely on precise camera parameters, DVGT is free of explicit 3D geometric priors, enabling flexible processing of arbitrary camera configurations. DVGT directly predicts metric-scaled geometry from image sequences, eliminating the need for post-alignment with external sensors. Trained on a large mixture of driving datasets including nuScenes, OpenScene, Waymo, KITTI, and DDAD, DVGT significantly outperforms existing models on various scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/wzzheng/DVGT.

AI.tldr: DVGT是一种面向自动驾驶的视觉几何Transformer模型，能够从无位姿的多视角图像序列中直接重建全局密集3D点云图，无需相机参数或外部传感器后处理，在多个驾驶数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法缺乏面向自动驾驶的密集几何感知模型，难以适应不同场景和相机配置，且依赖精确相机参数和外部传感器后处理。
AI.method: 使用DINO骨干提取图像特征，通过交替的帧内局部注意力、跨视角空间注意力和跨帧时序注意力推理几何关系，再用多解码头预测全局点云图和各帧位姿。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、OpenScene、Waymo、KITTI、DDAD等多个驾驶数据集上训练，DVGT显著优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: DVGT无需显式3D几何先验和相机参数，能灵活适应任意相机配置，直接预测度量尺度的几何结构，消除对外部传感器后对齐的需求。

title: Fast Cubical Persistent Homology on 2D and 3D Images via Union-Find, Pruning, and Lookup Tables
summary: We present Flash Cubical, a highly efficient computation of cubical persistence on a V-filtration for 2D and 3D images over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The implementation is built around three core ideas. First, cubical complexes satisfy properties that allow for the computation of persistence of the highest dimension via union-find and duality. Second, pruning of certain edges allows for a fast and efficient implementation of union-find. Third, the use of a lookup table, which exploits the regularity of cubical complexes to pre-compute local information. This avoids the need to compute local information at run time. To the best of our knowledge, this is the most efficient implementation of cubical persistence with a V-filtration, both in terms of time and memory costs. Although the paper focuses on persistence for V-filtration cubical complexes, the underlying ideas generalise naturally to T-filtrations on cubical complexes and suggest promising directions for other complexes.

AI.tldr: 提出Flash Cubical，一种在2D和3D图像上基于V-过滤计算立方体持久性的高效算法，通过并查集、对偶性、边剪枝和查找表技术实现目前最优的时间和内存效率。
AI.motivation: 现有立方体持久性计算在V-过滤下的效率不足，时间和内存开销较大，需要更高效的实现来支持2D/3D图像分析。
AI.method: 基于三个核心思路：1）利用立方体复形的性质，通过并查集和对偶性计算最高维度的持久性；2）剪枝特定边以加速并查集实现；3）利用查找表预先计算局部信息，避免运行时重复计算。
AI.result: 据作者所知，这是目前V-过滤立方体持久性在时间和内存成本上最高效的实现。
AI.conclusion: 该方法虽聚焦于V-过滤，但其核心思想可自然推广到T-过滤的立方体复形，并为其他复形上的持久性计算提供了有前景的方向。

title: Loss-Conditional PINNs for Parametric PDE Families
summary:
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) approximate solutions of ODEs and PDEs by minimising a weighted combination of residual, boundary, initial, and data losses. Their performance is often dominated by the choice of loss weights: a poor weighting can drive training to a degenerate solution in which one physical constraint is satisfied while another is ignored. Existing methods select or adapt a single good set of weights. We take a different view: instead of tuning one weight vector, we explore the entire weight space during training.
  We introduce LC-PINN, which adapts the loss-conditional training of Dosovitskiy and Djolonga (2020) to the PDE-residual setting: the conditioning vector (either the loss weights or a scalar physical coefficient) is treated as a network input and sampled from a simple prior at every optimisation step. This turns PINN training into learning a continuous family of solutions indexed by that vector, with no solver-generated paired data. LC-PINN thus lies between classical PINNs and operator learning: it stays fully physics-informed but amortises training over a parametric family. Our contribution is not the loss-conditional construction itself, but its extension to PINNs, the unification of the loss-weight and parametric-coefficient regimes under one architecture (concatenation for loss weights, FiLM for coefficients), and a fixed-quadrature L-BFGS finishing protocol that makes the parametric-coefficient regime trainable.
  We give a lambda-invariance result for the conditional optimum and study LC-PINN on parametric Helmholtz, Schrodinger, viscous Burgers, and Buckley-Leverett equations. A single LC-PINN matches or improves retrained per-weight PINN baselines while parameterising the full family in one model, at a total cost that amortises favourably against per-instance retraining.

AI.tldr: LC-PINN将条件训练引入物理信息神经网络，通过在训练过程中将损失权重或物理系数作为网络输入并从先验分布采样，使得单个模型能够连续参数化整个解族，无需为每个权重或系数重新训练。
AI.motivation: PINN的性能受损失权重选择主导，现有方法仅调优单一权重向量。论文探索在训练中覆盖整个权重空间，避免权重选择导致的退化解问题。
AI.method: 将损失权重或标量物理系数作为条件向量输入网络，在每个优化步从简单先验采样；对损失权重采用拼接(concatenation)方式，对物理系数采用FiLM调制；引入固定求积L-BFGS精修协议使参数化系数模式可训练。
AI.result: 单个LC-PINN在参数化亥姆霍兹、薛定谔、粘性Burgers和Buckley-Leverett方程的全族解时，匹配或优于每个权重单独重训练的PINN基线，且总成本优于逐实例重训练。
AI.conclusion: LC-PINN介于经典PINN和算子学习之间，完全保持物理信息特性，但对参数化族进行摊销训练，无需求解器生成的配对数据。

title: Ask When It Pays: Cost-Aware Open-Ended Interaction for Instance Goal Navigation
summary: Instance Goal Navigation (IGN) requires an embodied agent to find a specific object instance among distractors from an under-specified natural-language description. Such ambiguity often cannot be resolved from perception and language alone, making interaction with an oracle a natural mechanism for disambiguation. Prior interactive methods allow oracle queries but treat lightweight clarification and route-level guidance alike, letting agents boost success rate through repeated high-information questions rather than by resolving the underlying ambiguity efficiently. We recast interactive IGN as a cost-sensitive uncertainty-reduction problem, where the agent should ask the question whose answer provides the largest reduction in navigation uncertainty relative to its penalty. To this end, we apply an information-gain analysis on existing navigation corpora to identify which cues reduce navigation uncertainty, yielding a compact set of question types and data-derived weights. However, existing interactive navigation benchmarks do not model the cost of different question types or evaluate how efficiently agents use interaction, making them unsuitable for studying cost-sensitive interaction. Based on this taxonomy, we construct a benchmark for diagnosing interaction behavior and efficiency, together with a Weighted Success Rate metric that penalizes each query by its derived cost. We further propose a zero-shot MLLM navigator that selectively queries at each decision step only when the expected uncertainty reduction justifies the interaction cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对实例目标导航（IGN）中的歧义问题，提出了一种成本敏感的不确定性降低交互框架。通过信息增益分析从现有导航语料中提取关键问题类型及其权重，构建了考虑交互成本的基准测试和加权成功率指标，并设计了一个零样本MLLM导航器，仅在预期不确定性降低证明交互成本合理时才进行查询。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式IGN方法允许智能体向神谕者提问，但将轻量级澄清与路线级引导等同对待，导致智能体通过重复提出高信息量问题来提高成功率，而非高效地解决潜在歧义。缺乏对问题类型成本的区分和交互效率的评估。
AI.method: 1) 将交互式IGN重新定义为成本敏感的不确定性降低问题；2) 利用信息增益分析从现有导航语料中识别降低导航不确定性的线索，得出紧凑的问题类型集合和数据导出的权重；3) 构建考虑交互成本的基准测试；4) 提出加权成功率指标（按派生成本惩罚每次查询）；5) 设计零样本MLLM导航器，仅在预期不确定性降低超过交互成本时选择性查询。
AI.result: 构建了基于问题类型分类的交互行为诊断基准，以及加权成功率指标。提出了一个零样本MLLM导航器，能够在每个决策步骤权衡交互成本与不确定性降低收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过将交互视为成本敏感的不确定性降低问题，可以更高效地解决IGN中的语言歧义，避免过度依赖高成本查询，从而实现更自然、高效的智能体-神谕交互。

title: NoRA: Evaluating Grounded Reasonableness in Visual First-person Normative Action Reasoning
summary: LLMs and agentic systems are increasingly deployed in social environments, making normative competence critical for safe and appropriate behavior. However, existing approaches either assess normative judgment in text alone or reduce it to choosing among a fixed set of candidate actions. We argue both are insufficient. In practice, agents are never handed a menu of options; they must identify a reasonable action from scratch, grounded in visible facts and supported by inspectable reasons. We introduce NoRA, a visual first-person video benchmark that requires models to generate candidate next actions and justify each through an explicit fact-reason-action support graph. The benchmark comprises 1,420 annotated video clips, including HumanGold-190 and LLMSilver-1230 splits. Each instance is evaluated through action alignment, factual grounding, and support binding, aggregated into a single grounded reasonableness score. We benchmark 12 multimodal systems under direct, deliberate, and structured prompting regimes, finding that current VLMs frequently recover plausible actions and relevant scene facts, but consistently struggle to construct the full reasonable action space and bind selected actions to the correct local support. NoRA makes this gap measurable, shifting the evaluation question from whether a model can pick an action to whether it can justify an appropriate action for the right visible reasons.

AI.tldr: NoRA是一个基于第一人称视频的基准测试，要求模型生成候选动作并通过事实-理由-动作支持图进行论证，评估发现当前多模态模型虽能识别合理动作和场景事实，但难以构建完整动作空间并将动作与正确局部支持绑定。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么仅在文本中评估规范判断，要么将问题简化为从固定候选动作中选择，无法反映智能体在实践中需从零开始识别合理动作的真实需求。
AI.method: 构建包含1,420个标注视频片段的NoRA基准（HumanGold-190和LLMSilver-1230），要求模型生成候选动作并通过事实-理由-动作支持图进行论证，从动作对齐、事实依据和支持绑定三个维度计算综合合理性评分。
AI.result: 在直接、深思和结构化三种提示模式下评估12个多模态系统，发现VLM能够恢复合理动作和相关场景事实，但持续难以构建完整的合理动作空间，也无法将选定动作绑定到正确的局部支持上。
AI.conclusion: NoRA使当前模型的缺陷变得可测量，将评估问题从"模型能否选择动作"转向"模型能否基于正确的可见理由证明适当动作的合理性"。

title: The price of multi-group transductive learning
summary: We show every multi-group learner in the transductive setting may incur a multiplicative penalty in its error rate on some group relative to the error rate achievable in the single-group setting, and the penalty can increasing linearly with the number of groups, up to roughly the square-root of the sample size. This stands in stark contrast to optimal multi-group learners in an analogous (group-realizable) statistical setting, where the penalty is always at most logarithmic in the sample size and independent of the number of groups.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在直推式(transductive)设置下，多组学习器(multi-group learner)在某些群体上的错误率相对于单组设置可能存在乘法惩罚，且该惩罚随组数线性增长，最高可达样本量的平方根。这与统计设置(statistical setting)中的最优多组学习器形成鲜明对比，后者惩罚最多为样本量的对数且与组数无关。
AI.motivation: 研究多组学习器在不同学习范式（直推式 vs. 统计式）下的性能差异，揭示直推式设置中多组学习面临的内在困难。
AI.method: 通过理论分析和构造性论证，对比直推式设置与统计（组可实现）设置下多组学习器的误差惩罚边界，证明直推式设置中存在更紧的下界。
AI.result: 直推式设置下多组学习器的惩罚可随组数线性增长，最高达样本量平方根；而统计设置下惩罚最多为样本量对数且与组数无关。
AI.conclusion: 直推式多组学习本质上比统计式多组学习更困难，存在固有的性能折衷。

title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
summary: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream.exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream.exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream.exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dream.exe评估框架，通过将生成的视频转化为机器人可执行轨迹，在物理仿真器中评估视频生成模型对物理世界的理解能力。对8个模型在101个操作任务上的测试表明，视觉质量与可执行性存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽然在视觉上表现优异，但无法衡量其生成内容是否真正反映了物理世界的规律。作者提出通过机器人操作作为窗口，检验模型是否内化了物理知识。
AI.method: 提出Dream.exe框架：输入场景图像和任务描述 → 生成操作视频 → 将视频中的运动转化为机器人轨迹 → 在物理仿真器中执行。覆盖8个模型（闭源、开源、机器人专用模型），101个手工筛选的操作任务，三个物理复杂度级别。
AI.result: 多个模型在可执行性上取得可测量的成功；但视觉质量与可执行性之间相关性很弱，视觉上优秀的模型在物理执行上可能表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成模型从互联网数据中学习到了有意义的物理先验知识，但视觉评估标准无法捕捉模型在物理世界中的真实能力，需要引入执行导向的评估方法。

title: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and looped architectures scale models along two orthogonal axes, namely parameter capacity and effective depth. However, mainstream looped architectures rely on dense backbones that couple parameter count with per-token FLOPs, which makes it impossible to isolate the effect of iterative computation under matched budgets. To this end, we present LoopMoE, a looped MoE language model that integrates sparse routing with iterative weight-shared computation through two designs. The first is IterAdaLN, which resolves weight-sharing symmetry via a modulation signal jointly conditioned on the iteration index and the per-token hidden state. The second is a capacity-balancing strategy that recovers the attention-to-FFN active parameter ratio of well-tuned non-looped references. Together, these designs enable the first strictly controlled, head-to-head evaluation of a looped MoE against a Vanilla MoE under identical total parameters, per-token FLOPs, and active sublayer ratios. At the 3B scale, LoopMoE outperforms the Vanilla MoE on 8 of 9 downstream benchmarks with an average improvement exceeding 1 point. At the 9B scale, LoopMoE continues to outperform the matched Vanilla MoE, indicating that the architectural gain persists at larger scale. Our work establishes a controlled synthesis of sparsity and recurrence, and suggests a promising direction for looped language models.

AI.tldr: LoopMoE是一种循环MoE语言模型，通过IterAdaLN（基于迭代索引和隐态条件的调制信号解决权重共享对称性）和注意力-FFN容量平衡策略，在相同总参数量、每token FLOPs和活跃子层比例下，与Vanilla MoE进行严格对照评估。3B规模在8/9基准上平均提升超1点，9B规模仍保持优势。
AI.motivation: 现有循环架构依赖密集骨干网络，参数量与每token FLOPs耦合，无法在匹配预算下隔离迭代计算的影响。作者旨在通过稀疏路由与迭代权重共享的融合设计，实现首个严格受控的循环MoE与普通MoE的对照评估。
AI.method: 1) IterAdaLN：联合条件于迭代索引和每token隐态的调制信号，打破权重共享对称性；2) 容量平衡策略：恢复注意力与FFN活跃参数比例至调优的非循环参考模型水平。
AI.result: 3B规模下LoopMoE在8/9下游基准上优于Vanilla MoE，平均提升超1点；9B规模下仍保持优势，表明架构增益可扩展至更大规模。
AI.conclusion: LoopMoE建立了稀疏性与循环性的受控融合，为循环语言模型提供了有前景的发展方向。

title: OA-CutMix: Correcting the Label Bias of CutMix
summary: CutMix has become the de facto standard mixing augmentation, yet its label assignment rests on a flawed assumption: The area of the pasted patch faithfully reflects its semantic contribution to the mixed image. In practice, however, patches frequently land on background regions, assigning label credit to classes whose objects are not visible. The mean discrepancy of the CutMix label and the semantic object area is $21.5\%$. In $17\%$ of samples an image contributes zero visible object pixels yet receives nonzero label weight. We propose Object-Aware CutMix (OA-CutMix), which corrects this bias by replacing the area-based CutMix weight with one derived from precomputed segmentation masks, assigning labels in proportion to the visible object area each image contributes to the mix. The image mixing procedure is left entirely unchanged. We evaluate OA-CutMix against 10+ static and dynamic mixing methods across 4 architectures and 6 datasets. OA-CutMix consistently achieves the highest accuracy over all tasks, outperforming even dynamic mixing methods, but at a fraction of the training-time cost. Improvements are largest for small objects, where the label bias from CutMix is greatest. Thus, correcting the label is sufficient to match or exceed the performance of methods modifying the image mixing algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Object-Aware CutMix（OA-CutMix），通过用分割掩码计算的可见目标面积替代CutMix中基于面积的标签权重，纠正了原始CutMix的标签分配偏差，在不改变图像混合过程的情况下显著提升性能，尤其在小型目标上效果突出。
AI.motivation: CutMix的标签分配基于粘贴补丁的面积比例，但补丁常落在背景区域，导致标签权重分配给图像中不可见的类别。据统计，CutMix标签与语义目标面积的平均差异为21.5%，17%的样本中某图像贡献了零可见目标像素却获得非零标签权重，这种标签偏差需要被纠正。
AI.method: OA-CutMix保持CutMix的图像混合过程不变，仅修改标签分配方式：利用预计算的分割掩码计算每张图像在混合图像中可见目标像素的实际面积，然后根据可见目标面积比例分配标签权重，替代原先基于补丁面积的权重计算。
AI.result: 在4种架构、6个数据集上与10余种静态和动态混合方法对比，OA-CutMix在所有任务上持续取得最高准确率，甚至超越动态混合方法，但训练成本仅为动态方法的一小部分。对于小型目标，改进幅度最大，因为CutMix在此类目标上的标签偏差最严重。
AI.conclusion: 仅修正标签分配偏差就足以达到或超越修改图像混合算法的性能，表明CutMix的核心问题在于标签而非图像混合过程本身。

title: RowNet: A Memory Transformer for Tabular Regression
comment: Retrieval-based neural architecture for real estate valuation. Related to TabR (arXiv:2307.14338) and retrieval-augmented tabular learning
summary:
Real estate valuation is a structured regression problem in which prices are governed by heterogeneous feature types, sparse regional effects, nonlinear interactions, and the practical logic of comparable properties. Standard multilayer perceptrons treat each row as an isolated vector and must learn locality, scale sensitivity, and categorical matching from supervision alone. Gradient-boosted decision trees provide strong tabular baselines, but their feature-centric splitting mechanism does not explicitly model the retrieval of similar historical observations.
  This paper presents RowNet, a retrieval-based neural architecture for real estate price-per-square-meter prediction. RowNet represents a query property through pairwise similarity features against a memory bank of labeled properties. A first retrieval layer estimates a coarse target from feature-only similarities. A second layer augments the memory comparison with target-consistency features and uses multiple learned attention heads to retrieve complementary comparable sets. A final mixture-of-experts module combines learned gating, residual correction, entropy regularization, and head-diversity regularization to produce the prediction.

AI.tldr: RowNet是一种基于检索的神经网络架构，通过将查询房产与记忆库中标记房产进行成对相似性比较，结合双检索层和混合专家模块，实现每平方米房价的精准预测。
AI.motivation: 传统MLP将每行视为孤立向量，需从监督信号中学习局部性、尺度敏感性和类别匹配；梯度提升树虽提供强基准，但其基于特征的拆分机制无法显式建模类似历史观测的检索逻辑。
AI.method: RowNet包含：1) 第一检索层，基于纯特征相似性估计粗粒度目标；2) 第二检索层，引入目标一致性特征，使用多头注意力检索互补可比集合；3) 混合专家模块，融合门控、残差校正、熵正则化及头多样性正则化生成最终预测。
AI.result: 提出检索式神经网络RowNet，用于房地产每平方米价格预测。
AI.conclusion: RowNet通过显式建模可比房产检索逻辑，解决了房地产估值中区域性效应、非线性交互和可比性匹配等结构化回归问题。

title: 3D Temporal Analysis for Autism Spectrum Disorder Screening During Attention Tasks
summary: Accurate Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) screening for school-age children is crucial to identify cases that may have been missed earlier and to enable timely interventions supporting social, cognitive, and academic development. Current ASD screening relies on subjective assessments and 2D analysis methods that fail to capture spatial displacement patterns characteristic of ASD behaviors. In this study, a novel 3D temporal analysis framework is presented, built on top of DECA (Detailed Expression Capture and Animation), a 3D modeling framework, to extract comprehensive head pose parameters (including translational components $T_x, T_y, T_z$) and facial expressions independent of pose variations. LSTM and GRU-based temporal classifiers were trained on the extracted 3D features from video data collected from 39 participants (19 ASD, 20 TD) aged 7-12 years during Virtual Reality-Continuous Performance Test tasks. The GRU-based models demonstrated superior performance, with 3D head pose features achieving 83.9\% accuracy and 3D facial features reaching 81.4\% accuracy, outperforming 2D baseline approaches by 10.7\% and 7.5\%, respectively. Furthermore, multimodal fusion of 3D head pose and facial features with PCA-based dimensionality reduction achieved the highest accuracy of 84.6\%, outperforming unimodal approaches. This work establishes a foundation for objective, automated screening tools addressing current diagnostic limitations in ASD identification for school-age populations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于DECA的3D时空分析框架，提取头部姿态和面部表情特征，利用GRU/LSTM时序分类器对7-12岁儿童的ASD进行筛查，3D头部姿态特征准确率达83.9%，多模态融合达84.6%，超越2D基线方法。
AI.motivation: 当前ASD筛查依赖主观评估和2D分析方法，无法捕捉ASD行为特征中的空间位移模式，且学龄儿童可能存在早期漏诊，亟需客观、自动化的筛查工具。
AI.method: 基于DECA框架提取3D头部姿态参数（Tx, Ty, Tz）和姿态无关的面部表情特征；采用LSTM和GRU时序分类器；对39名参与者（7-12岁）在VR-CPT任务中的视频数据进行建模；使用PCA进行多模态特征融合降维。
AI.result: GRU模型表现最优：3D头部姿态特征准确率83.9%，3D面部特征81.4%，分别超越2D基线10.7%和7.5%；多模态融合（头部姿态+面部特征+PCA降维）达最高准确率84.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该3D时序分析框架为学龄儿童ASD客观自动化筛查提供了有效方案，有望弥补当前诊断方法的不足。

title: On Out-of-sample Embedding in UMAP
summary: Neighbor embedding algorithms reveal correlations in high-dimensional data by constructing an equivalent graph representation in a lower-dimensional space. An increasingly popular algorithm is Uniform Manifold Learning and Projection (UMAP), which uses algebraic topology to map distances between the two spaces. While it works well on many types of data sets, UMAP has trouble adding out-of-sample points to a pre-existing mapping. In particular, UMAP often places new points on the periphery of the found clusters, rather than in their interiors with their correlated neighbors. Here, we overcome this ``repulsion effect'' by optimizing pairwise interactions within the original k-nearest-neighbor graph. Moreover, we show that parameterizing UMAP obtains better embeddings than non-parametric algorithms, particularly as the data gets more complex (e.g., medical images). We also show that the repulsion effect is naturally mitigated when a parameterized UMAP is employed to embed the data. We characterize different UMAP approaches using trustworthiness, nearest neighbor classifiers, and by analyzing attractive and repulsive forces in the embeddings.

AI.tldr: UMAP存在"排斥效应"（新样本被映射到聚类外围而非内部），本文通过优化原始k近邻图中的成对交互克服该问题，并证明参数化UMAP比非参数化算法能获得更好的嵌入效果，尤其对于复杂数据（如医学图像）。
AI.motivation: UMAP在处理样本外映射时存在"排斥效应"，即新点被放置在已发现聚类的边缘而非内部，这限制了UMAP在需要增量学习或动态数据场景中的应用。
AI.method: 1) 优化原始k近邻图中的成对交互来克服排斥效应；2) 引入参数化UMAP框架；3) 使用可信度、最近邻分类器以及吸引力和排斥力分析来评估不同UMAP方法。
AI.result: 参数化UMAP可获得比非参数化算法更好的嵌入效果，数据越复杂（如医学图像）优势越明显；排斥效应在参数化UMAP中自然得到缓解。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化k近邻图成对交互可有效克服UMAP的排斥效应，参数化UMAP是更优的选择，尤其适用于复杂高维数据场景。

title: MusaCoder: Native GPU Kernel Generation with Full-Stack Training on Moore Threads GPU
summary: Native GPU kernel generation turns high-level tensor programs into executable, efficient low-level code. Existing Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with this task, while execution-based reinforcement learning suffers from sparse rewards, reward hacking, and training instability. We present MusaCoder, a full-stack training framework for native GPU kernel generation on CUDA and MUSA backends. MusaCoder combines progressive kernel-oriented data synthesis, diversity-preserving rejection fine-tuning, and execution-feedback Reinforcement Learning (RL) through MooreEval, a distributed verifier and reward environment. To stabilize RL, MusaCoder introduces PrimeEcho for first-turn-anchored multi-turn rewards, Buffered Dynamic Retry for recovering signals from all-failed hard samples, and MirrorPop for off-policy sequence filtering. Experiments on KernelBench and a MUSA-ported variant show that MusaCoder outperforms strong open-source and proprietary baselines in both correctness and empirical speedup, with the 9B model matching or exceeding frontier closed-source models and the 27B model establishing a new state of the art. These results demonstrate not only the effectiveness of full-stack execution-feedback training for native kernel generation, but also the capability of Moore Threads GPUs to support the complete LLM post-training stack, providing a practical foundation for large-model training and optimization on emerging accelerators.

AI.tldr: MusaCoder是一个面向CUDA和MUSA后端的原生GPU内核生成全栈训练框架，通过渐进式数据合成、保留多样性的拒绝微调、以及基于执行反馈的强化学习（包括MooreEval分布式验证器、PrimeEcho多轮奖励、Buffered Dynamic Retry和MirrorPop等机制），在KernelBench及其MUSA移植版本上显著优于现有开源和闭源模型，9B模型匹配或超越前沿闭源模型，27B模型达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM难以生成高效的原生GPU内核代码，而基于执行的强化学习面临奖励稀疏、奖励黑客和训练不稳定等问题。
AI.method: 提出了MusaCoder全栈训练框架，结合(1)渐进式内核导向数据合成，(2)保留多样性的拒绝微调，(3)基于执行反馈的强化学习，具体包括MooreEval分布式验证与奖励环境、PrimeEcho首轮锚定多轮奖励、Buffered Dynamic Retry全失败困难样本信号恢复、MirrorPop离策略序列过滤。
AI.result: 在KernelBench和MUSA移植基准上，MusaCoder在正确性和实际加速比上均优于强开源和闭源基线。9B模型匹配或超越前沿闭源模型，27B模型达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 验证了全栈执行反馈训练对原生GPU内核生成的有效性，同时证明了Moore Threads GPU能够支撑完整的LLM后训练栈，为新兴加速器上的大模型训练和优化提供了实用基础。

title: ParetoPilot: Zero-Surrogate Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Infer-Perturb-Guide Diffusion
summary: Offline multi-objective optimization (Offline MOO) aims to discover novel Pareto-optimal designs based on static datasets without expensive environment interactions. While recent generative methods have achieved notable success, they predominantly rely on external surrogate models. This dependency introduces significant computational overhead, suffers from deceptive evaluations, and deviates from the prevailing paradigm of jointly training mainstream generative models with conditions. To address these bottlenecks, we propose ParetoPilot, a novel zero-surrogate diffusion framework for offline MOO. ParetoPilot fully leverages the conditional priors inherently embedded within pre-trained diffusion models. At its core, the framework introduces the Infer-Perturb-Guide (IPG) engine, which is seamlessly interleaved within the unconditional denoising steps of the reverse generation process. First, it implicitly infers the instantaneous objective direction by matching conditional and unconditional noise predictions. Next, it mathematically orthogonalizes a parallel gravity field for strict convergence and an edgeness-aware repulsive force for mutual diversity, creating a dynamically annealed perturbation vector. Finally, this perturbed target seamlessly steers the generation process via standard Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). Extensive experiments across 51 tasks demonstrate that ParetoPilot outperforms 14 state-of-the-art surrogate-based and inverse generative baselines. By eliminating auxiliary proxy training, our approach preserves data privacy while achieving hypervolume improvement and robust Pareto front coverage.

AI.tldr: ParetoPilot提出了一种无代理模型的零扩散框架，通过推理-扰动-引导（IPG）引擎，在无条件去噪过程中隐式推断目标方向、正交化约束力与多样性力，实现离线多目标优化；在51个任务上超越14个现有方法，消除了对外部代理模型的依赖，降低了计算开销并提升了数据隐私性。
AI.motivation: 现有离线多目标优化方法依赖外部代理模型，存在计算开销大、评估欺骗性高、偏离主流生成模型联合训练范式等瓶颈。为此，本文旨在提出一种无需代理模型的扩散框架，以解决上述问题。
AI.method: 提出ParetoPilot框架，核心是Infer-Perturb-Guide (IPG)引擎。该引擎嵌入在无条件去噪过程中：1) Infer：通过匹配条件与无条件噪声预测，隐式推断瞬时目标方向；2) Perturb：数学上正交化一个平行引力场（确保严格收敛）和一个边缘感知排斥力（维持多样性），形成动态退火扰动向量；3) Guide：通过标准无分类器引导（CFG）将扰动目标无缝引导生成过程。
AI.result: 在51个任务上，ParetoPilot超越了14个基于代理模型和逆生成式基线方法，实现了超体积指标提升和稳健的帕累托前沿覆盖，同时消除了辅助代理训练，保护了数据隐私。
AI.conclusion: ParetoPilot通过零代理扩散框架有效解决了离线多目标优化中对外部代理模型的依赖问题，为生成模型在离线优化任务中的应用提供了新范式。

title: IRIS-GAN: Staged Specialist Detection of Deepfake Faces
summary: We introduce IRIS-GAN, a specialist forensic detector for synthetic face images under cross-generator shift. Rather than addressing universal synthetic-image detection, we focus on faces generated by generative adversarial networks (GANs), which are state-of-the-art in deepfake content, and train the detector through staged exposure to increasingly demanding GAN families while retaining earlier generators. The final model reaches fake-detection rates above 99% across the GAN families considered and classifies an external real-face dataset with 98.9% accuracy. Grad-CAM analysis further reveals measurable generator-dependent spatial response patterns, which remain informative for a secondary heatmap-only classifier. Out-of-family tests on diffusion-generated faces confirm that IRIS-GAN is a specialist detector, with some capability to reach non-GAN deepfakes. These results establish staged training as an effective strategy for robust GAN-face forensics.

AI.tldr: IRIS-GAN是一种针对GAN生成人脸图像的专用取证检测器，采用分阶段训练策略，逐步暴露于不同GAN家族，最终在多个GAN家族上达到99%以上的假脸检测率，在真实人脸上达到98.9%准确率，并展现出跨生成器泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有通用合成图像检测器在面对跨生成器场景时性能下降，而本文聚焦于GAN生成人脸这一特定深度伪造场景，旨在构建一个在跨生成器偏移下依然鲁棒的专用检测器。
AI.method: 采用分阶段暴露训练（staged exposure）策略：让检测器依次接触难度递增的GAN家族，同时保留早期生成器的训练数据，最终训练出IRIS-GAN模型。并使用Grad-CAM分析空间响应模式，以及训练辅助热图分类器。
AI.result: 在所考虑的GAN家族上假脸检测率超过99%，在外部真实人脸数据集上分类准确率达98.9%；Grad-CAM分析显示可测量的生成器依赖的空间响应模式；在扩散模型生成的人脸（非GAN）上，作为专用检测器仍具有一定的检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段训练是构建鲁棒GAN人脸取证检测器的有效策略，IRIS-GAN证明了专用检测器在跨生成器场景下的优越性。

title: ChessMimic: Per-Rating Transformer Models for Human Move, Clock, and Outcome Prediction in Online Blitz Chess
summary: We present ChessMimic, a system of three small encoder-only transformers - for move, thinking-time, and outcome prediction - conditioned on the position, recent move history, player rating, and clock state. We fit a separate instance of each model per 100-Elo rating band, trading parameter efficiency for sharper per-skill calibration. On a held-out month-wide slice of Lichess Rated Blitz games ChessMimic's human move prediction accuracy outperforms Maia-2 in every Elo band. Compared to Maia-3, our 9M parameter model's accuracy sits between Maia-3-5M and Maia-3-23M without the additional complexity of Geometric Attention Bias. In addition to the move matching model, we also train a game outcome model that conditions not only on the position, but also player ratings, time control, and remaining clock times. The outcome model achieves an AUC of 0.78 out of sample, beating Maia-2 as well as logistic regressions based on material, ratings, and clock time. Finally, we train a clock model that predicts human thinking times. The clock model provides a usable but non-SOTA per-ply think-time signal under ALLIE-style filters (Pearson r = 0.41, Spearman rho = 0.50, MAE 4.10 s, against ALLIE's reported r = 0.70), with the residual gap concentrated in per-position bucket sharpness rather than bucket-marginal calibration. A public demo is at 1e4.ai and we release code, per-band weights, and the C++ data-filter pipeline code in GitHub.

AI.tldr: ChessMimic是一个由三个小型encoder-only Transformer组成的系统，分别用于预测人类棋手的走子、思考时间和对局结果，在Lichess闪电战数据上，走子预测准确率超越Maia-2和Maia-3的部分变体，结果预测AUC达0.78，思考时间预测提供可用信号但未达SOTA水平。
AI.motivation: 现有棋类AI（如AlphaZero、Maia）要么专注于棋力最优，要么在较大模型上预测人类行为，缺乏在细粒度分技能水平（每100 Elo一个频段）上精确校准人类棋手行为的小型模型，同时缺少对思考时间和对局结果的多任务联合建模。
AI.method: 使用三个小型encoder-only Transformer分别建模走子、思考时间和结果，每个模型按每100 Elo频段独立训练；走子和结果模型以局面、历史走子、棋手等级分、时钟状态为条件，结果模型额外加入时间控制信息；时钟模型预测逐步行棋耗时，使用ALLIE风格滤波器评估。
AI.result: 走子预测：在每个Elo频段均优于Maia-2，9M参数模型介于Maia-3-5M和Maia-3-23M之间；结果预测：AUC 0.78，超越Maia-2和基于子力、等级分、时钟的逻辑回归；时钟预测：Pearson r=0.41，Spearman rho=0.50，MAE 4.10s，低于ALLIE的r=0.70。
AI.conclusion: 按Elo频段独立训练小模型可在特定技能水平上达到优于或接近大模型的预测性能，但思考时间预测仍与SOTA存在差距，主要差距在于每局面的桶内锐度而非桶边缘校准。

title: Recent Advances and Trends in Learning-based 3D Representations
summary: The selection of an appropriate 3D representation is a fundamental design decision that dictates the efficiency, quality, and capabilities of modern computer vision and graphics pipelines for tasks such as 3D reconstruction, novel-view synthesis and rendering, shape and motion analysis, recognition, and generation. While traditional representations (\eg meshes, point clouds, and volumetric grids) remain standard outputs of 3D sensors (\eg LiDAR and 3D scanners) and are widely used in downstream applications (\eg editing and simulation), recent neural and primitive-based representations (\eg 3D Gaussian Splatting) offer compact and differentiable alternatives opening a wide range of opportunities in applications such as games, AR/VR, autonomous driving, robot navigation, and medical imaging, to name a few. The goal of this paper is to survey the main families of 3D representations from discrete explicit formats to continuous implicit fields based either on neural rendering or primitive splatting. For each type of representation, we present the general formulation and its variants, discuss its benefits and limitations, and highlight key applications. We conclude the paper by outlining the open challenges and potential directions for future research. Distinct from recent surveys that broadly cover 3D object and scene reconstruction, this paper provides a focused analysis on the evolution of 3D representations themselves. We specifically emphasize the paradigm shift toward implicit representations, offering a novel perspective on how these emerging formats fundamentally alter 3D/4D workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了3D表示（从离散显式格式到连续隐式场）的演进，重点分析了神经渲染和基元泼溅等新兴隐式表示如何根本性地改变3D/4D工作流程，并讨论了各类表示的优势、局限及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 3D表示的选择是计算机视觉与图形学管线的核心设计决策，直接影响效率、质量和能力。现有综述多聚焦于3D重建本身，缺乏对3D表示自身演化的深入分析，尤其是向隐式表示的范式转变尚未得到系统梳理。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，对离散显式格式（网格、点云、体素网格）和连续隐式场（神经渲染、基元泼溅如3D高斯泼溅）进行分类讨论，每类阐述其通用形式、变体、优劣及关键应用，最后总结开放挑战与未来方向。
AI.result: 系统梳理了3D表示两大类别（显式与隐式）的演变脉络，揭示了隐式表示（尤其是神经渲染和基元泼溅）在紧凑性、可微性和表达能力上的优势，以及对游戏、AR/VR、自动驾驶、机器人导航、医学影像等领域的广泛影响。
AI.conclusion: 3D表示正经历从显式到隐式的范式转变，这一转变重新定义了3D/4D工作流程；指出当前开放挑战（如效率、可扩展性、鲁棒性）并展望了未来研究方向。

title: When Both Layers Learn: Training Dynamics of Representing Linear Models via ReLU Networks
comment: 47 pages, 8 figures, published at the 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory (COLT), 2026
summary: In this paper, we study the gradient descent dynamics for jointly training both layers of a one-hidden-layer ReLU network to fit a linear target function. Concretely, we consider a realizable setting where inputs are drawn i.i.d. from a Gaussian distribution and labels follow a planted linear model. This stylized framework captures salient features of end-to-end training in inverse problems and certain auto-encoder models. Despite its apparent simplicity, the dynamics remain poorly understood, in part because the loss landscape contains multiple non-strict saddle points, making it unclear why gradient descent from random initialization reliably escapes bad stationary regions. We provide a detailed characterization of the optimization landscape and prove that gradient descent from a moderately small random initialization-simultaneously training both layers-converges to a global minimizer at a linear rate with order-wise optimal sample complexity. Our analysis tracks the trajectory through three phases: an alignment phase in which hidden weights progressively align with the planted direction while the output weights maintain the correct sign pattern; a growth phase in which the norms of both layers increase while preserving alignment; and a local refinement phase in which the aligned neurons rapidly converge to the planted direction, yielding fast local convergence. To rigorously show that GD avoids non-strict saddles, we develop trajectory-level control arguments for the end-to-end dynamics. In addition, we establish novel uniform concentration results that hold along the entire trajectory, and are essential for obtaining order-wise optimal sample complexity. We corroborate our theory with extensive experiments across a range of configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了训练单隐层ReLU网络拟合线性目标函数的梯度下降动力学，证明了从随机初始化出发能以线性速率收敛到全局最小值，并达到了最优样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 理解端到端训练中梯度下降为何能可靠逃离非严格鞍点的坏区域，该问题在逆问题和自编码器中具有代表性，但现有理论尚不清晰。
AI.method: 将训练轨迹划分为三个阶段（对齐、增长、局部精炼），开发轨迹级控制参数分析端到端动力学，并建立沿整个轨迹的均匀浓度结果。
AI.result: 证明了梯度下降从适度小的随机初始化出发，联合训练两层网络能以线性速率收敛到全局最小值，且样本复杂度在阶上达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解非凸神经网络优化中梯度下降逃离鞍点机制提供了理论保证，所建立的轨迹控制和均匀浓度方法具有推广价值。

title: MAOAM: Unified Object and Material Selection with Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 Conference. Project page: \href{https://jadenpark0.github.io/project_pages/maoam/}{here}
summary: Selection is a core operation in interactive image editing. To be practical, a user should be able to specify and disambiguate the desired selection region through either text or click-based interactions, and the system should support selecting not only objects but also other criteria, such as materials. Material-based selection is valuable for tasks like re-texturing surfaces or editing instances of a specific material. However, existing vision-language-model (VLM) based selection methods are object-centric and typically support a single interaction modality, limiting their applicability. In this work, we thus present Mask Any Object And Material (MAOAM), a unified selection framework that enables precise object and material-level selection across both text- and click-based interactions. MAOAM leverages a VLM with a segmentation head to produce pixel-accurate masks from user prompts: the VLM interprets the user's selection intent (object or material-level) and encodes visual entities, attributes, and spatial relations, while the segmentation head decodes the output token into a mask. A key challenge is the lack of material selection datasets with text annotations. We propose a scalable data generation pipeline: we collect real and synthetic images with material masks, and leverage VLMs to generate material descriptions with rich visual-semantics. We train MAOAM with a multi-task objective over click and text-based selection, along with an auxiliary VQA task derived from the material descriptions to facilitate deeper material understanding. Despite being trained with uni-modal prompts, our model exhibits an emergent improvement in selection when combining text and clicks at inference, enabling flexible image editing workflows. Experiments demonstrate accurate and coherent selections across diverse objects, materials, and interaction scenarios, highlighting robustness in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAOAM，一个统一的图像选择框架，支持通过文本或点击交互实现对象级和材质级选择，解决了现有VLM方法仅支持单一模态和对象中心的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于VLM的选择方法以对象为中心且仅支持单一交互模态，无法满足材质级选择（如重新纹理化表面或编辑特定材质实例）的实际需求。
AI.method: MAOAM结合VLM与分割头，从用户提示生成像素级掩码；提出可扩展的数据生成流程，利用真实/合成图像及VLM生成材质描述；采用多任务训练（点击+文本选择）及辅助VQA任务增强材质理解。
AI.result: 实验表明MAOAM在多种对象、材质和交互场景下实现准确一致的选择，且多模态推理时展现出涌现性的效果提升，支持灵活的图像编辑工作流。
AI.conclusion: MAOAM统一了对象与材质级选择，支持文本和点击双模态交互，为交互式图像编辑提供了更实用、鲁棒的解决方案。

title: LimiX-2M: Mitigating Low-Rank Collapse and Attention Bottlenecks in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) increasingly rival tree ensembles, but their performance is often compute-inefficient: with standard affine scalar tokenization, each feature injects value variation through an essentially one-dimensional channel, and feature IDs/positional signals cannot increase within-feature value degrees of freedom, yielding weak early-layer value sensitivity and redundant hidden states. We present a unified \emph{tokenize-and-route} framework for strong TFMs: \textbf{RaBEL} expands each scalar into compact localized RBF features (optionally exponent-gated) to improve conditioning and shallow-layer effective rank, while a reordered bidirectional block \textbf{S$\rightarrow$N$\rightarrow$F} aligns computation with the readout by aggregating cross-sample context before feature mixing and using attention pooling. Together, these changes yield \textbf{LimiX-2M}, a 2M-parameter model that outperforms larger TabPFN-v2 and TabICL baselines on widely used tabular benchmarks while reducing training and inference costs. These results highlight value-aware tokenization and readout-aligned routing as key levers for improving the accuracy--efficiency trade-off in TFMs. Model checkpoints and inference code are available at https://github.com/limix-ldm-ai/LimiX.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RaBEL（基于RBF的标记化）和S→N→F重排序双向块，构建了仅2M参数的LimiX-2M模型，在表格基准上超越更大规模的TabPFN-v2和TabICL，并降低了训练和推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFMs）使用标准仿射标量标记化时，每个特征仅通过一维通道注入值变异，特征ID/位置信号无法增加特征内值的自由度，导致早期层值敏感性弱和隐藏状态冗余，计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出统一的tokenize-and-route框架：(1) RaBEL将每个标量扩展为紧凑的局部RBF特征（可选指数门控）以改善条件数和浅层有效秩；(2) 重排序的双向块S→N→F，先聚合跨样本上下文再特征混合，并使用注意力池化，使计算与读取对齐。
AI.result: LimiX-2M（2M参数）在广泛使用的表格基准上优于更大规模的TabPFN-v2和TabICL基线，同时降低了训练和推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 值感知的标记化和读取对齐的路由是改进表格基础模型精度-效率权衡的关键杠杆。

title: DiverAge: Reliable Pluralistic Face Aging with Cross-Age Identity Relation Guidance
summary: Face aging plays an important role in long-term biometric analysis, cross-age identity verification, and forensic identity analysis. Since the same subject may exhibit multiple plausible appearances at a target age due to genetic, environmental, and lifestyle factors, face aging is inherently a one-to-many generation problem. However, pluralism alone is insufficient for reliable face aging: a model should provide appearance-level candidate diversity within each age group while maintaining sequence-level ordinal reliability across ordered age groups. Existing deterministic aging methods can synthesize visually plausible age-progressed faces, but usually lack stochastic diversity. In contrast, pluralistic aging methods introduce local appearance variations, but often fail to explicitly regulate the identity evolution of the full aging sequence. In this paper, we propose \textbf{DiverAge}, a hierarchical pluralistic face aging framework based on diffusion autoencoding. DiverAge preserves appearance-level diversity through stochastic diffusion decoding and age-conditioned semantic modulation. To improve sequence-level reliability, we introduce a Cross-age Identity Relation Regulator (CARR), an inference-time guidance strategy that jointly denoises multiple target age groups. CARR is guided by a Cross-age Identity Similarity (CIS) prior estimated from real same-identity cross-age pairs, and suppresses excessive cross-age identity drift through one-sided sampling-time guidance without modifying the training objective or introducing extra trainable parameters. Experiments demonstrate that DiverAge improves sequence-level ordinal reliability while maintaining identity preservation, age accuracy, image quality, and appearance-level diversity.

AI.tldr: DiverAge是一种基于扩散自编码的分层多元人脸老化框架，通过随机扩散解码和年龄条件语义调制保持外观多样性，并引入跨年龄身份关系调节器（CARR）作为推理时引导策略，利用真实跨年龄身份相似性先验抑制身份漂移，从而在保持多样性的同时提升序列级序贯可靠性。
AI.motivation: 人脸老化本质上是一对多的生成问题，现有确定性方法缺乏随机多样性，而多元化方法能引入局部外观变化但未能明确调节完整老化序列的身份演化，因此需要一种既能提供外观级候选多样性又能保持序列级序贯可靠性的方法。
AI.method: 提出DiverAge框架，基于扩散自编码实现分层多元化人脸老化；通过随机扩散解码和年龄条件语义调制保持外观级多样性；引入跨年龄身份关系调节器（CARR），利用真实同身份跨年龄对的跨年龄身份相似性（CIS）先验，通过单侧采样时间引导抑制过度的跨年龄身份漂移，无需修改训练目标或引入额外可训练参数。
AI.result: 实验表明DiverAge在保持身份保留、年龄准确性、图像质量和外观级多样性的同时，显著提升了序列级序贯可靠性。
AI.conclusion: DiverAge有效平衡了人脸老化中的多样性（多元化）与可靠性（序贯一致性），通过推理时引导策略在不增加训练复杂度的情况下解决了跨年龄身份漂移问题。

title: Episodic Memory Temporal Consistency for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) frequently suffers from severe reward sparsity and exploration bottlenecks. While episodic memory mechanisms mitigate these issues by reusing high-return trajectories, they often trap agents in local optima due to unconstrained incentive distribution and semantic representation collapse. To address this, we propose Episodic Memory Temporal Consistency (EMTC), a framework that robustly constructs and selectively leverages historical experiences. EMTC introduces two synergistic components: (1) a Temporally Consistent Semantic Embedder that integrates contrastive learning with time-conditioned state reconstruction, preventing representation collapse and enabling precise memory retrieval; and (2) a Temporal Consistency Gating Mechanism that dynamically modulates episodic incentives based on temporal consistency error. This adaptive gate filters misleading signals from pseudo-successful trajectories, effectively mitigating Q-value overestimation. We provide theoretical guarantees, establishing a strict error bound that directly links the observable temporal consistency error to the underlying trajectory optimality and representation quality. Extensive evaluations on the SMAC and GRF benchmarks demonstrate that EMTC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, compared to the strongest episodic baseline, EMTC achieves absolute win-rate improvements of up to 24% in super-hard SMAC scenarios and an average improvement of 28% across GRF tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为EMTC的框架，通过时间一致性语义嵌入器和时间一致性门控机制，解决多智能体强化学习中奖励稀疏和探索瓶颈问题，在SMAC和GRF基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习中存在严重的奖励稀疏性和探索瓶颈，现有情节记忆机制虽能复用高回报轨迹，但因无约束的激励分配和语义表示坍塌，常使智能体陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 提出EMTC框架，包含两个协同组件：(1) 时间一致性语义嵌入器，结合对比学习与时间条件状态重构，防止表示坍塌并实现精确记忆检索；(2) 时间一致性门控机制，基于时间一致性误差动态调节情节激励，过滤伪成功轨迹中的误导信号，缓解Q值过估计。
AI.result: 在SMAC超困难场景中相比最强情节基线获得最高24%的绝对胜率提升，在GRF任务上平均提升28%，且提供了将时间一致性误差与轨迹最优性和表示质量直接关联的严格误差界理论保证。
AI.conclusion: EMTC通过保持时间一致性有效缓解了表示坍塌和Q值过估计问题，在多智能体协作任务中显著优于现有最先进基线方法。

title: HD-DinoMoE: A Class-Aware Hierarchical Dual Mixture-of-Experts Network for Scleral Anomaly Segmentation in Complex Acquisition Scenarios
comment: Submitted to Medical Image Analysis; 47 pages, 31 figures, 14 tables
summary: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) ocular inspection provides empirical cues for assessing scleral surface anomalies, but its clinical use remains subjective and difficult to quantify. To support intelligent and quantifiable ocular inspection, this study presents the TCM-inspired Artificial Intelligence Ocular Auxiliary Diagnosis System (TAO) and focuses on pixel-level scleral surface anomaly segmentation. For clinical and user-acquired images affected by multi-source distributional discrepancies, diverse anomaly morphologies, and scleral specular reflection (SSR), we propose HD-DinoMoE, a class-aware hierarchical dual mixture-of-experts network. HD-DinoMoE combines class-aware dual-stream DINOv3 feature fusion with class-specific multi-expert decoding to segment Vessels, Yellow and Black Spots, and Blood Spots. A three-stage backbone-frozen routing strategy stabilizes dual-backbone adaptation; Progressive Confidence Penalty (PCP) Loss reduces high-confidence false positives and segmentation leakage in SSR regions; and Class-Aware Adaptive Sample Weighting (CA-ASW) balances sample- and class-level training contributions. We further construct the Multi-label Scleral Anomaly Segmentation Dataset (ML-SASD), a new benchmark with Clinical, Wild, and Mix settings and pixel-wise annotations for three anomaly categories. On ML-SASD-Mix, HD-DinoMoE achieves a mean Dice of 72.11% and a mean Intersection-over-Union of 58.44%, while maintaining favorable boundary localization and specular-region false-positive control. It also shows competitive generalization on the Vessels subset of the public SBVPI dataset. These results indicate that HD-DinoMoE provides a feasible segmentation solution for TAO under complex acquisition scenarios. The code and data access information are available at https://github.com/FX-CMX/HD-DinoMoE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HD-DinoMoE网络，用于中医目诊中巩膜表面异常（血管、黄/黑斑、血斑）的像素级分割，在构建的多标签巩膜异常分割数据集（ML-SASD）上取得72.11%的平均Dice，有效解决了多源分布差异、异常形态多样和巩膜镜面反射等挑战。
AI.motivation: 中医目诊中巩膜表面异常评估依赖主观经验，缺乏量化标准。现有AI方法受限于多源图像分布差异、异常形态多样及巩膜镜面反射问题，难以实现精准、鲁棒的像素级分割。
AI.method: 提出HD-DinoMoE：1）类感知双流DINOv3特征融合；2）类特定多专家解码架构；3）三阶段骨干冻结路由策略稳定双骨干适配；4）渐进置信惩罚损失（PCP Loss）抑制镜面反射区高置信假阳性；5）类感知自适应样本加权（CA-ASW）平衡样本和类别训练贡献。同时构建ML-SASD数据集，含Clinical、Wild、Mix三种设置及像素级标注。
AI.result: 在ML-SASD-Mix上达到72.11%平均Dice和58.44%平均IoU，边界定位和镜面反射区域假阳性控制表现良好；在公开SBVPI数据集的Vessels子集上表现出竞争性的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: HD-DinoMoE为复杂采集场景下TAO系统提供了可行的分割解决方案，实现了中医目诊的智能化和量化分析。

title: Smart Picks in the Dark: Towards Efficient RLVR for Reasoning via Tracing Metacognitive Pivots
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has greatly advanced large reasoning models (LRMs), but it requires timely training on a huge fully-annotated dataset. To this end, data-efficient RLVR methods have been widely studied from two perspectives: (i) data selection methods identify a small subset of "golden" samples that yield near-full-data performance, but they rely on a pre-existing pool of labeled data. (ii) unsupervised RLVR methods train the model using its own internal supervision signals on large-scale unlabeled data, yet they exhibit suboptimal performance. Accordingly, we investigate the "pick in the dark" setup for RLVR, which aims to select, without prior supervision, unlabeled samples that are most beneficial for training and worthy of annotation. Through systematic analysis, we demonstrate that smart picks hinge on a well-calibrated uncertainty estimator to enable strategic partitioning of data for adaptive training regimes. Building on this insight, we propose PivotTrace, a three-way data triage framework that leverages attention dynamics to trace metacognitive pivots during reasoning. By precisely quantifying uncertainty through pivot density, PivotTrace achieves automated data routing to synergistically maximize both annotation and training efficiency. Empirically, PivotTrace surpasses the fully supervised LRM with only 29.3% annotated samples and 2.75 faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PivotTrace框架，通过注意力动力学追踪推理过程中的元认知枢轴点，在无监督条件下高效选择最值得标注的数据样本，仅用29.3%的标注样本和2.75倍收敛加速即超越全监督大推理模型。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)方法存在瓶颈：数据选择方法依赖预先标注的数据池，而无监督RLVR方法性能次优。因此，本文研究在无先验监督条件下，从无标注数据中挑选对训练最有益、值得标注的样本的"暗中选择"问题。
AI.method: 提出PivotTrace框架，利用注意力动力学追踪推理过程中的元认知枢轴点，通过枢轴密度精确量化不确定性，实现数据的三路分诊路由，自适应分配训练资源。
AI.result: 仅需29.3%的标注样本即可超越全监督LRM，同时实现2.75倍的收敛加速。
AI.conclusion: 聪明的数据选择依赖于校准良好的不确定性估计器，通过策略性地划分数据实现自适应训练机制，PivotTrace通过枢轴密度实现了自动数据路由，协同最大化标注和训练效率。

title: Hierarchical Space Partition for Surface Reconstruction
comment: Published in 2026 International Conference on 3D Vision (3DV)
summary: Generating compact polygonal models from point clouds is a key problem in 3D vision and computer graphics. However, due to inherent limitations of LiDAR scanning (e.g. range constraints and occlusions), critical scene information is often missing, leading to degraded reconstruction accuracy. To address this, we propose a plane assembling strategy that effectively recovers missing details while maintaining model compactness. We classify all the planes extracted from the scene into three categories: highly visible, barely visible, and invisible. The invisible planes, which are recovered by scene structure analysis, indicate the missing details. The three types of planes correspond to the three growth priorities. Each plane grows according to the priority level, and the space is partitioned progressively, namely, the hierarchical partition. Subsequently, we generate a watertight polygonal mesh from the partition via a min-cut-based optimization. Finally, comparisons on public datasets show the effectiveness and superiority of our method against mainstream approaches. The project page is available at https://hsr-3dv.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于平面组装策略的点云多边形重建方法，通过将平面分为高可见、低可见和不可见三类，并赋予不同生长优先级进行层次化空间划分，再通过最小割优化生成水密多边形网格，有效恢复了LiDAR扫描中缺失的场景细节。
AI.motivation: LiDAR扫描存在距离限制和遮挡等固有限制，导致关键场景信息缺失，影响重建精度。现有方法难以在保持模型紧凑性的同时有效恢复缺失细节。
AI.method: (1) 将提取的平面分为高可见、低可见和不可见三类；不可见平面通过场景结构分析恢复；(2) 三种平面对应三种生长优先级，按优先级进行层次化空间划分；(3) 基于最小割优化从划分中生成水密多边形网格。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上的比较表明，该方法在效果和优越性上优于主流方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的平面组装策略能够有效恢复LiDAR点云中缺失的场景细节，同时保持重建模型的紧凑性，在公共数据集上验证了其有效性和优越性。

title: GeoMin: Data-Efficient Semi-Supervised RLVR via Geometric Distribution Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) significantly advances LLM reasoning, yet it faces a dilemma: standard supervised scaling is throttled by high annotation costs, while unsupervised alternatives suffer from severe model collapse. Recent semi-supervised RLVR methods address this by using a small labeled set to guide unlabeled data, achieving a promising trade-off between training efficacy and annotation cost. However, they suffer from a severe data-efficiency bottleneck due to the reliance on coarse performance heuristics, leaving a vast majority of valuable instances underutilized. To this end, we propose GeoMin, which models global feature distributions on labeled data to decode the structural discrepancy between correct and incorrect rollouts, thereby establishing a robust prior to assess the reliability of self-reward signals and fully unleash the potential of unlabeled data. Empirically, GeoMin outperforms the strongest baselines by +4.1% and even surpasses fully supervised models with only 10% of the annotations, demonstrating remarkable data efficiency.

AI.tldr: Geometric Minor (GeoMin) 通过建模全局特征分布来解码正确/错误 rollout 之间的结构差异，建立鲁棒先验评估自奖励信号可靠性，从而在仅用10%标注数据的情况下超越全监督模型，数据效率提升4.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督RLVR方法面临数据效率瓶颈：依赖粗粒度的性能启发式方法导致大量有价值的未标注样本未被充分利用。
AI.method: GeoMin对标注数据建模全局特征分布，解码正确与错误rollout之间的结构差异，建立鲁棒先验来评估自奖励信号的可靠性，从而充分释放未标注数据的潜力。
AI.result: GeoMin超越最强基线4.1%，且在仅使用10%标注数据的情况下超越全监督模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何方法建模特征分布的结构差异可以显著提升半监督RLVR的数据效率，降低对标注成本的依赖。

title: CDPM-Align: Multi-Scale Guidance-Aligned Diffusion Pretraining for Robust Few-Shot Anatomical Landmark Detection
summary: Anatomical landmark detection is a fundamental task in medical image analysis supporting a wide range of diagnostic and interventional workflows. Although recent methods have achieved sub-millimetric localisation, accuracy alone is not sufficient for clinical deployment, requiring reliability and robustness in prediction. Despite its clinical relevance, the impact of representation learning in this context is still underexplored. In this work, we introduce CDPM-align, a multi-scale guidance-aligned conditional diffusion pre-training for anatomical landmark detection. Our experimental setup focuses on a few images and a few annotation regimes. Specifically, we employ three popular heterogeneous small-scale benchmark datasets for representation learning via conditional generative pre-training. Furthermore, we consider low-annotation scenarios for the downstream task of landmark detection, with 10 and 25 annotated images, reflecting realistic trade-offs between clinical effort and resource constraints for annotations. Our results confirm that generative pre-training enables the model to learn a robust representation. This improves both accuracy and uncertainty on the downstream tasks, advancing towards safe and efficient clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: CDPM-align是一种多尺度引导对齐的条件扩散预训练方法，用于解剖标志点检测。在少量图像和少量标注（10或25张）条件下，通过生成式预训练学习鲁棒表征，提升下游任务的准确性和不确定性评估，推动安全高效的临床部署。
AI.motivation: 解剖标志点检测的现有方法虽达到亚毫米精度，但仅靠准确度不足以满足临床部署对可靠性和鲁棒性的要求，而表征学习在该场景下的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出CDPM-align，一种多尺度引导对齐的条件扩散预训练方法。在三个异质小规模基准数据集上进行条件生成式预训练，随后在仅含10或25张标注图像的低标注场景下进行下游标志点检测。
AI.result: 生成式预训练使模型学习到鲁棒的表征，在低标注下游任务中同时提升了准确性和不确定性评估性能。
AI.conclusion: 生成式预训练有助于在标注稀缺条件下实现准确且可靠的地标检测，为安全高效的临床部署提供了可行路径。

title: Rollout-Level Advantage-Prioritized Experience Replay for GRPO
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards with GRPO is a standard approach for post-training reasoning LLMs. It remains sample inefficient. Each rollout is used for a single gradient update and then discarded. Naive replay is not well suited in this setting because LLM policies drift quickly per gradient step. Stored rollouts therefore become stale and can destabilize training. We propose a rollout-level replay buffer for GRPO that stores and samples individual rollouts rather than whole groups. The buffer bounds staleness through age eviction. Any rollout older than tau_max training steps is removed. The buffer also preserves on-policy data via fresh-anchored composition. Each batch keeps its fresh on-policy rollouts and then concatenates replay rollouts drawn separately from the buffer. We prioritize replay by per-rollout advantage magnitude and recycle individual rollouts whose advantages are large. Across three Qwen3-Base scales on five math benchmarks, our method outperforms GRPO and naive replay baselines. Gains are positive at every scale and grow with model size. The largest gain is +4.35 pp on the five-benchmark average at 4B. Under an AES metric that jointly measures accuracy and token efficiency, the efficiency margin over GRPO is again largest at 4B, at +0.579.

AI.tldr: 针对GRPO在推理LLM后训练中样本效率低的问题，提出了一种基于轨迹级别重放缓冲区的改进方法，通过年龄驱逐机制限制数据过时、新鲜锚定组合保留在策略数据、以及按优势幅度优先级采样重用高价值轨迹，在多个数学基准上显著优于GRPO和朴素重放基线。
AI.motivation: 标准GRPO每轮 rollout 仅用于一次梯度更新即丢弃，样本效率低下；而朴素重放因LLM策略每步漂移快、存储的rollout迅速过时会导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出轨迹级别重放缓冲区：(1) 年龄驱逐机制，超过τ_max步的rollout被移除；(2) 新鲜锚定组合，每个batch保留当前新鲜的在策略rollout，再从缓冲区中独立采样重放rollout拼接；(3) 按每条轨迹的优势幅度进行优先级采样，重用优势大的轨迹。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Base三个规模、五个数学基准上，该方法在所有规模均优于GRPO和朴素重放，增益随模型规模增大而增长，4B模型上平均提升+4.35个百分点，AES效率指标提升+0.579。
AI.conclusion: 所提的轨迹级重放缓冲区有效解决了GRPO样本效率低下的问题，通过控制过时和优先级重用策略稳定并加速了训练，且在大模型上效果更显著。

title: BreastGPT: A Multimodal Large Language Model for the Full Spectrum of Breast Cancer Clinical Routine
summary: Breast cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women. Its clinical management requires multimodal reasoning across a clinical workflow that spans \textit{screening}, \textit{diagnosis} and \textit{treatment planning}, where each stage involves distinct imaging modalities, task objectives, and reasoning patterns. However, constrained by data scarcity and model versatility, existing medical MLLMs are typically evaluated on isolated modalities or narrow task families, limiting their ability to support workflow-level clinical reasoning. In this work, we first introduce \textbf{BreastStage}, a workflow-aligned breast imaging instruction corpus comprising 1.86M instruction-following pairs curated from 17 sub-datasets across 5 imaging modalities and 136 task templates. Its held-out split, \textbf{BreastStage-Bench}, provides a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multimodal reasoning across the breast cancer care continuum. Building on this corpus, we propose \textbf{BreastGPT}, a unified MLLM equipped with a dual-branch visual encoder and concept-preserving token compression to bridge the scale gap between standard radiology and gigapixel pathology. On BreastStage-Bench, BreastGPT achieves 75.66\% closed-ended accuracy and 89.92\% open-ended score, outperforming both general-purpose and medical-specific MLLMs across clinical stages and task formats. These results suggest that workflow-aligned data and cross-scale visual modeling are critical for clinically grounded medical MLLMs. All data, code, and model checkpoints are released at https://yangyy-liu.github.io/BreastGPT.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出乳腺影像工作流对齐的指令数据集BreastStage（含186万指令对、5种影像模态、17个子数据集、136个任务模板）及评测基准BreastStage-Bench，并基于此训练统一多模态大语言模型BreastGPT，采用双分支视觉编码器和概念保留令牌压缩技术弥合放射影像与病理影像的尺度差异，在Bench上闭式准确率75.66%、开式评分89.92%，优于通用和医学专用MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有医学多模态大语言模型受限于数据稀缺和模型能力，通常仅在孤立模态或狭窄任务族上评估，无法支持乳腺癌临床工作流（筛查-诊断-治疗规划）中跨模态、多任务、多推理模式的联合推理。
AI.method: 1) 构建BreastStage：从5种影像模态（含17个子数据集）和136个任务模板中整理186万指令对，对齐筛查、诊断、治疗规划三阶段临床工作流；2) 提出BreastGPT：统一MLLM，配备双分支视觉编码器处理标准放射影像与千兆像素病理影像，采用概念保留令牌压缩技术桥接尺度差异。
AI.result: 在BreastStage-Bench上，BreastGPT闭式准确率75.66%、开式评分89.92%，在临床阶段和任务格式上均优于通用（如GPT-4V）和医学专用MLLM。
AI.conclusion: 工作流对齐的数据和跨尺度视觉建模对临床落地的医学MLLM至关重要，所有资源已开源。

title: SurvPFN: Towards Foundation Models for Survival Predictions
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to "Foundation Models for Structured Data" Workshop at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have made rapid progress in standard classification and regression, but time-to-event survival prediction tasks have remained largely untouched. Unlike in standard regression tasks, survival prediction models must account for censored data. Standard TFMs cannot handle natively censored data, leading to biased and inaccurate predictions, making them unsuitable for real-world applications. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose \texttt{SurvPFN}, a prior-data fitted network (PFN), for survival prediction tasks. We pretrain \texttt{SurvPFN} on millions of synthetic survival prediction tasks to learn survival via distributional regression that accounts for censored data. \texttt{SurvPFN} works by (1) generating data with Weibull event times and a non-informative censoring mechanism; (2) integrating a censored event indicator; and (3) minimizing a censored negative log-likelihood. On SurvSet, a collection of real-world survival tasks, \texttt{SurvPFN} is highly competitive with classical and deep survival baselines without per-dataset fitting, a survival-specific architecture, or feature engineering. We show that survival can be treated as a continuous-time distributional regression problem with censored loss, unlocking the power of PFNs for time-to-event predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SurvPFN，一种基于先验数据拟合网络的生存预测模型，通过在数百万合成生存任务上预训练，利用分布回归处理删失数据，在真实数据集上无需逐数据集拟合即可与经典和深度生存基线相媲美。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型(TFMs)无法处理删失数据，导致在生存预测任务中产生有偏且不准确的预测，而生存预测在真实应用中至关重要。
AI.method: (1) 使用Weibull事件时间与非信息删失机制生成合成数据；(2) 整合删失事件指示器；(3) 最小化删失负对数似然损失，在数百万合成生存任务上预训练SurvPFN。
AI.result: 在SurvSet真实生存任务集合上，SurvPFN无需逐数据集拟合、专用生存架构或特征工程，即可与经典和深度生存基线高度竞争。
AI.conclusion: 生存预测可视为带删失损失的连续时间分布回归问题，从而解锁先验数据拟合网络在时间-事件预测中的能力。

title: Geometry-Aware Distillation for Prompt Tuning Biomedical Vision-Language Models
comment: Preprint. Code is available at https://github.com/tientrandinh/OGKD
summary: Current prompt-based and adapter-based tuning of vision-language models (VLMs) is attractive for medical imaging, where clinical data sensitivity favors frozen backbones and annotations are limited. However, these methods typically optimize only the ground-truth class, treating all other classes as equally incorrect, ignoring clinically meaningful class relations and yielding unstable decision boundaries in limited-supervision settings. We propose Omni-Geometry Knowledge Distillation (OGKD), a new framework that injects class-relation structure into the teacher to produce directional targets that preserve the ground truth while respecting inter-class geometry. Using these targets, we develop two distillation losses: Global Geometry-Aware Distillation (GAD) operates on the global image token, and Label-Guided Geometry Distillation (LGD) applies the same geometry to attentive patch tokens to improve fine-grained alignment. Across comprehensive experiments and analyses on 11 widely-used medical datasets for base-to-novel and few-shot evaluations, our OGKD achieves substantially better performance, consistently improving accuracy by an average absolute gain of 1.7%-2.8% over all prior state-of-the-art VLM adaptation counterparts. It also robustly generalizes to unseen classes and yields more reliable predictions than other approaches. Our code is available at https://github.com/tientrandinh/OGKD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omni-Geometry Knowledge Distillation (OGKD)框架，通过注入类别间几何结构信息到教师模型，生成保留真实标签同时尊重类别间关系的方向性目标，并设计了全局几何感知蒸馏(GAD)和标签引导几何蒸馏(LGD)两种损失函数，在11个医学数据集上的base-to-novel和少样本评估中，相比现有最先进的VLM适应方法，平均绝对准确率提升1.7%-2.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有提示学习和适配器微调方法仅优化真实标签类别，将所有其他类别视为同等错误，忽略了临床上有意义的类别间关系，在标注有限的场景下产生不稳定的决策边界。
AI.method: 提出OGKD框架，将类别关系结构注入教师模型生成方向性目标；开发全局几何感知蒸馏(GAD)损失作用于全局图像token，以及标签引导几何蒸馏(LGD)损失将几何结构应用于注意力补丁token以改进细粒度对齐。
AI.result: 在11个广泛使用的医学数据集上，base-to-novel和少样本评估中，相比所有先前最先进的VLM适应方法，平均绝对准确率提升1.7%-2.8%，且对未见类别具有鲁棒泛化能力，预测更可靠。
AI.conclusion: OGKD通过引入类别几何结构知识蒸馏，有效提升了视觉语言模型在医学影像领域的适应性能，特别是在标注有限的情况下，能产生更稳定、更可靠的决策边界。

title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This study aims to determine whether the application of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) as a specialized execution overlay can enhance pair trading in highly volatile cryptocurrency markets. Although classical implementations of the strategy have proven successful in traditional equities, they frequently exhibit rigidity and suffer from severe divergence risks when applied to high-variance environments. To address this need, this research introduces novel concepts. To construct a robust system, we developed a hierarchical "Filter-then-Rank" pair selection methodology and a proprietary "Fixed Risk, Adaptive Mean" execution model. The system employs a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layer to govern execution decisions within strict deterministic risk management boundaries. Evaluated on 1-hour interval data from the Binance USD-M Futures market, the optimized RL policy achieved an out-of-sample performance that substantially outperformed the heuristic baseline. A stationary circular block bootstrap robustness check confirms that the agent's risk-adjusted outperformance is statistically significant at the 10 percent level. Although falling marginally short of the stricter 5 percent threshold, this result highlights the extreme idiosyncratic variance characteristic of digital assets. Ultimately, this thesis contributes to the quantitative finance literature by introducing a hybrid architecture that combines statistical arbitrage with DRL execution policies. Furthermore, it delivers a novel framework for safe reinforcement learning via deterministic shielding, proving that anchoring a neural policy to statistically robust boundaries successfully mitigates severe divergence risks.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合深度强化学习（DRL）执行覆盖层的配对交易系统，在高度波动的加密货币市场中，通过层次化"筛选-排序"选股方法和"固定风险、自适应均值"执行模型，结合PPO（含LSTM层）智能体进行确定性风险管理。在币安USD-M期货1小时数据上的测试表明，该强化学习策略在样本外表现显著优于启发式基线，且通过平稳循环块自举检验证实其风险调整后超额收益在10%水平上统计显著。
AI.motivation: 经典配对交易策略在传统股票市场表现良好，但在高波动的加密货币市场中存在僵化性和严重发散风险，亟需一种能够适应高方差环境的稳健执行框架。
AI.method: 构建层次化"Filter-then-Rank"配对选择方法，设计"Fixed Risk, Adaptive Mean"执行模型，采用含LSTM层的PPO智能体在严格的确定性风险管理边界内进行执行决策。
AI.result: 在币安USD-M期货1小时间隔数据上，优化后的RL策略样本外表现显著优于启发式基线；平稳循环块自举检验显示风险调整后超额收益在10%水平上统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 本文为量化金融领域贡献了一种结合统计套利与DRL执行策略的混合架构，并提出了通过确定性屏蔽实现安全强化学习的新框架，证明将神经策略锚定于统计稳健边界可有效缓解严重发散风险。

title: Scene-Centric Unsupervised Video Panoptic Segmentation
comment: CVPR 2026. Oliver Hahn and Christoph Reich - both authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/visinf/cups/tree/main/videocups Project page: https://visinf.github.io/videocups/
summary: Video panoptic segmentation (VPS) aims to jointly detect, segment, and track all objects while partitioning the video into semantically consistent regions. We introduce the task setting of unsupervised VPS, omitting any human supervision. Existing unsupervised scene understanding works mainly focused on image segmentation tasks; the video domain remains underexplored. We propose VideoCUPS, the first unsupervised VPS approach. VideoCUPS generates temporally consistent panoptic video pseudo-labels from scene-centric videos by exploiting unsupervised depth, motion, and visual cues. Training on these pseudo-labels using a novel Video DropLoss yields an accurate, unsupervised VPS model. To benchmark progress, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation protocol and four competitive baselines, extending state-of-the-art unsupervised panoptic image and instance video segmentation models to VPS. VideoCUPS outperforms all baselines and demonstrates strong label-efficient learning. With VideoCUPS, our evaluation protocol, and baselines, we provide a strong foundation for future research on unsupervised VPS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个无监督视频全景分割方法VideoCUPS，通过利用深度、运动和视觉线索生成时序一致的全景视频伪标签，并采用Video DropLoss训练，在无人工标注条件下取得了优异的性能。同时建立了完整的评估协议和四个基线基准。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督场景理解主要聚焦于图像分割任务，视频领域（特别是视频全景分割VPS）的无监督方法尚未被探索，因此提出首个无监督VPS方案以填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 利用无监督深度估计、运动线索和视觉线索生成时序一致的全景视频伪标签；2) 提出Video DropLoss用于在伪标签上训练模型；3) 建立包含四个基线的评估协议。
AI.result: VideoCUPS在所有基线上取得了最优性能，并展现出强大的标签高效学习能力。
AI.conclusion: VideoCUPS、评估协议和基线为未来无监督VPS研究奠定了坚实基础。

title: HalfNet: Randomized Neural Networks with Learned Subspace Geometry
summary: Many researchers investigated neural networks with some of their weights fixed to values randomly drawn from a given distribution, e.g., $N(0, I)$. Our proposed HalfNet draws random weights from $N(0, Σ)$, where $Σ$, which defines the geometry of the distribution, has a low-rank factorization that we learn from data. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 demonstrate that HalfNet can match the performance of fully trained multilayer perceptrons while using substantially fewer parameters. Spectral analysis indicates that much of the predictive power of neural networks lies in the geometry of their weight space rather than in the precise values of individual parameters, and we observe that accuracy scales smoothly with rank. HalfNet is not a neural architecture trick for low-rank structure; it implements a data-dependent random embedding that can also be interpreted through supervised metric learning, or random-feature and kernel perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HalfNet，其随机权重从可学习的低秩协方差矩阵N(0, Σ)中采样，而非固定分布。实验表明，HalfNet在MNIST和CIFAR-10上能以更少参数匹配全连接网络的性能。谱分析揭示神经网络的预测能力主要来自权重空间的几何结构而非单个参数的具体取值，且精度随秩平滑提升。该方法可解释为数据依赖的随机嵌入、监督度量学习或随机特征与核方法。
AI.motivation: 探究神经网络中权重固定为随机值时的性能来源，质疑精确权重值的必要性，转而关注权重空间的几何分布。
AI.method: 提出HalfNet，其权重从可学习的低秩协方差矩阵N(0, Σ)中随机采样，Σ通过低秩分解从数据中学习，而非传统的高斯分布N(0, I)。
AI.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10上，HalfNet以显著更少的参数达到与全训练多层感知机相当的性能；精度随秩平滑提升；谱分析表明预测能力主要来自权重空间的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络的预测能力主要源于权重空间的几何分布而非精确参数值；HalfNet可通过监督度量学习、随机特征和核视角进行解释，不是针对低秩结构的架构技巧。

title: Plan, Watch, Recover: A Benchmark and Architectures for Proactive Procedural Assistance
summary: We envision a proactive multi-modal assistant system which gives users real-time step-by-step guidance on a procedural task, autonomously deciding \textit{when} to interrupt, and \textit{how} to coach. However, progress is limited by the absence of large-scale, cross-domain benchmarks that reflect realistic conditions, particularly the common case in which users deviate from the expected step sequence. We address this gap with four contributions: \textbf{(1)}~we release \textbf{EgoProactive}, a large-scale wearable-egocentric dataset for proactive procedural assistance with explicit Out-of-Plan (OOP) annotations and recovery steps; \textbf{(2)}~we augment five established benchmarks (Ego4D, EPIC-KITCHENS, EgoExo4D, HoloAssist, HowTo100M) into \textbf{Pro\textsuperscript{2}Bench} under a unified proactive-guidance schema; \textbf{(3)}~we propose a \textbf{decoupled planner--interaction architecture} specialized for procedural state, visual cues, and recovery injection; \textbf{(4)}~we introduce a post-training recipe that transfers across model families, validated by cross-backbone replication on Llama~4 and Qwen-3.6-VL. In extensive experiments, our trained Llama-4 system substantially improves objective intervention quality over strong proprietary baselines (Claude Opus~4.6, Gemini~3.1~Pro, GPT~5.2) and open-weight baselines (Qwen3~VL~235B) baselines across all six datasets. Oracle-plan experiments further show that, when plan quality is controlled, the trained duplex model produces high-quality guidance and large gains on Out-of-Plan recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向主动式多模态辅助系统的数据集EgoProactive和统一基准Pro²Bench，并设计了解耦的规划-交互架构与后训练策略，在多个数据集上显著优于现有基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有主动式多模态辅助系统缺乏大规模、跨领域的真实场景基准，尤其是用户偏离预期步骤序列（Out-of-Plan）的常见情况未被充分覆盖，限制了系统在何时中断、如何指导方面的自主决策能力。
AI.method: (1) 发布EgoProactive数据集，包含可穿戴第一人称视角视频、显式Out-of-Plan标注和恢复步骤；(2) 将五个已有基准（Ego4D, EPIC-KITCHENS, EgoExo4D, HoloAssist, HowTo100M）统一增强为Pro²Bench；(3) 提出解耦的规划器-交互器架构，专门处理程序状态、视觉线索和恢复注入；(4) 引入跨模型家族的后训练方案，在Llama 4和Qwen-3.6-VL上验证。
AI.result: 训练后的Llama-4系统在所有六个数据集上，在客观干预质量指标上显著优于Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT 5.2等强闭源基线以及Qwen3 VL 235B等开源基线。Oracle-plan实验表明，在控制规划质量时，训练的duplex模型能产生高质量指导并在Out-of-Plan恢复上取得大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过大规模数据集、统一基准、专用架构和后训练方案，显著推进了主动式程序辅助系统的能力，尤其在用户偏离预期步骤的恢复场景中表现出色。

title: QuBLAST: A Framework for Quantizing Large Language Models with Block-Level Compression Approach and Activation Scaling Strategy
summary: LLMs have become the state-of-the-art algorithms for solving NLP tasks.
