To bridge this gap, we propose Skill-enhanced Test-Time Co-Evolution (\texttt{LifeSkill}), a two-stage reinforcement learning framework for Online Lifelong Learning Agents. Specifically, we design Verifier-Guided Skill Learning that addresses the lack of direct supervision for skill extraction by rewarding candidate skills according to the average verifier success of multiple skill-conditioned policy rollouts, encouraging the model to generate skills that are useful for solving tasks rather than merely plausible in text. Furthermore, we introduce Online Skill Internalization, which continuously improves the policy model during test-time interaction by transforming skill-conditioned trajectories into reward signals. This enables the agent to directly internalize reasoning capabilities into its parameters, avoiding the context bloat of experience retrieval. Experiments on LifelongAgentBench show that LifeSkill improves average performance by 7 absolute points by comparing with existing lifelong agent baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出LifeSkill框架，通过两阶段强化学习（验证器引导的技能学习+在线技能内化）实现LLM智能体的在线终身学习，在LifelongAgentBench上平均性能提升7个绝对百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有终身学习智能体在长时任务中依赖离散技能或过去经验检索，推理时参数静态，无法像人类学习者一样持续内化测试时的反馈。
AI.method: 两阶段强化学习框架：(1) 验证器引导的技能学习（Verifier-Guided Skill Learning），通过多技能条件策略rollout的平均验证器成功率为候选技能提供奖励，鼓励生成对任务有用的技能；(2) 在线技能内化（Online Skill Internalization），将技能条件轨迹转化为奖励信号，在测试时持续改进策略模型，将推理能力直接内化到参数中。
AI.result: 在LifelongAgentBench上相比现有终身学习智能体基线，平均性能提升7个绝对百分点。
AI.conclusion: LifeSkill通过在线技能内化避免经验检索的上下文膨胀问题，使智能体能够持续学习并提升性能。

title: Identifying Gems from Roman RAPIDly
comment: 15 pages, 10 figures, Submitted to the Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope (Roman), set for launch as early as September 2026, will conduct wide-field infrared imaging surveys with unprecedented spatial resolution and cadence, enabling the discovery of millions of astronomical transients. Hence, it is necessary to have automated pipelines for generating alerts in place so that the telescope can begin discovering reliable transients and variable objects soon after it is launched. However, no real Roman data currently exist, making the development of such pipelines difficult. In this work, we present a machine learning model $RuBR$ and a general methodology for distinguishing genuine transient and variable detections from spurious (bogus) detections within the RAPID pipeline. In particular, we present three models using this methodology: $RuBR_{comb}$ trained and tested on combined locally injected and OpenUniverse2024 transients, $RuBR_{loc}$ trained on locally injected transients and tested on OpenUniverse2024 transients, and $RuBR_{DA}$ that combines locally injected transients with a fraction of OpenUniverse2024 transients in domain-adaptation mode for training. This paves the way for strategies to adapt the $RuBR_{comb}$ model to real observations in the absence of any ground-truth labels during the early phases of the Roman mission. While the image differencing pipeline continues to be improved, our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach and its promise for robust real-bogus classification in the Roman era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于机器学习模型RuBR的自动化流水线方法，用于在缺乏真实数据的情况下，区分Roman望远镜观测中的真实瞬变/变源与虚假检测，为2026年发射后的实时警报生成奠定基础。
AI.motivation: Roman太空望远镜将于2026年发射，将产生海量瞬变天体数据，但目前尚无真实观测数据，亟需在发射前开发可靠的自动警报流水线以区分真实与虚假检测。
AI.method: 提出RuBR机器学习模型及通用方法论，训练了三个变体：RuBR_comb（本地注入+OpenUniverse2024联合训练）、RuBR_loc（本地注入训练，OpenUniverse2024测试）、RuBR_DA（域自适应模式，部分OpenUniverse2024参与训练）。
AI.result: 在尚无真实Roman数据的条件下，实验表明所提方法在真实-虚假分类任务上效果良好，为后续适应真实观测数据铺平了道路。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有望在Roman时代实现稳健的真实-虚假天体检测分类，且RuBR_comb模型可在无标签条件下适应真实观测数据。

title: Reconciling Causality and Non-Equilibrium Thermodynamics with Hamiltonian Causal Models
summary: Causal modeling of physical temporal phenomena must handle interventions that act along trajectories, nonstationary induced laws, path-dependent effects, and feedback mediated by dynamics, all challenging in standard causal models. We introduce Hamiltonian Causal Models (HCMs), a trajectory-level framework in which observed variables interact with local environments and interventions act as controls of Hamiltonian mechanisms. HCMs separate immutable equations of motion from intervenable mechanisms and define causal effects as discrepancies between interventional path laws. A key motivation for HCMs is their natural interface with non-equilibrium thermodynamics. Entropy production quantifies the irreversibility of a process and is a central causal observable: it is estimable from data and witnesses causal effects along the system's evolution that are invisible to endpoint and cumulative versions of the standard average treatment effect. As in physics, cause and effect are not primitives of the relation between two random variables but arise from the non-invertibility of the thermodynamic arrow. With this, our paper reconciles the language of statistical causal models and non-stationary thermodynamics, offering new tools to describe causality in a wide range of physical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出哈密顿因果模型（HCMs），一个在轨迹层面处理物理时间现象的因果框架，将观测变量与局部环境交互、干预作为哈密顿机制的控制，并通过熵产生作为关键因果可观测量，弥合了统计因果模型与非平衡热力学之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 标准因果模型难以处理物理时间现象中沿轨迹的干预、非平稳诱导律、路径依赖效应以及动力学介导的反馈，需要一种轨迹层面的因果建模框架。
AI.method: 提出哈密顿因果模型（HCMs），将不可变的运动方程与可干预的机制分离，干预作为哈密顿机制的控制，因果效应定义为干预路径律之间的差异。
AI.result: 熵产生作为关键因果可观测量，可从数据估计，能够揭示系统演化过程中标准平均处理效应无法捕捉的因果效应。
AI.conclusion: 因果与效应并非两个随机变量关系的原始概念，而是源自热力学箭头的不可逆性；该工作统一了统计因果模型与非平稳热力学的语言，为描述物理系统中的因果关系提供了新工具。

title: UniFine: A Unified and Fine-grained Approach for Zero-shot Vision-Language Understanding
summary: Vision-language tasks, such as VQA, SNLI-VE, and VCR are challenging because they require the model's reasoning ability to understand the semantics of the visual world and natural language. Supervised methods working for vision-language tasks have been well-studied. However, solving these tasks in a zero-shot setting is less explored. Since Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has shown remarkable zero-shot performance on image-text matching, previous works utilized its strong zero-shot ability by converting vision-language tasks into an image-text matching problem, and they mainly consider global-level matching (e.g., the whole image or sentence). However, we find visual and textual fine-grained information, e.g., keywords in the sentence and objects in the image, can be fairly informative for semantics understanding. Inspired by this, we propose a unified framework to take advantage of the fine-grained information for zero-shot vision-language learning, covering multiple tasks such as VQA, SNLI-VE, and VCR. Our experiments show that our framework outperforms former zero-shot methods on VQA and achieves substantial improvement on SNLI-VE and VCR. Furthermore, our ablation studies confirm the effectiveness and generalizability of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出一个利用细粒度信息（如句子中的关键词和图像中的对象）的统一框架，用于零样本视觉-语言学习，在VQA、SNLI-VE和VCR任务上超越了以往的零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的零样本视觉-语言任务方法主要依赖CLIP的全局级图像-文本匹配，忽略了细粒度信息（如关键词和图像对象）对语义理解的重要性。
AI.method: 提出一个统一框架，利用视觉和文本的细粒度信息（关键词和图像对象）进行零样本视觉-语言学习，覆盖VQA、SNLI-VE和VCR等多个任务。
AI.result: 在VQA上超越以往的零样本方法，在SNLI-VE和VCR上取得显著改进；消融实验验证了方法的有效性和泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度信息对零样本视觉-语言任务的语义理解至关重要，所提框架具有有效性和通用性。

title: Signed Dual Attention: Capturing Signed Dependencies in Time Series Forecasting
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, accepted at AAAI 2026 AI4TS Workshop
summary: Initially developed for natural language processing, Transformer architectures and attention mechanisms are now central to a wide range of deep learning models, including applications in time series forecasting. A standard attention mechanism, however, implicitly assumes homophilic interactions, limiting its ability to model data with positive and negative dependencies, such as time series. In this work, we introduce the Signed Dual Attention, a novel attention formulation that captures both positive and negative relational patterns without additional parameters. By leveraging a dual message-passing scheme inspired by correlation structures, Signed Dual Attention propagates both supportive and contrastive information within a single shared block, effectively achieving the expressiveness of two head attention without additional parameters. This module can be seamlessly integrated into existing architectures and can yield performance gains in certain situations, requiring signed relational modeling. This approach opens a pathway toward more expressive and parameter-efficient transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Signed Dual Attention的新型注意力机制，无需额外参数即可同时捕捉时序数据中的正负依赖关系，通过双消息传递方案在单共享块内传播支持性和对比性信息，实现了两注意力头的表达能力。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力机制隐含地假设数据具有同质交互（即只捕捉正相关），无法有效建模时序数据中存在的正负两种依赖关系，限制了其在时间序列等场景中的表现力。
AI.method: 提出Signed Dual Attention，借鉴相关结构设计双消息传递方案，在单一共享注意力块内同时传播支持性（正相关）和对比性（负相关）信息，无需增加额外参数即可实现类似两个注意力头的表达能力。
AI.result: 该模块可无缝集成到现有架构中，在需要符号关系建模的场景下能够带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为构建更具表现力且参数高效的Transformer模型开辟了新途径。

title: High-Quality Entity Segmentation and Grounding
summary: In this work, we propose ESG, a pipeline for high-quality entity segmentation and grounding supported by a new dataset EntitySeg. At first, the proposed dataset naming EntitySeg contains images spanning various image domains and entities, along with plentiful high-resolution images and high-quality mask annotations for training and testing. Then, the ESG mainly consists of two modules: CropFormer for high-quality entity segmentation whereas GELLA for accurate noun extraction from sentences and semantic matching between language and visual regions. Unlike existing grounding methods that jointly train a segmentation and a large language model, ESG adopts a two-stage decoupled design, preserving high-quality masks and grounding robustness without the trade-offs often introduced by joint training. CropFormer ensures high-quality entity segmentation results, which can then be encoded into the GELLA model for effective grounding. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed pipeline across five tasks, including entity segmentation, panoptic segmentation, open-vocabulary segmentation, referring segmentation, and panoptic localized narratives. Furthermore, GELLA module of ESG pipeline is highly flexible and capable of processing mask inputs from any segmentation framework, thanks to its lightweight colormap/vision encoder, language/mask decoder, and association module. The entity segmentation dataset and grounding code will be released at https://github.com/qqlu/Entity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ESG管道，包含EntitySeg数据集（高质量实体分割标注）和两个核心模块：CropFormer（高质量实体分割）和GELLA（名词提取与语义匹配）。采用两阶段解耦设计，避免联合训练的权衡，在五项任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有接地方法将分割与大语言模型联合训练存在性能权衡，缺乏高质量实体分割数据集，且缺乏灵活的解耦设计。
AI.method: 构建EntitySeg数据集，涵盖多领域图像与高质量掩码标注；提出两阶段管道ESG：CropFormer进行高质量实体分割，GELLA通过轻量级colormap/视觉编码器、语言/掩码解码器和关联模块实现名词提取与语义匹配。
AI.result: 在实体分割、全景分割、开放词汇分割、指代分割和全景定位叙事五项任务上均验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: ESG的两阶段解耦设计兼顾了分割质量和接地鲁棒性，GELLA模块灵活通用，可适配任意分割框架的掩码输入。

title: Prediction Under Imperfect Compression: A Theory of Approximate MDL
summary: Minimum Description Length (MDL) formalizes the principle of Occam's razor by optimizing the total description length: $L(\mathrm{model})+L(\mathrm{data} \ | \ \mathrm{model})$. For sequential prediction, the MDL method repeatedly selects a model with a minimum objective score of the observed prefix for the next step prediction. Classical MDL prediction theory shows that exact optimization of the MDL objective indeed provides a strong compression guarantee that supports reliable prediction. However, practical machine learning usually can only find models by approximately optimizing the objective function. To bridge this gap, this paper addresses the following fundamental question: Under what forms of approximation and regularization does approximate MDL still guarantee reliable sequential prediction? This work offers a principled characterization. We prove that for any approximation with additive slack $C$ of the more general form of the balanced MDL objective: $λ\cdot L(\mathrm{model})+L(\mathrm{data} \ | \ \mathrm{model})$, the cumulative expected squared prediction error is finite for all $λ\ge1$. The case $λ>1$ is proved by an affinity-telescoping argument, while the boundary case $λ=1$ is proved by a likelihood-ratio stopping argument based on exact static MDL bounds. Our results establish that classical MDL regularization remains robust to any fixed additive optimization error. Furthermore, we establish that our characterization of the approximate MDL framework is sharp: When $0<λ<1$, overfits can happen to incur infinite cumulative expected error in the universal class of estimable measures, and hence a strong form of model-complexity regularization is necessary. In addition, model selection may fail in every regularized regime $λ>0$, under multiplicative approximation, and thus, additive approximation is both sufficient and essential.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了近似最小描述长度（MDL）原理在顺序预测中的鲁棒性。证明当平衡MDL目标函数满足加性松弛C且正则化参数λ≥1时，累积期望平方预测误差有限；λ=1时通过精确静态MDL界的似然比停时论证证明，λ>1时通过亲和望远镜论证证明。同时证明该刻画是紧的：当0<λ<1时出现过拟合导致无限累积误差，且乘性近似下模型选择可能失败，说明加性近似既充分又必要。
AI.motivation: 经典MDL预测理论表明精确优化MDL目标可提供强压缩保证，但实际机器学习只能近似优化目标函数。为弥合这一差距，本文研究在何种近似形式和正则化条件下，近似MDL仍能保证可靠的顺序预测。
AI.method: 提出平衡MDL目标函数λ·L(模型)+L(数据|模型)，考虑加性松弛C的近似优化。对λ>1采用亲和望远镜论证，对λ=1采用基于精确静态MDL界的似然比停时论证。通过反例分析0<λ<1和乘性近似下的失败情形。
AI.result: λ≥1时加性近似下的累积期望平方预测误差有限；0<λ<1时存在过拟合导致无限累积误差；乘性近似下模型选择在所有λ>0正则化区间均可能失败。
AI.conclusion: 经典MDL正则化对固定加性优化误差具有鲁棒性，加性近似是充分且必要的条件，强模型复杂度正则化（λ≥1）是可靠顺序预测的保证。

title: Achieving Rotation-Invariant Convolution via Non-Learnable Orientation Alignment Operators
summary: Achieving rotational invariance in deep neural networks without data augmentation is a research hotspot. Intrinsic invariance enables features to capture targets' inherent properties, enhancing deep learning performance in visual tasks. Based on various types of non-learnable operators, this paper proposes a comprehensive set of convolution operations that are natually invariant to arbitrary rotations. Unlike most prior methods, these rotation-invariant convolutions (RIConvs) have the same number of learnable parameters and a similar computational process as standard convolutions, making them interchangeable. Using the MNIST-Rot dataset, we validate their invariance across rotation angles and compare them with previous rotation-invariant CNNs, where two gradient-based RIConvs achieve state-of-the-art results. Then, we integrate RIConvs with classic CNN backbones and evaluate them on texture recognition, aircraft type recognition, and remote sensing image classification tasks. Results show that RIConvs significantly improve accuracy, particularly with limited training data, and enhance performance even with data augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一组基于非可学习算子的旋转不变卷积操作（RIConvs），它们与标准卷积具有相同的参数量和计算过程，可即插即用。在MNIST-Rot数据集上验证了其旋转不变性，两种基于梯度的RIConvs达到最优。集成到经典CNN骨干后在纹理识别、飞机类型识别和遥感图像分类任务上显著提升了准确率，尤其在训练数据有限时效果突出。
AI.motivation: 实现深度神经网络在不依赖数据增强情况下的旋转不变性是一个研究热点。内在不变性能使特征捕捉目标的固有属性，从而提升视觉任务中的深度学习性能。
AI.method: 基于多种类型的非可学习算子，提出一组天然的旋转不变卷积操作（RIConvs）。这些操作与标准卷积具有相同数量的可学习参数和类似的计算过程，因此可以互换使用。
AI.result: 在MNIST-Rot数据集上验证了RIConvs在不同旋转角度下的不变性，两种基于梯度的RIConvs达到了最先进水平。集成到经典CNN骨干后，在纹理识别、飞机类型识别和遥感图像分类任务中显著提升了准确率，尤其在训练数据有限时效果更明显，且即使在使用数据增强时也能提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的旋转不变卷积操作能够有效提升模型在各类视觉任务中的旋转不变性，且无需增加参数量或显著改变计算过程，具有良好的通用性和实用性。

title: Uncertainty-Aware End-to-End Co-Design of Neural Network Processors: From Training and Mapping to Fabrication
summary: Designing a neural network processor is an end-to-end co-design problem: network architecture and training budget determine the inference workload; hardware mapping decisions determine chip area, latency, and energy; and these characteristics govern fabrication yield and manufacturing cost. In practice, these decisions are made in separate stages, and existing co-design methodologies are tightly coupled to specific algorithms, making it difficult to improve one component without reworking the entire pipeline. This paper presents a unified framework, grounded in monotone co-design theory, that composes four interoperable design blocks spanning network training, chip mapping, wafer-level fabrication, and compute resource allocation. Each block exposes only a functionality-resource interface to the rest of the system, so any block can be refined without structural changes elsewhere. A central contribution is the treatment of uncertainty: rather than collapsing stochastic outcomes into point estimates, the framework introduces Confidence, the inverse of success probability, as an explicit and optimizable resource alongside cost, time, and power. Three case studies validate the approach. The first recovers Pareto-optimal implementations across heterogeneous application scenarios. The second confirms that Confidence functions as a continuously tunable design knob rather than a post-hoc diagnostic. The third demonstrates that improving a single block's implementation set automatically propagates to the global Pareto front, without modifying the co-design diagram.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于单调协同设计理论的统一框架，将神经网络训练、芯片映射、晶圆制造和计算资源分配四个设计模块组合成可互操作的协同设计系统，并引入Confidence（成功概率的倒数）作为显式可优化资源，实现了端到端的神经网络处理器协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经网络处理器设计是端到端协同问题，但实际中各决策阶段分离，现有协同方法过度耦合特定算法，难以在不重构整个流程的情况下改进单一组件。
AI.method: 基于单调协同设计理论，构建由四个可互操作设计模块组成的统一框架（网络训练、芯片映射、晶圆制造、计算资源分配），每个模块仅暴露功能-资源接口，引入Confidence作为显式可优化资源。
AI.result: 三个案例验证：1) 恢复异构应用场景下的Pareto最优实现；2) Confidence可作为连续可调的设计旋钮而非事后诊断指标；3) 改进单一模块的实现在不修改协同设计图的情况下自动传播至全局Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该框架解耦了各设计阶段，允许独立优化单一模块而无需重构整个流程，且将不确定性作为可优化资源纳入协同设计，有效提升了神经网络处理器设计的灵活性和全局最优性。

title: Towards Evaluating the Robustness of Visual State Space Models
comment: Accepted at The 5th Workshop of Adversarial Machine Learning on Computer Vision (CVPRW 2025)
summary: Vision State Space Models (VSSMs), a novel architecture that combines the strengths of recurrent neural networks and latent variable models, have demonstrated remarkable performance in visual perception tasks by efficiently capturing long-range dependencies and modeling complex visual dynamics. However, their robustness under natural and adversarial perturbations remains a critical concern. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of VSSMs' robustness under various perturbation scenarios, including occlusions, image structure, common corruptions, and adversarial attacks, and compare their performance to well-established architectures such as transformers and Convolutional Neural Networks. Furthermore, we investigate the resilience of VSSMs to object-background compositional changes on sophisticated benchmarks designed to test model performance in complex visual scenes. We also assess their robustness on object detection and segmentation tasks using corrupted datasets that mimic real-world scenarios. To gain a deeper understanding of VSSMs' adversarial robustness, we conduct a frequency-based analysis of adversarial attacks, evaluating their performance against low-frequency and high-frequency perturbations. Our findings highlight the strengths and limitations of VSSMs in handling complex visual corruptions, offering valuable insights for future research. Our code and models will be available at https://github.com/HashmatShadab/MambaRobustness.

AI.tldr: 本文全面评估了视觉状态空间模型（VSSMs）在各种自然和对抗性扰动下的鲁棒性，包括遮挡、图像结构变化、常见损坏和对抗攻击，并与Transformer和CNN进行了比较，还进行了基于频率的对抗攻击分析。
AI.motivation: VSSMs在视觉感知任务中表现出色，但其在自然和对抗性扰动下的鲁棒性尚未得到系统评估，因此需要全面研究以了解其局限性和优势。
AI.method: 在多种扰动场景下（遮挡、图像结构变化、常见损坏、对抗攻击）评估VSSMs性能，与Transformer和CNN对比；在复杂视觉场景的基准上测试目标-背景组成变化下的鲁棒性；使用损坏数据集评估目标检测和分割任务；进行基于频率（低频vs高频）的对抗攻击分析。
AI.result: 揭示了VSSMs在处理复杂视觉损坏时的优势和局限性，提供了其在各种扰动场景下的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: VSSMs在不同扰动场景下展现出特定优缺点，研究结果为未来提升VSSMs鲁棒性提供了有价值的见解。

title: Rethinking Incompleteness: Formalizing Protocol Divergence and Train-Once Learning for Robust IMVC
summary: Standard IMVC evaluation retrains separate models for different missing-data configurations. We show that this paradigm obscures a fundamental vulnerability: missing rate alone is insufficient to characterize data incompleteness. Specifically, we show that protocols with identical nominal missing rates can differ by up to $50\times$ in their proportion of fully observed samples, inducing drastically different learning regimes. We formalize this phenomenon as incompleteness divergence, providing measures that capture structural disparities across missing-data protocols. We further prove that for a broad class of reconstruction-based objectives, learning becomes structurally ill-posed when the proportion of complete samples falls below a critical threshold, leading to near-random performance. To bypass this theoretical bound, we propose CRAFT (Complete-data Robust Attention-masked Fusion Transformer). CRAFT shifts the burden of robustness from the loss function to the architecture via two key properties: (i) per-sample independence, which removes reliance on complete-sample co-occurrence, and (ii) mask-aware variable-length fusion, which aggregates only observed views through attention masking. This design allows a single model, trained once on complete data, to generalize to diverse missing patterns at inference time without retraining. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks show that CRAFT matches or outperforms per-configuration baselines while reducing training overhead by $8.8\times$, demonstrating that robustness to missing data can be achieved as an inherent architectural property. Code (CRAFT) and our imvc-audit toolkit are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CRAFT-BF80/ and https://anonymous.4open.science/r/imvc-audit-8263/.

AI.tldr: 本文发现标准不完全多视图聚类（IMVC）评估范式存在根本性缺陷：缺失率无法充分刻画数据不完整性，相同缺失率的协议在完整样本比例上可相差50倍。作者形式化定义了"不完整发散"概念，并证明当完整样本比例低于临界阈值时，基于重构的目标函数学习在结构上是不适定的。为此提出CRAFT（完整数据鲁棒注意力掩码融合Transformer），通过样本独立性和掩码感知可变长度融合，使单模型在完整数据上训练一次即可泛化到各种缺失模式。七个基准实验显示CRAFT匹配或超越基线，训练开销减少8.8倍。
AI.motivation: 标准IMVC评估为不同缺失数据配置分别重训练模型，掩盖了一个根本性漏洞：缺失率单独不足以表征数据不完整性，导致对方法鲁棒性的错误评估。
AI.method: 提出CRAFT，核心包含两个设计：（i）样本级独立性，消除对完整样本共现的依赖；（ii）掩码感知可变长度融合，通过注意力掩码仅聚合观测到的视图。单模型在完整数据上训练一次，推理时泛化到任意缺失模式。
AI.result: 七个基准数据集上，CRAFT匹配或超越为每种缺失配置单独训练的基线，同时训练开销降低8.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 对缺失数据的鲁棒性可以作为架构的内在属性实现，而非依赖损失函数或针对每种缺失模式重训练。

title: CounterFace: A Synthetic Face Dataset for Fine-Grained Counterfactual Evaluation of Face Recognition Systems
comment: Code available at https://github.com/Guruprasad68/counterface_facct2026. Dataset available for non-commercial research upon request
summary:
Face recognition (FR) systems are widely deployed in critical applications, making their reliability and robustness across diverse populations and conditions essential. Standard evaluation of FR systems typically relies on datasets such as LFW to estimate average recognition accuracy. Some benchmarks also capture coarse-grained intra-identity variations such as aging, pose, and lighting. However, human faces undergo more fine-grained changes, including appearance changes such as hairstyles and makeup, that are underrepresented in existing benchmarks. Counterfactual evaluation provides a method to assess FR robustness under such fine-grained variations. Existing counterfactual face datasets synthesized with image generators, however, are limited in attribute coverage due to the use of humans for verification in the pipeline.
  We propose CounterFace, a new counterfactual evaluation dataset comprising 20 facial attributes and 8 demographic factors, exceeding prior synthetic face datasets by 14 attributes and 2 demographics. The dataset is generated using a fully automated pipeline based on off-the-shelf image generators with custom verifiers, removing human need for verification. CounterFace contains 11,821 counterfactual face pairs, and a post-hoc user study confirms the faithfulness of the generated counterfactuals. We evaluate two commercial and four open-source FR systems (AWS Rekognition, Face++, AdaFace, MagFace, ArcFace, FaceNet) across 160 attribute-demographic combinations. Our dataset helps in the isolation of precise failure modes for individual systems unlike standard evaluation benchmarks. Results indicate that the performance degradation varies across attributes and demographics for all six systems and occluding attributes (e.g., facemask and facial hair) universally degrade performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CounterFace，一个包含20种面部属性和8种人口统计因素的反事实评估数据集，用于系统评估人脸识别系统在细粒度外观变化下的鲁棒性。数据集通过全自动流水线生成，包含11,821个反事实人脸对，评估了6个主流FR系统在160种属性-人口统计组合下的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的人脸识别基准数据集（如LFW）主要评估平均识别准确率，虽然部分基准考虑了老化、姿态、光照等粗粒度变化，但忽略了发型、妆容等细粒度外观变化对FR系统的影响。已有的反事实人脸数据集因依赖人工验证，属性覆盖有限。
AI.method: 使用现成的图像生成器配合自定义验证器构建全自动流水线，生成包含20种面部属性（超出先前数据集14种）和8种人口统计因素（超出2种）的反事实人脸对数据集CounterFace，包含11,821对样本。
AI.result: 评估了两个商业FR系统（AWS Rekognition、Face++）和四个开源FR系统（AdaFace、MagFace、ArcFace、FaceNet）。性能退化因属性和人口统计因素而异，遮挡类属性（如口罩、胡须）普遍导致所有系统性能下降。数据集能够帮助发现单个系统的精确失败模式。
AI.conclusion: CounterFace作为反事实评估数据集，能够更精细地揭示人脸识别系统在细粒度外观变化下的失败模式，弥补了现有基准的不足，为FR系统的鲁棒性评估提供了更全面的工具。

title: Learning Empirically Admissible Neural Heuristics for Combinatorial Search
summary: Finding optimal solution paths for combinatorial puzzles like the Rubik's Cube, sliding tile puzzles, and Lights Out remains a classical challenge in artificial intelligence. Heuristic search algorithms, such as A* , guarantee path optimality only when using an admissible heuristic-one that never overestimates the true remaining cost-to-go. Deep reinforcement learning (RL) methods like DeepCubeA train deep neural networks to approximate cost-to-go heuristics. However, standard mean-squared error (MSE) training regularly yields overestimations, violating admissibility and compromising solution optimality. In this paper, we introduce a generalizable framework for learning validation-calibrated admissible neural heuristics. We train a value network using an underestimating Admissible Bellman Operator combined with an Asymmetric Loss function to penalize overestimation. To account for residual neural function approximation errors, we propose a post-hoc calibration safety offset computed over validation scrambles. We demonstrate that our calibrated neural heuristics achieve no observed admissibility violations under the evaluation protocol and preserve path optimality in practice while reducing search node expansions by up to 83.0% on a 2 by 2 Rubik's Cube, 19.9% on a 3 by 3 Lights Out grid, and 1.9% on an 8-Puzzle compared to standard analytical baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通用框架，通过学习可验证校准的可容许神经启发式函数，解决了深度强化学习在组合谜题中因过估计导致路径非最优的问题。该框架结合了可容许贝尔曼算子与非对称损失函数，并引入后处理校准安全偏移量，在2×2魔方、3×3 Lights Out和8-Puzzle上实现了无观测可容许性违规，同时将搜索节点扩展减少了最高83.0%。
AI.motivation: 组合谜题（如魔方、滑动拼图、Lights Out）的最优解路径搜索是AI中的经典挑战。启发式搜索算法（如A*）需要可容许启发式函数（从不高估剩余代价）来保证最优性。然而，深度强化学习方法（如DeepCubeA）使用MSE训练价值网络时经常产生过估计，违反可容许性，损害解的最优性。因此，本文旨在学习一种可验证校准的可容许神经启发式函数。
AI.method: 1）使用低估性的可容许贝尔曼算子（Admissible Bellman Operator）训练价值网络；2）结合非对称损失函数（Asymmetric Loss）来惩罚过估计；3）针对残差神经函数逼近误差，提出后验校准安全偏移量（post-hoc calibration safety offset），通过在验证打乱样本上计算得到。
AI.result: 校准后的神经启发式函数在评估协议下未观察到可容许性违规，并保持了实际路径最优性。搜索节点扩展减少：2×2魔方83.0%，3×3 Lights Out网格19.9%，8-Puzzle 1.9%（相较于标准分析基线）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了通过结合可容许贝尔曼算子、非对称损失和后验校准偏移量，可以有效训练出可验证可容许的神经启发式函数，在保证路径最优性的同时大幅提升搜索效率。

title: LaVIDE: Language-Prompted Satellite Change Detection via Map-Image Alignment
summary: Remote sensing change detection based on a map reference and an up-to-date image boosts timely observation of the Earth's surface when earlier images are lacking for comparison. However, the semantic gap between high-level map categories and low-level image details hinders the extraction of homogeneous features for robust temporal association in change detection. Unlike conventional approaches that either compare pixel-level visual similarity or propagate segmentation errors, \textcolor{black}{we propose a novel framework, \underline{La}nguage-\underline{VI}sion \underline{D}iscriminator for d\underline{E}tecting changes, LaVIDE}, which bridges the semantic gap between high-level map categories and low-level image details using language as an intermediary. Specifically, we introduce {\it restricted prompt learning} to generate context-aware textual prompts that align map semantics with image content, and an {\it object-aware embedding enhancement} strategy to integrate object-level attributes (e.g., shape, boundary) into map representations. These components enable robust cross-modal alignment within a unified language-vision feature space. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks, DynamicEarthNet, HRSCD, BANDON, and SECOND, demonstrate that LaVIDE outperforms state-of-the-art methods by significant margins, achieving $18.4\%$ and $5.2\%$ improvements in IoU on multi-class and single-class change detection tasks, respectively. Our framework not only advances the accuracy of map-image change detection but also provides a practical solution for rapid map updating with minimal human intervention, promising broad impacts in urban planning, disaster assessment, and ecological conservation. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/ShuGuoJ/LAVIDE.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LaVIDE框架，利用语言作为中介弥合高级地图类别与低级图像细节之间的语义鸿沟，实现基于地图参考与最新图像的遥感变化检测。通过受限提示学习和对象感知嵌入增强策略，在四个基准数据集上取得显著性能提升，IoU分别提升18.4%（多类）和5.2%（单类）。
AI.motivation: 传统遥感变化检测方法在缺乏早期图像时难以进行时间关联，原因在于高级地图类别与低级图像细节之间存在语义鸿沟。现有方法要么比较像素级视觉相似性，要么传播分割错误，均未能有效解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出LaVIDE框架：(1) 受限提示学习（Restricted Prompt Learning），生成上下文感知的文本提示以对齐地图语义与图像内容；(2) 对象感知嵌入增强（Object-aware Embedding Enhancement），将对象级属性（如形状、边界）融入地图表示，实现语言-视觉统一特征空间中的跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在DynamicEarthNet、HRSCD、BANDON和SECOND四个基准数据集上，LaVIDE显著超越现有方法，多类变化检测IoU提升18.4%，单类变化检测IoU提升5.2%。
AI.conclusion: LaVIDE不仅提升了地图-图像变化检测的精度，还提供了最少人工干预的快速地图更新方案，在城市规划、灾害评估和生态保护等领域具有广泛前景。

title: Provably Reduced Sample Cost in Prior-Guided Hyperparameter Optimization
summary: Large-scale hyperparameter optimization (HPO) in automated machine learning (AutoML) consumes substantial computational resources, raising growing concerns about scalability and energy efficiency. Existing methods use prior information heuristically to accelerate both black-box and multi-fidelity settings, but they lack a characterization of how prior informativeness quantitatively reduces sample complexity. In this work, we provide the first distribution-dependent sample complexity bounds for multi-fidelity HPO with priors through the formal lens of fixed-budget best-arm identification. By modeling priors directly over arm means as configuration performance, we derive explicit, distribution-dependent error bounds that quantify the relationship between priors and evaluation budget. Our analysis shows that informative priors, which concentrate probability mass on near-optimal arms, yield reductions in the number of required evaluations, whereas baseline performance is recovered with uninformative or misleading priors. We conduct proof-of-concept experiments on a synthetic benchmark and on LCBench, a common multi-fidelity HPO benchmark for deep learning, to confirm our theoretical results, achieving up to 90% budget reduction while retaining solution quality. Together, our results provide a principled foundation for prior-guided and compute-efficient green AutoML.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为带先验的多保真度超参数优化提供了基于分布的样本复杂度下界理论，证明了信息性先验可显著减少评估预算（实验最高减少90%），为绿色AutoML奠定了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 大规模超参数优化消耗大量计算资源，现有方法虽启发式地利用先验信息加速优化，但缺乏对先验信息性如何定量降低样本复杂度的理论刻画。
AI.method: 通过固定预算最佳臂识别形式化框架，将先验直接建模在臂均值（配置性能）上，推导出依赖分布的显式误差界，量化先验与评估预算的关系。
AI.result: 信息性先验（概率质量集中在近最优臂上）可减少所需评估次数；无信息或误导性先验恢复基线性能。在合成基准和LCBench上实验证实理论结果，预算最多减少90%且保持解质量。
AI.conclusion: 提供了先验引导的高效绿色AutoML的理论基础，表明合理利用先验可大幅提升计算效率。

title: Scalable Event Cloud Network for Event-based Classification
summary: Event cameras are biologically inspired sensors garnering significant attention from both industry and academia. Mainstream methods favor frame and voxel representations, which reach a satisfactory performance while introducing time-consuming transformations, bulky models, and sacrificing fine-grained temporal information. Alternatively, Point Cloud representation demonstrates promise in addressing the mentioned weaknesses, but it has limited scalability in abstracting features of higher spatial resolution and longer temporal sequence events. In this paper, we propose a Scalable Network named SECNet to leverage Event Cloud representation. SECNet integrates polarity at the structural level by innovating the Event-based Group and Sampling module rather than only at the input level. To accommodate the surge in the number of events, SECNet embraces feature extraction in the frequency domain via the Fourier transform.This approach not only substantially extinguishes the explosion of Multiply Accumulate Operations but also effectively abstracts spatio-temporal features. We conducted extensive experiments on \textbf{ten} event-based datasets, and substantiate the scalability, effectiveness, and efficiency of SECNet. Our code will be available at: https://github.com/rhwxmx/SECNet_ICML.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为SECNet的可扩展网络，利用事件云表示处理事件相机数据。通过结构级集成极性（事件分组与采样模块）和频域特征提取（傅里叶变换），解决了传统方法计算量大、时间信息丢失和可扩展性差的问题。在十个事件数据集上验证了其可扩展性、有效性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有事件相机主流方法依赖帧/体素表示，虽性能尚可但存在耗时长、模型庞大、细粒度时间信息丢失等问题；点云表示虽能缓解上述缺陷，但在高空间分辨率和长时序事件的特征抽象上可扩展性有限。因此需要一种兼具可扩展性、高效性和细粒度时空特征提取能力的网络架构。
AI.method: 提出SECNet：(1) 在结构层面设计Event-based Group and Sampling模块，将极性信息融入网络结构而非仅在输入层处理；(2) 引入频域特征提取（傅里叶变换），有效应对事件数量激增问题，减少乘累加运算爆炸的同时抽象时空特征。
AI.result: 在十个事件数据集上进行大量实验，验证了SECNet在可扩展性、有效性和效率方面的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: SECNet通过事件云表示、结构级极性集成和频域特征提取，成功实现了高效可扩展的事件数据处理，为事件相机领域提供了一种新的解决方案。

title: Towards Pretraining Text Encoders for TabPFN
summary: Tabular foundation models, such as TabPFN, achieve strong performance on tabular datasets with numerical and categorical data, but do not natively handle high-cardinality text features. Standard pipelines, therefore, embed text with a language model and compress the resulting vectors with PCA into a small number of scalar features before inputting them into TabPFN. This creates an information bottleneck: most embedding dimensions are discarded, and the compressed representation must then be expanded again by TabPFN's feature encoder. End-to-end alternatives can avoid PCA, but they require large amounts of pretraining data containing text cells and usually perform subpar compared to tabular foundation models that were pretrained on large amounts of synthetic data. Inspired by modality-alignment approaches like LLaVA (vision-to-LLM token projection) and TableGPT-style systems (table-to-LLM token projection), we introduce the TabPFN Text Adapter (text-to-TFM token projection). We freeze both the sentence encoder and TabPFN, and train only a lightweight adapter that maps text embeddings into a short sequence of tokens in TabPFN's embedding space. This design removes the PCA bottleneck, preserves TabPFN's numerical strengths, and is more efficient to train than end-to-end text-tabular pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TabPFN Text Adapter，一种轻量级文本适配器，通过将文本嵌入投影为TabPFN的token序列，取代了传统的PCA压缩瓶颈，在冻结编码器和TabPFN的情况下仅训练适配器，实现了高效且性能优异的文本-表格联合处理。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型（如TabPFN）不原生支持高基数文本特征，标准方案使用PCA压缩文本嵌入会造成信息瓶颈，而端到端方法需要大量预训练数据且性能不佳。
AI.method: 借鉴LLaVA和TableGPT的模态对齐思路，设计文本适配器将句子编码器的输出映射为TabPFN嵌入空间中的短token序列，冻结句子编码器和TabPFN，仅训练适配器。
AI.result: 消除PCA瓶颈，保留TabPFN在数值数据上的优势，训练效率高于端到端文本-表格流水线。
AI.conclusion: TabPFN Text Adapter是一种轻量、高效的文本-表格模态对齐方案，在保持TabPFN原有能力的同时实现了对文本特征的原生支持。

title: Robust-LLaVA: On the Effectiveness of Large-Scale Robust Image Encoders for Multi-modal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at Trustworthy FMs Workshop Trust Before Use: Building Foundation Models that You Can Trust (ICCVW) 2025
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in vision-language tasks but remain vulnerable to visual adversarial perturbations that can induce hallucinations, manipulate responses, or bypass safety mechanisms. Existing methods seek to mitigate these risks by applying constrained adversarial fine-tuning to CLIP vision encoders on ImageNet-scale data, ensuring their generalization ability is preserved. However, this limited adversarial training restricts robustness and broader generalization. In this work, we explore an alternative approach of leveraging existing vision classification models that have been adversarially pre-trained on large-scale data. Our analysis reveals two principal contributions: (1) the extensive scale and diversity of adversarial pre-training enables these models to demonstrate superior robustness against diverse adversarial threats, ranging from imperceptible perturbations to advanced jailbreaking attempts, without requiring additional adversarial training, and (2) end-to-end MLLM integration with these robust models facilitates enhanced adaptation of language components to robust visual features, outperforming existing plug-and-play methodologies on complex reasoning tasks. Through systematic evaluation across visual question-answering, image captioning, and jail-break attacks, we demonstrate that MLLMs trained with these robust models achieve superior adversarial robustness while maintaining favorable clean performance. Our framework achieves 2x and 1.5x average robustness gains in captioning and VQA tasks, respectively, and delivers over 10% improvement against jailbreak attacks. Code and pretrained models will be available at https://github.com/HashmatShadab/Robust-LLaVA.

AI.tldr: 本文探索利用大规模对抗预训练的视觉分类模型替代CLIP视觉编码器，以增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的对抗鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法无需额外对抗训练即可在视觉问答、图像描述和越狱攻击等任务上取得显著鲁棒性提升，同时保持干净的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM易受视觉对抗扰动攻击（幻觉、响应操控、安全机制绕过），而当前缓解方法（在CLIP视觉编码器上进行受限的对抗微调）因数据规模有限，鲁棒性和泛化能力不足。本文旨在探索一种替代方案，利用已有的大规模对抗预训练视觉分类模型来提升MLLM的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 本文方法不进行额外的对抗训练，而是直接利用在大规模数据上对抗预训练的视觉分类模型作为MLLM的视觉编码器，并将其端到端集成到MLLM中。通过这种方式，语言组件能够自适应地学习鲁棒的视觉特征，优于现有的即插即用方法。
AI.result: 在图像描述任务上获得2倍的平均鲁棒性提升，在VQA任务上获得1.5倍提升；针对越狱攻击的防御效果提升超过10%。同时保持良好的干净数据性能。
AI.conclusion: 大规模对抗预训练的视觉模型能够为MLLM提供更强的对抗鲁棒性，其关键优势在于预训练数据的规模和多样性，且端到端集成优于即插即用方式。该框架在多种对抗威胁（从不可察觉扰动到高级越狱攻击）下均表现出色。

title: Worker Utility as Hysteresis: A Preisach Model of Transaction Acceptance in Gig Labour Markets
summary: Worker utility is not observed -- only its consequence is. Each gig transaction produces a single bit: accepted or rejected. We argue this structure points directly to the Preisach hysteresis model as the natural representation of latent worker preferences. The Preisach operator models aggregate output as an integral over a population of binary threshold elements -- precisely the structure that emerges when heterogeneous workers each carry a private acceptance wage. We estimate two latent utility surfaces: acceptance utility U_1(X) and rejection utility U_0(X), via a dual-output neural network (shared layers 256->128, margin loss enforcing U_1 >= U_0). Classification reduces to the Preisach gap U_1(X) - U_0(X), passed into an XGBoost classifier alongside clip-stabilised price-to-threshold encodings. On 36,891 gig transactions, this pipeline achieves Jaccard = 0.827 and ROC AUC = 0.799. The price-to-threshold encoding accounts for +11.0 pp AUC over raw utility features. The model confirms the directional asymmetry hysteresis predicts: price decreases depress completion rates more than equivalent increases raise them. Applied to the full dataset, the model's recommendations simultaneously reduce the total wage bill by 21.3% and increase expected fill rate by 9.7 pp. For 74.2% of transactions, P(accept) already exceeds 0.80; reducing the wage keeps it above threshold (mean post-cut P = 0.972), releasing cost savings (median 31%). For the remaining 25.4%, a median 7% wage increase recovers +43 pp acceptance. A model without an explicit indifference zone cannot execute both moves simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Preisach磁滞模型表征零工经济中不可观测的工人效用，通过双输出神经网络估计接受/拒绝效用曲面，结合XGBoost分类器在36,891笔交易上达到Jaccard=0.827、AUC=0.799。模型验证了价格方向不对称性，并能在降低21.3%工资总额的同时提升9.7个百分点填充率。
AI.motivation: 工人效用无法直接观测，每次零工交易仅产生一个二值结果（接受/拒绝）。需要一种能刻画异质性工人私密保留工资与价格阈值行为的潜在偏好表示方法。
AI.method: 将Preisach磁滞模型作为工人潜在偏好的自然表示；构建双输出神经网络（共享层256→128，边界损失函数U₁≥U₀）估计接受效用U₁(X)和拒绝效用U₀(X)；分类器使用XGBoost，输入为Preisach间隙U₁-U₀及经裁剪稳定的价格-阈值编码。
AI.result: 在36,891笔零工交易上，Jaccard=0.827，ROC AUC=0.799；价格-阈值编码贡献+11.0个百分点AUC；模型可将工资总额降低21.3%并提升填充率9.7个百分点；74.2%的交易P(accept)>0.80，降薪后仍维持均值0.972；25.4%的交易提薪7%可回收+43个百分点接受率。
AI.conclusion: Preisach磁滞模型有效刻画了零工市场中工人效用的方向不对称性（降价对完成率的抑制大于涨价的提升效果）；包含无差异区的模型结构能同时实现降本与增效，而无该结构的模型无法做到。

title: Hierarchical Self-Supervised Adversarial Training for Robust Vision Models in Histopathology
comment: Accepted at 28th International Conference On Medical Image Computing And Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2025)
summary: Adversarial attacks pose significant challenges for vision models in critical fields like healthcare, where reliability is essential. Although adversarial training has been well studied in natural images, its application to biomedical and microscopy data remains limited. Existing self-supervised adversarial training methods overlook the hierarchical structure of histopathology images, where patient-slide-patch relationships provide valuable discriminative signals. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Self-Supervised Adversarial Training (HSAT), which exploits these properties to craft adversarial examples using multi-level contrastive learning and integrate it into adversarial training for enhanced robustness. We evaluate HSAT on multiclass histopathology dataset OpenSRH and the results show that HSAT outperforms existing methods from both biomedical and natural image domains. HSAT enhances robustness, achieving an average gain of 54.31% in the white-box setting and reducing performance drops to 3-4% in the black-box setting, compared to 25-30% for the baseline. These results set a new benchmark for adversarial training in this domain, paving the way for more robust models. Our Code for training and evaluation is available at https://github.com/HashmatShadab/HSAT.

AI.tldr: 提出层次自监督对抗训练（HSAT），利用组织病理图像的病人-切片-图像块层次结构进行多层级对比学习，在OpenSRH数据集上白盒场景平均提升54.31%，黑盒场景性能下降仅3-4%（基线为25-30%）。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督对抗训练方法忽视了组织病理图像中病人-切片-图像块的层次结构，这些结构蕴含丰富的判别性信号，而现有的对抗训练研究主要集中在自然图像领域，对生物医学和显微图像的应用有限。
AI.method: 利用组织病理图像的层次结构（病人-切片-图像块关系），设计多层级对比学习来构造对抗样本，并将其整合到对抗训练流程中，形成HSAT框架。
AI.result: 在多类别组织病理数据集OpenSRH上，HSAT在白盒设置下平均提升54.31%；在黑盒设置下性能下降仅3-4%，而基线下降25-30%。
AI.conclusion: HSAT为该领域的对抗训练设立了新的基准，为构建更鲁棒的医学图像模型铺平了道路。

title: Geospatial Foundation Models to Enable Progress on Sustainable Development Goals
summary: Foundation Models (FMs) are large-scale, pre-trained artificial intelligence (AI) systems that have revolutionized natural language processing and computer vision, and are now advancing geospatial analysis and Earth Observation (EO). They promise improved generalization across tasks, scalability, and efficient adaptation with minimal labeled data. However, despite the rapid proliferation of geospatial FMs, their real-world utility and alignment with global sustainability goals remain underexplored. We introduce SustainFM, a comprehensive benchmarking framework grounded in the 17 Sustainable Development Goals with extremely diverse tasks ranging from asset wealth prediction to environmental hazard detection. This study provides a rigorous, interdisciplinary assessment of geospatial FMs and offers critical insights into their role in attaining sustainability goals. Our findings show: (1) While not universally superior, FMs often outperform traditional approaches across diverse tasks and datasets. (2) Evaluating FMs should go beyond accuracy to include transferability, generalization, and energy efficiency as key criteria for their responsible use. (3) FMs enable scalable, SDG-grounded solutions, offering broad utility for tackling complex sustainability challenges. Critically, we advocate for a paradigm shift from model-centric development to impact-driven deployment, and emphasize metrics such as energy efficiency, robustness to domain shifts, and ethical considerations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SustainFM基准框架，基于17个可持续发展目标系统评估地理空间基础模型。研究发现：基础模型虽非普遍优于传统方法，但在多个任务中表现更佳；评估应超越准确率，纳入可迁移性、泛化能力和能效等指标；基础模型可为可持续发展提供可扩展的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 尽管地理空间基础模型快速发展，但其实际效用及与全球可持续发展目标的契合程度尚未得到充分探索。现有评估缺乏系统性的、跨学科的基准框架来衡量这些模型在真实世界可持续性任务中的表现。
AI.method: 构建SustainFM基准框架，基于17个可持续发展目标设计涵盖资产财富预测、环境危害检测等多样化任务的数据集，从准确率、可迁移性、泛化能力和能效等多个维度对地理空间基础模型进行系统性评估。
AI.result: (1)基础模型在多数任务上优于传统方法，但并非绝对；(2)评估需综合考虑多种指标；(3)基础模型能为可持续发展目标提供可扩展的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 倡导从以模型为中心的开发转向以影响力驱动的部署，强调能效、领域偏移鲁棒性和伦理考量等指标的重要性。

title: Reproducing, Analyzing, and Detecting Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) uses an LLM-as-a-Judge (LaaJ) to score model outputs according to rubrics as rewards. However, policy models may exploit latent biases in the judge, leading to reward hacking and ineffective or unsafe training outcomes. In real-world rubric-based RL, such hacking behaviors are often subtle and entangled with multiple judge biases, making them difficult to analyze, detect, and mitigate. In this paper, we introduce CHERRL, a controllable hacking environment for rubric-based RL. By injecting known biases into LaaJ, CHERRL enables stable reproduction of reward hacking, explicit observation of reward divergence, and precise identification of hacking onset. This provides a clean experimental testbed for studying the mechanisms and mitigations of reward hacking in rubric-based RL. To demonstrate its utility, we analyze different judge biases from the perspectives of discoverability and exploitability, and explore an agent-based system for automatically detecting reward hacking onset from training logs. The code and environment are publicly available at https://github.com/THUAIS-Lab/CHERRL.

AI.tldr: CHERRL是一个可控的基于评分标准的强化学习奖励破解环境，通过向LLM裁判注入已知偏见，稳定复现奖励破解行为，为研究奖励破解的机制与缓解方法提供了干净的实验平台。
AI.motivation: 在基于评分标准的强化学习中，策略模型可能利用LLM裁判的潜在偏见产生奖励破解，导致训练无效或不安全。这些破解行为往往微妙且与多种裁判偏见纠缠，难以分析、检测和缓解，因此需要一个可控的实验环境来系统研究该问题。
AI.method: 提出了CHERRL框架，通过向LLM裁判中注入已知偏见，实现奖励破解的稳定复现、奖励偏差的显式观察以及破解起点的精确识别。从可发现性和可利用性两个维度分析不同裁判偏见，并探索了基于智能体的系统来自动检测训练日志中的奖励破解起点。
AI.result: CHERRL能够稳定复现奖励破解行为，提供干净的实验测试平台，使研究人员能够显式观察奖励发散并精确定位破解发生的时刻。
AI.conclusion: CHERRL为研究基于评分标准的强化学习中的奖励破解机制及缓解方法提供了有效的实验工具，代码和环境已公开发布。

title: Can VLMs Predict Future States? Bootstrapping World Models from Inverse Dynamics
summary: Can unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform forward dynamics prediction (FDP), i.e., predicting the future state (in image form) given the previous observation and an action (in language form)? We find that VLMs struggle to generate physically plausible transitions between frames from instructions. Nevertheless, we identify a crucial asymmetry in multimodal grounding: fine-tuning a VLM to learn inverse dynamics prediction (IDP)-effectively captioning the action between frames-is significantly easier than learning FDP. In turn, IDP can be used to bootstrap FDP through two main strategies: 1) weakly supervised learning from synthetic data and 2) inference time verification. Firstly, IDP can annotate actions for unlabelled pairs of video frame observations to expand the training data scale for FDP. Secondly, IDP can assign rewards to multiple samples of FDP to score them, effectively guiding search at inference time. We evaluate the FDP resulting from both strategies through the task of action-centric image editing on Aurora-Bench with two families of VLMs. Despite remaining general-purpose, our best model achieves a performance competitive with state-of-the-art image editing models, improving on them by a margin between 7% and 13% according to GPT4o-as-judge, and achieving the best average human evaluation across all subsets of Aurora-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文发现统一视觉语言模型（VLM）在前向动力学预测（FDP，即根据前一帧图像和语言动作预测未来图像）上表现不佳，但逆动力学预测（IDP，即根据前后帧图像描述动作）相对容易。利用IDP通过两种策略（弱监督合成数据扩展训练集、推理时验证评分）引导FDP，最终在Aurora-Bench动作导向图像编辑任务上达到与SOTA模型竞争甚至领先7%-13%的性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在根据语言动作预测未来物理状态（图像形式）的前向动力学预测任务上存在困难，生成帧间物理合理转换的能力不足。
AI.method: 利用多模态对齐中IDP比FDP容易学习的不对称性，通过两种策略引导FDP：1) 用IDP为无标注视频帧对标注动作，扩充FDP训练数据（弱监督）；2) 在推理时用IDP为多个FDP采样结果打分，指导搜索。
AI.result: 在Aurora-Bench动作导向图像编辑任务上，使用GPT4o作为裁判，最佳模型比SOTA图像编辑模型提升7%-13%，且在所有子集上取得最佳人工评估平均分。
AI.conclusion: 尽管保持通用性，利用IDP引导FDP的策略能有效提升VLM的前向动力学预测能力，达到与专用模型竞争甚至更优的性能。

title: Data Attribution in Large Language Models via Bidirectional Gradient Optimization
comment: Presented at the AI Governance (AIGOV) Workshop at AAAI 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across diverse applications, raising critical questions for governance, accountability, and data provenance. Understanding which training data most influenced a model's output remains a fundamental open problem. We address this challenge through training data attribution (TDA) for auto-regressive LLMs by expanding upon the inverse formulation: How would training data be affected if the model had seen the generated output during training? Our method perturbs the base model using bidirectional gradient optimization (gradient ascent and descent) on a generated text sample and measures the resulting change in loss across training samples. Our framework supports attribution at arbitrary data granularity, enabling both factual and stylistic attribution. We evaluate our method against baselines on pretrained models with known datasets, and show that it outperforms previous work on influence metrics, thereby enhancing model interpretability, an essential requirement for accountable AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双向梯度优化的训练数据归因方法（TDA），通过逆向扰动自回归LLM的基础模型（在生成文本样本上执行梯度上升和下降），测量训练样本损失的变化，从而在任意数据粒度下实现事实和风格归因，在影响力指标上优于先前工作。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛部署，但理解哪些训练数据最影响模型输出仍是一个基本开放问题，这对治理、问责和数据溯源至关重要。
AI.method: 通过逆向公式：对生成文本样本执行双向梯度优化（梯度上升和下降）扰动基础模型，测量训练样本上损失的变化，支持任意数据粒度的归因。
AI.result: 在预训练模型和已知数据集上，该方法在影响力指标上优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法增强了模型可解释性，是实现可信AI系统的关键要求。

title: MATCH: Multi-faceted Adaptive Topo-Consistency for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
summary: In semi-supervised segmentation, capturing meaningful semantic structures from unlabeled data is essential. This is particularly challenging in histopathology image analysis, where objects are densely distributed. To address this issue, we propose a semi-supervised segmentation framework designed to robustly identify and preserve relevant topological features. Our method leverages multiple perturbed predictions obtained through stochastic dropouts and temporal training snapshots, enforcing topological consistency across these varied outputs. This consistency mechanism helps distinguish biologically meaningful structures from transient and noisy artifacts. A key challenge in this process is to accurately match the corresponding topological features across the predictions in the absence of ground truth. To overcome this, we introduce a novel matching strategy that integrates spatial overlap with global structural alignment, minimizing discrepancies among predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach effectively reduces topological errors, resulting in more robust and accurate segmentations essential for reliable downstream analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/Melon-Xu/MATCH.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种半监督分割框架MATCH，通过随机丢弃和时间训练快照生成多种扰动预测，强制拓扑一致性，并引入结合空间重叠与全局结构对齐的新颖匹配策略，有效减少组织病理学图像中的拓扑错误，提升分割鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.motivation: 在半监督分割中，从无标签数据中捕捉有意义的语义结构至关重要，而组织病理学图像中物体密集分布使得这一任务尤为困难。现有方法难以有效识别和保留与生物学相关的拓扑特征，容易受到瞬态噪声伪影的干扰。
AI.method: 1) 利用随机丢弃和时间训练快照生成多个扰动预测；2) 强制这些不同输出之间的拓扑一致性，以区分生物学有意义的结构与噪声伪影；3) 提出一种新颖的匹配策略，整合空间重叠与全局结构对齐，在无真实标签的情况下准确匹配不同预测间的对应拓扑特征，最小化预测间差异。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法有效减少了拓扑错误，生成了更鲁棒和准确的分割结果，能够可靠地支持下游分析任务。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明强制拓扑一致性并辅以有效的特征匹配策略，是提升半监督组织病理学图像分割质量的有效途径，代码已开源。

title: Sequential Data Poisoning in LLM Post-Training
summary: LLM post-training proceeds through multiple stages, e.g., supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or direct preference optimization (DPO), where each stage draws data from different, potentially untrusted sources. Existing literature assumes data poisoning attacks may occur at each training stage, but neglects the possibility of multiple attackers. To study the trustworthiness of the entire post-training pipeline, we propose the threat model of sequential data poisoning, where multiple adversaries separately poison the SFT and preference datasets. Under this threat model, we identify the single-attacker illusion: each adversary, evaluated in isolation, appears to pose a negligible threat. Yet when adversaries collaborate across stages, the true vulnerability is revealed. In the SFT $\to$ DPO pipeline, their contributions are additive: splitting a fixed poison budget across stages outperforms concentrating it in either stage alone. In the SFT $\to$ PPO pipeline, their contributions are complementary: neither SFT nor reward model poisoning succeeds individually, yet their combination does. These findings show that security analyses of individual post-training stages systematically underestimate compound vulnerabilities that emerge only from their interaction. Code is available at https://github.com/jcksanderson/sequential-poisoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“顺序数据投毒”威胁模型，发现后训练流水线（SFT→DPO/PPO）中多个攻击者跨阶段协作时，单个阶段看似无害的投毒会产生叠加或互补效应，暴露真实安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设每个训练阶段可能发生数据投毒攻击，但忽略了多个攻击者同时存在的可能性，导致对后训练流水线整体安全性的评估不完整。
AI.method: 提出顺序数据投毒威胁模型：多个对手分别毒化SFT数据集和偏好数据集。在SFT→DPO和SFT→PPO两种流水线上分析攻击效果，比较单阶段投毒与跨阶段协作投毒的影响。
AI.result: 1) 发现“单一攻击者幻觉”——单个攻击者单独评估时威胁可忽略，但跨阶段协作时暴露真实漏洞。2) SFT→DPO中，跨阶段分配投毒预算优于集中单一阶段，效果叠加。3) SFT→PPO中，单独SFT投毒或奖励模型投毒均无效，但组合有效。
AI.conclusion: 单个训练阶段的安全分析会系统性低估跨阶段交互产生的复合漏洞，需要对后训练流水线进行整体安全评估。

title: Platonic Transformers: A Solid Choice For Equivariance
summary: While widespread, Transformers lack inductive biases for geometric symmetries common in science and computer vision. Existing equivariant methods often sacrifice the efficiency and flexibility that make Transformers so effective through complex, computationally intensive designs. We introduce the Platonic Transformer to resolve this trade-off. By defining attention relative to reference frames from the Platonic solid symmetry groups, our method induces a principled weight-sharing scheme. This enables combined equivariance to continuous translations and Platonic symmetries, while preserving the exact architecture and computational cost of a standard Transformer. Furthermore, we show that this attention is formally equivalent to a dynamic group convolution, which reveals that the model learns adaptive geometric filters and enables a highly scalable, linear-time convolutional variant. Across diverse benchmarks in computer vision (CIFAR-10), 3D point clouds (ScanObjectNN), and molecular property prediction (QM9, OMol25), the Platonic Transformer achieves competitive performance by leveraging these geometric constraints at no additional cost.

AI.tldr: 提出Platonic Transformer，通过基于柏拉图立体对称群定义参考帧的注意力机制，在不增加计算开销的前提下实现连续平移和柏拉图对称性的联合等变性，并在计算机视觉、3D点云和分子属性预测任务上取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: Transformer缺乏对科学和计算机视觉中常见几何对称性的归纳偏置，而现有的等变方法通常以复杂且计算密集的设计牺牲了Transformer的效率和灵活性。
AI.method: 基于柏拉图立体对称群定义参考帧，在注意力机制中引入对连续平移和柏拉图对称性的联合等变性，实现原则性的权重共享方案；该注意力机制等价于动态群卷积，进而衍生出线性时间的高可扩展卷积变体。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10（计算机视觉）、ScanObjectNN（3D点云）、QM9和OMol25（分子属性预测）等基准上取得竞争性表现，且不增加额外计算成本。
AI.conclusion: Platonic Transformer在不牺牲标准Transformer架构和计算效率的前提下，通过几何约束实现了有效的等变学习，在多种几何相关任务上表现优异。

title: AdaKoop: Efficient Modeling of Nonlinear Dynamics from Nonstationary Data Streams with Koopman Operator Regression
summary: Real-time data analysis requires the ability to accurately and adaptively address nonlinear dynamics in a nonstationary data stream while preserving computational efficiency. However, nonlinear dynamics are so complex that capturing dynamically changing nonlinear patterns and utilizing them for downstream tasks under strict time constraints is nontrivial. To bridge the gap between nonlinear complexity and computational tractability, this study applies Koopman operator theory, which states that nonlinear dynamics can be represented as linear transitions in an infinite-dimensional space. Building upon finite-dimensional approximations of this operator, we present AdaKoop, an efficient streaming algorithm for modeling nonlinear dynamics over nonstationary data streams. Our approach utilizes a probabilistic framework grounded in Koopman operator theory, treating both raw observations and reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) features as emissions from latent vectors. This dual-view formulation allows nonlinear dynamics to be expressed as a tractable linear system. Therefore, AdaKoop enables the efficient and stable modeling of nonlinear dynamics in a streaming fashion, avoiding the prohibitive computational costs of iterative nonlinear optimization. Furthermore, to address nonstationarity in data streams, AdaKoop adaptively detects the switching of patterns via statistical hypothesis testing for abrupt pattern shifts and incrementally updates model parameters to handle continuous changes. Extensive experiments on a total of 71 practical benchmark datasets across various domains demonstrate that AdaKoop outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of real-time forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaKoop，一种基于Koopman算子理论的流式算法，通过将非线性动力学表示为无限维空间中的线性变换，结合概率框架和再生核希尔伯特空间特征，实现非平稳数据流上非线性动力学的高效建模与实时预测，并在71个基准数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 实时数据分析需要在保持计算效率的同时，准确捕捉非平稳数据流中的非线性动力学，但非线性动力学的高度复杂性使其在严格时间约束下难以被有效建模和利用。
AI.method: 基于Koopman算子理论，将非线性动力学表示为无限维空间中的线性变换；通过有限维近似构建概率框架，将原始观测和RKHS特征均视为潜在向量的发射值，将非线性动力学转化为可解的线性系统；采用统计假设检验检测模式突变，并增量更新模型参数以应对非平稳性。
AI.result: 在涵盖多个领域的71个实际基准数据集上，AdaKoop在实时预测精度和计算效率方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: AdaKoop成功弥合了非线性复杂性与计算可解性之间的鸿沟，为非平稳数据流中的非线性动力学建模提供了一种高效、稳定的流式解决方案。

title: J-RAS: Mutual Adaptation for Medical Image Segmentation via Contrastive Retrieval-Augmented Joint Optimization
summary: Manual medical image segmentation by clinicians, though accurate, is time-consuming and variable across experts, whereas AI-based models automate this process but often underperform with limited data and domain shifts. Inspired by how pathology trainees acquire disease recognition skills through guided comparison with expert-annotated slides and histopathology atlas reference images, we propose Joint Retrieval-Augmented Segmentation (J-RAS). This framework enables segmentation networks to learn with guidance. J-RAS jointly optimizes a segmentation model and a retrieval model through alternating contrastive and supervised learning, allowing the retrieval network to discover contextually relevant image-mask pairs that refine the segmentation model's anatomical reasoning. Unlike conventional retrieval-based augmentation that passively provides similar samples, J-RAS establishes a mutual adaptation and optimization loop where the retrieval model learns to emphasize segmentation-relevant cues, while the segmentation model leverages retrieved examples to improve boundary delineation, robustness to rare cases, and cross-dataset generalization. Evaluations on four public benchmarks spanning different imaging modalities, including ACDC and M&Ms (MRI), Breast Cancer Ultrasound, and lung and infection CT, across multiple backbones (U-Net, TransUNet, SAM, and SegFormer) demonstrate the generalizability and effectiveness of J-RAS. For instance, on ACDC, SegFormer improves from a mean Dice of 0.8708$\pm$0.042 and HD of 1.8130$\pm$2.49 to 0.9115$\pm$0.031 and 1.1489$\pm$0.30. These results highlight how retrieval-guided contrastive optimization bridges human-like guidance and machine-learned precision in medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联合检索增强分割框架（J-RAS），通过交替对比学习和监督学习联合优化分割模型与检索模型，使检索网络能够发现上下文相关的图像-掩膜对，从而提升分割模型在不同医学影像模态和骨干网络上的性能。
AI.motivation: 人工医学图像分割准确但耗时且存在专家间差异，AI模型在数据有限和域漂移情况下表现不佳。受病理学实习生通过对比专家标注切片和图谱参考图像学习疾病识别技能的启发，作者希望将这种"引导式学习"机制引入分割网络。
AI.method: J-RAS框架通过交替对比学习和监督学习，联合优化分割模型与检索模型。检索模型学习发现与分割任务相关的图像-掩膜对，分割模型利用检索到的示例改善边界分割、罕见病例鲁棒性和跨数据集泛化能力，两者形成相互适应与优化的闭环。
AI.result: 在ACDC（心脏MRI）、M&Ms（MRI）、乳腺癌超声和肺部CT四个公开数据集上，以U-Net、TransUNet、SAM和SegFormer为骨干网络进行验证。例如在ACDC上，SegFormer的平均Dice从0.8708±0.042提升至0.9115±0.031，HD从1.8130±2.49降至1.1489±0.30。
AI.conclusion: 检索引导的对比优化能够桥接人类引导式学习与机器学习精度，J-RAS在多种医学影像模态和骨干网络上均展现了泛化性和有效性。

title: Mean-based algorithms: A lower bound and regret
summary:
Mean-based algorithms are a class of online learning algorithms that assign low probability to actions with low average rewards. Recent work indicates these algorithms converge favorably to serially undominated actions, which approximate Nash equilibria in economic games. However, empirical studies also show slower convergence compared to established algorithms in bandit-feedback scenarios.
  We study mean-based algorithms when the time horizon is unknown and only bandit feedback is available. In this setting, we provide the first lower bound on the algorithm-defining sequence $γ_t$ that formally establishes a limit on how fast these algorithms can learn. Additionally, we propose two mean-based algorithms: one generalizes $ε$-greedy, and the other extends the mean-based Exp3 to unknown horizons. Our experiments show that mean-based algorithms, although slightly slower, can perform competitively with other bandit-feedback algorithms.
  We further analyze the relationship to no-regret algorithms. Depending on the choice of $γ_t$, the intersection with no-regret algorithms is non-trivial, and we show that algorithms exist that are both mean-based and no-regret. This adds context to the "exploitability" of this class of algorithms that previous contributions suggest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了未知时间跨度下仅依赖bandit反馈的mean-based在线学习算法，首次给出了算法定义序列γ_t的下界，提出了两种新算法（泛化ε-greedy和扩展Exp3），实验表明其性能虽略慢但具竞争力，并分析了与no-regret算法的交集关系。
AI.motivation: 现有mean-based算法在博弈论中能收敛到序列无占优策略（近似纳什均衡），但在bandit反馈场景下收敛速度慢于经典算法。本文旨在理论研究其学习速度的极限，并提出改进算法以提升实际性能。
AI.method: 1. 理论推导了算法定义序列γ_t的下界，形式化刻画了学习速度的极限；2. 提出了两种mean-based算法：泛化ε-greedy算法，以及将Exp3扩展到未知时间跨度下的mean-based版本；3. 通过实验比较了所提算法与其他bandit反馈算法的性能；4. 分析了mean-based算法与no-regret算法之间的交集关系。
AI.result: 首次给出了mean-based算法在未知时间跨度bandit反馈下的下界；提出的两种算法在实验中虽略慢于某些基线，但整体具有竞争力；证明存在同时满足mean-based和no-regret性质的算法。
AI.conclusion: mean-based算法在bandit反馈场景下存在固有的学习速度上限，但通过合理设计仍可达到与主流算法竞争的性能；其与no-regret算法的非平凡交集为理解这类算法的"可剥削性"提供了更丰富的语境。

title: Exposing Blindspots: Cultural Bias Evaluation in Generative Image Models
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at IASEAI 2026. Huichan Seo, Sieun Choi, and Minki Hong contributed equally
summary: Generative image models produce striking visuals yet often misrepresent culture. Prior work has examined cultural bias mainly in text-to-image (T2I) systems, leaving image-to-image (I2I) editors underexplored. We bridge this gap with a unified evaluation across six countries, an 8-category/36-subcategory schema, and era-aware prompts, auditing both T2I generation and I2I editing under a standardized protocol that yields comparable diagnostics. Using open models with fixed settings, we derive cross-country, cross-era, and cross-category evaluations. Our framework combines standard automatic metrics, a culture-aware retrieval-augmented VQA, and expert human judgments collected from native reviewers. To enable reproducibility, we release the complete image corpus, prompts, and configurations. Our study reveals three findings: (1) under country-agnostic prompts, models default to Global-North, modern-leaning depictions that flatten cross-country distinctions; (2) iterative I2I editing erodes cultural fidelity even when conventional metrics remain flat or improve; and (3) I2I models apply superficial cues (palette shifts, generic props) rather than era-consistent, context-aware changes, often retaining source identity for Global-South targets. These results highlight that culture-sensitive edits remain unreliable in current systems. By releasing standardized data, prompts, and human evaluation protocols, we provide a reproducible, culture-centered benchmark for diagnosing and tracking cultural bias in generative image models. Project page: https://seochan99.github.io/ECB

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一评估框架，对文本到图像（T2I）和图像到图像（I2I）生成模型进行文化偏见审计，涵盖6个国家、8大类36子类及时代感知提示。实验发现：无国家提示时模型默认输出全球北方现代风格；迭代I2I编辑会侵蚀文化保真度；I2I模型仅应用表面线索而非时代一致且上下文感知的编辑。研究提供了可复现的文化中心基准数据集和评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要研究文本到图像（T2I）系统中的文化偏见，但对图像到图像（I2I）编辑器的文化偏见研究不足。需要统一评估框架来系统比较两类模型的文化表现。
AI.method: 构建包含6个国家、8大类36子类文化类别和时代感知提示的统一评估框架，使用开放模型在固定设置下进行T2I生成和I2I编辑审计，结合标准自动指标、文化感知检索增强VQA和母语专家人工评估。
AI.result: (1) 无国家提示时模型默认输出全球北方现代风格；(2) 迭代I2I编辑侵蚀文化保真度而传统指标平坦或改善；(3) I2I模型应用表面线索而非时代一致的变化，对全球南方目标常保留源身份。
AI.conclusion: 当前系统对文化敏感的编辑不可靠，需要更完善的文化中心基准来诊断和追踪生成图像模型中的文化偏见。

title: STaR-Quant: State-Time Consistent Post-Training Quantization for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (DLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs by generating text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional context. However, their large model sizes and iterative denoising process introduce substantial memory and computational overhead, motivating post-training quantization for efficient deployment. In this paper, we identify two key challenges for low-bit DLLM quantization: state-dependent activation disparity and temporal error accumulation. Masked and unmasked tokens exhibit different activation distributions within each denoising step, while quantization errors can accumulate across steps during iterative decoding. To address these challenges, we propose STaR-Quant, a state-time consistent PTQ framework for DLLMs. STaR-Quant introduces State-Guided Activation Transformation (SGAT) to assign masked and unmasked tokens to different activation transformation spaces with a unified static weight-side transformation. It further introduces Temporal Attention Compensation (TAC) to correct the quantized attention representation via a lightweight block-diagonal affine mapping. Experiments on representative DLLMs demonstrate that STaR-Quant consistently improves low-bit weight-activation quantization over strong PTQ baselines, while delivering up to 1.69x speedup and 3.14x memory saving over FP16 deployment.

AI.tldr: STaR-Quant提出了一种面向扩散大语言模型(DLLM)的低比特后训练量化框架，通过状态引导激活变换(SGAT)解决掩码/非掩码令牌的激活分布差异，并通过时间注意力补偿(TAC)减少跨步量化误差累积，在保持低比特量化的同时实现1.69倍加速和3.14倍内存节省。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型(DLLM)虽作为自回归模型的有前景替代方案，但其大模型尺寸和迭代去噪过程导致显著的内存与计算开销，低比特后训练量化是高效部署的关键。然而现有方法面临两大挑战：每个去噪步内掩码与非掩码令牌的激活分布差异（状态依赖性），以及迭代解码过程中量化误差的跨步累积（时间误差累积）。
AI.method: 提出STaR-Quant框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 状态引导激活变换(SGAT)：为掩码和非掩码令牌分配不同的激活变换空间，同时使用统一的静态权重侧变换；2) 时间注意力补偿(TAC)：通过轻量级块对角仿射映射校正量化后的注意力表示，减少跨步误差传播。
AI.result: 在代表性DLLM上的实验表明，STaR-Quant在低比特权重量化方面一致优于强PTQ基线，并在FP16部署基础上实现最高1.69倍加速和3.14倍内存节省。
AI.conclusion: STaR-Quant有效解决了DLLM低比特量化中的状态依赖和时间误差累积两大挑战，为扩散大语言模型的高效部署提供了实用方案。

title: Med-Banana: Learning Quality-Controlled Medical Image Editing from Success-and-Failure Trajectories
summary: Text-guided medical image editing must satisfy the requested pathology while preserving anatomy, modality-specific appearance, and clinical plausibility. However, existing datasets largely supervise editors with final accepted edits and discard the failed attempts produced during generation. We argue that these failures provide essential supervision for quality control: they specify what should be rejected, why an edit is medically or visually invalid, and how the instruction should be revised. We present Med-Banana, a trajectory-supervised framework for quality-controlled medical image editing. We introduce Med-Banana-80K, a large-scale resource of success-and-failure editing trajectories with candidate images, verification outcomes, rejection reasons, and prompt refinements. Building on it, Med-Banana jointly trains an editor, verifier, and refiner, enabling edit--verify--refine inference from accepted and rejected attempts. Experiments across MLLM judges, blind expert assessment, source-preservation and real--synthetic separability probes demonstrate consistent improvements over open medical image editors. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: Med-Banana提出了一种轨迹监督框架，通过同时利用成功和失败的编辑轨迹（含候选图像、验证结果、拒绝原因和提示优化）来训练编辑器、验证器和优化器，实现质量可控的医学图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像编辑数据集仅使用最终接受的编辑结果进行监督，丢弃了生成过程中失败的尝试。但这些失败样本提供了质量控制所需的关键信息——指定了什么应该被拒绝、编辑为何在医学或视觉上无效、以及如何修正指令。
AI.method: 构建Med-Banana-80K大规模资源，包含成功与失败的编辑轨迹（候选图像、验证结果、拒绝原因、提示优化）；在此基础上联合训练编辑器（editor）、验证器（verifier）和优化器（refiner）；实现"编辑-验证-优化"推理流程。
AI.result: 在多模态大模型评判、盲法专家评估、源图像保持性和真实-合成可分性探测等实验中，Med-Banana相比开源医学图像编辑器表现出一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用失败轨迹进行监督学习，可以有效提升医学图像编辑的质量控制能力，代码和数据已公开。

title: Be Fair! Can Machine Learning Engineering Agents Adhere to Fairness Constraints?
summary: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents promise to automate end-to-end ML pipeline development from raw data and natural language instructions, potentially making ML accessible to non-technical domain experts. However, in sensitive and regulated domains, this abstraction creates a responsibility gap: end-users may lack visibility into design choices that affect correctness, robustness, fairness, and regulatory compliance. We argue that existing benchmarks are insufficient to assess whether MLE agents can be safely applied in such settings. We propose desiderata for a responsibility-centered evaluation framework and conduct an exploratory study on melanoma classification, focusing on fairness across skin tones as a responsibility constraint. When evaluating two recent MLE agents, we find that agent-generated pipelines show high variance and consistently underperform manually designed baselines in both predictive quality and fairness, despite fairness-oriented prompts. These preliminary results suggest that further research is needed towards redesigning MLE agents to allow humans to guide the search process and reliably assess the compliance and quality of the generated ML pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有机器学习工程（MLE）智能体在敏感和受监管领域存在责任缺失问题，现有基准不足，并以黑色素瘤分类为例评估了两个MLE智能体，发现其生成的pipeline在预测质量和公平性上均低于人工设计的基线，且高方差问题显著，表明需要重新设计MLE智能体以允许人工引导和合规性评估。
AI.motivation: 现有MLE智能体承诺自动化端到端ML流程开发，但在敏感和受监管领域（如医疗），非技术用户无法感知影响正确性、鲁棒性、公平性和法规合规性的设计选择，存在责任缺口（responsibility gap）。现有基准不足以评估MLE智能体在此类场景下的安全应用。
AI.method: 提出以责任为中心的评估框架应满足的期望标准（desiderata），并以黑色素瘤分类任务为案例，以肤色间的公平性为责任约束，对两个近期MLE智能体进行探索性研究。
AI.result: MLE智能体生成的pipeline在预测质量和公平性上均持续低于人工设计的基线，且存在高方差问题；即使使用面向公平性的提示词，公平性表现仍不理想。
AI.conclusion: 需要进一步研究重新设计MLE智能体，使其允许人类引导搜索过程，并能可靠评估生成ML pipeline的合规性与质量。

title: Label-Efficient 3D Forest Mapping: Self-Supervised and Transfer Learning for Instance Segmentation, Semantic Segmentation, and Species Classification
summary: Detailed structural and species information on individual tree level is increasingly important to support precision forestry, biodiversity conservation, and provide reference data for biomass and carbon mapping. Point clouds from airborne and ground-based laser scanning are currently the most suitable data source to rapidly derive such information at scale. Recent advancements in deep learning improved segmenting and classifying individual trees and identifying semantic tree components. However, deep learning models typically require large amounts of annotated training data which limits further improvement. Producing dense, high-quality annotations for 3D point clouds, especially in complex forests, is labor-intensive and challenging to scale. We explore strategies to reduce dependence on large annotated datasets using self-supervised and transfer learning. Our objective is to improve performance across three tasks: instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, and tree classification using realistic and operational training sets. We observe improvements across all tasks, compared to training from scratch, evaluated with their respective metrics. For instance segmentation, self-supervised learning combined with domain adaptation improves AP50 by 16.98%. For semantic segmentation, self-supervised learning alone improves mIoU by 1.79%. For tree classification, hierarchical transfer learning improves mean Jaccard by 6.07%. To simplify use and encourage uptake, we integrated the tasks into a unified framework, streamlining the process from raw point clouds to tree delineation, structural analysis, and species classification. Pretrained models reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions by ~21%. This open-source contribution aims to accelerate operational extraction of individual tree information from laser scanning point clouds to support forestry, biodiversity, and carbon mapping.

AI.tldr: 本文探索利用自监督学习和迁移学习策略，在激光雷达点云数据上减少对大量标注数据的依赖，提升个体树木实例分割、语义分割和树种分类三大任务的性能，并将三者整合为统一框架，同时降低能耗和碳排放约21%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习方法在树木点云分割与分类中表现优异，但需要大量高质量标注数据，而在复杂森林环境中获取密集3D点云标注成本高、难以规模化，亟需减少对标注数据依赖的训练策略。
AI.method: 采用自监督学习（对比学习等）和迁移学习（层次迁移、域自适应）策略，在实例分割、语义分割和树种分类三个任务上分别评估效果，并将三者整合为从原始点云到树木勾绘、结构分析、树种分类的统一框架；同时提供预训练模型以减少计算开销。
AI.result: 实例分割任务中，自监督学习+域自适应使AP50提升16.98%；语义分割任务中，自监督学习使mIoU提升1.79%；树种分类任务中，层次迁移学习使平均Jaccard指数提升6.07%；预训练模型减少约21%的能耗和碳排放。
AI.conclusion: 自监督与迁移学习能有效降低对标注数据的依赖并在多个树木点云分析任务上取得显著提升；统一框架和开源预训练模型有助于推动精准林业、生物多样性保护和碳汇制图等应用。

title: AlphaQ: Calibration-Free Bit Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Quantization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse expert activation, but their deployment remains memory-bound because all expert weights must reside in memory. Mixed-precision quantization can substantially reduce this footprint by assigning different bit-widths to different experts. Existing approaches, however, typically rely on calibration data to estimate expert importance and determine bit allocation. For frontier MoE LLMs, the original training data, and hence the true training distribution, is proprietary and inaccessible. As a result, calibration sets are inevitably imperfect surrogates, and this can misestimate expert utilization and lead to suboptimal bit allocation. Motivated by the substantial cross-expert quality variability observed in modern MoE models, and by the success of Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory at predicting neural network model quality without access to training or testing data, we propose AlphaQ, a calibration-free bit-allocation method for MoE quantization. AlphaQ draws on HT-SR theory and follows a simple principle: experts with more heavy-tailed weight spectra are typically better trained and hence should receive higher bit-widths, while experts with weaker heavy-tailed structure can be quantized more aggressively. AlphaQ operationalizes this principle by measuring expert-wise spectral heavy-tailedness and solving a budget-constrained optimization problem that minimizes total quantization error under a global bit-budget constraint. Across several MoE models, AlphaQ consistently outperforms calibration-based baselines under matched bit budgets. Notably, on Qwen1.5-MoE, AlphaQ achieves near full-precision accuracy with an average expert precision of only 3.5 bits, while delivering more than 4$\times$ memory compression. Our code is available at https://github.com/Superone77/AlphaQ.

AI.tldr: AlphaQ是一种无需校准数据的混合精度量化方法，基于重尾自正则化理论，通过专家权重的谱重尾性分配比特数，实现对MoE大语言模型的高效量化，在Qwen1.5-MoE上以平均3.5比特精度达到接近全精度的性能，并提供超过4倍的内存压缩。
AI.motivation: MoE架构虽然通过稀疏激活扩展了模型容量，但部署时所有专家权重常驻内存，导致内存瓶颈。现有混合精度量化方法依赖校准数据估计专家重要性，但前沿MoE大模型的原始训练数据不可获取，校准集作为代理无法完美匹配真实分布，导致次优的比特分配。
AI.method: AlphaQ基于重尾自正则化理论，通过测量每个专家权重的谱重尾性指标，遵循"谱重尾越显著的专家训练越充分，应分配更高比特"的原则，并将比特分配形式化为一个预算约束下的最小化总量化误差优化问题。
AI.result: 在多个MoE模型上，AlphaQ在相同比特预算下持续优于基于校准的基线方法。在Qwen1.5-MoE上，以平均3.5比特精度达到接近全精度的准确率，并实现超过4倍的内存压缩。
AI.conclusion: AlphaQ证明了无需校准数据即可有效实现MoE模型的混合精度量化，为无法访问原始训练数据的场景提供了实用解决方案。

title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images
summary: We present SAM 3D, a generative model for visually grounded 3D object reconstruction, predicting geometry, texture, and layout from a single image. SAM 3D excels in natural images, where occlusion and scene clutter are common and visual recognition cues from context play a larger role. We achieve this with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline for annotating object shape, texture, and pose, providing visually grounded 3D reconstruction data at unprecedented scale. We learn from this data in a modern, multi-stage training framework that combines synthetic pretraining with real-world alignment, breaking the 3D "data barrier". We obtain significant gains over recent work, with at least a 5:1 win rate in human preference tests on real-world objects and scenes. We will release our code and model weights, an online demo, and a new challenging benchmark for in-the-wild 3D object reconstruction.

AI.tldr: SAM 3D是一个从单张图像进行视觉引导的3D物体重建生成模型，通过人类与模型协同的数据标注流程和合成预训练+真实世界对齐的多阶段训练框架，突破了3D数据瓶颈，在自然图像中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 自然图像中普遍存在遮挡和场景杂乱问题，现有3D重建方法在真实世界场景中表现不佳，主要受限于缺乏大规模、高质量且具有视觉真实感的3D标注数据。
AI.method: 采用人类与模型协同的流水线（human-and-model-in-the-loop pipeline）大规模标注物体形状、纹理和姿态；采用多阶段训练框架：先在合成数据上预训练，再在真实数据上进行对齐微调，从而打破3D数据壁垒。
AI.result: 在人类偏好测试中，针对真实世界物体和场景，获得至少5:1的胜率，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SAM 3D通过创新的数据标注流程和训练策略，有效解决了自然图像中的3D重建难题，将开源代码、模型权重、在线演示以及新的野外3D物体重建基准。

title: New Benchmarking Shows Limited Generalization Power of TCR Antigenic Epitope Prediction Models
summary: Accurate computational prediction of T cell receptor (TCR) antigen specificity would transform the study of T cell biology and enable scalable immune engineering, yet existing models lack sufficient sensitivity and specificity for broad applications. A major limitation is the absence of rigorously defined, unseen benchmark datasets that allow unbiased evaluation of model performance and generalizability. Here, we describe two complementary classes of datasets that meet this criterion and argue that they provide both a robust framework for model assessment and a foundation for next-generation TCR-antigen prediction algorithm development.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前TCR-抗原特异性预测模型缺乏足够灵敏度和特异性，主要原因在于缺乏严格定义的、未见过的基准数据集。作者提出了两类互补的、满足此标准的数据集，为模型评估和下一代预测算法开发提供框架。
AI.motivation: 现有TCR-抗原特异性预测模型在广泛应用中表现不佳，缺乏足够灵敏度和特异性，根本原因在于缺少严格定义且未见过的基准数据集，无法对模型性能和泛化能力进行 unbiased 评估。
AI.method: 描述了两类互补的数据集，这些数据集满足"严格定义的未见过的基准"这一标准，为模型评估提供了稳健框架。
AI.result: 提出了两类互补的数据集，作为评估TCR-抗原预测模型性能和泛化能力的基准。
AI.conclusion: 这些数据集不仅提供了鲁棒的模型评估框架，也为下一代TCR-抗原预测算法的开发奠定了基础。

title: AttnRegDeepLab: A Two-Stage Decoupled Framework for Interpretable Embryo Fragmentation Grading
summary: Embryo fragmentation is a morphological indicator critical for evaluating developmental potential in In Vitro Fertilization (IVF). However, manual grading is subjective and inefficient, while existing deep learning solutions often lack clinical explainability or suffer from accumulated errors in segmentation area estimation. To address these issues, this study proposes AttnRegDeepLab (Attention-Guided Regression DeepLab), a framework characterized by dual-branch Multi-Task Learning (MTL). A vanilla DeepLabV3+ decoder is modified by integrating Attention Gates into its skip connections, explicitly suppressing cytoplasmic noise to preserve contour details. Furthermore, a Multi-Scale Regression Head is introduced with a Feature Injection mechanism to propagate global grading priors into the segmentation task, rectifying systematic quantification errors. A 2-stage decoupled training strategy is proposed to address the gradient conflict in MTL. Also, a range-based loss is designed to leverage weakly labeled data. Our method achieves robust grading precision while maintaining excellent segmentation accuracy (Dice coefficient =0.729), in contrast to the end-to-end counterpart that might minimize grading error at the expense of contour integrity. This work provides a clinically interpretable solution that balances visual fidelity and quantitative precision.

AI.tldr: 提出AttnRegDeepLab框架，通过双分支多任务学习、注意力门控、多尺度回归头及两阶段解耦训练策略，在胚胎碎片分级中兼顾分割精度（Dice=0.729）与分级准确性，解决传统方法主观性强、深度学习缺乏临床可解释性及分割误差累积问题。
AI.motivation: 胚胎碎片是IVF中评估发育潜力的关键形态学指标，但人工分级主观低效，现有深度学习方法缺乏临床可解释性或存在分割区域估计的累积误差。
AI.method: 提出AttnRegDeepLab框架，包含：1) 在DeepLabV3+跳跃连接中集成注意力门控以抑制细胞质噪声；2) 引入多尺度回归头，通过特征注入机制传播全局分级先验以纠正分割量化误差；3) 两阶段解耦训练策略解决多任务学习的梯度冲突；4) 基于范围的损失函数利用弱标注数据。
AI.result: Dice系数达0.729，在保持优异分割精度的同时实现稳健的分级精度，优于以牺牲轮廓完整性换取分级误差最小化的端到端方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了临床可解释的解决方案，在视觉保真度与定量精度之间取得平衡，为IVF胚胎评估提供了兼顾准确性与可解释性的计算框架。

title: Enhancing the MADDPG Algorithm for Multi-Agent Learning via Action Inference and Importance Sampling
summary: We investigate multi-agent deep reinforcement learning and propose two enhancements to the Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) algorithm.
