First, we introduce a novel Action Inference mechanism that enables each agent to predict other agents' intended actions, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of its own policy. Second, we apply an importance sampling strategy, using geometric distribution, in the replay buffer to prioritize more recent and informative experiences, which helps mitigate the non-stationarity inherent in multi-agent environments. We evaluate both modifications on the discrete-action Predator-Prey task provided by the PettingZoo library, a flexible Python interface for general multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmarks. Our results indicate that Action Inference is effective in improving learning stability and inter-agent cooperation and that importance sampling using geometric distribution can lead to significant improvements in exploration efficiency over standard MADDPG. Code available at https://github.com/shaashwathsivakumar/MARL_Proj

AI.tldr: 本文针对MADDPG算法提出了两项改进：动作推断机制（Action Inference）和基于几何分布的重要性采样策略，在离散动作的捕食者-猎物任务中验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习中存在非平稳性问题，标准MADDPG算法对其它智能体策略的建模不够精确，且经验回放机制未能有效处理环境动态变化带来的影响。
AI.method: 1）提出Action Inference机制，使每个智能体能够预测其他智能体的意图动作，从而提升自身策略的准确性与稳定性；2）在经验回放缓冲区中引入基于几何分布的重要性采样策略，优先采样更近且更具信息量的经验样本。
AI.result: 在PettingZoo库提供的离散动作捕食者-猎物任务上，Action Inference有效提升了学习稳定性和智能体间协作能力；基于几何分布的重要性采样显著提高了探索效率，优于标准MADDPG。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的两项改进均能有效缓解多智能体环境中的非平稳性问题，提升MADDPG算法的性能。

title: Dynamic Content Moderation in Livestreams: Combining Supervised Classification with MLLM-Boosted Similarity Matching
comment: To be published at KDD 2026 (ADS track)
summary: Content moderation remains a critical yet challenging task for large-scale user-generated video platforms, especially in livestreaming environments where moderation must be timely, multimodal, and robust to evolving forms of unwanted content. We present a hybrid moderation framework deployed at production scale that combines supervised classification for known violations with reference-based similarity matching for novel or subtle cases. This hybrid design enables robust detection of both explicit violations and novel edge cases that evade traditional classifiers. Multimodal inputs (text, audio, visual) are processed through both pipelines, with a multimodal large language model (MLLM) distilling knowledge into each to boost accuracy while keeping inference lightweight. In production, the classification pipeline achieves 67% recall at 80% precision, and the similarity pipeline achieves 76% recall at 80% precision. Large-scale A/B tests show a 6-8% reduction in user views of unwanted livestreams}. These results demonstrate a scalable and adaptable approach to multimodal content governance, capable of addressing both explicit violations and emerging adversarial behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向直播平台的混合内容审核框架，结合监督分类与基于参考的相似性匹配，利用多模态大语言模型进行知识蒸馏，在生产环境中实现了对已知违规和新型边缘案例的有效检测。
AI.motivation: 大规模用户生成视频平台（特别是直播环境）的内容审核面临及时性、多模态性以及不断演变的违规内容形式等挑战，现有单一方法难以同时兼顾已知违规的高效检测和新型边缘案例的鲁棒识别。
AI.method: 提出混合审核框架：1) 监督分类流水线处理已知违规；2) 参考相似性匹配流水线处理新型或细微案例。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对两个流水线进行知识蒸馏，在保持轻量推理的同时提升准确性。双流水线均处理文本、音频、视觉多模态输入。
AI.result: 监督分类流水线在80%精确率下达到67%召回率，相似性匹配流水线在80%精确率下达到76%召回率。大规模A/B测试显示用户对违规直播的观看量减少6-8%。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架展示了一种可扩展且自适应的多模态内容治理方法，能够有效应对明确的违规内容和新兴的对抗行为，适用于生产环境部署。

title: Invariant Gradient Alignment for Robust Reasoning Distillation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from shortcut learning: they systematically fail on out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs whose semantic surface differs from training data, even when the logical structure is identical. This undermines knowledge distillation pipelines that transfer chain-of-thought reasoning to smaller students. We introduce Invariant Gradient Alignment (IGA), a training framework that aligns gradient updates across semantically diverse but logically isomorphic examples via three innovations: (i) Logical Isomer Sets, groups of problems sharing identical logical structure across distinct semantic domains (mathematics, medicine, law, science); (ii) a differentiable \emph{Continuous Gradient Conflict Mask}, that suppresses parameter dimensions with high cross-domain gradient variance while preserving invariant directions; and (iii) a truncated SVD projection of the masked gradient back onto the LoRA low-rank manifold, maintaining parameter efficiency throughout. Theoretically, IGA yields tighter OOD generalization bounds than ERM, scaling with the number of isomer domains, and converges at the standard SGD rate under mild regularity. Empirically, IGA outperforms eight baselines across four benchmarks with accuracy gains up to 14.3 pp over ERM-SFT and a Logical Consistency Score of 0.031 versus 0.142 -- a fourfold improvement in representational invariance.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型在逻辑相同但语义不同的分布外输入上系统失效的捷径学习问题，本文提出不变梯度对齐（IGA）训练框架，通过逻辑同构集、连续梯度冲突掩码和截断SVD投影到LoRA低秩流形三大创新，实现了更紧的OOD泛化界和最高14.3个百分点的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在捷径学习问题，即在语义表面不同但逻辑结构相同的分布外输入上系统性失败，这严重损害了将思维链推理迁移到小模型的知识蒸馏流程。
AI.method: 提出不变梯度对齐（IGA）框架，包含三大创新：(i) 逻辑同构集，即跨数学、医学、法律、科学等不同语义领域但共享相同逻辑结构的问题组；(ii) 可微的连续梯度冲突掩码，抑制高跨域梯度方差的参数维度，保留不变方向；(iii) 将掩码后梯度通过截断SVD投影回LoRA低秩流形，保持参数效率。
AI.result: IGA在四个基准上超越八种基线方法，准确率最高提升14.3个百分点；逻辑一致性分数从0.142降至0.031，表征不变性提升四倍。
AI.conclusion: 理论上IGA的OOD泛化界比ERM更紧，随同构域数量扩展，且在温和正则条件下以标准SGD速率收敛。

title: From Segments to Scenes: Temporal Understanding for Agentic Autonomous Driving via Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as the perception and reasoning backbone of autonomous agents acting in the wild, with autonomous driving (AD) being one of the most safety-critical instances. Reliable temporal understanding is essential for such agents to anticipate events, attribute causes, and act safely in dynamic environments, yet this remains a significant challenge even for state-of-the-art (SoTA) VLMs. Prior video benchmarks have emphasized other content (sports, cooking, etc.), yet no existing benchmark focuses exclusively on temporal understanding for both short- and long-form AD footage. To fill this gap, we present the Temporal Understanding in Autonomous Driving (TAD) benchmark, comprising nearly 6000 question-answer (QA) pairs across 7 tasks, and evaluate 9 closed- and open-source generalist as well as AD-specialist models. Current SoTA models perform substantially below human accuracy on TAD. To improve the temporal reasoning of VLM-based driving agents, we propose two novel training-free solutions: Scene-CoT, which uses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, and TCogMap, which incorporates an ego-centric temporal cognitive map produced by a trajectory-analysis module that operates as an agentic tool around the VLM. Integrated with existing VLMs, our methods improve average accuracy on TAD by up to $17.72\%$ and by up to $10.35\%$ on STSBench. By introducing TAD, benchmarking SoTA models, and proposing effective enhancements, this work aims to catalyze further progress on temporal understanding for agentic AD systems operating in the wild. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at ${\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/vbdai/TAD}{\text{Hugging Face}}}$ and ${\href{https://github.com/vbdi/tad_bench}{\text{GitHub}}}$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAD基准测试，包含近6000个QA对和7个时间理解任务，评估了9个VLM模型在自动驾驶场景中的表现。现有SOTA模型远低于人类水平。作者提出两种无需训练的方法（Scene-CoT和TCogMap），分别通过链式推理和基于轨迹分析的时态认知地图来提升模型性能，在TAD上最高提升17.72%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在自动驾驶这一安全关键领域中缺乏对时间理解的专门评估基准，已有的视频基准多关注体育、烹饪等内容，没有专门针对自动驾驶短时和长时视频片段的时间理解基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建TAD基准数据集，包含近6000个QA对和7种时间理解任务；2) 提出Scene-CoT（链式推理方法）和TCogMap（基于轨迹分析模块构建以自我为中心的时态认知地图，作为VLM的智能体工具），两种方法均为无需训练的直接集成方案。
AI.result: 在TAD上，现有SOTA模型准确率远低于人类。集成提出的Scene-CoT和TCogMap后，模型在TAD上平均准确率提升最高17.72%，在STSBench上提升最高10.35%。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出TAD基准、评估现有模型并提供有效的无训练增强方案，旨在推动面向野外自动驾驶智能体系统的时间理解能力进一步发展。

title: Validity Threats for Foundation Model Research
summary: Controlled experiments are the backbone of machine learning research, but at the scale of modern foundation models, they have become prohibitively expensive. Instead, the community increasingly relies on research strategies that approximate the ideal experiment at a fraction of the cost: proxy experiments and scaling laws, observational studies with publicly available models, and single-run designs that leverage variation within individual training runs. In this work, we argue that there is no free lunch when approximating large-scale experiments on a compute budget. Specifically, savings in compute come at the cost of validity threats -- hidden and sometimes untestable assumptions that, when violated, can invalidate research claims. To help navigate such threats, we propose an evaluation framework that casts foundation model research as a causal inference problem. Within this framework, we evaluate different research strategies through four types of validity adapted from the empirical social sciences -- statistical, internal, external, and construct validity. We find that each strategy comes with a characteristic validity profile: proxy experiments trade external and construct validity for statistical and internal validity; observational studies face confounding and effect heterogeneity; and single-run designs are strained by interference between treated units. This analysis reveals several validity threats that have received insufficient attention in the literature. Overall, our evaluation framework provides researchers with a practical toolkit for scrutinizing validity threats in foundation model research~designs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，在大规模基础模型研究中，通过代理实验、观察研究和单次运行设计等低成本策略来近似理想对照实验，虽然在计算上节省成本，但会引入统计、内部、外部和构念效度方面的有效性威胁。作者借鉴社会科学因果推断框架，系统评估了各类研究策略的效度特征，为研究人员提供了识别和审视有效性威胁的实用工具。
AI.motivation: 基础模型规模的快速增长使得传统的对照实验成本过高，社区不得不依赖各种近似策略来开展研究。然而，这些策略的效度威胁尚未被系统审视，可能导致研究结论的可靠性受损。作者希望借鉴社会科学的因果推断框架，系统分析这些近似策略的有效性代价，帮助研究人员识别和规避潜在的效度问题。
AI.method: 将基础模型研究建模为因果推断问题，借鉴社会科学的四类效度框架（统计效度、内部效度、外部效度、构念效度），系统评估代理实验与规模定律、观察研究、单次运行设计这三种常见研究策略的效度特征与威胁。
AI.result: 每种研究策略都有其独特的效度特征：代理实验以牺牲外部效度和构念效度换取统计效度和内部效度；观察研究面临混杂偏差和效应异质性问题；单次运行设计则受限于处理单元间的干扰效应。分析揭示了文献中尚未充分关注的多类效度威胁。
AI.conclusion: 大规模实验的近似策略不存在免费午餐，计算成本节省必然伴随着效度风险。作者提出的评估框架为研究人员提供了一套实用工具，可用于审视和应对基础模型研究设计中的各类有效性威胁。

title: DMAConv: Dual Mask-Adaptive Convolution for Remote Sensing Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening aims to fuse a high-resolution panchromatic image with a low-resolution multispectral image. Existing deep learning methods, including recent adaptive convolutions, struggle with regional heterogeneity in remote sensing images and often incur prohibitive computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose Dual Mask-Adaptive Convolution (DMAConv), a novel operator that dynamically allocates computational resources based on feature characteristics. DMAConv first employs a lightweight module to generate soft and hard masks. The hard mask separates features into a compact branch for processing redundant information globally and a focused branch that models complex, heterogeneous regions with greater computational investment. The soft mask then preliminarily modulates the input features for both branches. This dual-branch, mask-adaptive design significantly enhances feature representation while minimizing computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves SOTA on a broad array of quantitative benchmarks, with substantially lower parameter counts and the minimal computational cost among adaptive convolution models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dual Mask-Adaptive Convolution (DMAConv)，通过软硬掩码将特征分离为紧凑分支（处理全局冗余信息）和聚焦分支（建模复杂异质区域），实现动态计算资源分配，在降低参数和计算成本的同时达到全色锐化SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法（包括自适应卷积）难以处理遥感图像的区域异质性，且计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出DMAConv算子：1) 轻量模块生成软掩码和硬掩码；2) 硬掩码将特征分为紧凑分支（全局冗余处理）和聚焦分支（复杂异质区域建模）；3) 软掩码对两分支输入进行初步调制；4) 双分支掩码自适应设计增强特征表示并降低计算开销。
AI.result: 在多项定量基准上达到SOTA，参数量显著降低，且在自适应卷积模型中计算成本最低。
AI.conclusion: DMAConv通过动态计算资源分配有效解决了区域异质性问题，在性能和效率之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: In-Context Graphical Inference
summary: Marginal inference in discrete graphical models forces a choice between exactness and scalability: exact algorithms are intractable for high-treewidth graphs, while iterative approximations (Belief Propagation, variational methods) sacrifice convergence guarantees on frustrated topologies. We argue that this dichotomy stems from a mismatched inductive bias: iterative methods abandon the sequential elimination structure that makes exact inference correct. We introduce In-Context Graphical Inference (ICG-I), an autoregressive Graph Transformer that restores this structure by mimicking Variable Elimination with learned, Tensor- Train-compressed intermediate factors, paired with a Dirichlet output layer and Weighted Conformal Prediction for calibrated, distribution-free coverage guarantees under topological shift. We prove that TT compression errors propagate at most lincarly through the autoregressive chain, that the Dirichlet-Multinomial loss is a proper scoring rule, and that WCP maintains coverage with a quantifiable degradation under estimated density ratios. We conducted intensive experiments to evaluate ICG-I and achieved state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks. ICG-I reduces MAE from 0.041 (best baseline) to 0.020 on standard instances and achieves 0.048 on N=500 frustrated spin glasses where BP diverges entirely.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICG-I，一种自回归图Transformer，通过模拟带张量压缩的变量消除过程实现离散图模型上的精确且可扩展的边际推断，在标准实例和受阻自旋玻璃问题上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有离散图模型边际推断方法在精确性与可扩展性之间存在矛盾：精确算法在高树宽图上不可行，而迭代近似方法在受阻拓扑上缺乏收敛保证。作者认为这种二分法源于错误归纳偏置——迭代方法放弃了变量消除的顺序结构。
AI.method: 提出ICG-I，包含：(1) 自回归图Transformer模拟变量消除过程；(2) 张量训练（Tensor-Train）压缩中间因子；(3) Dirichlet输出层；(4) 加权共形预测（WCP）提供校准的、分布自由的覆盖保证。理论上证明了TT压缩误差在自回归链中线性传播，Dirichlet-Multinomial损失是适当评分规则，WCP在估计密度比下保持覆盖保证且退化可量化。
AI.result: 在标准实例上MAE从0.041降至0.020；在N=500受阻自旋玻璃上MAE达0.048（BP完全发散），全面超越所有基线方法达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: ICG-I通过恢复变量消除的顺序结构，弥合了离散图模型边际推断中精确性与可扩展性之间的鸿沟，同时提供了理论上的误差传播保证和覆盖保证。

title: Take a Peek: Efficient Encoder Adaptation for Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation via LoRA
summary: Few-shot semantic segmentation (FSS) aims to segment novel classes in query images using only a small annotated support set. While prior research has mainly focused on improving decoders, the encoder's limited ability to extract meaningful features for unseen classes remains a key bottleneck. In this work, we introduce \textit{Take a Peek} (TaP), a simple yet effective method that enhances encoder adaptability for both FSS and cross-domain FSS \rev{by inducing a lightweight \textit{feature-space shift} conditioned on the support set}. TaP leverages Low-Rank Adaptation to fine-tune the encoder on the support set with minimal computational overhead, enabling fast adaptation to novel classes while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our method is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing FSS pipelines. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks--including COCO $20^i$, Pascal $5^i$, and cross-domain datasets such as DeepGlobe, ISIC, and Chest X-ray--demonstrate that TaP consistently improves segmentation performance across diverse models and shot settings. Notably, TaP delivers significant gains in complex multi-class scenarios, highlighting its practical effectiveness in realistic settings. A rank sensitivity analysis also shows that strong performance can be achieved even with low-rank adaptations, thereby ensuring computational efficiency. By addressing a critical limitation in FSS--the encoder's generalization to novel classes--TaP paves the way toward more robust, efficient, and generalizable segmentation systems. The code is available at https://github.com/pasqualedem/TakeAPeek.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Take a Peek (TaP)方法，通过基于支持集条件诱导轻量级特征空间偏移，利用低秩适应(LoRA)微调编码器，以最小计算开销增强编码器对新颖类别的适应性，解决少样本语义分割中编码器泛化能力不足的问题。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，TaP能一致提升分割性能，尤其在复杂多类场景下效果显著。
AI.motivation: 现有FSS研究主要关注改进解码器，但编码器对未见类别提取有意义特征的能力有限，成为关键瓶颈。本文旨在增强编码器对新颖类别的适应性，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: TaP利用低秩适应(LoRA)在支持集上微调编码器，诱导轻量级特征空间偏移，实现快速适应新颖类别且计算开销极小，方法为模型无关，可无缝集成到现有FSS流程。
AI.result: 在COCO 20^i、Pascal 5^i以及DeepGlobe、ISIC、Chest X-ray等跨域数据集上的实验表明，TaP在不同模型和shot设置下均一致提升分割性能，在复杂多类场景中提升尤为显著。秩敏感性分析显示低秩适应即可取得强性能。
AI.conclusion: TaP通过解决编码器对新颖类别的泛化这一关键限制，为构建更鲁棒、高效和可泛化的分割系统铺平了道路。

title: Graph Cascades: Contagion-Based Mesoscopic Rewiring for Structure-Aware Graph Machine Learning
summary: We introduce Graph Cascades, a mesoscopic rewiring strategy for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Graph Transformers (GTs) that captures intermediate-scale graph structure beyond purely local edges or fully global attention. Using contagion-based diffusion processes, Graph Cascades constructs, in O(|V|+|E|) time, an auxiliary graph where node pairs supported by repeated multi-hop reinforcement are promoted to direct neighbors. We theoretically characterize when reinforcement-based rewiring helps: sufficient conditions under which reinforcement-based edge selection is more label-aligned than direct adjacency, an SBM witness in which two-hop reinforcement is perfectly homophilic, and a formalization of mesoscopic connectivity via graph effective resistance. Empirically, across node-classification benchmarks, Graph Cascades improves multiple GNN and sparse-GT backbones, with the most reliable gains observed on heterophilic and moderate- to high-degree homophilic graphs. The theoretical conditions also identify regimes where mesoscopic rewiring is unlikely to be beneficial -- low-degree regular graphs and graphs with structural bottlenecks -- and these predictions match the observed failures. We additionally observe tight correlations between performance and structural properties in the rewired graphs.

AI.tldr: Graph Cascades提出了一种基于传播过程的介观重连策略，通过O(|V|+|E|)时间构建辅助图，将多跳强化支持的节点对提升为直接邻居，从而在GNN和GT中捕获介于局部边和全局注意力之间的中尺度结构。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN和GT在捕获图结构时存在极端：局部邻域聚合（GNN）无法感知远距离信息，全局注意力（GT）计算成本高且忽略中间结构。亟需一种能捕获介观尺度（介于局部与全局之间）图结构的高效重连策略。
AI.method: 基于传染扩散过程，在O(|V|+|E|)时间内构建辅助图，将具有多跳重复强化支持的节点对提升为直接邻居。理论上给出了强化重连有益的条件：强化边选择比直接邻接更标签对齐的充分条件、两跳强化完全同质性的SBM实例、以及通过图有效电阻形式化介观连通性。
AI.result: 在节点分类基准上，Graph Cascades提升了多种GNN和稀疏GT骨干网络性能，在同质性较低和中高程度的同质图上增益最可靠。理论条件识别出低度正则图和结构瓶颈图等不太受益的场景，与观测到的失败案例一致。重连图的性能与结构性质之间存在紧密相关性。
AI.conclusion: Graph Cascades作为一种高效的介观重连策略，能够增强GNN和GT在节点分类任务上的表现，其理论框架可预测适用场景，为图神经网络中的结构学习提供了新的视角。

title: ViewMask-1-to-3: Multi-View Consistent Image Generation via Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Motivated by discrete diffusion's success in language-vision modeling, we explore its potential for multi-view generation, a task dominated by continuous approaches. We introduce ViewMask-1-to-3, formulating multi-view generation as a discrete sequence modeling problem where each viewpoint is represented as visual tokens from MAGVIT-v2. Through discrete diffusion via masked token prediction, our approach enables progressive multi-view generation via iterative token unmasking, unifying language and vision in a shared token space. Importantly, simple random masking combined with self-attention naturally encourages cross-view consistency without specialized architectures or 3D geometric priors. Our method outperforms the baseline on the GSO and 3D-FUTURE benchmarks, ranking first on average across standard image metrics, and achieving a 10.6% higher IoU than continuous diffusion models on 3D-FUTURE. Furthermore, the proposed framework can be naturally extended to support text-to-image generation and multimodal understanding, highlighting its potential toward a more unified paradigm for multimodal understanding and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViewMask-1-to-3，将多视图生成建模为离散序列问题，使用MAGVIT-v2视觉标记和掩码标记预测的离散扩散方法，通过随机掩码和自注意力实现跨视图一致性，无需专门架构或3D几何先验，在GSO和3D-FUTURE基准上优于基线，IoU比连续扩散模型高10.6%，并支持扩展到文本到图像生成和多模态理解。
AI.motivation: 探索离散扩散在语言-视觉建模中的成功经验是否能应用于多视图生成领域，该领域目前主要由连续方法主导。
AI.method: 将多视图生成建模为离散序列建模问题，每个视角用MAGVIT-v2表示为视觉标记，通过掩码标记预测的离散扩散机制，利用迭代式token去掩码逐步生成多视图，采用简单随机掩码结合自注意力实现跨视图一致性。
AI.result: 在GSO和3D-FUTURE基准上各项标准图像指标平均排名第一，在3D-FUTURE上IoU比连续扩散模型高10.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需专门架构或3D几何先验即可实现跨视图一致性，可自然扩展到文本到图像生成和多模态理解，为统一多模态理解与生成范式提供了新方向。

title: FLAGG: Flexible Autoregressive Graph Generation
comment: Accepted for publication at JMLR, currently in press
summary: The Deep Graph Generation's panorama spans two extremes: one-shot and sequential models. The former generates nodes and edges jointly, while the latter samples them autoregressively. Each method performs better in different graph domains depending on size and topology, but neither is applicable to all graph categories. For instance, one-shot methods struggle with generating large graphs, while sequential methods underperform on smaller graphs. A possible way to overcome these limitations is to flexibly combine the two methods in a unique system. In this work, we propose the FLAGG (Flexible Autoregressive Graph Generation) framework, which sequentially generates portions of graphs with one-shot models. FLAGG can apply any one-shot model to make it autoregressive, allowing flexibility in choosing the sequential policy. This policy is specified through a stochastic node removal process, which an Insertion Model learns to reverse. We evaluate FLAGG with the DiGress one-shot model on several data sets of different graph sizes and domains. We show that the approach outperforms both one-shot and autoregressive baselines in terms of sampling quality.

AI.tldr: FLAGG框架通过将一次性图生成模型与自回归策略结合，实现了对任意规模和图类型的高质量灵活图生成。
AI.motivation: 一次性生成和自回归生成两种图生成方法各有优劣：前者擅长小图，后者擅长大规模图，但两者均无法适用于所有图类型。作者旨在通过灵活组合两种方法，克服各自的局限性。
AI.method: 提出FLAGG框架，通过随机节点移除过程定义顺序策略，利用插入模型学习反转该过程，使任意一次性模型具备自回归能力，从而分块顺序生成图。
AI.result: 在多个不同规模和领域的图数据集上，使用DiGress一次性模型作为基座，FLAGG在采样质量上优于一次性生成和自回归生成的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FLAGG成功融合了一次性和自回归方法的优势，为不同图类型提供了一种统一的、高质量生成方案。

title: Improving Semantic Uncertainty Quantification in LVLMs with Semantic Gaussian Processes
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often produce plausible but unreliable outputs, making robust uncertainty estimation essential. Recent work on semantic uncertainty estimates relies on external models to cluster multiple sampled responses and measure their semantic consistency. However, these clustering methods are often fragile, highly sensitive to minor phrasing variations, and can incorrectly group or separate semantically similar answers, leading to unreliable uncertainty estimates. We propose Semantic Gaussian Process Uncertainty (SGPU), a Bayesian framework that quantifies semantic uncertainty by analyzing the geometric structure of answer embeddings, avoiding brittle clustering. SGPU maps generated answers into a dense semantic space, computes the Gram matrix of their embeddings, and summarizes their semantic configuration via the eigenspectrum. This spectral representation is then fed into a Gaussian Process Classifier that learns to map patterns of semantic consistency to predictive uncertainty, and that can be applied in both black-box and white-box settings. Across six LLMs and LVLMs on eight datasets spanning VQA, image classification, and textual QA, SGPU consistently achieves state-of-the-art calibration (ECE) and discriminative (AUROC, AUARC) performance. We further show that SGPU transfers across models and modalities, indicating that its spectral representation captures general patterns of semantic uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出语义高斯过程不确定性（SGPU）框架，通过分析答案嵌入的几何结构（谱表示）来量化LVLM的语义不确定性，避免脆弱的聚类方法，在多个模型和数据集上达到SOTA校准与判别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语义不确定性的方法依赖外部模型对多个采样响应进行聚类并衡量语义一致性，但聚类方法脆弱，对细微措辞变化高度敏感，易错误分组或分离语义相似的答案，导致不确定性估计不可靠。
AI.method: 将生成答案映射到密集语义空间，计算嵌入的Gram矩阵，通过特征谱总结语义配置；将谱表示输入高斯过程分类器，学习从语义一致性模式到预测不确定性的映射；支持黑盒和白盒两种设置。
AI.result: 在6个LLM/LVLM、8个数据集（涵盖VQA、图像分类、文本QA）上，校准性能（ECE）和判别性能（AUROC、AUARC）均达SOTA；谱表示可跨模型和模态迁移。
AI.conclusion: SGPU通过几何结构的谱分析替代脆弱的聚类方法，提供更可靠、可迁移的语义不确定性估计框架。

title: RIDE: An Open Dataset and Benchmark for Train Delay Prediction
summary: Train delay prediction is an important problem for both passengers and railway operators, yet progress in the field remains difficult to assess due to the lack of standardized datasets, prediction targets, and evaluation protocols. To address this gap, we introduce RIDE, an open dataset and benchmark for train delay prediction built at nationwide scale over the Belgian railway network. RIDE covers 94.5M train events, 3.6M journeys, and 35.7M weather records from 2023 to 2025. It is organized as a layered data pipeline from raw railway and weather sources to two public releases: a reusable intermediate relational dataset and model-ready benchmark datasets. The benchmark standardizes the prediction task and the training and testing data. It also provides a unified evaluation protocol that supports direct comparison across models. Using this framework, we provide the first comprehensive comparative evaluation of non-learning, statistical learning, and deep learning models. We show that learning-based methods clearly outperform non-learning models, with graph neural networks achieving the best mean performance, while the strongest learning-based models remain relatively close to one another. Beyond aggregate mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE), the framework also provides breakdowns by prediction horizon and delay change, enabling more detailed analysis of model behavior across forecasting regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RIDE，一个覆盖比利时全国铁路网络的大规模开放数据集和基准测试平台，包含9450万条铁路事件、360万次旅程和3570万条天气记录（2023-2025年）。该基准标准化了预测任务、训练/测试数据和评估协议，并首次对非学习、统计学习和深度学习方法进行了全面比较评估，结果表明基于学习的方法显著优于非学习方法，其中图神经网络取得了最佳平均性能。
AI.motivation: 列车延误预测对乘客和铁路运营商都至关重要，但由于缺乏标准化的数据集、预测目标和评估协议，该领域的进展难以评估。作者旨在通过构建统一的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建了从原始铁路和天气数据源到两个公开版本（可复用中间关系数据集和模型就绪基准数据集）的分层数据管道。基准标准化了预测任务、训练/测试数据，并提供了统一的评估协议以支持跨模型直接比较。
AI.result: 基于学习的方法显著优于非学习方法；图神经网络取得最佳平均性能，但最强学习模型之间性能差距较小。除MAE和RMSE外，还按预测时域和延误变化提供了性能分解。
AI.conclusion: RIDE为列车延误预测提供了标准化基准，推动了该领域的可复现研究和公平比较。学习型方法（特别是GNN）表现最佳，但各先进模型间差距不大，暗示仍有提升空间。

title: Learning What Not to Impute: An Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Framework for Meaningful Missingness
summary: Missing value imputation is a fundamental task in machine learning, with most existing methods assuming that all missing entries correspond to unobserved regular values. In many real-world datasets, however, missingness may arise from two distinct sources: some entries are meaningfully missing (intrinsically absent and semantically valid), while others are missing due to the observation process and should be imputed. We formalize this distinction as a selective imputation problem, where the goal is to jointly infer which missing entries should be preserved and which should be recovered. To address this challenge, we propose Diff-Joint, a diffusion-based framework that jointly models tabular data together with a latent missingness mask. The method alternates between conditional sampling and uncertainty-aware aggregation to iteratively refine both imputed values and missingness labels. Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that Diff-Joint effectively identifies meaningfully missing entries while achieving competitive imputation accuracy and improved downstream task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Diff-Joint，一个基于扩散模型的框架，用于解决选择性插补问题——即区分“有意义缺失”和“需插补缺失”，并同时对缺失数据进行插补和缺失类型识别。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失值插补方法假设所有缺失条目都是未观测到的常规值，但现实数据中缺失可能源于两种不同来源：有意义的缺失（内在不存在且语义有效）和观测过程导致的缺失（应被插补）。现有方法未能区分这两种缺失类型。
AI.method: 提出Diff-Joint框架，基于扩散模型联合建模表格数据与潜在缺失掩码。通过交替执行条件采样和不确定性感知聚合，迭代优化插补值和缺失标签。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，Diff-Joint能有效识别有意义缺失的条目，同时实现有竞争力的插补精度，并提高下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 区分缺失类型并进行选择性插补是可行的，Diff-Joint为实际场景中混合缺失类型的数据处理提供了有效方案。

title: T2AV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
comment: 41 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026
summary: Text-to-Audio-Video (T2AV) generation aims to synthesize temporally coherent video and semantically synchronized audio from natural language, yet its evaluation remains fragmented, often relying on unimodal metrics or narrowly scoped benchmarks that fail to capture cross-modal alignment, instruction following, and perceptual realism under complex prompts. To address this limitation, we present T2AV-Compass, a unified benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of T2AV systems, consisting of 500 diverse and complex prompts constructed via a taxonomy-driven pipeline to ensure semantic richness and physical plausibility. Besides, T2AV-Compass introduces a dual-level evaluation framework that integrates objective signal-level metrics for video quality, audio quality, and cross-modal alignment with a subjective MLLM-as-a-Judge protocol for instruction following and realism assessment. Extensive evaluation of 11 representative T2AVsystems reveals that even the strongest models fall substantially short of human-level realism and cross-modal consistency, with persistent failures in audio realism, fine-grained synchronization, instruction following, etc. These results indicate significant improvement room for future models and highlight the value of T2AV-Compass as a challenging and diagnostic testbed for advancing text-to-audio-video generation.

AI.tldr: T2AV-Compass是一个针对文本到音视频生成系统的统一基准，包含500个复杂提示和双层次评估框架，通过客观信号指标和主观MLLM评估，揭示了现有模型在跨模态对齐、指令遵循和感知真实性方面的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有T2AV评估方法碎片化，多依赖单模态指标或狭隘基准，无法捕捉跨模态对齐、指令遵循和复杂提示下的感知真实性，亟需统一的综合评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含500个多样化复杂提示的基准（通过分类学驱动管线保证语义丰富性和物理合理性），并设计了双层次评估框架：客观信号级指标（视频质量、音频质量、跨模态对齐）和主观MLLM-as-a-Judge协议（指令遵循与真实性评估）。
AI.result: 评估11个代表性T2AV系统后发现，最强模型在人类级真实感和跨模态一致性上仍显著不足，在音频真实感、细粒度同步、指令遵循等方面持续失败。
AI.conclusion: 当前T2AV模型存在巨大改进空间，T2AV-Compass可作为推动文本到音视频生成领域发展的挑战性诊断测试平台。

title: Learning Association via Track-Detection Matching for Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Multi-object tracking aims to maintain object identities over time by associating detections across video frames. Two dominant paradigms exist in literature: tracking-by-detection methods, which are computationally efficient but rely on handcrafted association heuristics, and end-to-end approaches, which learn association from data at the cost of higher computational complexity. We propose Track-Detection Link Prediction (TDLP), a tracking-by-detection method that performs per-frame association via link prediction between tracks and detections, i.e., by predicting the correct continuation of each track at every frame. TDLP is architecturally designed primarily for geometric features such as bounding boxes, while optionally incorporating additional cues, including pose and appearance. Unlike heuristic-based methods, TDLP learns association directly from data without handcrafted rules, while remaining modular and computationally efficient compared to end-to-end trackers. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that TDLP consistently surpasses state-of-the-art performance across both tracking-by-detection and end-to-end methods. Finally, we provide a detailed analysis comparing link prediction with metric learning-based association and show that link prediction is more effective, particularly when handling heterogeneous features such as detection bounding boxes. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/Robotmurlock/TDLP}{https://github.com/Robotmurlock/TDLP}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TDLP，一种基于链接预测的跟踪-检测方法，通过学习数据中的关联规则而非手工设计的启发式方法，在保持计算效率的同时，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有目标跟踪方法存在两种范式：跟踪-检测方法计算高效但依赖手工设计的关联启发式规则；端到端方法可从数据中学习关联但计算复杂度过高。作者希望结合两者优势，实现既无需手工规则、又保持计算效率的跟踪方法。
AI.method: 提出Track-Detection Link Prediction (TDLP)，将每帧的关联问题建模为轨迹与检测之间的链接预测任务，即预测每条轨迹在当前帧的正确延续。架构主要基于几何特征（如边界框），可选融合姿态、外观等额外线索。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TDLP在跟踪-检测方法和端到端方法两大类中都持续超越当前最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 链接预测相比度量学习在关联任务中更有效，尤其在处理异构特征（如检测边界框）时优势明显。代码已开源。

title: RePercENT: Scaling Disentangled Representation Learning Beyond Two Modalities
summary: To leverage the full potential of multimodal data, we need representations that go beyond the state-of-the-art alignment and fusion approaches and exploit all cross-modal interactions without sacrificing modality-specific information. Learning disentangled representations is a principled way to identify these underlying shared and unique factors that are hidden in observational data. However, while multimodal disentanglement is a compelling paradigm, existing methods are largely confined to the two-modality regime due to its inherent scalability bottleneck. To address this, we propose RePercENT, a self-supervised framework designed to surpass these limitations and unlocks scalable pairwise disentanglement beyond two modalities. Through a multimodal `plug-and-play' architecture, our approach operates directly on pre-extracted embeddings, eliminating the need for extensive joint pre-training while making no assumptions regarding the underlying modalities or foundation model backbones. Moreover, we introduce a joint optimization objective for simultaneously deriving the shared and unique components, and provide formal theoretical guarantees that characterize the optimality of our solution. Across diverse modalities and tasks, RePercENT successfully recovers disentangled components while maintaining competitive performance and significantly reducing computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出RePercENT框架，通过可扩展的成对解耦方法实现多模态（超过两种模态）数据的共享与独特因子分离，无需联合预训练，并提供了理论最优性保证。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态解耦方法受限于两种模态的可扩展性瓶颈，无法充分利用多模态数据（超过两种模态）中的跨模态交互和模态特定信息。
AI.method: 1) 设计多模态"即插即用"架构，直接操作预提取的嵌入；2) 提出联合优化目标，同步推导共享与独特成分；3) 提供形式化理论保证解的最优性。
AI.result: 在多种模态和任务上，RePercENT成功恢复了解耦成分，保持竞争性能的同时显著降低了计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: RePercENT突破了多模态解耦的 scalability 瓶颈，为超过两种模态的成对解耦提供了高效、通用的解决方案。

title: SharpNet: Enhancing MLPs to Represent Functions with Controlled Non-differentiability
summary: Multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) are a standard tool for learning and function approximation, but they inherently produce globally smooth outputs. Consequently, they struggle to represent functions that are continuous yet intentionally non-differentiable (i.e., functions with prescribed $C^0$ sharp features) without ad hoc post-processing. We present SharpNet, a modified MLP architecture that encodes user-specified sharp features by augmenting the network with an auxiliary feature function defined as the solution to Poisson's equation with jump Neumann boundary conditions. This feature function is evaluated via an efficient local integral and is fully differentiable with respect to the feature locations, allowing us to jointly optimize both the feature locations and the MLP parameters to recover the target function or geometry. This construction provides precise control over where non-differentiability occurs, enforcing the desired $C^0$ behavior at feature locations while preserving smoothness elsewhere. We validate SharpNet on 2D problems and 3D CAD reconstruction, and compare it with several state-of-the-art baselines. In both settings, SharpNet accurately recovers sharp edges and corners while remaining smooth away from them, whereas existing methods tend to blur gradient discontinuities. Qualitative and quantitative results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Our project page, code and models are publicly available at https://sharpnettech.github.io.

AI.tldr: SharpNet通过在MLP中引入基于泊松方程跳跃Neumann边界条件的辅助特征函数，实现了对尖锐特征（C⁰不连续性）的精确编码与优化，在保持全局光滑性的同时精准恢复尖锐边缘和角点。
AI.motivation: 标准MLP本质产生全局光滑输出，难以表示连续但故意非可微的函数（即具有C⁰尖锐特征），现有方法要么模糊梯度不连续性，要么需要ad hoc后处理。
AI.method: 1) 修改MLP架构，添加基于泊松方程（带跳跃Neumann边界条件）求解的辅助特征函数；2) 特征函数通过高效局部积分计算，且对特征位置完全可微；3) 联合优化特征位置与MLP参数。
AI.result: 在2D问题和3D CAD重建中，SharpNet准确恢复尖锐边缘和角点，同时在远离特征处保持光滑；在定性和定量结果上均优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SharpNet通过可微的尖锐特征编码机制，实现了对函数C⁰不连续位置的精确控制，为需要保留尖锐几何特征的神经网络表示提供了有效方案。

title: Graph Set Transformer
summary: We introduce the Graph Set Transformer (GST), a neural network architecture for learning on sets of graphs, designed for tasks in which per-element predictions depend on set-wide context as well as local structure. Existing architectures, including DeepSets and SetTransformer, require pre-encoded graph embeddings from a separate GNN, creating a bottleneck between feature extraction and set-level contextualisation. In contrast, GST interleaves node-level feature propagation and cross-graph contextual modelling at every layer, fusing the two levels of information through a gating mechanism. We evaluate GST on a controlled synthetic suite designed to isolate set-conditional structural reasoning and on three real-data benchmarks spanning per-atom reaction-centre identification, reaction yield prediction, and image classification. Under matched parameter budgets, GST performs better than the baselines across these settings. An architectural ablation strongly suggests that the interleaving of local and set context contributes substantially to this advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph Set Transformer (GST)，一种用于图集合学习的神经网络架构。与需要预编码图嵌入的现有方法不同，GST在每一层交织进行节点级特征传播和跨图上下文建模，并通过门控机制融合两类信息。在合成套件和三个真实基准上，GST在相同参数预算下优于基线方法，消融实验表明局部与集合上下文的交织是性能提升的关键。
AI.motivation: 现有架构（如DeepSets、SetTransformer）需要先用单独的GNN预编码图嵌入，造成特征提取与集合级上下文建模之间的瓶颈，无法有效融合局部结构和集合上下文信息。
AI.method: GST在每一层同时进行节点级特征传播（局部）和跨图上下文建模（集合），通过门控机制融合这两类信息，实现了局部与全局信息的深度交互。
AI.result: 在控制合成套件和三个真实基准（逐原子反应中心识别、反应产率预测、图像分类）上，GST在匹配参数预算下均优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 局部特征传播与集合上下文建模的交织是GST性能优势的关键来源，消融实验验证了这一设计的有效性。

title: Towards Efficient and Evidence-grounded Mobility Prediction with LLM-Driven Agent
summary: Individual-level mobility prediction is central to urban simulation, transportation planning, and policy analysis. Supervised sequence models achieve strong accuracy but require task-specific training and offer limited decision-level transparency. Recent LLM-based methods improve interpretability, yet mostly rely on static prompts and single-pass inference, limiting their ability to seek additional evidence when mobility signals are weak or conflicting. We propose \method{}, a training-free LLM-driven agent framework that formulates next-location prediction as adaptive evidence-controlled decision making. \method{} resolves routine cases through a fast path based on historical regularity, while ambiguous cases trigger iterative tool use over recent trajectories, historical behavior, stay-move likelihood, and geographical evidence. Across three mobility datasets, AgentMob achieves the strongest overall performance among training-free LLM-based methods, with GPT-5.4 reaching 71.42\% Acc@1 on BW, 33.14\% on YJMob100K, and 33.50\% on Shanghai ISP. On BW non-fast-path cases, the LLM controller improves Acc@1 from 30.65\% to 48.62\% over a same-tool statistical baseline, showing that its main benefit lies in resolving ambiguous predictions through adaptive evidence gathering. Our code is available at https://github.com/Unknown-zoo/AgentMob.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentMob，一个无需训练、基于LLM的智能体框架，将下一位置预测建模为自适应证据控制的决策过程。该框架通过快速路径处理常规情况，对模糊情况则通过迭代工具调用收集多种证据进行推理。在三个移动数据集上，AgentMob在无训练LLM方法中表现最佳，且在模糊案例中准确率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有监督序列模型预测准确但缺乏决策透明度，而基于LLM的方法虽然可解释性更好，但大多依赖静态提示和单次推理，无法在移动信号弱或冲突时寻求额外证据。
AI.method: 提出AgentMob框架，包含两条路径：快速路径基于历史规律处理常规情况；模糊路径触发迭代工具调用，收集近期轨迹、历史行为、停留-移动可能性及地理证据，由LLM控制器进行自适应决策。
AI.result: 在三个移动数据集上，AgentMob在无训练LLM方法中表现最佳。GPT-5.4在BW上达到71.42% Acc@1，YJMob100K上33.14%，Shanghai ISP上33.50%。在BW非快速路径案例中，LLM控制器将Acc@1从30.65%提升至48.62%。
AI.conclusion: AgentMob通过自适应证据收集机制，在无需训练的情况下显著提升了下一位点预测的准确性和可解释性，尤其擅长解决模糊预测问题。

title: Shifting the Breaking Point of Flow Matching for Multi-Instance Editing
summary: Flow matching models have recently emerged as an efficient alternative to diffusion, especially for text-guided image generation and editing, offering faster inference through continuous-time dynamics. However, existing flow-based editors predominantly support global or single-instruction edits and struggle with multi-instance scenarios, where multiple parts of a reference input must be edited independently without semantic interference. We identify this limitation as a consequence of globally conditioned velocity fields and joint attention mechanisms, which entangle concurrent edits. To address this issue, we introduce Instance-Disentangled Attention, a mechanism that partitions joint attention operations, enforcing binding between instance-specific textual instructions and spatial regions during velocity field estimation. We evaluate our approach on both natural image editing and a newly introduced benchmark of text-dense infographics with region-level editing instructions. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach promotes edit disentanglement and locality while preserving global output coherence, enabling single-pass, instance-level editing.

AI.tldr: 提出实例解耦注意力机制（Instance-Disentangled Attention），通过分区联合注意力操作，解决流匹配模型在多实例图像编辑中的语义纠缠问题，实现单次前向传播的独立实例级编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配编辑器主要支持全局或单指令编辑，在多实例场景下，由于全局条件速度场和联合注意力机制导致并发编辑相互纠缠，无法对参考输入的多个部分进行独立编辑。
AI.method: 提出实例解耦注意力机制（Instance-Disentangled Attention），将联合注意力操作分区，在速度场估计过程中强制实例特定的文本指令与对应空间区域之间建立绑定关系。
AI.result: 在自然图像编辑和新引入的文本密集型信息图区域级编辑基准上，该方法提升了编辑解耦性和局部性，同时保持全局输出一致性，实现了单次前向传播的实例级编辑。
AI.conclusion: 实例解耦注意力机制有效解决了流匹配模型在多实例图像编辑中的语义干扰问题，为高效、解耦的实例级编辑提供了新方案。

title: Deep Embedded Multiplicative DMD for Algebra-Preserving Koopman Learning
summary: Koopman theory turns nonlinear dynamics into a linear spectral problem. In computation, however, everything depends on a hard finite-dimensional choice: the observables must be expressive, nearly invariant under the dynamics, and, ideally, compatible with composition. Deep Koopman methods learn flexible coordinates, whereas structure-preserving methods enforce operator identities on fixed dictionaries. We combine these ideas by introducing Deep Embedded Multiplicative Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DeepMDMD), a method that learns a latent space and a partition of it, while enforcing the Koopman product rule as an exact algebraic constraint. Training alternates between an exact multiplicative operator update and a differentiable latent-clustering step that promotes Koopman closure. The result is a finite transition map on learned latent cells. Its nonzero spectrum lies on the unit circle, its dictionary is shaped by the dynamics rather than by ambient geometry, and forecasts are made in latent coordinates before being decoded to physical space. Across Hamiltonian, chaotic, and fluid examples, DeepMDMD learns dictionaries that are far more compact and dynamically coherent than those produced by geometric MDMD partitions. It reduces spectral pollution, reveals richer continuous-spectrum structure, and gives stable forecasts under severe noise. In high-dimensional flows, including a 158,624-dimensional cylinder wake and a noisy $Re=20,000$ lid-driven cavity, it preserves coherent structures and long-time spectral statistics where state-space MDMD fails. These results suggest a practical rule for Koopman learning: learn the coordinates, constrain the algebra.

AI.tldr: DeepMDMD通过结合深度学习和代数约束，在潜在空间中学习动态一致的分区，并强制满足Koopman乘积规则，从而得到紧凑、谱污染少且能稳定预测的有限维转移映射。
AI.motivation: 深度Koopman方法虽能学习灵活坐标，但缺乏结构约束；而结构保持方法虽能强制执行算子恒等式，但依赖固定的有限字典。二者未能结合各自的优势。
AI.method: 提出Deep Embedded Multiplicative Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DeepMDMD)，它在潜在空间中同时学习表示和分区，通过交替进行精确乘法算子更新和可微的潜在聚类步骤，将Koopman乘法规则作为精确代数约束强制执行。
AI.result: 在哈密顿、混沌和流体算例中，DeepMDMD学习到的字典比几何MDMD分区更紧凑且动态一致，减少了谱污染，揭示了更丰富的连续谱结构，并在严重噪声下保持稳定预测。在高维流场（如158,624维圆柱绕流和$Re=20,000$的方腔驱动流）中，它保持了相干结构和长时间谱统计，而状态空间MDMD失败。
AI.conclusion: Koopman学习的实用原则是：学习坐标，约束代数。DeepMDMD验证了这一原则的有效性。

title: Generating Financial Time Series by Matching Random Convolutional Features
summary: Generating realistic financial time series is challenging as training data is often limited to a single historical path. With such scarce data, overfitting is hard to avoid, especially under adversarial training where a trained discriminator can memorize the training samples. To mitigate this, recent approaches train generators to minimize the discrepancy between untrained feature representations of real and generated time series. In these works, the feature maps are based on path signatures, which can fail to capture relevant time series properties at tractable truncation depths. In this work, we instead train generators by matching random convolutional features of real and generated time series. Existing random convolutional feature maps, such as Rocket and Hydra, have been shown to provide informative representations of real-world time series, but cannot supervise generative models because they are non-differentiable. We introduce SOCK (SOft Competing Kernels), a fully differentiable random convolutional feature map, suited to train generative time series models. We show that generators trained by matching random SOCK features consistently outperform signature and diffusion baselines across a wide range of small-sample financial datasets. We further demonstrate SOCK's expressiveness on two-sample hypothesis testing and time series classification tasks, where SOCK matches or outperforms existing unsupervised feature maps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SOCK（SOft Competing Kernels），一种完全可微的随机卷积特征映射方法，用于解决金融时间序列生成中因数据稀缺导致的过拟合问题。通过匹配真实与生成时间序列的随机卷积特征来训练生成器，在少量金融数据集上优于签名和扩散基线方法，并在双样本假设检验和时间序列分类任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 生成逼真的金融时间序列极具挑战性，因为训练数据通常只包含单一历史路径，数据极度稀缺导致对抗训练中判别器容易记忆训练样本而过拟合。现有基于路径签名的方法在可截断深度下无法捕获相关时间序列属性。
AI.method: 提出SOCK（SOft Competing Kernels），一种完全可微的随机卷积特征映射。它通过匹配真实与生成时间序列的随机卷积特征来训练生成器，解决了现有随机卷积特征映射（如Rocket、Hydra）因不可微而无法监督生成模型的问题。
AI.result: 在多种小样本金融数据集上，基于SOCK特征匹配训练的生成器一致优于签名和扩散基线方法。在双样本假设检验和时间序列分类任务中，SOCK匹配或超越现有无监督特征映射的性能。
AI.conclusion: SOCK作为一种完全可微的随机卷积特征映射，有效解决了金融时间序列生成中的数据稀缺和过拟合问题，同时具备良好的表达能力和可迁移性，在生成、分类和假设检验等多个任务上表现优异。

title: TrajTok: Learning Trajectory Tokens enables better Video Understanding
summary: Tokenization in video models, typically through patchification, generates an excessive and redundant number of tokens. This severely limits video efficiency and scalability. While recent trajectory-based tokenizers offer a promising solution by decoupling video duration from token count, they rely on complex external segmentation and tracking pipelines that are slow and task-agnostic. We propose TrajTok, an end-to-end video tokenizer module that is fully integrated and co-trained with video models for a downstream objective, dynamically adapting its token granularity to semantic complexity, independent of video duration. TrajTok contains a unified segmenter that performs implicit clustering over pixels in both space and time to directly produce object trajectories in a single forward pass. By prioritizing downstream adaptability over pixel-perfect segmentation fidelity, TrajTok is lightweight and efficient, yet empirically improves video understanding performance. With TrajTok, we implement a video CLIP model trained from scratch (TrajViT2). It achieves the best accuracy at scale across both classification and retrieval benchmarks, while maintaining efficiency comparable to the best token-merging methods. TrajTok also proves to be a versatile component beyond its role as a tokenizer. We show that it can be seamlessly integrated as either a probing head for pretrained visual features (TrajAdapter) or an alignment connector in vision-language models (TrajVLM) with especially strong performance in long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: TrajTok是一种端到端视频分词器模块，通过隐式时空聚类生成对象轨迹，将token数量与视频时长解耦，动态适应语义复杂度，在提升视频理解性能的同时保持高效性，并可灵活集成到多种视频模型中。
AI.motivation: 现有视频模型的patch化分词方式会产生大量冗余token，严重限制视频处理的效率与可扩展性。基于轨迹的分词器虽有前景，但依赖复杂的外部分割和跟踪流程，速度慢且与任务无关。
AI.method: 提出TrajTok端到端分词器模块，包含统一分割器，通过在空间和时间维度上对像素进行隐式聚类，单次前向传播直接生成对象轨迹。与视频模型联合训练，动态调整token粒度以适应语义复杂度。
AI.result: 基于TrajTok的TrajViT2模型在分类和检索基准测试中均达到最佳精度，效率与最优token合并方法相当；TrajAdapter和TrajVLM在长视频推理任务中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: TrajTok是一种轻量高效且通用的视频分词组件，能够灵活集成多种视频模型架构（作为分词器、探针头或对齐连接器），显著提升视频理解性能，尤其在长视频推理中表现优异。

title: BBOmix: A Tabular Benchmark for Hyperparameter Optimization of Unsupervised Biological Representation Learning
summary: The rapid advancement of high-throughput sequencing has led to large, high-dimensional omics datasets. Deep unsupervised learning architectures, particularly Autoencoders (AEs), are increasingly used for dimensionality reduction and representation learning in this domain. However, AEs are highly sensitive to architectural choices and hyperparameters, and unsupervised optimization typically relies on reconstruction loss, which may be a poor proxy for downstream utility. Exhaustive hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is computationally expensive, leading researchers to frequently rely on suboptimal default configurations. To democratize access to large-scale unsupervised HPO research, we introduce $\textbf{BBOmix}$, the first open-source tabular benchmark for unsupervised representation learning on real-world biological data. Our benchmark includes 105,000 evaluations across four AE architectures and seven multi-omics modalities from the TCGA and SCHC datasets. We quantify the correlation between reconstruction loss and downstream task performance and provide an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art single-fidelity, multi-fidelity, and transfer learning HPO methods, establishing a rigorous baseline for future research in unsupervised biological representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BBOmix，第一个面向生物数据无监督表示学习的开源表格基准，包含105,000次评估、四种自编码器架构和七种多组学模态，系统评估了无监督HPO方法中重构损失与下游任务性能的相关性。
AI.motivation: 高维组学数据的无监督表示学习中，自编码器对超参数高度敏感，但穷举HPO计算成本过高，研究人员常使用次优默认配置。缺乏标准化的基准来推动无监督HPO研究。
AI.method: 构建BBOmix基准，包含105,000次超参数评估，覆盖四种AE架构和七种TCGA/SCHC数据集的多组学模态，量化重构损失与下游任务性能的关联，评估单保真度、多保真度和迁移学习HPO方法。
AI.result: 建立了无监督生物学表示学习HPO的严谨基线，量化了重构损失在下游任务中的代理有效性。
AI.conclusion: BBOmix为无监督HPO研究提供了标准化基准，有助于降低计算成本并推动组学数据表示学习的可重复研究。

title: Plug-and-Play Diffusion Meets ADMM: Dual-Variable Coupling for Robust Medical Image Reconstruction
summary: Plug-and-Play diffusion prior (PnPDP) frameworks have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving imaging inverse problems by treating pretrained generative models as modular priors. However, we identify a critical flaw in prevailing PnP solvers (e.g., based on HQS or Proximal Gradient): they function as memoryless operators, updating estimates solely based on instantaneous gradients. This lack of historical tracking inevitably leads to non-vanishing steady-state bias, where the reconstruction fails to strictly satisfy physical measurements under heavy corruption. To resolve this, we propose Dual-Coupled PnP Diffusion (DC-PnPDP), which restores the classical dual variable to provide integral feedback, progressively enforce agreement between the data-consistency and prior. However, this rigorous geometric coupling introduces a secondary challenge: the accumulated dual residuals exhibit spectrally colored, structured artifacts that violate the Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) assumption of diffusion priors, causing severe hallucinations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Spectral Homogenization (SH), a frequency-domain adaptation mechanism that modulates these structured residuals into statistically compliant pseudo-AWGN inputs. This effectively aligns the solver's rigorous optimization trajectory with the denoiser's valid statistical manifold. Extensive experiments on CT and MRI reconstruction demonstrate that our approach resolves the bias-hallucination trade-off, achieving state-of-the-art fidelity with significantly accelerated convergence. The code is available at https://github.com/duchenhe/DC-PnPDP

AI.tldr: 本文提出DC-PnPDP框架，通过引入对偶变量提供积分反馈解决PnP扩散先验中的稳态偏差问题，并采用频谱均匀化机制将结构化残差转化为类高斯白噪声输入，从而在不产生幻觉的前提下实现高保真图像重建，在CT和MRI重建任务中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有PnP扩散先验求解器（如基于HQS或近端梯度的方案）本质上是无记忆算子，仅依赖瞬时梯度更新估计，缺乏历史追踪能力，导致在严重退化条件下存在非零稳态偏差，重建结果无法严格满足物理测量约束。
AI.method: 1) 提出DC-PnPDP框架，恢复经典对偶变量以提供积分反馈，渐进强制数据一致性与先验之间的对齐；2) 提出频谱均匀化机制，在频域中将累积的结构化对偶残差调制为统计上符合扩散先验假设的伪高斯白噪声输入，确保优化轨迹与去噪器的有效统计流形对齐。
AI.result: 在CT和MRI重建任务上，该方法解决了偏差-幻觉的权衡问题，实现了最先进的保真度且收敛速度显著加快。
AI.conclusion: 对偶变量的积分反馈结合频谱均匀化能够有效解决PnP扩散框架中稳态偏差与结构化伪影之间的根本矛盾，为物理约束下的逆问题求解提供了更可靠的范式。

title: Failed Reasoning Traces Tell You What Is Fixable (But Not by Reading Them)
summary: When post-trained language models fail on reasoning problems, the common test-time-scaling response is to spend more compute on additional attempts, and the failed traces play no further role. We argue this discards a crucial signal; some failures come from unlucky sampling, where more rollouts help, while others are structural and resist resampling regardless of budget. We propose that failed traces encode recoverability structure: the inference-time signature of which test-time interventions can rescue a given failure. Three problem-level trajectory features, derived from the structure of available interventions, recover this structure from the distributional signature of failed rollouts, not their text. They cluster failures into stable regimes, characterize the failure topography of different post-training methods ($84.3{\pm}4.3\%$ accuracy, $+20\%$ over a majority-class baseline), and support a training-free routing rule that lifts rescue by $+12.2\%$ on the deployment-relevant Steerable-Hard subset (failures where retry is insufficient and a bounded intervention is reachable). The features and the routing rule transfer across two cross-family probes. The same three features thus convert failed traces from discarded data into a diagnostic object, supporting test-time routing and post-training analysis without training-time or weight-space access.

AI.tldr: 论文提出失败轨迹（failed traces）中编码了可恢复性结构（recoverability structure），通过三个轨迹级特征从失败rollout的分布信号中提取该结构，无需训练或权重访问即可实现测试时路由（test-time routing）和后训练分析。
AI.motivation: 后训练语言模型在推理问题上失败时，通常丢弃失败轨迹并增加更多尝试，但这种方式忽略了失败轨迹中蕴含的信号：有些失败来自不幸运的采样（可通过更多rollout挽救），而另一些是结构性的（无论如何重采样都无法解决）。因此需要一种方法从失败轨迹中提取可恢复性信息。
AI.method: 提出三个问题级轨迹特征（基于可用干预的结构提取），从失败rollout的分布信号（而非文本内容）中恢复可恢复性结构；通过这些特征对失败进行聚类，并支持无需训练的测试时路由规则。
AI.result: 三个特征在聚类失败、表征不同后训练方法的失败地形（failure topography）上达到84.3±4.3%准确率，比多数类基线高+20%；在Steerable-Hard子集（重试不足且有限干预可达的失败）上路由规则提升挽救率+12.2%；特征和路由规则跨两个跨家族探针迁移。
AI.conclusion: 失败轨迹可被转化为诊断对象，支持测试时路由和后训练分析，无需训练时或权重空间访问。

title: ShareVerse: Multi-Agent Consistent Video Generation for Shared World Modeling
summary: This paper presents ShareVerse, a video generation framework enabling multi-agent shared world modeling, addressing the gap in existing works that lack support for unified shared world construction with multi-agent interaction. ShareVerse leverages the generation capability of large video models and integrates three key innovations: 1) A dataset for large-scale multi-agent interactive world modeling is built on the CARLA simulation platform, featuring diverse scenes, weather conditions, and interactive trajectories with paired multi-view videos (front/ rear/ left/ right views per agent) and camera data. 2) We propose a spatial concatenation strategy for four-view videos of independent agents to model a broader environment and to ensure internal multi-view geometric consistency. 3) We integrate cross-agent attention blocks into the pretrained video model, which enable interactive transmission of spatial-temporal information across agents, guaranteeing shared world consistency in overlapping regions and reasonable generation in non-overlapping regions. ShareVerse, which supports 49-frame large-scale video generation, accurately perceives the position of dynamic agents and achieves consistent shared world modeling.

AI.tldr: ShareVerse是一个基于大型视频模型的多智能体共享世界建模框架，通过空间拼接策略和跨智能体注意力机制，实现了多智能体交互下的统一共享世界视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成工作缺乏对统一共享世界构建和多智能体交互的支持，无法实现多个智能体在共享环境中的协同建模。
AI.method: 1) 基于CARLA仿真平台构建大规模多智能体交互世界建模数据集，包含多样化场景、天气条件和多视角视频。2) 提出独立智能体四视角视频的空间拼接策略，实现更广泛环境建模并保证内部多视角几何一致性。3) 在预训练视频模型中集成跨智能体注意力模块，实现智能体间时空信息交互传输，保证重叠区域共享世界一致性和非重叠区域合理生成。
AI.result: ShareVerse支持49帧大规模视频生成，能够准确感知动态智能体的位置，实现一致的共享世界建模。
AI.conclusion: ShareVerse通过多智能体共享世界建模框架，有效弥合了现有工作在统一共享世界构建方面的空白，为多智能体交互场景的视频生成提供了可行方案。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Rich Feedback with Distributional DAgger
summary: Reasoning models have advanced rapidly, but the dominant reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) recipe remains surprisingly narrow: sample many responses and reward each with a single bit indicating whether the final answer is correct. Yet many settings provide rich feedback, including execution traces, tool outputs, expert corrections, and model self-evaluations. We study how to use such feedback through a distributional variant of the classic imitation learning algorithm DAgger, where the learner has local access to an expert distribution on states visited by the current policy. This yields a simple forward cross-entropy objective that admits a blackbox expert and whose sequence-level gradient {conduct rich credit assignment by propagating} future expert-student disagreement back to earlier decisions. We show that prior RL with self-distillation objectives based on reverse KL or Jensen-Shannon fail to guarantee monotonic policy improvement: even when the expert has higher reward, their updates may increase probability on worse actions. In contrast, we show that forward cross-entropy admits monotonic policy improvement and enjoys guarantees on regret. We further show that our objective optimizes a lower bound on teacher-weighted likelihood of success, leading to improved Pass@N. Empirically, our approach, DistIL, improves over RLVR and RL with self-distillation baselines across a variety of domains: scientific reasoning, coding, and solving hard mathematical problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DistIL，一种基于前向交叉熵的分布模仿学习方法，能够有效利用执行轨迹、工具输出等丰富反馈信号进行推理模型训练，在科学推理、编程和数学问题求解等任务上优于传统的RLVR和自蒸馏强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 当前基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法仅使用最终答案是否正确这一单比特信号进行奖励，忽视了执行轨迹、工具输出、专家修正和模型自评估等丰富的反馈信息。作者希望设计一种能充分利用这些丰富反馈信号的方法来提升推理模型性能。
AI.method: 提出DistIL方法，基于DAgger算法的一种分布变体。学习器可以局部访问当前策略所访问状态上的专家分布，通过简单的前向交叉熵目标进行优化。该目标支持黑盒专家，其序列级梯度通过将未来专家-学生不一致性传播回早期决策来实现丰富的信用分配。理论证明前向交叉熵能保证单调策略改进并具有遗憾界保证。
AI.result: 在科学推理、编程和求解困难数学问题等多个领域，DistIL相比RLVR和基于自蒸馏的强化学习基线方法均取得了更好的性能。同时理论分析表明，该方法优化了教师加权成功可能性的下界，从而改进了Pass@N指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用丰富的反馈信号进行分布模仿学习，前向交叉熵目标相比传统的反向KL或JS散度自蒸馏方法具有理论上的单调改进保证，且在实践中更有效。DistIL为推理模型训练提供了一种更充分利用反馈信号的新范式。

title: Beyond Pixel Histories: World Models with Persistent 3D State
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. To appear in the Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR). 9 pages
summary: Interactive world models continually generate video by responding to a user's actions, enabling open-ended generation capabilities. However, existing models typically lack a 3D representation of the environment, meaning 3D consistency must be implicitly learned from data, and spatial memory is restricted to limited temporal context windows. This results in an unrealistic user experience and presents significant obstacles to downstream tasks such as training agents. To address this, we present PERSIST, a new paradigm of world model which simulates the evolution of a latent 3D scene: environment, camera, and renderer. This allows us to synthesise new frames with persistent spatial memory and consistent geometry. Both quantitative metrics and a qualitative user study show substantial improvements in spatial memory, 3D consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing methods, enabling coherent, evolving 3D worlds. We further demonstrate novel capabilities, including synthesising diverse 3D environments from a single image, as well as enabling fine-grained, geometry-aware control over generated experiences by supporting environment editing and specification directly in 3D space. Project page: https://francelico.github.io/persist.github.io

AI.tldr: PERSIST提出了一种基于隐式3D场景表示的世界模型新范式，通过模拟环境、相机和渲染器的演化，实现了具有持久空间记忆和一致几何结构的视频生成，在3D一致性、空间记忆和长期稳定性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型缺乏3D环境表示，3D一致性只能从数据中隐式学习，且空间记忆受限于有限的时序上下文窗口，导致用户体验不真实并阻碍下游任务（如智能体训练）。
AI.method: 提出PERSIST范式，模拟潜在3D场景（环境、相机、渲染器）的演化，利用隐式3D场景表示合成具有持久空间记忆和一致几何结构的新帧。
AI.result: 定量指标和定性用户研究均表明，PERSIST在空间记忆、3D一致性和长期稳定性上显著优于现有方法，支持从单张图像合成多样3D环境，并支持在3D空间中直接编辑和指定环境以实现细粒度几何感知控制。
AI.conclusion: PERSIST作为一种新范式，通过显式3D场景建模实现了连贯演化的3D世界生成，为交互式世界模型在3D一致性方面提供了有效解决方案。

title: STRIDE: Training Data Attribution via Sparse Recovery from Subset Perturbations
summary: Training Data Attribution (TDA) seeks to trace a model's predictions back to its training data. The gold standard for TDA relies on causal interventions, observing how a model changes when data is added or removed, but repeated retraining is computationally challenging for Large Language Models (LLMs). Consequently, most approaches approximate this effect in the parameter space using gradients. However, tracking gradients across billions of parameters is not only prohibitively expensive but relies on local approximations. In this work, we propose a shift: rather than estimating parameter changes, we model the functional effect of training data in the activation space. We introduce STRIDE (Steering-based Training Data Influence Decomposition), a framework that formulates TDA as a sparse recovery problem in the spirit of compressive sensing. STRIDE learns lightweight "steering operators" that mimic the behavioral shift caused by training on data subsets. By measuring how these operators perturb test predictions, we recover individual training example influences via sparse linear decomposition. STRIDE achieves state-of-the-art for LLM pre-training attribution while being an order of magnitude ($13\times$) faster than previous art. We further validate its practical utility through downstream applications including data selection, data contamination, and qualitative analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRIDE框架，通过在激活空间中建模训练数据的功能性影响，而非在参数空间中追踪梯度变化，实现了高效的大语言模型训练数据归因。STRIDE将数据归因建模为压缩感知中的稀疏恢复问题，通过学习轻量级"转向算子"模拟训练子集的行为影响，再通过稀疏线性分解恢复单个训练样本的贡献。该方法在LLM预训练归因任务上达到最优性能，且速度比先前方法快13倍。
AI.motivation: 现有训练数据归因方法面临双重困境：基于因果干预的重训练方法计算成本过高，不适用于大语言模型；而基于参数空间梯度近似的方法不仅计算代价高昂（需追踪数十亿参数），且依赖局部线性近似，精度有限。核心动机是寻找一种既能避免重训练又能突破梯度方法局限的高效归因范式。
AI.method: STRIDE将数据归因重新定义为激活空间中的稀疏恢复问题。具体地：1) 学习轻量级"转向算子"，模拟训练子集对模型行为的影响；2) 通过测量这些算子对测试预测的扰动，将单个训练样本的影响恢复为稀疏线性分解问题。该方法借鉴压缩感知的思想，在激活空间而非参数空间进行操作。
AI.result: STRIDE在LLM预训练归因任务上达到最先进水平，同时计算速度比先前方法快一个数量级（13倍）。在下游应用（数据选择、数据污染检测、定性分析）中进一步验证了其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种从参数空间转向激活空间的数据归因新范式，通过压缩感知框架实现了高效且精确的训练数据追溯，为理解和改进LLM的数据驱动行为提供了实用工具。

title: When Detectors Forget Forensics: Blocking Semantic Shortcuts for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The growing realism of generative models has blurred the boundary between real and synthetic content, posing significant challenges to reliable AI-generated image detection. Although large-scale pre-trained Vision Foundation Models have advanced detection capability, their generalization to images from unseen generation pipelines remains inadequate. In this paper, we identify, for the first time, a key failure mechanism, termed \emph{semantic fallback}, wherein forensic fine-tuning fails to fully reshape the representation space. Consequently, the resulting representations remain organized along high-level semantic structures rather than manipulation-specific forensic cues. Building on this insight, we propose a \textbf{Geometric Semantic Decoupling (GSD)} framework, which explicitly suppresses semantically dominant directions, thereby promoting invariant forensic representations. Specifically, GSD leverages a frozen CLIP encoder to estimate the dominant semantic subspace via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). It then suppresses the semantic components through a geometry-constrained formulation with the suppression strength adaptively modulated across samples and layers. We further introduce a mini-batch SVD approximation strategy that amortizes subspace estimation, achieving over a $15 \times$ reduction in computational overhead while preserving effectiveness. Finally, considering practical scenarios spanning both large-scale and online evaluation, we develop three inference protocols, batch, per-sample, and reference-based inference, and demonstrate that they induce consistent semantic decoupling, yielding a stable forgery-oriented feature manifold.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了生成图像检测中视觉基础模型微调后存在的"语义回退"失效机制，并提出几何语义解耦（GSD）框架，通过SVD估计并抑制CLIP编码器中的语义主导方向，强制模型关注伪造线索，同时引入mini-batch SVD近似实现15倍以上计算加速，支持批量、单样本和参考三种推理协议。
AI.motivation: 生成模型的逼真度模糊了真实与合成内容的边界，现有大规模视觉基础模型虽具备检测能力，但对未见过的生成管线泛化能力不足，关键失效机制尚未被揭示。
AI.method: 提出GSD框架：1) 利用冻结的CLIP编码器通过SVD估计语义主导子空间；2) 通过几何约束公式自适应抑制语义成分；3) 引入mini-batch SVD近似策略降低计算开销15倍以上；4) 设计批量、单样本和基于参考的三种推理协议。
AI.result: GSD框架有效抑制语义回退，使表征专注于伪造线索而非高层语义结构；mini-batch SVD实现超15倍计算加速；三种推理协议均能产生一致的语义解耦效果，形成稳定的面向伪造的特征流形。
AI.conclusion: 通过揭示"语义回退"机制并提出几何语义解耦方法，显著提升了视觉基础模型在AI生成图像检测任务上对未见生成管线的泛化能力，为可泛化的伪造检测提供了新范式。

title: How do machines learn? Evaluating the AIcon2abs method
comment: textual review (spelling and grammar); reorganization of the elements of some figures; New references included
summary: This study expands on previous work that introduced the AIcon2abs method (AI from Concrete to Abstract: Demystifying Artificial Intelligence to the general public), an innovative approach designed to increase public understanding of machine learning (ML) across diverse age groups, including K-12 students, and aims to evaluate its effectiveness. AIcon2Abs employs the WiSARD algorithm, a weightless neural network known for its simplicity, and user accessibility. WiSARD does not require Internet, making it ideal for non-technical users and resource-limited environments. This method enables participants to intuitively visualize and interact with ML processes through engaging, hands-on activities, as if they were the algorithms themselves. The method allows users to intuitively visualize and understand the internal processes of training and classification through practical activities. Once WiSARDs functionality does not require an Internet connection, it can learn effectively from a minimal dataset, even from a single example. This feature enables users to observe how the machine improves its accuracy incrementally as it receives more data. Moreover, WiSARD generates mental images representing what it has learned, highlighting essential features of the classified data. AIcon2abs was tested through a six-hour remote course with 34 Brazilian participants, including 5 children, 5 adolescents, and 24 adults. Data analysis was conducted from two perspectives: a mixed-method pre-experiment (including hypothesis testing), and a qualitative phenomenological analysis. Nearly all participants rated AIcon2abs positively, with the results demonstrating a high degree of satisfaction in achieving the intended outcomes. This research was approved by the CEP-HUCFF-UFRJ Research Ethics Committee.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了AIcon2abs方法——一种基于WiSARD无权重神经网络的AI教学法，通过无需互联网的动手活动帮助各年龄段（包括K-12学生）理解机器学习原理。在34名巴西参与者（含5名儿童、5名青少年和24名成人）的6小时远程课程测试中，该方法获得高度满意评价。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科普方法对非技术用户尤其是低龄学习者不够友好，缺乏直观、低门槛的教学工具。本研究旨在验证AIcon2abs方法能否有效提升不同年龄段（含K-12学生）对机器学习的理解。
AI.method: 采用WiSARD算法（无需互联网、可从极少量样本学习的权重神经网络），设计动手实践活动让参与者直观体验训练和分类过程。通过6小时远程课程对34名巴西参与者（5名儿童、5名青少年、24名成人）进行测试，采用混合方法预实验（含假设检验）和定性现象学分析进行数据评估。
AI.result: 几乎所有参与者对AIcon2abs给予正面评价，结果显示在实现预期目标方面具有高度满意度。
AI.conclusion: AIcon2abs方法能有效促进不同年龄段（含K-12学生）对机器学习的理解，WiSARD算法的特性（无需互联网、小样本学习、生成心理图像）使其特别适合资源受限环境和低门槛AI教育推广。

title: EvoPrompt: Guided Prompt Evolution for Vision-Language Models Adaptation
summary: The adaptation of large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks with limited labeled data remains a significant challenge. While parameter-efficient prompt learning methods offer a promising path, they often suffer from catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Toward addressing this limitation, our work is grounded in the insight that governing the evolutionary path of prompts is essential for forgetting-free adaptation. To this end, we propose EvoPrompt, a novel framework designed to explicitly steer the prompt trajectory for knowledge-preserving fine-tuning. Specifically, our approach employs a Modality-Shared Prompt Projector (MPP) to generate hierarchical prompts from a unified embedding space. Critically, an evolutionary training strategy decouples low-rank updates into directional and magnitude components, preserving early-learned semantic directions while only adapting their magnitude, thus enabling prompts to evolve without discarding foundational knowledge. This process is further stabilized by Feature Geometric Regularization (FGR), which enforces feature decorrelation to prevent representation collapse. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EvoPrompt achieves state-of-the-art performance in few-shot learning while robustly preserving the original zero-shot capabilities of pre-trained VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoPrompt框架，通过显式控制提示的演化路径（解耦低秩更新的方向与幅度、统一嵌入空间生成层次化提示、特征几何正则化），在少样本学习中既保持预训练VLMs的零样本能力又实现最优性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在少样本下游任务中面临灾难性遗忘问题，现有参数高效提示学习方法虽然部分缓解了该问题，但无法从根本上避免预训练知识的遗忘。
AI.method: 1) Modality-Shared Prompt Projector (MPP)：从统一嵌入空间生成层次化提示；2) 进化训练策略：将低秩更新解耦为方向分量和幅度分量，保留早期学习的语义方向仅调整幅度；3) Feature Geometric Regularization (FGR)：特征去相关正则化防止表示坍塌。
AI.result: 在少样本学习任务上达到最先进性能，同时鲁棒地保留了预训练VLMs原有的零样本能力。
AI.conclusion: EvoPrompt通过显式引导提示演化路径实现了免遗忘的VLMs微调，为保持预训练知识与适应下游任务之间的权衡提供了有效解决方案。

title: SpurAudio: A Benchmark for Studying Shortcut Learning in Few-Shot Audio Classification
summary: Few-shot classification (FSC) is widely used for learning from limited labeled data, yet most evaluations implicitly assume that target concepts are independent of contextual cues. In real-world settings, however, examples often appear within rich contexts, allowing models to exploit spurious correlations between foreground content and background signals. While such effects have been studied in few-shot image classification, their role in few-shot audio classification remains largely unexplored, and existing audio benchmarks offer limited control over contextual structure. We introduce SpurAudio, a benchmark that leverages the natural separability of foreground events and background environments in audio to enable controlled, multi-level evaluation of contextual shifts across support and query sets. Using this benchmark, we show that many state-of-the-art few-shot methods suffer severe performance degradation when background correlations are disrupted, despite achieving similar accuracy under standard evaluation protocols. Crucially, this vulnerability persists even in large pretrained audio foundation models, ruling out limited backbone capacity as an explanation. Moreover, methods that appear comparable under conventional benchmarks can exhibit markedly different sensitivity to spurious correlations, revealing systematic algorithmic strengths and vulnerabilities tied to how feature representations interact with classifier heads at inference time. These findings provide new insight into the behavior of few-shot methods in audio and highlight the need for benchmarks that explicitly probe context dependence when evaluating FSC models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpurAudio基准，揭示少样本音频分类中模型对背景环境伪相关性的严重依赖，即使大规模预训练音频基础模型也无法避免此类脆弱性，并发现不同方法对伪相关的敏感度存在系统性差异。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本分类评估隐含假设目标概念与上下文线索无关，但现实场景中模型会利用前景与背景间的伪相关。图像领域已有相关研究，但音频领域的此类效应尚未被探索，且现有音频基准缺乏对上下文结构的可控评估。
AI.method: 利用音频中前景事件与背景环境的天然可分离性，构建SpurAudio基准，支持对支撑集和查询集之间上下文偏移进行可控、多级评估。
AI.result: 1）多种少样本方法在背景相关性被破坏时性能严重下降；2）即使大规模预训练音频基础模型也存在此脆弱性，排除了骨干网络容量不足的解释；3）传统基准下表现相似的方法对伪相关的敏感度存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了少样本音频分类中上下文依赖的关键问题，表明亟需设计明确探测上下文依赖性的基准来评估FSC模型。

title: Revisiting Model Stitching In the Foundation Model Era
summary: Model stitching, connecting early layers of one model (source) to later layers of another (target) via a light stitch layer, has served as a probe of representational compatibility. Prior work finds that models trained on the same dataset remain stitchable (negligible accuracy drop) despite different initializations or objectives. We revisit stitching for Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) that vary in objectives, data, and modality mix (e.g., CLIP, DINOv2, SigLIP 2) and ask: Are heterogeneous VFMs stitchable? We introduce a systematic protocol spanning the stitch points, stitch layer families, training losses, and downstream tasks. Three findings emerge. (1) Stitch layer training matters: conventional approaches that match the intermediate features at the stitch point or optimize the task loss end-to-end struggle to retain accuracy, especially at shallow stitch points. (2) With a simple feature-matching loss at the target model's penultimate layer, heterogeneous VFMs become reliably stitchable across vision tasks. (3) For deep stitch points, the stitched model can surpass either constituent model at only a small inference overhead (for the stitch layer). Building on these findings, we further propose the VFM Stitch Tree (VST), which shares early layers across VFMs while retaining their later layers, yielding a controllable accuracy-latency trade-off for multimodal LLMs that often leverage multiple VFMs. Taken together, our study elevates stitching from a diagnostic probe to a practical recipe for integrating complementary VFM strengths and pinpointing where their representations align or diverge.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了视觉基础模型（VFM）的拼接问题，发现通过简单的特征匹配损失（在目标模型的倒数第二层）可以使异构VFM（如CLIP、DINOv2、SigLIP 2）在不同视觉任务上可靠拼接，并提出VFM拼接树（VST）以实现多模态大模型中多个VFM的准确率-延迟可控权衡。
AI.motivation: 先前模型拼接研究主要针对同一数据集训练的模型，而视觉基础模型（VFM）在训练目标、数据和模态混合上存在显著异构性。本文旨在探究异构VFM是否可拼接，并推动拼接从诊断工具发展为实用集成方法。
AI.method: 设计了系统的拼接协议，涵盖拼接点位置、拼接层族、训练损失和下游任务。通过对比传统方法（特征匹配或端到端任务损失）与提出的简单特征匹配损失（在目标模型倒数第二层），评估异构VFM的拼接效果，并进一步提出VFM拼接树（VST）共享早期层、保留后期层。
AI.result: (1) 传统拼接方法在浅层拼接点难以保持准确率；(2) 在目标模型倒数第二层使用简单特征匹配损失，异构VFM可在视觉任务上可靠拼接；(3) 深层拼接点可使拼接模型超越任一组成模型，仅增加少量推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 模型拼接可以从诊断探针提升为实用工具，用于整合互补VFM优势，并在多模态大模型中实现可控的准确率-延迟权衡。

title: Spatial Transcriptomics as Images for Large-Scale Pretraining
summary: Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) profiles thousands of gene expression values at discrete spots with precise coordinates on tissue sections, preserving spatial context essential for clinical and pathological studies. With rising sequencing throughput and advancing platforms, the expanding data volumes motivate large-scale ST pretraining. However, the fundamental unit for pretraining, i.e., what constitutes a single training sample, remains ill-posed. Existing choices fall into two camps: (1) treating each spot as an independent sample, which discards spatial dependencies and collapses ST into single-cell transcriptomics; and (2) treating an entire slide as a single sample, which produces prohibitively large inputs and drastically fewer training examples, undermining effective pretraining. To address this gap, we propose treating spatial transcriptomics as croppable images. Specifically, we define a multi-channel image representation with fixed spatial size by cropping patches from raw slides, thereby preserving spatial context while substantially increasing the number of training samples. Along the channel dimension, we define gene subset selection rules to control input dimensionality and improve pretraining stability. Extensive experiments show that the proposed image-like dataset construction for ST pretraining consistently improves downstream performance, outperforming conventional pretraining schemes. Ablation studies verify that both spatial patching and channel design are necessary, establishing a unified, practical paradigm for organizing ST data and enabling large-scale pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将空间转录组学(ST)数据视为可裁剪的图像进行预训练，通过定义多通道图像表示（空间上裁剪patch，通道上定义基因子集选择规则），解决了现有预训练方案中样本定义不明确的问题，实验证明该方法在下游任务中优于传统预训练方案。
AI.motivation: 现有ST预训练面临根本性难题：训练样本的基本单位定义不明确。将每个spot视为独立样本会丢弃空间依赖性，将整个切片视为一个样本则导致输入过大、训练样本过少，均不利于有效预训练。
AI.method: 提出将ST数据视为可裁剪图像：1) 从原始切片裁剪固定空间尺寸的patch，构建多通道图像表示，保留空间上下文并增加训练样本数；2) 沿通道维度定义基因子集选择规则，控制输入维度并提升预训练稳定性。
AI.result: 实验证明所提出的图像式数据集构建方法在ST预训练中持续提升下游性能，优于传统预训练方案。消融实验验证了空间patch和通道设计两者均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种统一、实用的ST数据组织范式，使大规模预训练成为可能。

title: Efficient Brood Cell Detection in Layer Trap Nests for Bees and Wasps: Balancing Labeling Effort and Species Coverage
summary:
Monitoring cavity-nesting wild bees and wasps is vital for biodiversity research and conservation. Layer trap nests (LTNs) are emerging as a valuable tool to study the abundance and species richness of these insects, offering insights into their nesting activities and ecological needs. However, manually evaluating LTNs to detect and classify brood cells is labor-intensive and time-consuming.
  To address this, we propose a deep learning based approach for efficient brood cell detection and classification in LTNs. LTNs present additional challenges due to densely packed brood cells, leading to a high labeling effort per image. Moreover, we observe a significant imbalance in class distribution, with common species having notably more occurrences than rare species. Comprehensive labeling of common species is time-consuming and exacerbates data imbalance, while partial labeling introduces data incompleteness which degrades model performance.
  To reduce labeling effort and mitigate the impact of unlabeled data, we introduce a novel Constrained False Positive Loss (CFPL) strategy. CFPL dynamically masks predictions from unlabeled data, preventing them from interfering with the classification loss during training.
  Experimental results demonstrate that our method improves detection performance, balances model accuracy and labeling effort, while also mitigating class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于深度学习的巢穴陷阱（LTN）中育雏细胞检测与分类方法，并引入约束假阳性损失（CFPL）策略，通过动态掩码未标注数据预测来减少标注工作量、缓解类别不平衡，实验证明该方法能提升检测性能并平衡模型精度与标注成本。
AI.motivation: 监测洞穴筑巢野蜂和黄蜂对生物多样性研究与保护至关重要，但人工评估巢穴陷阱（LTN）来检测和分类育雏细胞耗时耗力。现有深度学习方法面临育雏细胞密集排列导致标注工作量大、常见种与稀有种类别分布严重不平衡、完全标注加剧数据不平衡、部分标注又造成数据不完整降低模型性能等问题。
AI.method: 提出一种基于深度学习的方法用于LTN中育雏细胞的检测与分类。核心创新是引入约束假阳性损失（Constrained False Positive Loss, CFPL）策略，该策略在训练过程中动态掩码未标注数据的预测结果，阻止它们干扰分类损失的计算，从而减少标注工作量并缓解未标注数据带来的负面影响。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法提升了检测性能，在模型精度与标注工作量之间取得了良好平衡，同时有效缓解了类别不平衡问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出的CFPL策略能够在不完全标注数据的情况下有效训练深度学习模型，减少人工标注成本，同时保持或提升育雏细胞检测与分类的性能，为自动化生态监测提供了可行的解决方案。

title: SC-TauPath: A Structural Connectivity Attribution Framework for Mapping Tau Propagation Pathways in Alzheimer's Disease
summary: Understanding how structural connections are associated with tau propagation in Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains a central open question, yet existing computational models either rely heavily on biophysical assumptions or lack neurobiologically interpretable pathway maps. We present SC-TauPath, a structural connectivity (SC) attribution framework that maps tau propagation pathways from in vivo neuroimaging data. SC-TauPath combines a Network Diffusion Model (NDM)-augmented multilayer perceptron with gradient $\times$ input attribution to score each SC edge's contribution to tau prediction, then translates these attribution scores into multi-scale pathway maps (backbone edges, high-traffic routes, and hub ROIs), which validates established Braak staging anatomy. Applied to 234 ADNI participants with paired DTI SC and 18F-Flortaucipir PET, SC-TauPath achieves strong cross-validated tau prediction and yields attribution-based pathway maps consistent with established Braak staging anatomy, demonstrating that SC encode spatially specific information about regional tau distribution in AD.

AI.tldr: SC-TauPath是一个结合网络扩散模型和MLP的结构连接归因框架，通过梯度×输入归因方法映射tau蛋白在阿尔茨海默病中的传播路径，生成多尺度通路图，验证了Braak分期解剖结构。
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型要么过度依赖生物物理假设，要么缺乏神经生物学可解释的通路图，无法有效揭示结构连接与tau蛋白传播之间的关系。
AI.method: 结合NDM增强的多层感知机与梯度×输入归因方法，对每条SC边的tau预测贡献进行评分，并转化为多尺度通路图（骨干边、高流量路径、枢纽ROI）。
AI.result: 在234名ADNI参与者数据上实现了强交叉验证的tau预测，生成的归因通路图与已建立的Braak分期解剖结构一致。
AI.conclusion: 结构连接编码了关于AD中区域tau分布的空间特异性信息，SC-TauPath为理解tau蛋白传播机制提供了可解释的计算框架。

title: Transferable Multi-Bit Watermarking Across Frozen Diffusion Models via Latent Consistency Bridges
comment: Accepted in Second Workshop on Technical AI Governance Research (TAIGR) @ ICML 2026
summary: As generative AI advances, global governance frameworks increasingly mandate verifiable content provenance. However, existing watermarking techniques face a critical policy-to-technology disconnect: sampling-based methods require computationally prohibitive inversion, while fine-tuning approaches are tethered to specific model checkpoints, hindering standardized, cross-model oversight. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiffMark, a plug-and-play multi-bit watermarking framework. DiffMark embeds a persistent, learned perturbation into every denoising step of a frozen diffusion model, accumulating a recoverable signal in the final latent space. To enable efficient training through the frozen network, we utilize Latent Consistency Models (LCMs) as a differentiable training bridge. DiffMark achieves 64-bit extraction in a single 16.4 ms forward pass, which is a $45\times$ speed-up over inversion baselines.
