By enabling per-image key flexibility and cross-architecture transferability without retraining, DiffMark provides the practical, scalable technical tooling necessary to operationalize user accountability and enforce emerging AI governance mandates.

AI.tldr: DiffMark是一种即插即用的多比特水印框架，通过在冻结扩散模型的每个去噪步骤嵌入可学习的扰动，利用潜在一致性模型（LCMs）作为可微训练桥梁，实现了64位水印在16.4毫秒内的单次前向提取（比反演基线快45倍），并支持跨架构迁移，弥合了生成式AI治理政策与现有水印技术之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 全球治理框架日益要求可验证的内容溯源，但现有水印技术存在“政策-技术断连”：采样方法需要计算代价高昂的反演，微调方法受限于特定模型检查点，难以实现标准化、跨模型的监管。
AI.method: 提出DiffMark，一种即插即用的多比特水印框架。该方法在冻结的扩散模型的每个去噪步骤中嵌入一个持久的可学习扰动，使最终潜空间中累积可恢复信号。利用潜在一致性模型（LCMs）作为可微训练桥梁，实现通过冻结网络进行高效训练。
AI.result: DiffMark在单次16.4毫秒前向传递中实现64位提取，相比反演基线获得45倍加速，并实现了每图像密钥灵活性和跨架构可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: DiffMark提供了实用、可扩展的技术工具，能够操作化用户问责制并执行新兴的AI治理要求。

title: GenSpan: Generation-Calibrated Motion Span Priors for Multi-Verb Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
comment: Major revision with title change, updated method, and additional experiments
summary: Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) aims to retrieve both the correct video and its temporal segment corresponding to a natural-language query, a task that is especially challenging for multi-verb queries where temporal action ordering is critical. Existing approaches often rely solely on text or static images and struggle to capture implicit motion dynamics, leading to retrieval errors and temporal misalignment. We propose GenSpan, a generation-calibrated VCMR framework that constructs short auxiliary videos from LLM-selected subtitle cues and decomposed sub-events, using these as temporal priors rather than direct retrieval targets. A token selector filters candidate-video features aligned with generated motion, and a bidirectional state-space model efficiently predicts video-moment tuples. Experiments on TVR and ActivityNet-Captions demonstrate that GenSpan improves corpus-level retrieval and moment localization, particularly for complex multi-action queries, while reducing computational cost compared to state-of-the-art multimodal baselines.

AI.tldr: GenSpan是一个生成校准的视频语料库时刻检索框架，通过LLM选择字幕线索和子事件构建辅助短视频作为时序先验，利用令牌选择器和双向状态空间模型预测视频-时刻元组，在TVR和ActivityNet-Captions数据集上提升了复杂多动作查询的检索性能并降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有VCMR方法在处理多动词查询时，难以捕捉隐式运动动态，导致检索错误和时序对齐不佳。需要一种能够有效建模时间动作顺序的方法。
AI.method: GenSpan框架包含三个核心组件：1) 利用LLM从字幕线索中生成短辅助视频作为时序先验；2) 令牌选择器过滤与生成运动对齐的候选视频特征；3) 双向状态空间模型高效预测视频-时刻元组。
AI.result: 在TVR和ActivityNet-Captions数据集上，GenSpan在语料库级检索和时刻定位方面优于现有方法，尤其对复杂多动作查询效果显著，同时计算成本低于最先进的多模态基线。
AI.conclusion: 生成校准的辅助视频作为时序先验是一种有效的VCMR策略，能够改善多动词查询的时序对齐问题，且计算效率更高。

title: On-the-fly Repulsion in the Contextual Space for Rich Diversity in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Modern Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have achieved remarkable semantic alignment, yet they often suffer from a significant lack of variety, converging on a narrow set of visual solutions for any given prompt. This typicality bias presents a challenge for creative applications that require a wide range of generative outcomes. We identify a fundamental trade-off in current approaches to diversity: modifying model inputs requires costly optimization to incorporate feedback from the generative path. In contrast, acting on spatially-committed intermediate latents tends to disrupt the forming visual structure, leading to artifacts. In this work, we propose to apply repulsion in the Contextual Space as a novel framework for achieving rich diversity in Diffusion Transformers. By intervening in the multimodal attention channels, we apply on-the-fly repulsion during the transformer's forward pass, injecting the intervention between blocks where text conditioning is enriched with emergent image structure. This allows for redirecting the guidance trajectory after it is structurally informed but before the composition is fixed. Our results demonstrate that repulsion in the Contextual Space produces significantly richer diversity without sacrificing visual fidelity or semantic adherence. Furthermore, our method is uniquely efficient, imposing a small computational overhead while remaining effective even in modern "Turbo" and distilled models where traditional trajectory-based interventions typically fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在DiT模型的上下文空间（Contextual Space）中施加排斥力，通过在文本条件与图像结构融合后的注意力层间注入干预，在不牺牲视觉质量和语义一致性的前提下显著提升生成多样性，且计算开销小，适用于Turbo等蒸馏模型。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型存在典型性偏差（typicality bias），即对同一提示生成的图像缺乏多样性，限制了创意应用。现有方法中，修改模型输入需要昂贵的优化，而作用于中间潜变量则会破坏视觉结构导致伪影。
AI.method: 在Diffusion Transformers的多模态注意力通道中，于文本条件被注入图像结构信息之后、构图固定之前的中间层之间，在上下文空间中施加实时的排斥力（on-the-fly repulsion），从而重定向引导轨迹。
AI.result: 该方法在不牺牲视觉保真度和语义对齐的前提下，显著提升了生成多样性；计算开销小，且在传统轨迹干预方法失效的Turbo和蒸馏模型中依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 在上下文空间中施加排斥力是一种高效且鲁棒的多样性增强框架，平衡了多样性、质量和语义一致性，尤其适用于现代快速蒸馏模型。

title: Action Motifs: Self-Supervised Hierarchical Representation of Human Body Movements
comment: Accepted as Highlight at CVPR2026. Project page: https://vision.ist.i.kyoto-u.ac.jp/research/action-motifs/
summary: Effective human behavior modeling requires a representation of the human body movement that capitalizes on its compositionality. We propose a hierarchical representation consisting of Action Atoms that capture the atomic joint movements and Action Motifs that are formed by their temporal compositions and encode similar body movements found across different overall human actions. We derive A4Mer, a nested latent Transformer to learn this hierarchical representation from human pose data in a fully self-supervised manner. A4Mer splits a 3D pose sequence into variable-length segments and represents each segment as a single latent token (Action Atoms). Through bottom-up representation learning, temporal patterns composed of these Action Atoms, which capture meaningful temporal spans of reusable, semantic segments of body movements, naturally emerge (Action Motifs). A4Mer achieves this with a unified pretext task of masked token prediction in their respective latent spaces. We also introduce Action Motif Dataset (AMD), a large-scale dataset of multi-view human behavior videos with full SMPL annotations. We introduce a novel use of cameras by mounting them on the feet to achieve their frame-wise annotations despite frequent and heavy body occlusions. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of A4Mer for extracting meaningful Action Motifs, which significantly benefit human behavior modeling tasks including action recognition, motion prediction, and motion interpolation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A4Mer——一种嵌套潜Transformer，通过自监督学习从人体姿态数据中提取分层表示：Action Atoms（原子关节运动）和Action Motifs（时序组合形成的语义运动片段）。同时构建了AMD数据集（带SMPL标注的多视角人体行为视频，采用脚装摄像机解决遮挡问题）。实验证明该分层表示在动作识别、运动预测和插值等任务中效果显著。
AI.motivation: 有效的人体行为建模需要利用人体运动的分层组合特性，但现有方法缺乏对这种层次结构的显式建模和自监督学习机制。
AI.method: 提出A4Mer（嵌套潜Transformer），将3D姿态序列分割为可变长度片段，每个片段编码为潜变量token（Action Atoms）；通过自下而上的表示学习，这些原子在时间上组合形成可复用的语义运动模式（Action Motifs）；统一采用掩码token预测作为预文本任务。同时构建AMD数据集，创新性地使用脚装摄像机实现帧级SMPL标注以应对严重遮挡。
AI.result: A4Mer能够有效提取有意义的Action Motifs，在动作识别、运动预测和运动插值等人体行为建模任务中表现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于Action Atoms和Action Motifs的分层表示是一种有效的人体运动建模范式，自监督学习方法能够自动发现可复用的语义运动片段，且脚装摄像机为遮挡场景下的姿态标注提供了可行方案。

title: MAEPose: Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Learning for Human Pose Estimation on mmWave Video
summary: Millimetre-wave (mmWave) radar offers a more privacy-preserving alternative to RGB-based human pose estimation. However, existing methods typically rely on pre-extracted intermediate representations such as sparse point clouds or spectrogram images, where the rich spatiotemporal information naturally present in radar video streams is discarded for model learning, while such signal processing adds system complexity. In addition, existing solutions are mainly conducted in an end-to-end supervised manner without leveraging unlabelled raw video streams to learn generalized representations. In this study, we present MAEPose, a masked autoencoding-based human pose estimation approach that operates directly on mmWave spectrogram videos. MAEPose learns spatiotemporal motion-aware generalized representations from unlabelled radar video, and leverages its heatmap decoder for multi-frame pose estimation predictions. We evaluate it across three datasets based on leave-one-person-out cross-validation with rigorous statistical testing. MAEPose consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 22.1% in MPJPE p<0.05, and maintains robust accuracy under zero-shot bystander interference with only a 6.5% error increase. Ablation studies confirm that both the pre-training and the heatmap decoder contribute substantially, while modality analysis indicates that leveraging Range-Doppler video as input achieves better pose estimation performance than Range-Azimuth or their fusion, with lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: MAEPose是一种基于掩码自编码的毫米波雷达人体姿态估计方法，直接处理雷达频谱视频，通过自监督预学习时空运动感知表示，在三个数据集上优于现有方法最高22.1% MPJPE，并保持零样本干扰下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有毫米波雷达人体姿态估计方法依赖预提取的中间表示（如稀疏点云或频谱图像），丢弃了雷达视频流中丰富的时空信息，且信号处理增加了系统复杂度；同时现有方法多为端到端监督学习，无法利用未标注的原始视频流学习泛化表示。
AI.method: MAEPose采用掩码自编码框架，直接以毫米波频谱视频为输入，通过自监督预训练学习时空运动感知的通用表示，并使用热图解码器进行多帧姿态估计预测。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上采用留一人交叉验证，MAEPose在MPJPE指标上优于最先进基线最高22.1%（p<0.05），零样本旁观者干扰下误差仅增加6.5%。消融实验验证了预训练和热图解码器的贡献，模态分析表明Range-Doppler视频输入比Range-Azimuth或其融合效果更好且计算成本更低。
AI.conclusion: MAEPose通过直接处理雷达频谱视频和掩码自编码预训练，有效提升了毫米波雷达人体姿态估计的精度和泛化能力，同时具有隐私保护优势和抗干扰鲁棒性。

title: StateVLM: A State-Aware Vision-Language Model for Robotic Affordance Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown remarkable performance in various robotic tasks, as they can perceive visual information and understand natural language instructions. However, when applied to robotics, VLMs remain subject to a fundamental limitation inherent in large language models (LLMs): they struggle with numerical reasoning, particularly in object detection and object-state localization. To explore numerical reasoning as a regression task in VLMs, we propose a novel training strategy to adapt VLMs for object detection and object-state localization. This approach leverages box decoder outputs to compute an Auxiliary Regression Loss (ARL) during fine-tuning, while preserving standard sequence prediction at inference. We leverage this training strategy to develop StateVLM (State-aware Vision-Language Model), a novel model designed to perceive and learn fine-grained object representations, including precise localization of objects and their states, as well as graspable regions. Due to the lack of a benchmark for object-state affordance reasoning, we introduce an open-source benchmark, Object State Affordance Reasoning (OSAR), which contains 1172 scenes with 7746 individual objects and corresponding bounding boxes. Comparative experiments on adapted benchmarks (RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg) demonstrate that ARL improves model performance by an average of 1.6% compared to models without ARL. Experiments on the OSAR benchmark further support this finding, showing that StateVLM with ARL achieves an average of 5.2% higher performance than models without ARL. In particular, ARL is also important for the complex task of affordance reasoning in OSAR, where it enhances the consistency of model outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为StateVLM的视觉语言模型，通过辅助回归损失（ARL）训练策略增强数值推理能力，用于机器人抓取中的物体检测和状态定位；同时发布了包含1172个场景和7746个物体的OSAR基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人任务中表现优异，但在数值推理（特别是物体检测和状态定位）方面存在固有局限，这一问题源于大语言模型（LLM）的根本性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出辅助回归损失（ARL）训练策略：在微调阶段利用框解码器输出计算回归损失，同时保留推理时的标准序列预测。基于此策略开发StateVLM模型，并构建OSAR基准数据集用于物体状态可供性推理。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg基准上，ARL使模型性能平均提升1.6%；在OSAR基准上，StateVLM+ARL比无ARL模型平均提升5.2%；在OSAR的复杂可供性推理任务中，ARL显著增强了模型输出的一致性。
AI.conclusion: ARL训练策略能有效提升VLM在物体检测和状态定位任务中的数值推理能力，StateVLM在机器人抓取相关的精细物体表征学习方面表现出色。

title: DPM++: Dynamic Masked Metric Learning for Occluded Person Re-identification
summary: Although person re-identification has made impressive progress, occlusion caused by obstacles remains an unsettled issue in real applications. The difficulty lies in the mismatch between incomplete occluded samples and holistic identity representations. Severe occlusion removes discriminative body cues and introduces interference from background clutter and occluders, making global metric learning unreliable. Existing methods mainly rely on extra pre-trained models to estimate visible parts for alignment or construct occluded samples via data augmentation, but still lack a unified framework that learns robust visibility-consistent matching under realistic occlusion patterns. In this paper, we propose DPM++, a Dynamic Masked Metric Learning framework for occluded person re-identification. DPM++ learns an input-adaptive masked metric that dynamically selects reliable identity subspaces for each occluded instance, enabling matching to emphasize visibility-consistent evidence while suppressing unreliable components. Built upon the classifier-prototype space, DPM++ introduces a CLIP-based two-stage supervision scheme, where ID-level semantic priors are learned from the text branch and transferred into the classifier-prototype space for dynamic masked matching. To strengthen the masked metric, we introduce a saliency-guided patch transfer strategy to synthesize controllable and photo-realistic occluded samples during training. Exploiting real scene priors, this strategy exposes the model to realistic partial observations and provides richer supervision than random erasing. In addition, occlusion-aware sample pairing and mask-guided optimization improve the stability and effectiveness of the framework. Experiments on occluded and holistic person re-identification benchmarks show that DPM++ consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods in both holistic and occlusion scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPM++，一种动态掩码度量学习框架，用于解决遮挡场景下行人重识别问题。该方法通过输入自适应的动态掩码度量选择可靠的身份子空间，结合CLIP两阶段监督方案和显著性引导的块迁移策略，在遮挡和整体行人重识别基准上均达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 遮挡导致的不完整样本与整体身份表示之间的不匹配是行人重识别的核心难题。现有方法依赖额外预训练模型或数据增强，缺乏统一框架来处理真实遮挡模式下的鲁棒匹配。
AI.method: DPM++包含三个关键组件：1) 基于分类器-原型空间的动态掩码度量学习，自适应选择可靠身份子空间；2) CLIP两阶段监督方案，从文本分支学习ID级语义先验并迁移到分类器-原型空间；3) 显著性引导的块迁移策略，合成可控且逼真的遮挡训练样本。
AI.result: 在遮挡和整体行人重识别基准上，DPM++一致性地超越了先前的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DPM++为遮挡行人重识别提供了统一的动态掩码度量学习框架，通过自适应选择和语义先验迁移有效解决了遮挡场景下的可靠匹配问题。

title: Venus-DeFakerOne: Unified Fake Image Detection & Localization
summary: In recent years, the rapid evolution of generative AI has fundamentally reshaped the paradigm of image forgery, breaking the traditional boundaries between document editing, natural image manipulation, DeepFake generation, and full-image AIGC synthesis. Despite this shift toward unified forgery generation, existing research in Fake Image Detection and Localization (FIDL) remains fragmented. This creates a mismatch between increasingly unified forgery generation mechanisms and the domain-specific detection paradigm. Bridging this mismatch poses two key challenges for FIDL: understanding cross-domain artifacts transfer and interference, and building a high-capacity unified foundation model for joint detection and localization. To address these challenges, we propose DeFakerOne, a data-centric, unified FIDL foundation model integrating InternVL2 and SAM2. DeFakerOne enables simultaneous image-level detection and pixel-level forgery localization across diverse scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeFakerOne achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming baselines on 39 forgery detection benchmarks and 9 localization benchmarks. Furthermore, the model exhibits superior robustness against real-world perturbations and state-of-the-art generators such as GPT-Image-2. Finally, we provide a systematic analysis of data scaling laws, cross-domain artifacts transfer-interference patterns, the necessity of fine-grained supervision, and the original resolution artifacts preservation, highlighting the design principles for scalable, robust, and unified FIDL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeFakerOne，一个基于数据驱动的统一伪造图像检测与定位基础模型，集成InternVL2和SAM2，在39个检测基准和9个定位基准上达到SOTA性能，并系统分析了跨域伪影迁移、数据缩放规律等设计原则。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展使图像伪造机制趋于统一，但现有伪造图像检测与定位（FIDL）研究仍然碎片化，存在域特定的检测范式与统一的伪造生成机制之间的不匹配。为弥合这一差距，需解决跨域伪影迁移与干扰的理解问题，以及构建高容量的统一基础模型实现联合检测与定位。
AI.method: 提出DeFakerOne，一种数据驱动的统一FIDL基础模型，集成InternVL2和SAM2，能够同时进行图像级检测和像素级伪造定位，覆盖多种场景。
AI.result: 在39个伪造检测基准和9个定位基准上达到最先进性能，对真实世界扰动和先进生成器（如GPT-Image-2）表现出优异的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 系统分析了数据缩放规律、跨域伪影迁移-干扰模式、细粒度监督的必要性以及原始分辨率伪影保留，揭示了可扩展、鲁棒且统一的FIDL设计原则。

title: HyperDiT: Hyper-Connected Transformers for High-Fidelity Pixel-Space Diffusion
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models bypass the reconstruction bottleneck of Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) but face a fundamental "granularity dilemma": capturing global semantics favors large patch scales, while generating high-fidelity details demands fine-grained inputs. To address this issue, we propose HyperDiT, a unified framework establishing Hyper-Connected Cross-Scale Interactions to bridge the semantic and pixel manifold. Diverging from injecting semantics by AdaLN, HyperDiT utilizes Cross-Attention mechanisms, enabling fine-grained tokens to query multi-level semantic anchors globally. To resolve the spatial mismatch during multi-scale interactions, we introduce Scale-Aware Rotary Position Embedding (SA-RoPE) to ensure precise geometric alignment among tokens of varying patch sizes. Furthermore, we incorporate Registers to learn the dense semantics from a pretrained Visual Foundation Model (VFM), effectively reducing generation hallucination and artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HyperDiT achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) FID of $\mathbf{1.56}$ on ImageNet $256\times256$ directly within the pixel space. By combining the fine-grained stream with semantic guidance, HyperDiT offers a superior paradigm for high-fidelity pixel generation.

AI.tldr: HyperDiT提出了一种统一框架，通过超连接跨尺度交互（Hyper-Connected Cross-Scale Interactions）解决像素空间扩散模型中的"粒度困境"，在ImageNet 256×256上实现了1.56的SoTA FID。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型虽避免了VAE的重建瓶颈，但面临根本性的"粒度困境"：捕获全局语义需要大块尺度，而生成高保真细节则需要细粒度输入，二者难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出HyperDiT框架：(1) 使用Cross-Attention机制替代AdaLN，让细粒度token全局查询多级语义锚点；(2) 引入尺度感知旋转位置编码（SA-RoPE），解决多尺度交互中的空间错位；(3) 引入Registers从预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）学习密集语义，减少生成幻觉和伪影。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上直接于像素空间实现了1.56的FID，达到当前最优水平（SoTA）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将细粒度流与语义引导相结合，HyperDiT为高保真像素生成提供了一种优越的范式。

title: Flash-GRPO: Efficient Alignment for Video Diffusion via One-Step Policy Optimization
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization has emerged as essential for aligning video diffusion models with human preferences, but faces a critical computational bottleneck: training a 14B parametered model typically demands hundreds of GPU days per experiment. Existing efficiency methods reduce costs through sliding window subsampling training timesteps, but fundamentally compromise optimization, exhibiting severe instability and failing to reach full trajectory performance. We present Flash-GRPO, a single-step training framework that outperforms full trajectory training in alignment quality under low computational budgets while substantially improving training efficiency. Flash-GRPO addresses two critical challenges: iso-temporal grouping eliminates timestep-confounded variance by enforcing prompt-wise temporal consistency, decoupling policy performance from timestep difficulty; temporal gradient rectification neutralizes the time-dependent scaling factor that causes vastly inconsistent gradient magnitudes across timesteps. Experiments on 1.3B to 14B parameter models validate Flash-GRPO's effectiveness, demonstrating substantial training acceleration with consistent stability and state-of-the-art alignment quality.

AI.tldr: Flash-GRPO提出了一种单步训练框架，通过等时分组和时间梯度校正两大创新，在极低计算预算下实现超越完整轨迹训练的对齐质量，显著提升训练效率并保持稳定性。
AI.motivation: GRPO在视频扩散模型对齐中面临严重计算瓶颈（14B模型需数百GPU天），现有滑动窗口子采样方法虽降低计算成本但导致优化不稳定，无法达到完整轨迹性能。亟需一种既高效又保持对齐质量的方法。
AI.method: 1）等时分组（Iso-temporal Grouping）：通过强制提示维度的时间一致性，消除时间步混杂方差，解耦策略性能与时间步难度；2）时间梯度校正（Temporal Gradient Rectification）：消除跨时间步梯度幅值不一致的时间依赖缩放因子。
AI.result: 在1.3B到14B参数模型上验证，Flash-GRPO实现了显著的训练加速，同时保持一致的稳定性和最先进的对齐质量。
AI.conclusion: Flash-GRPO成功证明了单步训练框架可以超越完整轨迹训练的对齐效果，为大规模视频扩散模型的高效对齐提供了可行路径。

title: DanceHMR: Hand-Aware Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery from Monocular Videos
summary: Monocular video human mesh recovery is essential for digital humans, avatar animation, and embodied simulation, where both temporal stability and expressive whole-body motion are required. Existing video HMR methods produce coherent body motion but often overlook detailed hand articulation, while image-based whole-body methods recover SMPL-X meshes independently per frame, often leading to jittery and inaccurate hand motion. We present a temporally coherent whole-body HMR framework for challenging in-the-wild monocular videos. Our model unifies body context and part-specific hand observations through residual body-hand fusion, enabling stable body motion and detailed hand recovery within a single temporal architecture. We further introduce close-up-aware augmentation to improve robustness under upper-body framing. Experiments on whole-body and body-only benchmarks demonstrate improved hand reconstruction and competitive body accuracy. Our method also produces temporally stable and 2D-consistent SMPL-X motion in challenging real-world videos.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向单目视频的时序一致全身体网格恢复框架，通过残差体手融合机制统一身体上下文与手部观测，并引入近景感知增强提升鲁棒性，在保持身体稳定性的同时实现精细手部重建。
AI.motivation: 现有视频HMR方法能产生连贯的身体运动但忽略了精细手部姿态，而基于图像的全身体方法逐帧独立恢复SMPL-X网格会导致手部运动抖动且不准确，缺乏时序一致性。
AI.method: 1) 残差体手融合机制：统一身体上下文和手部局部观测，在单一时序架构中实现稳定身体运动与精细手部恢复；2) 近景感知增强：改善上半身特写帧下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在全身体和仅身体基准测试中，手部重建效果提升，身体精度具有竞争力；在真实世界视频中产生时序稳定且2D一致的SMPL-X运动。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了视频全身体重建中身体-手部时序一致性问题，在保持身体运动稳定性的同时显著提升了手部细节恢复质量。

title: Rebalancing Reference Frame Dominance to Improve Motion in Image-to-Video Models
summary: Image-to-video models often generate videos that remain overly static, compared to text-to-video models. While prior approaches mitigate this issue by weakening or modifying the image-conditioning signal, they often require additional training or sacrifice fidelity to the reference image. In this work, we identify reference-frame dominance as a key mechanism behind motion suppression. We observe that non-reference frames in I2V models allocate excessive self-attention to reference-frame key tokens, causing reference information to be over-propagated across time and suppressing inter-frame dynamics. Based on this finding, we propose DyMoS (Dynamic Motion Slider), a training-free and model-agnostic method that rebalances the attention pathway from generated frames to the reference frame during initial denoising steps. DyMoS leaves both the input image and model weights unchanged and introduces a single scalar parameter for continuous control over motion strength. Experiments across multiple state-of-the-art I2V backbones demonstrate that DyMoS consistently improves motion dynamics while maintaining visual quality and fidelity to the reference image.

AI.tldr: DyMoS是一种无需训练、模型无关的方法，通过重新平衡生成帧对参考帧的注意力分配，有效提升图像到视频（I2V）模型的运动动态，同时保持对参考图像的保真度。
AI.motivation: 图像到视频模型生成的视频往往过于静态，现有方法通过削弱或修改图像条件信号来缓解，但需要额外训练或牺牲对参考图像的保真度。本文旨在不改变模型权重和输入图像的前提下，解决运动抑制问题。
AI.method: DyMoS识别出参考帧主导是关键机制——非参考帧过度关注参考帧的key token导致运动抑制。该方法在初始去噪步骤中重新平衡从生成帧到参考帧的注意力路径，引入单一标量参数实现运动强度的连续控制，无需训练且模型无关。
AI.result: 在多个最先进的I2V骨干模型上的实验表明，DyMoS能持续提升运动动态，同时保持视觉质量和参考图像保真度。
AI.conclusion: DyMoS通过注意力重平衡机制，在不改变输入图像和模型权重、无需额外训练的条件下，有效解决了I2V模型中的运动抑制问题，实现了运动强度连续可控的视频生成。

title: Vision Transformers and Convolutional Neural Networks for Land Use Scene Classification
summary: Land Use Scene Classification (LUSC) from remote sensing imagery plays a critical role in environmental monitoring, urban planning, and sustainable resource management. In recent years, deep learning methods have significantly advanced the state of the art, with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) dominating the field because of their strong ability to capture local spatial features. However, the emergence of Vision Transformers (ViTs) has introduced a new paradigm that models long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms, potentially enabling improved global context understanding. This paper presents a comparative assessment of Vision Transformers and CNN-based architecture for remote sensing land use scene classification. Representative CNN models, such as AlexNet, is evaluated alongside the Vision Transformer (ViT) using benchmark remote sensing datasets, including the UC Merced Land Use and EuroSAT Land Use datasets. The study examines classification accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and computational complexity to provide a comprehensive performance comparison. Experimental results demonstrate that CNNs perform robustly on datasets with limited training samples and strong local texture characteristics, whereas Vision Transformers exhibit superior performance in capturing global spatial relationships in complex scenes when sufficient training data are available. However, ViTs typically require greater computational resources and larger training datasets to achieve optimal performance. The findings of this study provide insights into the strengths and limitations of both architectures and offer guidance for selecting appropriate models for remote sensing land use scene classification applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对比评估了Vision Transformer (ViT)和CNN（以AlexNet为代表）在遥感土地利用场景分类中的性能。实验表明，CNN在训练样本有限、强局部纹理特征的数据集上表现稳健，而ViT在充足训练数据下能更好地捕获复杂场景中的全局空间关系，但ViT需要更大的计算资源和训练数据。
AI.motivation: 遥感土地利用场景分类在环境监测、城市规划和资源管理中至关重要。尽管CNN在该领域占据主导地位，但Vision Transformer的出现带来了通过自注意力机制建模长程依赖的新范式。本文旨在系统比较两种架构的性能差异，为实际应用中的模型选择提供指导。
AI.method: 选取代表性CNN模型AlexNet和Vision Transformer (ViT)作为对比对象，在UC Merced Land Use和EuroSAT Land Use两个基准遥感数据集上进行实验，从分类准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数和计算复杂度等多个维度进行综合性能评估。
AI.result: CNN在训练样本有限且局部纹理特征突出的数据集上表现稳健；Vision Transformer在训练数据充足时能更好地捕获复杂场景中的全局空间关系，表现更优；但ViT需要更大的计算资源和更多的训练数据才能达到最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 两种架构各有优劣：CNN适合小样本和强局部纹理场景，ViT适合大样本和复杂全局场景。研究结果为遥感土地利用场景分类应用中模型的选择提供了参考依据。

title: Correcting Visual Blur Induced by Attention Distraction to Reduce Hallucinations: Algorithm and Theory
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucinations, yet the visual perceptual mechanism underlying this failure remains poorly understood. In this work, we reveal that hallucinations are strongly associated with a human-like attention distraction phenomenon, where humans under divided focus experience degraded visual clarity and produce inaccurate descriptions, while in models the same mechanism manifests as spatial inconsistency in multi-head attention and temporal fading of attention to image tokens during decoding. We further provide theoretical insights that attention dispersion increases model complexity and degrades classification generalization. Motivated by these findings, we propose an Attention-Focused Approach for Improved Image Perception (AFIP), which corrects attention distraction via cross-head attention enrichment and reinforces visual grounding through dynamic historical attention enhancement. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks and models validate the effectiveness of AFIP without additional training.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大模型中的物体幻觉与注意力分散现象密切相关，并提出无需额外训练的AFIP方法，通过跨头注意力增强和历史注意力动态强化来纠正注意力分散，显著提升模型视觉感知能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型频繁出现物体幻觉现象，但其背后的视觉感知机制尚不明确。本文旨在探究幻觉产生的根本原因，并据此提出有效的缓解方法。
AI.method: 提出了Attention-Focused Approach for Improved Image Perception (AFIP)方法，包含两个核心组件：1) 跨头注意力增强，用于纠正多头部注意力中的空间不一致性；2) 动态历史注意力增强，用于强化视觉接地，缓解解码过程中对图像令牌的注意力衰减。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试和模型上的大量实验验证了AFIP的有效性，且无需额外训练。
AI.conclusion: 物体幻觉与人类注意力分散现象高度相似，表现为多头部注意力的空间不一致性和解码时对图像令牌注意力的时间衰减。AFIP通过纠正这两种注意力分散机制，无需训练即可有效缓解幻觉，提升多模态大模型的视觉感知质量。

title: Anatomy-Anchored Self-Supervision: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Invariant Ultrasound Representation
comment: MICCAI 2026 Accepted Paper; Anatomy-Anchored Ultrasound Self-Supervision
summary: Self-supervised pre-training paradigm has gained increasing prominence for learning transferable representations in medical imaging, yet existing methods for ultrasound (US) images operate at the image or frame level, overlooking the anatomical context for clinical-aligned representation learning. In this work, we propose an anatomy-anchored ultrasound self-supervision framework ANAUS that shifts representation learning from generic visual regions to clinically meaningful anatomical structures. Utilizing a learnable latent prompt engine alongside a one-time domain adaptation on existing public image-mask pairs, we empower the LP-SAM module to achieve annotation-free anatomy delineation at scale. Building upon this anatomical grounding, we propose a dual-policy self-supervised learning paradigm consisting of inter-view semantics-aware anatomy-separating alignment and contextual core-region prediction to enhance representation learning. Specifically, the former enforces feature invariance within identical anatomical regions while promoting discriminability across distinct structures; the latter compels the model to reconstruct corrupted regions, thereby capturing fine-grained structural details. Extensive evaluations on six public datasets demonstrate that ANAUS consistently outstrips current state-of-the-art methods while maintaining the computational efficiency essential for clinical deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/ANAUS.

AI.tldr: 提出ANAUS框架，通过解剖锚定的自监督学习实现超声图像中与临床对齐的表征学习，利用LP-SAM模块进行免标注解剖分割，结合双重策略自监督范式，在六个公开数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有超声图像自监督预训练方法在图像或帧级别操作，忽略了有助于临床对齐表征学习的解剖结构上下文信息。
AI.method: 1) 利用可学习潜在提示引擎和一次性域自适应，构建LP-SAM模块实现大规模免标注解剖分割；2) 提出双重策略自监督学习范式，包含跨视图语义感知的解剖分离对齐（增强相同解剖区域特征不变性及不同结构间判别性）和上下文核心区域预测（重建损坏区域以捕捉细粒度结构细节）。
AI.result: 在六个公开数据集上，ANAUS一致超越当前最先进方法，同时保持临床部署所需的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 将自监督表征学习从通用视觉区域转向临床有意义的解剖结构，能有效提升超声图像表征质量，具备良好的临床部署潜力。

title: Equivariant Latent Alignment via Flow Matching under Group Symmetries
summary: Geometry-aware generative models and novel view synthesis approaches have shown strong potential in visual fidelity and consistency. In parallel, equivariant representation learning has emerged as a powerful framework for constructing latent spaces where analytically known group transformations could act directly, capturing geometric structure in data and enhancing both interpretability and generalization in novel view synthesis. However, we identify that existing approaches often suffer from latent misalignment, a discrepancy between the intended group action and the actually required transformations in the latent space. Consequently, the learned latents often fail to consistently preserve the equivariant relations imposed by the underlying group symmetry. To address this, we propose Residual Latent Flow, a flow-based framework that corrects the misaligned latents, thereby improving compliance with the underlying equivariance relation. Our comprehensive experiments show that our method significantly reduces latent misalignment and improves novel view synthesis quality, under rotation groups SO(n).

AI.tldr: 提出残差潜流（Residual Latent Flow）框架，通过流模型修正潜空间中的错位问题，提升等变表示学习在新视图合成中的旋转群SO(n)等变性，显著提高合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有几何感知生成模型和新视图合成方法中，等变表示学习常面临潜错位问题——潜在空间中实际所需的变换与理论群作用不一致，导致学到的潜在表示无法一致地保持等变关系，限制了合成质量。
AI.method: 提出Residual Latent Flow，一个基于流的框架，通过学习残差流来修正错位的潜在表示，使其更好地符合底层等变关系。
AI.result: 在旋转群SO(n)上的实验表明，该方法显著减少了潜错位，并提升了新视图合成的质量。
AI.conclusion: Residual Latent Flow有效解决了等变潜空间中的错位问题，增强了等变约束的满足程度，从而改善了基于等变表示的新视图合成性能。

title: GGT-100K: Generative Ground Truth for Generalizable Real-World Image Restoration
summary: Real-world image restoration (IR) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality paired training data. Synthetic datasets are abundant but often fail to model real-world degradations, while real-world paired datasets are expensive and difficult to capture. As a result, IR models trained on these datasets show limited generalization in real-world scenarios. In this work, we propose Generative Ground Truth (GGT) by using generative multimodal foundation models (MFMs) to produce high-quality (HQ) targets from real-world low-quality (LQ) images. We first conduct a systematic evaluation of nine state-of-the-art MFMs, including Nano-Banana-2 and GPT-Image-2, on images of various scenes and degradation types. The results demonstrate that Nano-Banana-2 with VLM-based adaptive prompting shows the highest capability to synthesize perceptually realistic and content-faithful HQ targets, which can serve as the GGT for the LQ input. We then employ Nano-Banana-2 to build a GGT synthesis pipeline, which involves multi-stage quality control to ensure data reliability, and construct GGT-100K, an LQ-HQ paired dataset comprising 103,707 training pairs and covering diverse scenes and complex real-world degradations. A test set of 500 image pairs is also established. Extensive experiments show that GGT-100K consistently improves the real-world generalization of a wide range of IR models, with particularly strong benefits for finetuning generative models for IR tasks. Our results suggest that MFMs can serve as practical tools for restoration-oriented data generation, and GGT-100K is a useful resource to expand the generalization boundaries of real-world IR models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成式真实标注（GGT）方法，利用多模态基础模型（MFMs）从真实世界低质量图像生成高质量目标，构建了GGT-100K数据集（103,707对训练图像），系统评估了9种MFM模型，发现Nano-Banana-2结合VLM自适应提示能生成最逼真且内容忠实的高质量图像，该数据集显著提升了多种图像复原模型在真实场景中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 真实图像复原面临高质量配对训练数据稀缺的瓶颈：合成数据集无法模拟真实退化，而真实配对数据采集成本高昂，导致现有模型在真实场景中泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 1) 系统评估9种多模态基础模型在不同场景和退化类型上的性能；2) 采用Nano-Banana-2结合VLM自适应提示生成高质量目标；3) 构建GGT合成流程，包含多阶段质量控制保证数据可靠性；4) 构建GGT-100K数据集（103,707训练对+500测试对）。
AI.result: GGT-100K数据集在多种图像复原模型上持续提升了真实世界泛化能力，尤其在生成式模型的微调中表现突出。Nano-Banana-2结合VLM自适应提示在感知真实性和内容忠实度方面表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 多模态基础模型可作为面向图像复原的数据生成实用工具，GGT-100K数据集有望扩展真实图像复原模型的泛化边界。

title: Representation Forcing for Bottleneck-Free Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) aim to handle perception and generation in a single model. Yet existing UMMs still rely on a frozen, separately pretrained VAE for image generation, imposing a structural bottleneck. Naively removing it introduces a quality gap, as the model must learn both high-level structure and low-level details from raw pixels. In this paper, we propose Representation Forcing (RF), a technique that closes this gap by making representation prediction a native capability of the model. Concretely, RF forces the decoder to autoregressively predict visual representations as intermediate tokens before pixels; these tokens then stay in context to guide pixel diffusion within the same backbone. By turning representations from perception outputs into generation targets, RF eliminates the need for any external generative latent space. We find that RF benefits both understanding and generation. On image generation, our pixel-space model with RF matches state-of-the-art VAE-based unified models. On image understanding, pixel-space RF generally outperforms its VAE-based variant. Together, these results offer an effective step toward end-to-end, bottleneck-free UMMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Representation Forcing (RF) 技术，通过让解码器自回归预测视觉表示作为中间 token，再在其指导下进行像素扩散，从而消除统一多模态模型中 VAE 的结构瓶颈，使模型无需依赖外部生成潜空间即可在像素空间实现高质量的图像生成与理解。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMMs）仍依赖冻结的、单独预训练的 VAE 进行图像生成，这引入了结构瓶颈。直接移除 VAE 会导致质量下降，因为模型需要同时从原始像素中学习高层结构和低层细节。作者希望消除这一瓶颈，实现端到端无瓶颈的 UMMs。
AI.method: Representation Forcing (RF)：强制解码器在生成像素之前，自回归地预测视觉表示作为中间 token；这些中间 token 保留在上下文中，在同一骨干网络内引导后续的像素扩散。从而将表示从感知输出转变为生成目标，消除了对外部生成潜空间的依赖。
AI.result: 在图像生成上，基于像素空间的 RF 模型达到了与基于 VAE 的最先进统一模型相当的性能；在图像理解上，像素空间的 RF 普遍优于其基于 VAE 的变体。
AI.conclusion: RF 有效弥合了像素空间模型的质量差距，同时提升了理解和生成能力，为构建端到端、无瓶颈的统一多模态模型迈出了有效的一步。

title: Blessing from Human-AI Interaction: Super Reinforcement Learning in Confounded Environments
summary: As AI becomes more prevalent throughout society, effective methods of integrating humans and AI systems that leverage their respective strengths and mitigate risk have become an important priority. In this paper, we introduce the paradigm of super policy learning that takes advantage of Human-AI interaction for data driven sequential decision making. This approach utilizes the observed action, either from AI or humans, as input for achieving a stronger oracle in policy learning for the decision maker (humans or AI). In the decision process with unmeasured confounding, the actions taken by past agents can offer valuable insights into undisclosed information. By including this information for the policy search in a novel and legitimate manner, the proposed super policy learning will yield a super-policy that is guaranteed to outperform both the standard optimal policy and the behavior one (e.g., past agents' actions). We call this stronger oracle a blessing from human-AI interaction. Furthermore, to address the issue of unmeasured confounding in finding super-policies using the batch data, a number of nonparametric and causal identifications are established under the framework of proximal causal inference. Building upon on these novel identification results, we develop several super-policy learning algorithms and systematically study their theoretical properties such as finite-sample regret guarantee. Finally, we illustrate the effectiveness of our proposal through extensive simulations and real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"超级策略学习"范式，通过将人类与AI的交互行为作为输入，在存在未测量混杂因素的决策过程中构建优于标准最优策略和过往行为策略的超级策略，并基于近端因果推断建立了非参数识别框架，开发了相应的学习算法并提供了理论保证。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在社会中日益普及，如何有效整合人类与AI系统各自优势并降低风险成为重要议题。现有策略学习方法在存在未测量混杂因素时，未能充分利用人机交互中蕴含的未披露信息来提升决策性能。
AI.method: 提出超级策略学习范式，利用人类或AI的观测行为作为输入；在存在未测量混杂的决策过程中，通过近端因果推断建立非参数和因果识别框架；基于识别结果开发多种超级策略学习算法，并研究其有限样本遗憾保证等理论性质。
AI.result: 理论上证明超级策略能同时优于标准最优策略和过往行为策略（即"人机交互的祝福"）；通过大量模拟和实际应用验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 超级策略学习为人机协同决策提供了新的理论框架和方法工具，能够有效利用人机交互中的信息提升决策质量，在存在未测量混杂时仍可保证策略的优越性。

title: LastAct: Trajectory-Guided Latest-Activity Localization for Real-Time Smart-Home Activity Recognition
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from ambient sensors enables smart-home applications such as health monitoring and assisted living. In realistic deployments, however, sensor events arrive as a continuous stream and activity boundaries are unknown. Sliding-window inference therefore produces many windows that straddle transitions and contain mixed activities, creating boundary contamination that violates the pre-segmented instance assumption used by most benchmarks and models. Moreover, many pipelines under-use spatial context by treating sensor IDs as independent tokens. We present LastAct, a trajectory-centric framework for streaming smart-home HAR that targets the most recent activity under mixed windows while explicitly modeling spatial structure. LastAct projects sensor events onto the home floorplan to form a layout-aligned trajectory image sequence that preserves spatial continuity. A lightweight gate identifies contaminated windows, and a boundary localizer estimates the last transition to enable boundary-guided masking that emphasizes post-boundary evidence and suppresses stale context. For efficiency, we reuse a precomputed layout-aligned template cache to avoid repeated rendering. Empirically, across four public smart-home datasets under near-realistic mixed-activity protocols, LastAct achieves competitive or superior performance on pure windows and yields substantial Macro-F1 gains on cross/mixed windows, demonstrating improved robustness under near-realistic sliding-window regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出LastAct框架，通过将传感器事件投影到家居平面图形成轨迹图像、门控识别污染窗口、边界定位器进行边界引导掩码，有效解决流式智能家居HAR中窗口边界污染和空间结构利用不足的问题，在混合活动窗口上取得了显著的Macro-F1提升。
AI.motivation: 现有流式智能家居HAR方法面临两大问题：(1)滑动窗口推理中窗口跨越活动边界导致边界污染，混合活动违反了大多数基准和模型采用的预分割实例假设；(2)多数管线将传感器ID视为独立token，未能充分利用空间上下文信息。
AI.method: (1) 将传感器事件投影到家居平面图，形成布局对齐的轨迹图像序列，保持空间连续性；(2) 轻量级门控机制识别污染窗口；(3) 边界定位器估计最后一次活动转换位置，通过边界引导掩码增强边界后证据、抑制过时上下文；(4) 预计算布局对齐模板缓存以避免重复渲染，提升效率。
AI.result: 在四个公开智能家居数据集上，采用接近真实场景的混合活动协议进行评测，LastAct在纯净窗口上达到竞争性或更优性能，在交叉/混合窗口上获得了显著的Macro-F1提升，展示了在接近真实的滑动窗口机制下的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LastAct通过轨迹中心化的设计有效解决了流式场景下的边界污染问题，同时显式建模空间结构，为实际部署中的智能家居HAR提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: SkyShield: Occupancy as a Safety Interface for Low-Altitude UAV Autonomy
summary: For low-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) autonomy, 3D spatial understanding is not merely a perception objective, but the safety interface between human instructions and physical flight. In human-scale urban airspace below 20 meters, thin geometry, occlusions, vegetation, and urban clutter define whether an aerial agent can safely enter the space ahead. However, existing UAV datasets mainly provide 2D annotations or 3D boxes, while driving-oriented occupancy benchmarks assume stable ground-level sensor rigs. Both miss the defining regime of low-altitude flight: a front-facing monocular camera observing occupied and free space from a moving aerial body with frame-wise changing 6-DoF pose and camera extrinsics. To bridge this gap, we introduce SkyShield, to the best of our knowledge the first front-view monocular semantic occupancy benchmark for urban UAV flight below 20 meters. Built on CARLA, SkyShield contains 36K front-view UAV samples across diverse urban scenes and weather conditions, pairing each image with frame-wise 6-DoF UAV pose, frame-wise dynamic camera geometry, UAV states, and front-frustum semantic occupancy labels. We further propose KAR-mIoU, a UAV-centric and dynamics-aware metric that re-weights voxel-level evaluation by kinematic reachability and time-to-collision, revealing safety-critical risks hidden by conventional mIoU. To tackle this challenging new setting, we provide SkyOcc, a geometry-first monocular baseline that integrates frame-wise UAV attitude into projection, fuses temporal occupancy features, and applies safety-prior optimization to preserve sparse collision-critical structures. Together, SkyShield, KAR-mIoU, and SkyOcc establish occupancy as a safety interface for low-altitude aerial autonomy. Code and dataset will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出SkyShield，首个面向低空无人机前方单目语义占据感知基准，包含36K前视样本及6-DoF位姿/相机几何/占据标签，并设计KAR-mIoU运动学感知评估指标与SkyOcc几何优先基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机数据集仅提供2D标注或3D框，驾驶场景占据基准假设地面稳定传感器，均无法适用于低空飞行中前视单目相机随6-DoF位姿变化的占据/自由空间感知需求，亟需建立专门的占据感知基准。
AI.method: 基于CARLA构建36K前视样本，包含帧级6-DoF位姿、动态相机几何、无人机状态及语义占据标签；提出KAR-mIoU指标重加权体素评估；设计SkyOcc基线模型融合帧级姿态投影与时序特征，应用安全先验优化。
AI.result: 建立了首个低空无人机前视占据感知基准，KAR-mIoU揭示了常规mIoU无法反映的安全关键风险，SkyOcc在挑战性设置下取得有效结果。
AI.conclusion: 占据感知可作为低空无人机自主飞行中连接人类指令与物理飞行安全的关键接口。

title: Kernel Neural Operators (KNOs) for Scalable, Memory-efficient, Geometrically-flexible Operator Learning
summary: This paper introduces the Kernel Neural Operator (KNO), a provably convergent operator-learning architecture that utilizes compositions of deep kernel-based integral operators for function-space approximation of operators (maps from functions to functions). The KNO decouples the choice of kernel from the numerical integration scheme (quadrature), thereby naturally allowing for operator learning with explicitly-chosen trainable kernels on irregular geometries. On irregular domains, this allows the KNO to utilize domain-specific quadrature rules. To help ameliorate the curse of dimensionality, we also leverage an efficient dimension-wise factorization algorithm on regular domains. More importantly, the ability to explicitly specify kernels also allows the use of highly expressive, non-stationary, neural anisotropic kernels whose parameters are computed by training neural networks. We present universal approximation theorems showing that both the continuous and fully discretized KNO are universal approximators on operator learning problems. Numerical results demonstrate that on existing benchmarks the training and test accuracy of KNOs is closely comparable to or higher than that of popular neural operators while typically using an order of magnitude fewer trainable parameters, with the more expressive kernels proving important to attaining high accuracy. KNOs thus facilitate low-memory, geometrically-flexible, deep operator learning, while retaining the implementation simplicity and transparency of traditional kernel methods from both scientific computing and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出核神经算子(KNO)，一种可证明收敛的算子学习架构，通过组合深度核积分算子实现函数空间上的算子逼近。KNO将核选择与数值积分方案解耦，支持不规则几何上的显式可训练核算子学习，并利用维度分解算法缓解维数诅咒。实验表明，KNO在保持与传统核方法类似简洁性的同时，以少一个数量级的可训练参数达到或超越主流神经算子的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子方法（如FNO、DeepONet）在处理不规则几何时受限，且参数效率不高。KNO旨在通过将核函数选择与数值积分解耦，实现几何灵活的算子学习，同时提高参数效率和可解释性。
AI.method: KNO利用深度核积分算子的组合进行算子逼近，将核选择与数值积分方案解耦，在不规则域上利用特定域的正交规则，在规则域上采用维度分解算法。同时使用非平稳各向异性核，其参数通过训练神经网络计算。
AI.result: 提供了KNO连续和离散形式的通用逼近定理证明。数值实验表明，KNO在现有基准上的训练和测试精度与主流神经算子相当或更高，而可训练参数通常少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: KNO实现了低内存、几何灵活的深度算子学习，同时保留了传统核方法的实现简洁性和透明性，高表达力的核对于实现高精度至关重要。

title: MedSyn2: Flexible Control of 3D CT Generation via Text and Semantically-Defined Segmentation Prompts
summary: Generative models for volumetric medical images have found many applications in medical imaging, ranging from data augmentation to serving as priors for inverse problems. For these applications, generating high-resolution 3D images with strong controllability is essential but remains highly challenging. Existing approaches typically control generation either through radiology reports used as text prompts or through full image segmentation. While text-based prompting is flexible, it provides limited spatial control over the location, shape, and boundary of abnormalities. In contrast, segmentation-based methods receive precise spatial guidance but are restrictive in requiring full-organ annotations. In this work, we propose a flexible multimodal framework for controllable volumetric image generation that supports input from radiology reports and segmentation prompts (both optional). Our approach allows users to provide segmentation of a specific anatomy or abnormality without requiring full-organ annotations. The semantic meaning of the segmentation mask is specified through an accompanying text description, resulting in a highly flexible and scalable conditioning mechanism. We develop a memory-efficient architecture based on a modified diffusion transformer that jointly processes image and segmentation tokens. The model further incorporates gated attention to effectively attend to long radiology reports. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art perceptual and semantic scores (e.g., 24% relative improvement in mean FID), generates high-resolution anatomically consistent CT volumes, and improves data efficiency when used for data augmentation. Radiologists' evaluation further confirms strong alignment between generated and real medical images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种灵活的模态融合框架，支持通过放射报告和/或部分分割提示（而非全器官标注）控制三维医学影像生成，基于改进的扩散Transformer架构在CT体积生成上实现了SOTA性能（FID提升24%）。
AI.motivation: 现有可控体积医学图像生成方法存在两难：基于文本的提示灵活但空间控制弱，基于分割的方法空间精确但需要全器官标注，缺乏一种兼具灵活性与精确空间控制且标注负担轻的方案。
AI.method: 提出一个多模态框架，支持放射报告和分割提示（均可选）；分割只需标注特定解剖结构或异常区域，其语义通过对应文本描述指定；采用基于改进扩散Transformer（DiT）的内存高效架构，联合处理图像与分割token，并通过门控注意力机制有效处理长放射报告。
AI.result: 在感知和语义指标上达到SOTA（平均FID相对提升24%），能生成高分辨率解剖一致CT体积，用于数据增强时提升数据效率，放射科医生评估证实生成图像与真实医学图像高度对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在灵活性和精确性之间取得了良好平衡，有望在医学影像的数据增强、逆问题先验等应用中发挥重要作用。

title: Explaining a probabilistic prediction on the simplex with Shapley compositions
summary: Originating in game theory, Shapley values are widely used for explaining a machine learning model's prediction by quantifying the contribution of each feature's value to the prediction. This requires a scalar prediction as in binary classification, whereas a multiclass probabilistic prediction is a discrete probability distribution, living on a multidimensional simplex. In such a multiclass setting the Shapley values are typically computed separately on each class in a one-vs-rest manner, ignoring the compositional nature of the output distribution. In this paper, we introduce Shapley compositions as a well-founded way to properly explain a multiclass probabilistic prediction, using the Aitchison geometry from compositional data analysis. We prove that the Shapley composition is the unique quantity satisfying linearity, symmetry and efficiency on the Aitchison simplex, extending the corresponding axiomatic properties of the standard Shapley value. We demonstrate this proper multiclass treatment in a range of scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多分类概率预测的Shapley值解释问题，提出了基于Aitchison几何的Shapley composition方法，该方法在单纯形上满足线性性、对称性和效率性公理，是标准Shapley值在多分类场景下的合理推广。
AI.motivation: 现有Shapley值在多分类概率预测解释中被以"一对多"的方式分别计算每个类别的贡献，忽略了输出概率分布的成分性（compositional nature），即分布位于多维单纯形上而非标量空间。需要一种能正确处理多分类概率预测本质结构的解释方法。
AI.method: 引入成分数据分析（Compositional Data Analysis）中的Aitchison几何，将多分类概率预测视为单纯形上的成分数据，在此基础上定义Shapley composition，并证明其在Aitchison单纯形上满足线性性、对称性和效率性公理，从而推广标准Shapley值的公理化性质。
AI.result: 证明了Shapley composition是唯一在Aitchison单纯形上满足线性性、对称性和效率性的量，并在多种场景下展示了该方法相较于传统一对多方式的优势。
AI.conclusion: Shapley composition为多分类概率预测的特征贡献解释提供了一种理论基础扎实、公理化性质完备的解决方案，弥补了现有方法忽视输出分布成分结构的缺陷。

title: Data Collection for Training Quality-Control AI in Carpet Manufacturing
summary: Visual inspection remains the dominant quality-control practice in woven and tufted carpet production, yet it is slow, subjective, and inconsistent at the line speeds and widths of modern looms. We present a design proposal for an in-line machine-vision system whose primary purpose is twofold: to inspect the carpet web in real time and, equally importantly, to systematically collect and label images of defect patterns so that increasingly capable quality-control models can be trained over the life of the installation. The proposal is grounded in a concrete industrial setting: a Six Sigma (DMAIC) project at a woven-carpet production facility that anticipated a production bottleneck following the installation of additional weaving machines, with a substantial baseline defect rate and significant financial exposure associated with quality failures. We describe an imaging subsystem based on synchronized line-scan cameras with combined bright-field and grazing illumination, derive the resolution and throughput requirements needed to resolve fine structural defects across a multi-metre web, and define a carpet-specific defect taxonomy. We then lay out a staged modelling strategy that begins with unsupervised anomaly detection trained on defect-free material, following the paradigm exemplified by the carpet category of the MVTec Anomaly Detection benchmark, and matures through a human-in-the-loop annotation flywheel into supervised detection and segmentation models. Finally, we connect detection performance to the DMAIC objectives, showing how reductions in escaped defects translate into improved process quality and process sigma levels. The contribution is an end-to-end, deployable blueprint that treats data collection as a first-class engineering objective rather than an afterthought.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于机织和簇绒地毯生产的在线机器视觉系统设计方案，该系统集成了线扫描相机、缺陷分类体系和无监督/监督混合建模策略，将数据采集作为一等工程目标，并基于六西格玛（DMAIC）项目验证了其减少缺陷漏检、提升过程质量水平的可行性。
AI.motivation: 地毯生产中依赖人工视觉检测，存在速度慢、主观性强、一致性差的问题，且随着织机数量和生产线速度提升，质量检测将成为生产瓶颈，带来巨大的财务风险。
AI.method: 采用同步线扫描相机结合亮场和掠射照明方案，推导了跨米级幅面的分辨率和吞吐量需求；定义了地毯特定缺陷分类法；提出了从无监督异常检测（基于无缺陷材料训练）起步，经人机协同标注飞轮过渡到有监督检测/分割模型的递进策略。
AI.result: 在六西格玛DMAIC项目框架下，将缺陷逃逸率降低与过程质量改进、过程西格玛水平提升直接关联，显示出系统在减少质量损失方面的量化收益。
AI.conclusion: 该方案提供了一种端到端、可部署的设计蓝图，将数据采集作为一等工程目标而非事后补充，为地毯行业在产线速度和幅面不断提升背景下实现实时、客观、可持续优化的视觉检测提供了可行路径。

title: Learning Randomized Reductions
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 (Spotlight). 9 pages main text + appendix
summary: Randomized self-reductions (RSRs) express $f(x)$ using $f$ evaluated at random correlated points, enabling self-correcting programs, instance-hiding protocols, and applications in complexity theory and cryptography. Yet discovering RSRs has required manual expert derivation for over 40 years, limiting their practical use. We present Bitween for automated RSR learning. First, we formalize RSR learning with sample complexity analysis under correlated sampling. Second, we develop Vanilla Bitween, which integrates multiple backends (linear regression, genetic programming, symbolic regression, and mixed-integer programming). The linear regression backend outperforms the others, discovering RSRs for 43 of 80 functions (54%) in RSR-Bench, our benchmark suite, including the first known reduction for sigmoid. Third, we introduce Agentic Bitween, a neuro-symbolic approach where LLM agents propose novel query functions beyond the fixed set ($x+r$, $x-r$, $x \cdot r$, $x$, $r$) in prior work. Agentic Bitween discovers RSRs for 64 of 80 functions (80%), outperforming pure neural baselines in both RSR discovery and verification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出Bitween框架实现随机自归约（RSR）的自动化学习，其中Vanilla Bitween通过多种后端为80个函数中的43个发现RSR（包括首个sigmoid的归约），Agentic Bitween通过LLM智能体提出新型查询函数，将发现率提升至80%。
AI.motivation: 四十多年来RSR的发现完全依赖人工专家推导，严重限制了其实际应用，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: 首先形式化RSR学习问题并进行样本复杂度分析；然后提出Vanilla Bitween，集成线性回归、遗传编程、符号回归和混合整数规划四种后端；进而提出Agentic Bitween，利用LLM智能体以神经符号方式生成超越固定查询函数集合的新型查询函数。
AI.result: Vanilla Bitween在RSR-Bench基准中为80个函数中的43个（54%）发现RSR，其中线性回归后端表现最优；Agentic Bitween将发现率提升至64/80（80%），在RSR发现和验证准确率上均优于纯神经基线方法。
AI.conclusion: Bitween框架成功实现了RSR的自动化发现，显著降低了人工门槛，Agentic Bitween通过LLM驱动的查询函数扩展进一步提升了效果，为自纠错程序、实例隐藏协议等应用提供了自动化工具支持。

title: PaCX-MAE: Physiology-Augmented Chest X-Ray Masked Autoencoder
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 3rd Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences (FM4LS)
summary: Clinical diagnosis often requires combining imaging with physiological measurements, yet deployed models typically operate on unimodal data. We present PaCX-MAE, a cross-modal distillation framework that injects physiological priors into chest X-ray (CXR) encoders while remaining strictly unimodal at inference. PaCX-MAE augments in-domain masked autoencoding with a dual contrastive-predictive objective, aligning CXR representations with paired ECG and laboratory embeddings. Extensive evaluation across nine benchmarks demonstrates consistent improvements over domain-specific MAE, particularly on physiology-dependent tasks (e.g., +2.7 AUROC on MedMod; +6.5 F1 on VinDr). The method proves highly label-efficient in the 1% regime and preserves anatomical fidelity, achieving parity with MAE on segmentation tasks. Zero-shot and attention analyses confirm that PaCX-MAE successfully learns to attend to physiological indicators, such as the cardiac silhouette, absent in standard visual pretraining.

AI.tldr: PaCX-MAE是一种跨模态蒸馏框架，通过将生理先验注入胸部X光编码器，在保持单模态推理的同时，在多项基准测试中取得优于领域特定MAE的性能提升（如MedMod上AUROC提高2.7，VinDr上F1提高6.5），并具备标签高效性和解剖保真度。
AI.motivation: 临床诊断通常需要结合影像与生理测量数据，但现有模型大多仅处理单模态数据。作者旨在弥合这一差距，在不改变推理时单模态架构的前提下，让CXR编码器学习到生理先验知识。
AI.method: 在域内掩码自编码（MAE）基础上，引入双对比-预测目标（dual contrastive-predictive objective），将CXR表征与配对的心电图（ECG）和实验室检测嵌入进行对齐，从而实现跨模态蒸馏。
AI.result: 在九个基准上一致优于领域特定MAE：MedMod AUROC提升2.7，VinDr F1提升6.5；1%数据标签高效；分割任务与MAE持平；零样本和注意力分析表明模型成功关注到心脏轮廓等生理指标。
AI.conclusion: PaCX-MAE通过跨模态蒸馏成功将生理先验注入单模态CXR编码器，在生理依赖型任务上显著提升性能，同时保持了解剖学特征的保真度，证明了该方法在临床实用性上的潜力。

title: When and why randomised exploration works (in linear bandits)
comment: Minor corrections to formulas and text; results unchanged
summary: We provide an approach for the analysis of randomised exploration algorithms like Thompson sampling that does not rely on forced optimism or posterior inflation. With this, we demonstrate that in the $d$-dimensional linear bandit setting, when the action space is smooth and strongly convex, randomised exploration algorithms enjoy an $n$-step regret bound of the order $O(d\sqrt{n} \log(n))$. Notably, this shows for the first time that there exist non-trivial linear bandit settings where Thompson sampling can achieve optimal dimension dependence in the regret.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的分析方法，用于分析如汤普森采样等随机探索算法，无需依赖强制乐观主义或后验膨胀。在d维线性赌博机环境中，当动作空间平滑且强凸时，证明了随机探索算法可以实现O(d√n log(n))的n步遗憾界，首次表明在非平凡线性赌博机设置中，汤普森采样可以在遗憾中获得最优维度依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有分析随机探索算法（如汤普森采样）的方法通常依赖强制乐观主义或后验膨胀，这限制了理论结果的最优性。作者希望开发一种不依赖这些技术的新分析框架，以证明随机探索算法在更一般条件下能达到最优遗憾界。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的分析框架，不依赖强制乐观主义或后验膨胀，专门用于分析随机探索算法。该框架应用于d维线性赌博机环境，要求动作空间平滑且强凸。
AI.result: 在该设置下，随机探索算法（包括汤普森采样）实现了O(d√n log(n))的n步遗憾界，其中维度d的依赖关系是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明在非平凡线性赌博机设置中，汤普森采样可以实现最优维度依赖的遗憾界，为随机探索算法的理论分析提供了新视角。

title: $\text{VG}^2$GT: Voxel-Gaussian Splatting Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
summary: Gaussian splatting has shown strong potential for 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis. However, most existing methods require accurate camera parameters and per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods with pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives often suffer from artifacts and non-uniform primitives. In this paper, we propose $\text{VG}^2$GT, a Voxel-Gaussian Splatting Visual Geometry-Grounded Transformer. $\text{VG}^2$GT leverages a frozen pretrained visual foundation model (VFM), incorporates a multi-scale differentiable voxel module to enhance geometric understanding, and directly splits and regresses Gaussian primitive parameters from voxel features. During training, depth maps are supervised through stochastic solid volume rendering, enabling geometrically accurate Gaussian scene reconstruction while keeping the visual foundation model fully frozen. This design enables $\text{VG}^2$GT to be seamlessly plugged into any patch-feature-based VFM, while substantially reducing the required training cost. $\text{VG}^2$GT outperforms current state-of-the-art methods on widely used DTU, Replica, TAT, and ScanNet datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出VG²GT，一种基于体素-高斯泼溅的视觉几何接地Transformer，利用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型、多尺度可微分体素模块和随机实体体积渲染，实现无需逐场景优化的几何精确高斯场景重建，在多个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅方法大多需要精确相机参数和逐场景优化，前馈式像素对齐高斯原语方法存在伪影和非均匀原语问题。
AI.method: 采用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型(VFM)，引入多尺度可微分体素模块增强几何理解，直接从体素特征分裂和回归高斯原语参数，通过随机实体体积渲染监督深度图训练。
AI.result: 在DTU、Replica、TAT和ScanNet数据集上超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: VG²GT可无缝嵌入任何基于补丁特征的VFM，显著降低训练成本，实现几何精确的场景重建。

title: Post-Training Corrections for Improved Time-Series Forecasting
summary:
Time-series forecasting is a critical task in various business domains, but it remains inherently challenging.
  Typically, large forecasting models are trained in a single, resource-intensive run. Once training is completed, a natural question arises:~\emph{is there still potential for meaningful improvement in the model's performance?}
  Motivated by techniques from boosting, we introduce the concept of~\emph{post-training corrections}. This approach enhances a trained forecaster by sequentially applying a carefully selected set of corrections to its predictions.
  Our method offers a lightweight, model-agnostic, and scalable strategy to improve forecasting performance in practical settings.
  We provide theoretical foundations for the approach, starting with the affine correction case, and analyze the expected performance gains and computational costs in more general settings.
  Across a range of benchmark datasets, our method consistently delivers up to a $30\%$ improvement in forecasting accuracy over existing state-of-the-art models, with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“训练后修正”（post-training corrections）的轻量级方法，通过顺序应用精心选择的修正来提升已训练时间序列预测模型的性能，无需重新训练，可在多个基准数据集上实现最高30%的准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 大型时间序列预测模型通常需要单次、资源密集的训练，训练完成后自然产生一个疑问：模型性能是否还有显著提升的空间？受boosting技术启发，作者希望探索一种无需重新训练的轻量级后处理策略来进一步提升预测性能。
AI.method: 提出训练后修正方法，顺序地对已训练模型的预测结果应用一组精心选择的修正（从仿射修正开始，逐步推广到更一般情形）。该方法与模型无关、可扩展，且计算开销极小。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法相较于现有最先进模型，预测准确率提升最高可达30%，且计算开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 训练后修正是一种轻量级、模型无关且可扩展的实用策略，能够有效提升已训练时间序列预测模型的性能，为后训练阶段的性能优化提供了一种新思路。

title: PhyScene3D: Physically Consistent Interactive 3D Tabletop Scene Generation
summary: Generating physically consistent 3D tabletop scenes is a fundamental yet underexplored problem for interactive and generalist robotic learning. The challenge stems from dense object hierarchies and irregular affordances. Here, an interactive scene denotes a physically valid, collision-free environment directly loadable into physics simulators. Existing methods, ranging from decoupled symbolic solvers to end-to-end regression models, often suffer from error propagation or overfitting to noisy supervision containing widespread physical violations. To address these limitations, we introduce PhyScene3D, a framework that reformulates generation as a Human-Mimetic Constructive Process. The proposed Cognitive Topological Reasoning Chain (CTRC) factorizes scene synthesis into a sequential, anchor-conditioned process. It employs a 3D AABB-based placement scheme that imposes a strong structural inductive bias. To address imperfect supervision and physical infeasibility, we introduce Physics-Aware Denoising Alignment (PADA). It integrates a differentiable Signed Distance Field (SDF) with Test-Time Optimization (TTO) to project generated scenes onto a physics-feasible manifold while preserving semantic intent. Experiments demonstrate that PhyScene3D outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both semantic accuracy and physical validity, achieving a 40% reduction in scene-wise collision rate relative to the human-annotated training data.

AI.tldr: PhyScene3D 提出了一种将3D桌面场景生成重构为类人构造过程的方法，通过认知拓扑推理链（CTRC）和物理感知去噪对齐（PADA）实现高物理有效性和语义准确性，场景碰撞率相比人工标注数据降低40%。
AI.motivation: 现有3D桌面场景生成方法（包括解耦符号求解器和端到端回归模型）存在误差传播或对含广泛物理违例的噪声监督过拟合的问题，而生成物理一致的交互式场景对于机器人学习至关重要，但该问题因密集的对象层次结构和不规则空间关系而未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出PhyScene3D框架：1) 认知拓扑推理链（CTRC）将场景合成分解为基于锚点的顺序生成过程，采用3D AABB放置方案引入强结构归纳偏置；2) 物理感知去噪对齐（PADA）结合可微有符号距离场（SDF）和测试时优化（TTO），将生成场景投影到物理可行流形上同时保持语义意图。
AI.result: 在语义准确性和物理有效性方面均超越现有最优方法，场景级碰撞率相比人工标注训练数据降低40%。
AI.conclusion: 通过类人构造过程建模和物理感知优化，有效解决了3D场景生成中物理一致性与语义保真度的平衡问题，为交互式机器人学习提供了可直接加载到物理模拟器的场景生成方案。

title: Certified Neural Approximations of Nonlinear Dynamics
comment: first and second author contributed equally
summary: Neural networks hold great potential to act as approximate models of nonlinear dynamical systems, with the resulting neural approximations enabling verification and control of such systems. However, in safety-critical contexts, the use of neural approximations requires formal bounds on their closeness to the underlying system. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose a novel, adaptive, and parallelizable verification method based on certified first-order models. Our approach provides formal error bounds on the neural approximations of dynamical systems, allowing them to be safely employed as surrogates by interpreting the error bound as bounded disturbances acting on the approximated dynamics. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our method on a range of established benchmarks from the literature, showing that it significantly outperforms the state of the art. Furthermore, we show that our framework can successfully address additional scenarios previously intractable for existing methods -- neural network compression and an autoencoder-based deep learning architecture for training Koopman operators for the purpose of trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于可认证一阶模型的自适应、可并行化的验证方法，为神经网络近似非线性动力学系统提供正式误差界，使神经网络可作为安全的替代模型使用，并在多个基准测试上显著超越现有方法，同时可处理神经网络压缩和基于自编码器的Koopman算子训练等新场景。
AI.motivation: 神经网络在近似非线性动力系统方面潜力巨大，但在安全关键场景中，需要对其与底层系统之间的近似误差提供形式化保证，这是当前面临的根本性挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种自适应、可并行化的验证方法，基于可认证的一阶模型，为动力学系统的神经网络近似提供形式化误差界，将误差界解释为作用于近似动力学上的有界扰动。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上显著超越现有方法，并能处理神经网络压缩和基于自编码器的Koopman算子训练等此前难以解决的场景。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够提供形式化误差保证，使得神经网络近似可安全地作为替代模型用于安全关键系统中的验证与控制任务。

title: ProtoAda: Prototype-Guided Adaptive Adapter Expansion and Geometric Consolidation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, but real-world deployment requires them to continually acquire new vision-language capabilities, making Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) essential. To reduce inter-task interference and promote collaboration, recent methods often employ sparse architectures like Mixture of LoRA Experts with image-text similarity routing. However, tasks with distinct response structures could share highly similar visual-linguistic semantics and thus be wrongly routed to the same expert; image-text similarity alone is insufficient for reliable task assignment. For example, an expert in a grounding task requiring coordinate prediction may be biased toward producing short textual answers after learning semantically similar VQA tasks. This format-blind task assignment integrates heterogeneous response types into shared parameters, inducing gradient interference and ineffective expert collaboration. To address this problem, we propose ProtoAda, a prototype-guided adaptive tuning framework. ProtoAda introduces format-aware task prototypes to align task assignment and routing with both task semantics and output structure, and further consolidates format-compatible updates in a geometry-aware manner to effectively reuse and progressively refine existing parameters. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ProtoAda achieves superior performance, especially on tasks whose answer structures are easily corrupted by sequential tuning.

AI.tldr: ProtoAda提出原型引导的自适应调优框架，通过格式感知任务原型解决多模态持续指令调优中因视觉-语言语义相似但输出结构不同导致的任务路由错误和梯度干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE方法仅依赖图文相似度进行任务路由，忽略了不同任务输出结构（如坐标预测与短文本回答）的差异，导致语义相似但格式不同的任务被错误分配到同一专家，产生梯度干扰。
AI.method: ProtoAda引入格式感知任务原型，将任务分配路由同时对齐任务语义和输出结构；并以几何感知方式整合格式兼容的更新，实现参数重用与渐进优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准上达到优越性能，尤其对答案结构易受顺序调优破坏的任务提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 格式感知的任务路由与几何感知的参数整合能有效缓解跨任务干扰，提升多模态持续指令调优效果。

title: Model-Preserving Adaptive Rounding
summary: The goal of quantization is to produce a compressed model whose output distribution is as close to the original model's as possible. To do this tractably, most quantization algorithms minimize the immediate activation error of each layer as a proxy for the end-to-end error. However, this ignores the effect of future layers, making it a poor proxy. In this work, we introduce Yet Another Quantization Algorithm (YAQA), an adaptive rounding algorithm that directly considers the error at the network's output. YAQA introduces a series of theoretical results that culminate in the first end-to-end error bounds for quantization algorithms. First, we characterize the convergence time of adaptive rounding algorithms via the structure of their Hessian approximations. We then show that the end-to-end error can be bounded by the approximation's cosine similarity to the true Hessian. This admits a natural Kronecker-factored approximation with corresponding near-optimal Hessian sketches. YAQA is provably better than GPTQ/LDLQ and empirically reduces the error by $\approx 30\%$ over these methods. YAQA even achieves a lower error than quantization aware training. This translates to state of the art performance on downstream tasks, all while adding no inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YAQA，一种直接考虑网络输出端误差的自适应舍入量化算法，首次给出了量化算法的端到端误差界，相比GPTQ/LDLQ等方法误差降低约30%，且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有量化算法以每层激活误差作为端到端误差的代理，忽略了后续层的影响，导致代理效果不佳。本文旨在直接最小化网络输出端的误差，并给出理论上的端到端误差界。
AI.method: 通过Hessian近似结构刻画自适应舍入算法的收敛时间，证明端到端误差可由近似Hessian与真实Hessian的余弦相似度来界定，进而采用Kronecker因子分解近似实现近最优的Hessian草图。
AI.result: YAQA理论上优于GPTQ/LDLQ，实际误差降低约30%，甚至低于量化感知训练，在下游任务上达到SOTA性能，且无推理开销。
AI.conclusion: YAQA是首个具有端到端误差界的量化算法，通过直接优化输出端误差和理论保证，在无推理开销前提下显著优于现有方法。

title: Tiny Collaborative Inference for Occlusion-Robust Object Detection
summary: Edge AI nodes for search and rescue are increasingly expected to run computer vision locally, yet ultra-low-end hardware imposes hard constraints on memory, compute, and inter-device communication. This work addresses occlusion-robust object detection on devices with less than 1 MB SRAM by combining an MCUNet backbone, a YOLOv2 detection head, and Lite quantisation. Two collaborative inference strategies are evaluated: feature-level fusion, concatenating intermediate feature maps, and decision-level fusion via Weighted Boxes Fusion (WBF). WBF outperforms feature-level fusion under all tested occlusion conditions, yielding gains of up to +0.2736 mAP in asymmetric scenarios. Extending fusion to three views improves accuracy further (up to +0.3827 mAP) at modest communication overhead (~1.3 KB per exchange). Hardware experiments progress from a host-assisted USB-relay baseline to a Wi-Fi peer-to-peer deployment on two Coral Dev Board Micro units, where WBF executes on-device with negligible communication energy relative to inference. In a 301.9 s autonomous session of 108 frames, fused output is produced on 61 frames versus 47 for a single board - a coverage gain of +29.8%. A decentralised federated learning feasibility note is included but not treated as a primary result, as performance remains limited under non-iid data. The results support decision-level fusion as a viable option for improving occlusion robustness in small-scale edge object detection, including host-free multi-board operation on ultra-low-end hardware.

AI.tldr: 针对低于1MB SRAM的超低端边缘AI节点，本文结合MCUNet骨干网络、YOLOv2检测头和Lite量化实现遮挡鲁棒的目标检测，验证了决策级融合（WBF）在准确率和通信开销上优于特征级融合，并在双Coral Dev Board Micro上实现了无主机多板协同推理，覆盖增益提升29.8%。
AI.motivation: 超低端边缘AI节点（<1MB SRAM）在搜救场景中需本地运行计算机视觉任务，但内存、算力和设备间通信的硬约束使得遮挡鲁棒的目标检测极具挑战，现有方法难以在如此苛刻的硬件条件下兼顾准确性与实时性。
AI.method: 采用MCUNet骨干+YOLOv2检测头+Lite量化的轻量级检测流水线；对比特征级融合（拼接中间特征图）与决策级融合（Weighted Boxes Fusion, WBF）两种协同推理策略；硬件实验从USB-relay基线演进到Wi-Fi直连双Coral Dev Board Micro部署。
AI.result: WBF在所有遮挡条件下优于特征级融合，非对称场景mAP提升最高+0.2736；三视图融合进一步提升至+0.3827 mAP，通信开销仅~1.3 KB/次；自主采集108帧共301.9秒，融合输出61帧 vs 单板47帧，覆盖增益+29.8%。
AI.conclusion: 决策级融合（WBF）是超低端边缘设备上提升遮挡鲁棒性的可行方案，支持无主机多板协同操作，通信能量远低于推理能耗；去中心化联邦学习在非独立同分布数据下性能有限，不作为主要结论。

title: Neural Variance-aware Dueling Bandits with Deep Representation and Shallow Exploration
summary: We introduce the first variance-aware algorithms for contextual dueling bandits that leverage shallow exploration strategies with neural networks for nonlinear utility approximation. A key theoretical challenge is the absence of a closed-form estimator, which led prior work to require an extremely large network width $m$ (i.e., $m = \widetildeΩ(T^{14})$). We address this constraint with a novel analytical approach that combines iterative self-improvement with spectral analysis. Our analysis significantly reduces the network width requirement to $m = \widetildeΩ(T^{6})$, and shows that our algorithms achieve a sublinear regret of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^{T} σ_t^2} + \sqrt{dT})$ under both UCB and TS frameworks. Empirical results show that the proposed algorithms are not only computationally efficient and exhibit sublinear regret in practical settings, but also achieve state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个利用浅层探索策略与神经网络进行非线性效用逼近的方差感知上下文对决赌博算法，通过迭代自改进与谱分析相结合的新方法，将网络宽度需求从 $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{14})$ 显著降低至 $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{6})$，并在UCB和TS框架下实现了 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^{T} \sigma_t^2} + \sqrt{dT})$ 的次线性遗憾，实验证明算法计算高效且达到了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 上下文对决赌博算法中缺乏方差感知机制，且由于缺少闭式估计量，现有方法需要极大的网络宽度（$m = \widetilde{\Omega}(T^{14})$），计算成本过高，亟需降低网络宽度要求并引入方差感知策略。
AI.method: 提出了结合迭代自改进（iterative self-improvement）与谱分析（spectral analysis）的新型分析方法，在UCB和Thompson采样两种框架下设计方差感知算法，利用浅层探索策略与神经网络逼近非线性效用函数。
AI.result: ① 网络宽度需求从 $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{14})$ 降至 $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{6})$；② 在UCB和TS框架下均实现 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^{T} \sigma_t^2} + \sqrt{dT})$ 的次线性遗憾界；③ 合成数据与真实任务上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论创新大幅降低了神经网络对决赌博算法的网络宽度需求，证明了方差感知策略的有效性，为实际应用提供了计算高效且理论上保证的解决方案。

title: Uncovering Insights of Compound Flooding with Data-Driven AI
comment: Accepted to SIGKDD 2026 AI for Science Track; 12 Pages, 5 Figures, 6 Tables
summary: Compound flooding, driven by nonlinear interactions between multiple hydrometeorological factors, poses a significant challenge to hazard prevention. Existing forecasting approaches, whether physics-based or data-driven, often emphasize temporal patterns while underexploring how multiple interacting factors jointly shape flood dynamics. To address this problem, we conduct a large-scale data-driven analysis of compound flooding in South Florida, a typical area for compound flooding, by integrating tidal conditions, rainfall, groundwater stage, and human water management activities. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (i) models that capture temporal dynamics alone fail to represent multi-factor interactions during compound events; (ii) subsurface saturation, as reflected by groundwater levels, emerges as a dominant predictor of flood severity, often outweighing immediate rainfall intensity in this porous coastal region; and (iii) the spatial state of surrounding monitoring stations within a finite effective radius provides critical causal context for flooding, while extending temporal history yields diminishing returns during extreme events. These findings suggest that compound flooding is governed more by spatially coupled system states than by long-term temporal dependencies, challenging rain-centric and sequence-dominated forecasting paradigms. By framing data-driven models as tools for scientific inquiry rather than prediction alone, this study offers new insights into the mechanisms of compound flooding and informs the design of more physically grounded early-warning systems for coastal environments. Our dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/AslanDing/SFBench.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模数据驱动分析，揭示了南佛罗里达复合洪水由空间耦合系统状态主导，而非单纯的时间序列依赖，其中地下水位是比降雨强度更关键的预测因子，并且周边监测站的空间状态提供了关键因果背景。
AI.motivation: 现有洪水预报方法（无论是物理模型还是数据驱动）往往侧重时间模式，而忽略了多个相互作用的因素如何共同塑造洪水动态，尤其缺乏对复合洪水（由多种水文气象因素非线性相互作用驱动）中多因素联合作用的深入探索。
AI.method: 基于大规模数据驱动的分析方法，整合了潮汐条件、降雨量、地下水位和人类水管理活动等多源数据，对南佛罗里达这一典型复合洪水区域进行了系统性分析。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：(i) 仅捕捉时间动态的模型无法表征复合事件中的多因素交互；(ii) 地下水位（反映地下饱和程度）是洪水严重度的主导预测因子，在多孔沿海区域往往比即时降雨强度更重要；(iii) 有限有效半径内周边监测站的空间状态提供了关键的因果上下文，而延长时间历史在极端事件中收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 复合洪水更多由空间耦合系统状态主导而非长期时间依赖，挑战了以降雨为中心和序列主导的预报范式；数据驱动模型可作为科学探究工具而非仅用于预测，为沿海环境的物理基础预警系统设计提供了新见解。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
summary: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

AI.tldr: XIPER是一种跨域视频预测奖励模型，通过将智能体观测映射到专家领域并利用预测似然作为奖励信号，实现了从视觉不同领域的专家视频中进行强化学习，在DMC Color Suite、DMC Body Suite和sim-to-real迁移任务中均优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 从视觉不同的专家视频中进行强化学习面临两大挑战：缺乏奖励信号以及存在领域差异（如颜色、形态或sim-to-real差距），现有方法难以有效处理这些跨域问题。
AI.method: XIPER训练一个跨域视频预测模型，将智能体的观测映射到专家领域，然后使用该预测的似然作为奖励信号，从而弥合视觉域之间的差距。
AI.result: 在DMC Color Suite（8个任务）和DMC Body Suite（3个任务）上，XIPER在智能体颜色和形态存在差异的情况下 consistently 优于基线方法；在sim-to-real迁移数据集上，仅使用模拟专家视频即可为真实机器人观测产生有意义的奖励信号。
AI.conclusion: XIPER通过跨域视频预测有效解决了从视觉不同领域专家视频中进行强化学习的难题，特别在sim-to-real迁移场景下展示了实用价值。

title: MesaNet: Sequence Modeling by Locally Optimal Test-Time Training
summary: Sequence modeling is currently dominated by causal transformer architectures that use softmax self-attention. Although widely adopted, transformers require scaling memory and compute linearly during inference. A recent stream of work linearized the softmax operation, resulting in powerful recurrent neural network (RNN) models with constant memory and compute costs such as DeltaNet, Mamba or xLSTM. These models can be unified by noting that their recurrent layer dynamics can all be derived from an in-context regression objective, approximately optimized through an online learning rule. Here, we join this line of work and introduce a numerically stable, chunkwise parallelizable version of the recently proposed Mesa layer (von Oswald et al., 2024), which could only run sequentially in time and was therefore not scalable. This layer again stems from an in-context loss, but which is now minimized to optimality at every time point using a fast conjugate gradient solver. Through an extensive suite of experiments study up to the billion-parameter scale, we show that optimal test-time training enables reaching lower language modeling perplexity and higher downstream benchmark performance than previous RNNs, especially on tasks requiring long context understanding. This performance gain comes at the cost of additional flops spent during inference time. Our results are therefore intriguingly related to recent trends of increasing test-time compute to improve performance -- here by spending compute to solve sequential optimization problems within the neural network itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于共轭梯度求解器的最优测试时训练方法（Mesa层），通过分块并行化实现了数值稳定的高效计算，在十亿参数规模下展现出优于现有RNN（如DeltaNet、Mamba、xLSTM）的语言建模困惑度和长上下文理解性能，但代价是推理时额外的FLOPs开销。
AI.motivation: 现有因果Transformer在推理时需要线性增长的显存和计算量，而线性化softmax得到的RNN模型（如DeltaNet、Mamba、xLSTM）虽然具有常数复杂度，但其循环层动力学仅通过在线学习规则近似优化上下文回归目标，未能达到最优。Mesa层虽能通过精确优化每个时间点的上下文损失来提升性能，但原版只能串行运行，无法扩展至大规模。
AI.method: 提出Mesa层的数值稳定、分块可并行化版本：在每个时间点使用快速共轭梯度求解器将上下文损失最小化至最优，并设计分块并行计算策略以克服原版串行限制，实现可扩展训练和推理。
AI.result: 在十亿参数规模实验表明：相比现有RNN模型，该方法在语言建模困惑度上更低，下游基准性能更高，尤其在长上下文理解任务上优势显著；但性能提升伴随推理时额外的FLOPs消耗。
AI.conclusion: 该工作与当前增加测试时计算量以提升性能的趋势密切相关——通过在神经网络内部消耗计算资源来解决序列优化问题。这揭示了在模型架构中分配更多测试时计算资源来执行精确优化，可以换取更强的表达能力，为RNN类模型的发展提供了新方向。

title: P$^2$-DPO: Grounding Hallucination in Perceptual Processing via Calibration Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Hallucination has recently garnered significant research attention in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aims to learn directly from the corrected preferences provided by humans, thereby addressing the hallucination issue. Despite its success, this paradigm has yet to specifically target the perceptual bottleneck in attended regions or address insufficient Visual Robustness against image degradation. Furthermore, existing preference pairs are often vision-agnostic and their inherently off-policy nature limits their effectiveness in guiding model learning. To address these challenges, we propose Perceptual Processing Direct Preference Optimization (P$^2$-DPO), a novel training paradigm in which the model generates and learns from its own preference pairs, thereby directly addressing the identified visual bottlenecks while inherently avoiding the issues of vision-agnostic and off-policy data. It introduces: (1) an on-policy preference pairs construction method targeting Focus-and-Enhance perception and Visual Robustness, and (2) a well-designed Calibration Loss to precisely align visual signals with the causal generation of text. Experimental results demonstrate that with a comparable amount of training data and cost, P$^2$-DPO outperforms strong baselines that rely on costly human feedback on benchmarks. Furthermore, evaluations on Attention Region Fidelity (ARF) and image degradation scenarios validate the effectiveness of P$^2$-DPO in addressing perceptual bottleneck in attended regions and improving Visual Robustness against degraded inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P²-DPO（感知处理直接偏好优化），一种让大视觉语言模型自行生成并学习自身偏好对的新训练范式，通过聚焦感知瓶颈和视觉鲁棒性的在线偏好对构建方法及校准损失函数，有效缓解幻觉问题，在相当训练数据量下超越依赖昂贵人类反馈的强基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有DPO方法存在三个问题：(1) 未针对性解决注意力区域的感知瓶颈和图像退化下的视觉鲁棒性不足；(2) 偏好对通常是视觉无关的（vision-agnostic）；(3) 偏好对的离策略（off-policy）性质限制了模型学习效果。
AI.method: 提出P²-DPO训练范式，包含：(1) 在线策略偏好对构建方法，针对Focus-and-Enhance感知和视觉鲁棒性；(2) 校准损失函数（Calibration Loss），用于精确对齐视觉信号与文本的因果生成。
AI.result: 在相当训练数据量和成本下，P²-DPO在基准测试中优于依赖昂贵人类反馈的强基线；在注意力区域保真度（ARF）和图像退化场景的评估中，验证了其在缓解感知瓶颈和提升视觉鲁棒性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: P²-DPO通过自生成在线偏好对和校准损失，有效解决了现有DPO在视觉感知瓶颈和鲁棒性方面的不足，为LVLMs幻觉缓解提供了更高效、更精准的新范式。

title: Reusing Trajectories in Policy Gradients Enables Fast Convergence
