This paper introduces Variance-Gated Ensembles (VGE), an intuitive, differentiable framework that injects epistemic sensitivity via a signal-to-noise gate computed from ensemble statistics. VGE provides: (i) a Variance-Gated Margin Uncertainty (VGMU) score that couples decision margins with ensemble predictive variance; and (ii) a Variance-Gated Normalization (VGN) layer that generalizes the variance-gated uncertainty mechanism to training via per-class, learnable normalization of ensemble member probabilities. We derive closed-form vector-Jacobian products enabling end-to-end training through ensemble sample mean and variance. VGE matches or exceeds state-of-the-art information-theoretic baselines while remaining computationally efficient. As a result, VGE provides a practical and scalable approach to epistemic-aware uncertainty estimation in ensemble models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方差门控集成（VGE）框架，通过信号-噪声门控机制将认知不确定性注入集成模型，在保持计算效率的同时匹配或超越现有最先进的不确定性估计方法。
AI.motivation: 传统不确定性分解方法（将不确定性加性分解为偶然不确定性和认知不确定性）在使用有限集成采样或不匹配的预测分布时失效，需要一种更鲁棒且可扩展的不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: 提出VGE框架，包含两个核心组件：(i) 方差门控边际不确定性（VGMU）评分，将决策边际与集成预测方差耦合；(ii) 方差门控归一化（VGN）层，通过每类可学习的集成成员概率归一化将不确定性机制扩展到训练过程。推导了闭式向量-雅可比积以实现端到端训练。
AI.result: VGE在保持计算高效的同时，匹配或超越了基于信息论的最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VGE为集成模型提供了一种实用且可扩展的认知感知不确定性估计方法，解决了传统加性分解在有限集成采样下的失效问题。

title: Learning to Remember, Learn, and Forget in Attention-Based Models
summary: In-Context Learning (ICL) in transformers acts as an online associative memory and is believed to underpin their high performance on complex sequence processing tasks. However, in gated linear attention models, this memory has a fixed capacity and is prone to interference, especially for long sequences. We propose Palimpsa, a self-attention model that views ICL as a continual learning problem that must address a stability-plasticity dilemma. Palimpsa uses Bayesian metaplasticity, where the plasticity of each attention state is tied to an importance state grounded by a prior distribution that captures accumulated knowledge. We demonstrate that various gated linear attention models emerge as specific architecture choices and posterior approximations, and that Mamba2 is a special case of Palimpsa where forgetting dominates. This theoretical link enables the transformation of any non-metaplastic model into a metaplastic one, significantly expanding its memory capacity. Our experiments show that Palimpsa consistently outperforms baselines on the Multi-Query Associative Recall (MQAR) benchmark and on Commonsense Reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: Palimpsa将Transformer中的上下文学习视为持续学习问题，通过贝叶斯元可塑性机制解决稳定性-可塑性困境，显著扩展了注意力模型的记忆容量，并在MQAR和常识推理任务上优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的门控线性注意力模型在上下文学习中存在固定记忆容量和长序列干扰问题，作者希望解决这种稳定性-可塑性困境，从而扩展模型的长序列处理能力。
AI.method: 提出Palimpsa自注意力模型，将上下文学习建模为持续学习问题，利用贝叶斯元可塑性机制将每个注意力状态的塑性绑定到一个重要性状态，该状态由捕获累积知识的先验分布驱动。通过理论推导证明多种门控线性注意力模型是Palimpsa的特定架构选择和后验近似，Mamba2是遗忘主导的特例。
AI.result: Palimpsa在Multi-Query Associative Recall (MQAR)基准测试和常识推理任务上持续优于基线模型。非元塑性模型可通过该理论框架转化为元塑性模型，显著扩展记忆容量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文学习重新定义为持续学习问题并引入贝叶斯元可塑性，Palimpsa有效解决了注意力模型的记忆容量和干扰问题，为改进现有非元塑性模型提供了理论基础和实践路径。

title: It's TIME: Towards the Next Generation of Time Series Forecasting Benchmarks
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are revolutionizing the forecasting landscape from specific dataset modeling to generalizable task evaluation. However, we contend that existing benchmarks exhibit common limitations in four dimensions: constrained data composition dominated by reused legacy sources, compromised data integrity lacking rigorous quality assurance, misaligned task formulations detached from real-world contexts, and rigid analysis perspectives that obscure generalizable insights. To bridge these gaps, we introduce TIME, a next-generation task-centric benchmark comprising 50 fresh datasets and 98 forecasting tasks, tailored for strict zero-shot TSFM evaluation free from data leakage. Integrating large language models and human expertise, we establish a human-in-the-loop benchmark construction pipeline to ensure high data integrity and redefine task formulation by aligning forecasting configurations with real-world operational requirements and variate predictability. Furthermore, we propose a novel pattern-level evaluation perspective that moves beyond traditional dataset-level evaluations based on static meta labels. By leveraging structural time series features to characterize intrinsic temporal properties, this approach offers generalizable insights into model capabilities across diverse patterns. We evaluate 12 TSFMs and establish a multi-granular leaderboard to facilitate in-depth analysis and visualized inspection. The leaderboard is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/Real-TSF/TIME-leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIME基准，包含50个新数据集和98个预测任务，用于零样本时间序列基础模型评估。通过人机协同的构建流程保证数据完整性，重新定义任务公式以匹配真实世界需求，并提出基于模式级结构特征的新评估视角，建立多粒度排行榜评估12个TSFM模型。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型基准存在四方面局限：数据构成受限（重复使用旧数据集）、数据完整性缺乏质量保证、任务公式脱离真实场景、分析视角僵化无法提供通用洞察。
AI.method: 1) 构建含50个新数据集和98个预测任务的TIME基准；2) 采用大语言模型与人类专家结合的人机协同构建流程确保数据完整性；3) 通过对齐预测配置与真实运维需求及变量可预测性重新定义任务公式；4) 提出基于结构化时序特征的模式级评估视角替代传统数据集级静态元标签评估。
AI.result: 评估了12个TSFM模型，建立了多粒度排行榜，并提供可视化检查，排行榜已公开在Hugging Face平台。
AI.conclusion: TIME基准通过解决现有基准的四项关键局限，为TSFM的零样本评估提供了更可靠、更贴近真实世界的测试平台，其模式级评估视角为模型能力的通用化洞察提供了新方向。

title: Unifying Model-Free Efficiency and Model-Based Representations via Latent Dynamics
comment: Similarities found with a prior work. Hence, requesting for withdrawal until further notice
summary: We present Unified Latent Dynamics (ULD), a novel reinforcement learning algorithm that unifies the efficiency of model-free methods with the representational strengths of model-based approaches, without incurring planning overhead. By embedding state-action pairs into a latent space in which the true value function is approximately linear, our method supports a single set of hyperparameters across diverse domains -- from continuous control with low-dimensional and pixel inputs to high-dimensional Atari games. We prove that, under mild conditions, the fixed point of our embedding-based temporal-difference updates coincides with that of a corresponding linear model-based value expansion, and we derive explicit error bounds relating embedding fidelity to value approximation quality. In practice, ULD employs synchronized updates of encoder, value, and policy networks, auxiliary losses for short-horizon predictive dynamics, and reward-scale normalization to ensure stable learning under sparse rewards. Evaluated on 80 environments spanning Gym locomotion, DeepMind Control (proprioceptive and visual), and Atari, our approach matches or exceeds the performance of specialized model-free and general model-based baselines -- achieving cross-domain competence with minimal tuning and a fraction of the parameter footprint. These results indicate that value-aligned latent representations alone can deliver the adaptability and sample efficiency traditionally attributed to full model-based planning.

AI.tldr: 提出统一潜态动力学（ULD）算法，通过将状态-动作对嵌入到值函数近似线性的潜空间，统一了无模型方法的效率和基于模型方法的表征能力，无需规划开销，在80个环境上以单一超参数集达到或超越专门方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无模型方法效率高但表征能力有限，基于模型方法表征能力强但需规划开销且泛化性差，缺乏一种能兼顾两者优势且无需规划的统一算法。
AI.method: 将状态-动作对嵌入到值函数近似线性的潜空间；证明该嵌入的时序差分不动点与线性模型值扩展一致；采用编码器、值网络、策略网络的同步更新，辅助短时域预测动态损失，以及奖励尺度归一化。
AI.result: 在80个环境（Gym locomotion、DeepMind Control、Atari）上，以单一超参数集匹配或超越专门的无模型和通用基于模型的基线方法，参数开销更小。
AI.conclusion: 与值对齐的潜表征本身即可提供传统上归因于完整模型规划的适应性和样本效率，跨领域能力可仅通过嵌入学习实现。

title: A Unified Framework for Locality in Scalable MARL
summary: Scalable methods for networked multi-agent reinforcement learning let each agent plan using only a small neighborhood of the agent graph. This works only when the system is value-local, meaning a perturbation at one agent affects the long-run value at another agent weakly when the two are far apart. In the average-reward setting, the standard way to certify locality is the Dobrushin row-sum bound on a single matrix $C^π$ that captures how each agent's next state depends on each other agent's current state. To make this matrix easy to work with, prior work bounds it by a supremum over joint actions. The resulting bound is independent of the policy, but it is loose whenever the policy never picks the worst-case action. We split $C^π$ into pieces that separately track environment sensitivity and policy sensitivity, $C^π\preceq E^{\mathrm s}+E^{\mathrm a}Π(π)$, where $E^{\mathrm s}$ measures how the next state moves with the current state, $E^{\mathrm a}$ measures how it moves with the current action, and $Π(π)$ measures how reactive the policy is to changes in state. The spectral radius of $H^π:= E^{\mathrm s}+E^{\mathrm a}Π(π)$ then controls the decay of the average-reward Poisson solution, and the spectral certificate $ρ(H^π)<1$ is strictly weaker than the row-sum condition $\|H^π\|_\infty<1$ on the same matrix and applies in regimes where policy-independent action-supremum bounds used in prior Dobrushin-style work cannot. For temperature-$τ$ softmax policies we get $Π(π)\le L/(2τ)$, so the softmax temperature directly controls locality. We use this decay result to give a deterministic oracle guarantee for a block-coordinate KL-proximal policy-improvement template whose truncation bias decays exponentially in the message-passing radius $κ$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的谱方法来判断多智能体强化学习中的值局部性（value locality），通过将耦合矩阵C^π分解为环境敏感度E^s和策略敏感度E^aΠ(π)两部分，证明了谱半径条件ρ(H^π)<1比传统的Dobrushin行和条件更弱且适用性更广，并给出了softmax温度参数与局部性的直接关联，以及块坐标KL近端策略改进模板的确定性理论保证。
AI.motivation: 在 networked multi-agent reinforcement learning 中，可扩展方法要求系统具有值局部性（value locality），即远端智能体的扰动对本地智能体的长期价值影响很小。现有方法使用Dobrushin行和条件来认证值局部性，但该条件基于对联合动作的上确界（supremum over joint actions）进行放缩，导致结果与策略无关且过于宽松。本文旨在提出一种更紧且策略相关的条件来刻画值局部性。
AI.method: 将耦合矩阵C^π分解为E^s（环境敏感度：下一状态如何随当前状态变化）和E^aΠ(π)（策略敏感度：下一状态如何随当前动作变化，其中Π(π)度量策略对状态变化的反应性）两部分，然后定义H^π = E^s + E^aΠ(π)，利用H^π的谱半径ρ(H^π)来控制平均奖励泊松解的衰减。对于温度τ的softmax策略，进一步推导出Π(π) ≤ L/(2τ)的界。
AI.result: 证明了谱条件ρ(H^π)<1严格弱于传统Dobrushin行和条件∥H^π∥_∞<1，且适用于策略无关的动作上确界方法无法处理的场景。softmax温度参数τ直接控制局部性：温度越低，局部性越强。基于该衰减结果，给出了消息传递半径κ的块坐标KL近端策略改进模板，其截断偏差随κ指数衰减。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的谱证书（spectral certificate）为多智能体强化学习的值局部性提供了更精确且策略相关的刻画，揭示了策略（尤其是softmax温度）对局部性的直接影响，并为可扩展的多智能体强化学习算法提供了更坚实的理论基础。

title: Sparse Bayesian Deep Functional Learning with Structured Region Selection
summary: In modern applications such as ECG monitoring, neuroimaging, wearable sensing, and industrial equipment diagnostics, complex and continuously structured data are ubiquitous, presenting both challenges and opportunities for functional data analysis. However, existing methods face a critical trade-off: conventional functional models are limited by linearity, whereas deep learning approaches lack interpretable region selection for sparse effects. To bridge these gaps, we propose a sparse Bayesian functional deep neural network (sBayFDNN). It learns adaptive functional embeddings through a deep Bayesian architecture to capture complex nonlinear relationships, while a structured prior enables interpretable, region-wise selection of influential domains with quantified uncertainty. Theoretically, we establish rigorous approximation error bounds, posterior consistency, and region selection consistency. These results provide the first theoretical guarantees for a Bayesian deep functional model, ensuring its reliability and statistical rigor. Empirically, comprehensive simulations and real-world studies confirm the effectiveness and superiority of sBayFDNN. Crucially, sBayFDNN excels in recognizing intricate dependencies for accurate predictions and more precisely identifies functionally meaningful regions, capabilities fundamentally beyond existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种稀疏贝叶斯函数深度神经网络（sBayFDNN），通过深度贝叶斯架构学习自适应函数嵌入以捕捉复杂非线性关系，并利用结构化先验实现可解释的区域选择，首次为贝叶斯深度函数模型提供了近似误差界、后验一致性和区域选择一致性的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 现有函数数据分析方法面临关键权衡：传统函数模型受限于线性性，而深度学习方法缺乏可解释的区域选择来识别稀疏效应。
AI.method: 提出sBayFDNN，包括：(1) 深度贝叶斯架构学习自适应函数嵌入，捕捉复杂非线性关系；(2) 结构化先验实现可解释的、区域化的显著域选择，并提供量化不确定性。
AI.result: 理论方面建立了逼近误差界、后验一致性和区域选择一致性；经验方面通过综合模拟和真实研究验证了有效性和优越性。
AI.conclusion: sBayFDNN在识别复杂依赖关系以进行准确预测和精确定位功能上有意义的区域方面显著优于现有方法，且首次为贝叶斯深度函数模型提供了理论保障。

title: Does Order Matter : Connecting The Law of Robustness to Robust Generalization
summary: Bubeck and Selke (2021) propose the connection between the Law of Robustness and robust generalization error as an open problem. The Law of Robustness states that overparameterization is necessary for models to interpolate robustly, i.e., the interpolating function is required to be Lipschitz. Wu et al. (2023) extend this law to arbitrary data distributions, proving that the Lipschitz constant satisfies $L = Ω(n^{1/d})$. Robust generalization, on the other hand, asks whether small robust training loss implies small robust test loss. This can be studied using statistical learning techniques such as Rademacher complexities, where a bound on the Rademacher complexity of the robust loss class implies a bound on the Lipschitzness of the function class. We use this connection to explicitly link the two for arbitrary data distributions. (i) We prove that the order of the Lipschitz bound remains the same when considering the global Rademacher complexity of robust loss classes. (ii) At the local scale, i.e., for subsets of functions with small empirical error, the order of the Lipschitz bound changes with the perturbation radius $ρ$ and the localized concentration term $\sqrt{r/n}$.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了稳健性定律（Lipschitz常数下界）与稳健泛化误差（Rademacher复杂度上界）之间的显式联系，证明全局尺度下Lipschitz界阶数不变，而局部尺度下该界随扰动半径和局部化浓度项变化。
AI.motivation: Bubeck和Selke将稳健性定律与稳健泛化误差之间的联系视为开放问题，本文旨在为任意数据分布建立两者之间的显式联系。
AI.method: 利用Rademacher复杂度理论，将稳健损失函数类的Rademacher复杂度上界与函数类的Lipschitz性质联系起来，分别在全局和局部尺度下分析Lipschitz界的变化。
AI.result: (i) 全局Rademacher复杂度下，Lipschitz界的阶数保持不变；(ii) 局部尺度下（小经验误差函数子集），Lipschitz界的阶数随扰动半径ρ和局部化浓度项√(r/n)变化。
AI.conclusion: 成功建立了稳健性定律与稳健泛化误差之间的显式理论联系，揭示了不同尺度下二者的定量关系。

title: Breaking the Scale Barrier: One-Shot Knowledge Transfer via Frequency Transform
summary: Transferring knowledge by fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained networks has become a standard paradigm for downstream tasks, yet the knowledge of a pre-trained model is tightly coupled with monolithic architecture, which restricts flexible reuse across models of varying scales. In response to this challenge, recent approaches typically resort to either parameter selection, which fails to capture the interdependent structure of this knowledge, or parameter prediction using generative models that depend on impractical access to large network collections. In this paper, we identify the low-frequency components of model weights as the concrete carrier of foundational, task-agnostic knowledge, its ``learngene", and validate this by demonstrating its efficient inheritance by downstream models and tasks. Based on this insight, we propose FRONT (FRequency dOmain kNowledge Transfer), a novel framework that uses the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) to isolate the low-frequency ``learngene". This learngene can be seamlessly adapted to initialize models of arbitrary size via simple truncation or padding, a process that is entirely training-free. For enhanced performance, we propose an optional low-cost refinement process that introduces a spectral regularizer to further improve the learngene's transferability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FRONT achieves the state-of-the-art performance, accelerates convergence by up to $15\times$ in vision tasks, and reduces training FLOPs by an average of 40.5% in language tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/LUcy0505/FRONT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FRONT框架，利用离散余弦变换(DCT)从预训练模型中提取低频成分作为"learngene"（可继承的基础知识），通过简单的截断或填充操作即可将其适配到任意规模的模型，无需训练即可实现知识迁移，且可选的低成本微调过程能进一步提升迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 预训练大模型的知识与单一架构紧密耦合，难以灵活地在不同规模模型间复用。现有方法要么通过参数选择（无法捕捉知识的内在结构），要么依赖生成模型进行参数预测（需要访问大规模网络集合，不切实际）。
AI.method: 1) 发现模型权重的低频成分是任务无关基础知识的载体（learngene）；2) 使用DCT分离低频成分；3) 通过截断或填充将learngene适配到任意大小模型（训练无关）；4) 可选：引入频谱正则化器进行低成本优化提升迁移性。
AI.result: 在视觉任务中加速收敛最高达15倍，在语言任务中平均减少40.5%的训练FLOPs，达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: FRONT框架通过频域知识提取实现了高效、灵活、无需训练的跨规模模型知识迁移，验证了低频权重成分作为通用知识载体的有效性。

title: Good Reasoning Makes Good Demonstrations: Implicit Reasoning Quality Supervision via In-Context Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in large language models but treats all correct solutions equally, potentially reinforcing flawed traces that arrive at correct answers by chance. We observe that \emph{better reasoning makes better demonstrations}: high-quality solutions serve as more effective in-context examples than low-quality ones. We term this teaching ability \textbf{Demonstration Utility}, and show that the policy model's own in-context learning ability provides an efficient way to measure it, yielding a quality signal termed \textbf{Evidence Gain}. To leverage this signal during training, we introduce \textbf{In-Context RLVR}, which prepends demonstrations before each rollout. Theoretically, we prove that this simple input modification implicitly reweights rewards by a factor approximately proportional to Evidence Gain, assigning higher weights to high-quality traces without requiring costly computation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in both accuracy and reasoning quality over standard RLVR baselines. Our codes and datasets are available at https://github.com/Mithas-114/IC-DAPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出In-Context RLVR方法，通过在rollout前添加优质示范来隐式地按证据增益重加权奖励，从而提升大语言模型推理的质量和准确性，而无需额外计算成本。
AI.motivation: 标准的RLVR对所有正确答案一视同仁，可能强化那些偶然得出正确答案但推理过程有缺陷的轨迹。作者观察到高质量解决方案比低质量方案作为上下文示例更有效，因此希望利用这一特性来改进训练信号。
AI.method: 提出Demonstration Utility和Evidence Gain概念，利用策略模型自身的上下文学习能力来度量示范质量。In-Context RLVR在每次rollout前将高质量示范添加到输入中，理论证明这种修改能隐式地将奖励按Evidence Gain比例重加权，从而自动给高质量轨迹更高权重。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和推理质量上均一致优于标准RLVR基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练中引入高质量的上下文示范，可以有效提升策略模型的推理质量，且该方法简单高效，不增加额外计算成本。

title: Efficient Reasoning on the Edge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought reasoning achieve state-of-the-art performance across complex problem-solving tasks, but their verbose reasoning traces and large context requirements make them impractical for edge deployment. These challenges include high token generation costs, large KV-cache footprints, and inefficiencies when distilling reasoning capabilities into smaller models for mobile devices. Existing approaches often rely on distilling reasoning traces from larger models into smaller models, which are verbose and stylistically redundant, undesirable for on-device inference. In this work, we propose a lightweight approach to enable reasoning in small LLMs using LoRA adapters combined with supervised fine-tuning. We further introduce budget forcing via reinforcement learning on these adapters, significantly reducing response length with minimal accuracy loss. To address memory-bound decoding, we exploit parallel test-time scaling, improving accuracy at minor latency increase. Finally, we present a dynamic adapter-switching mechanism that activates reasoning only when needed and a KV-cache sharing strategy during prompt encoding, reducing time-to-first-token for on-device inference. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B demonstrate that our method achieves efficient, accurate reasoning under strict resource constraints, making LLM reasoning practical for mobile scenarios. Videos demonstrating our solution running on mobile devices are available on our project page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级方法，通过LoRA适配器结合监督微调使小型LLM具备推理能力，并引入强化学习的预算控制、并行测试时扩展、动态适配器切换和KV-cache共享策略，在Qwen2.5-7B上实现了资源受限下的高效准确推理，适用于移动端部署。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在复杂问题解决任务中表现出色，但其冗长的推理轨迹和大上下文需求导致高令牌生成成本、大KV-cache占用，不适合边缘部署。现有蒸馏方法将冗长冗余的推理轨迹迁移到小模型，效率低下。因此需要一种轻量级方法使小模型在资源严格受限下实现高效推理。
AI.method: 1) 使用LoRA适配器结合监督微调使小型LLM具备推理能力；2) 在适配器上引入基于强化学习的预算控制，显著减少响应长度且精度损失极小；3) 利用并行测试时扩展，以较小延迟增加换取精度提升；4) 设计动态适配器切换机制，仅在需要时激活推理；5) 在提示编码阶段采用KV-cache共享策略，减少移动端推理的首令牌时间。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B上的实验表明，该方法能在严格资源约束下实现高效、准确的推理，使LLM推理在移动场景下变得实用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过组合多种轻量级技术（LoRA微调、强化学习预算控制、并行解码、动态适配器切换、KV-cache共享），成功将推理能力高效部署到移动设备，为边缘端LLM推理提供了实用方案。

title: AgentDS Technical Report: Benchmarking the Future of Human-AI Collaboration in Domain-Specific Data Science
summary: Data science plays a critical role in transforming complex data into actionable insights across numerous domains. Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents have significantly automated data science workflow. However, it remains unclear to what extent AI agents can match the performance of human experts on domain-specific data science tasks, and in which aspects human expertise continues to provide advantages. We introduce AgentDS, a benchmark and competition designed to evaluate both AI agents and human-AI collaboration performance in domain-specific data science. AgentDS consists of 17 challenges across six industries: commerce, food production, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, and retail banking. We conducted an open competition involving 29 teams and 80 participants, enabling systematic comparison between human-AI collaborative approaches and AI-only baselines. Our results show that current AI agents struggle with domain-specific reasoning. AI-only baselines perform below the top quartile of competition participants, while the strongest solutions arise from human-AI collaboration. These findings challenge the narrative of complete automation by AI and underscore the enduring importance of human expertise in data science, while illuminating directions for the next generation of AI. Visit the AgentDS website here: https://agentds.org/ and open source datasets here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lainmn/AgentDS .

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AgentDS，一个用于评估AI智能体和人类-AI协作在特定领域数据科学任务中表现的基准测试和竞赛。通过涵盖6个行业的17个挑战，对29支队伍和80名参与者进行对比，结果表明当前AI智能体在领域特定推理上存在困难，纯AI基线表现低于参赛者前25%，而最强的解决方案来自人机协作。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型和AI智能体在数据科学工作流自动化方面取得了显著进展，但目前尚不清楚AI智能体在领域特定的数据科学任务中能否达到人类专家的表现水平，以及人类专业知识在哪些方面仍然具有优势。
AI.method: 构建了包含17个跨行业挑战的AgentDS基准测试（涵盖商业、食品生产、医疗、保险、制造和零售银行6个行业），并组织了开放竞赛，对29支队伍和80名参与者进行系统比较，包括人机协作方法和纯AI基线方法。
AI.result: 当前AI智能体在领域特定推理方面表现不佳；纯AI基线的表现低于参赛者前25%的水平；最强解决方案来自人类-AI协作。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现挑战了AI完全自动化的叙事，强调了人类专业知识在数据科学中的持久重要性，同时为下一代AI的发展指明了方向。

title: ALMAB-DC: Active Learning, Multi-Armed Bandits, and Distributed Computing for Sequential Experimental Design and Black-Box Optimization
summary:
Sequential experimental design under expensive, gradient-free objectives is a central challenge in computational statistics: evaluation budgets are tightly constrained and information must be extracted efficiently from each observation. We propose \textbf{ALMAB-DC}, a GP-based sequential design framework combining active learning, multi-armed bandits (MAB), and distributed asynchronous computing for expensive black-box experimentation. A Gaussian process surrogate with uncertainty-aware acquisition identifies informative query points; a UCB or Thompson-sampling bandit controller allocates evaluations across parallel workers; and an asynchronous scheduler handles heterogeneous runtimes. We present cumulative regret bounds for the bandit components and characterize parallel scalability via Amdahl's Law.
  We validate ALMAB-DC on five benchmarks. On the two statistical experimental-design tasks, ALMAB-DC achieves lower simple regret than Equal Spacing, Random, and D-optimal designs in dose--response optimization, and in adaptive spatial field estimation matches the Greedy Max-Variance benchmark while outperforming Latin Hypercube Sampling; at $K=4$ the distributed setting reaches target performance in one-quarter of sequential wall-clock rounds. On three ML/engineering tasks (CIFAR-10 HPO, CFD drag minimization, MuJoCo RL), ALMAB-DC achieves 93.4\% CIFAR-10 accuracy (outperforming BOHB by 1.7\,pp and Optuna by 1.1\,pp), reduces airfoil drag to $C_D = 0.059$ (36.9\% below Grid Search), and improves RL return by 50\% over Grid Search. All advantages over non-ALMAB baselines are statistically significant under Bonferroni-corrected Mann--Whitney $U$ tests. Distributed execution achieves $7.5\times$ speedup at $K = 16$ agents, consistent with Amdahl's Law.

AI.tldr: 提出ALMAB-DC框架，结合高斯过程、多臂老虎机和异步计算，用于昂贵黑箱实验的序列设计，在统计实验、ML/工程等任务上优于多种基线方法，分布式可实现7.5倍加速。
AI.motivation: 在昂贵、无梯度目标函数下的序列实验设计面临评估预算紧张、信息提取效率要求高的核心挑战，现有方法在并行扩展性和不确定性感知方面存在不足。
AI.method: 基于高斯过程代理模型结合不确定性感知采集函数（UCB/汤普森采样），多臂老虎机控制器分配并行工作节点评估任务，异步调度器处理异构运行时间，构成ALMAB-DC框架。
AI.result: 在5个基准任务上：剂量-响应优化中低于等间距/随机/D最优设计；空间场估计匹配贪婪最大方差基准；CIFAR-10 HPO达93.4%准确率（超BOHB 1.7pp、Optuna 1.1pp）；翼型阻力降至0.059（低于网格搜索36.9%）；RL回报提升50%；K=16时达7.5倍加速。
AI.conclusion: ALMAB-DC在统计实验设计及ML/工程黑箱优化任务中均显著优于基线方法，分布式异步计算有效加速实验进程，累积遗憾界和Amdahl定律分析提供了理论保证。

title: Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a central post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Yet existing methods share a common blind spot: they optimize policies based on instantaneous group-level or batch-level statistics without ever verifying whether the resulting update actually improved the model. This open-loop design -- updating in isolation at each step, guided only by within-group (batch) reward signals -- means optimization can drift or collapse with no mechanism to detect and correct these failures. We argue that the missing ingredient is policy improvement feedback: the ability to measure and optimize inter-iteration progress directly. To this end, we introduce Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning (PIRL), a framework that replaces surrogate reward maximization with the explicit objective of maximizing cumulative policy improvement across iterations, and prove this temporal objective is perfectly aligned with maximizing final task performance. Building on PIRL, we propose Policy Improvement Policy Optimization (PIPO), which implements closed-loop optimization through retrospective verification. At each iteration, PIPO evaluates whether the previous update yielded genuine improvement against a sliding-window historical baseline, then actively reinforces beneficial updates and suppresses the harmful ones -- transforming an open-loop process into a self-correcting one. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PIPO performs ascent on the PIRL objective in expectation, and experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved stability and performance over GRPO and its variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIRL框架和PIPO算法，通过引入策略改进反馈（跨迭代的闭环验证）替代传统的组级奖励最大化，将强化学习的开环优化转变为自纠正的闭环过程，在数学推理基准上提升了稳定性和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法存在盲点：优化基于瞬时组级/批级统计量，无法验证更新是否真正改进了模型。这种开环设计可能导致优化漂移或崩溃，缺乏检测和纠正机制。
AI.method: 1) PIRL框架：以最大化跨迭代的累积策略改进为显式目标，取代替代奖励最大化；2) PIPO算法：通过回溯验证实现闭环优化——每次迭代评估前一次更新是否带来真实改进（基于滑动窗口历史基线），主动强化有益更新、抑制有害更新。
AI.result: 理论证明PIPO在期望上对PIRL目标进行上升；实验在数学推理基准上展示了优于GRPO及其变体的稳定性和性能。
AI.conclusion: 引入策略改进反馈（跨迭代进度测量）是RLVR中缺失的关键要素，闭环自纠正机制能够有效提升强化学习训练大语言模型推理能力的稳定性和最终性能。

title: Orthogonal Learner for Estimating Heterogeneous Long-Term Treatment Effects
summary: Estimation of heterogeneous long-term treatment effects (HLTEs) is relevant for personalized decision-making in marketing, economics, and medicine, where short-term observational datasets are often combined with long-term observational datasets. However, HLTE estimation is challenging due to limited overlap in treatment assignments or in long-term outcomes for certain subpopulations, which can lead to unstable HLTE estimates with large finite-sample variance. To address this challenge, we introduce the LT-O-learners (Long-Term Orthogonal Learners), a set of novel orthogonal learners for HLTE estimation in the canonical HLTE setting with surrogacy. The key idea of our LT-O-learners is to retarget the loss via custom overlap weights that downweight low-overlap samples. We show that the retargeted loss recovers the true HLTE pointwise and satisfies Neyman-orthogonality. We further prove two key theoretical results: (i) The nuisance error enters the error bound only through higher-order terms, which means our learners are robust to nuisance estimation error. (ii) Under a linear function class, the retargeting effectively controls the asymptotic variance of the HLTE estimator via the overlap weights in low-overlap regimes. We conduct experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets to confirm the theoretical properties of our LT-O-learners, particularly robustness in low-overlap regimes. To our knowledge, ours are the first orthogonal learners for HLTE estimation robust to low overlap in long-term settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LT-O-learners（长周期正交学习器），通过重定目标损失并引入自定义重叠权重，解决异构长周期治疗效果（HLTE）估计中因低重叠导致的有限样本方差大和估计不稳定问题，在理论（Neyman正交性、渐近方差控制）和实验（合成与真实数据）上验证了其在低重叠场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在营销、经济和医学等领域的个性化决策中，需要估计异构长周期治疗效果（HLTE），但短周期与长周期观测数据的有限重叠（包括治疗分配重叠不足和长周期结局重叠不足）导致HLTE估计不稳定且有限样本方差大，现有方法缺乏对此问题的有效处理。
AI.method: 提出LT-O-learners，核心思想是通过自定义重叠权重对损失函数进行重定目标（retargeting），降低低重叠样本的权重；理论分析证明重定目标后的损失能逐点恢复真实HLTE且满足Neyman正交性，并证明在低重叠场景下通过重叠权重有效控制渐近方差。
AI.result: 理论结果：（i）干扰误差仅通过高阶项进入误差界，即对干扰估计误差具有鲁棒性；（ii）在线性函数类下，重定目标通过重叠权重有效控制HLTE估计量的渐近方差。实验结果表明LT-O-learners在低重叠场景下具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: LT-O-learners是首个在长周期低重叠场景下实现鲁棒HLTE估计的正交学习器，填补了该领域的空白。

title: Reasoning Shift: How Context Silently Shortens LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibiting test-time scaling behavior, such as extended reasoning traces and self-verification, have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex, long-term reasoning tasks. However, the robustness of these reasoning behaviors remains underexplored. To investigate this, we conduct a systematic evaluation of multiple reasoning models across three scenarios: (1) problems augmented with lengthy, irrelevant context; (2) multi-turn conversational settings with independent tasks; and (3) problems presented as a subtask within a complex task. We observe an interesting phenomenon: reasoning models tend to produce much shorter reasoning traces (up to 65%) for the same problem under different context conditions compared to the traces produced when the problem is presented in isolation. A finer-grained analysis reveals that this compression is associated with a decrease in self-verification and uncertainty management behaviors, such as double-checking. While this behavioral shift does not compromise performance on straightforward problems, it might affect performance on more challenging tasks. Additionally, we show that targeted supervised fine-tuning partially mitigates the adverse effects of irrelevant context. We hope our findings draw additional attention to both the robustness of reasoning models and the problem of context management for LLMs and LLM-based agents.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了推理型大语言模型在不同上下文条件下的鲁棒性，发现模型在遇到冗长无关上下文、多轮对话或复杂子任务时，推理链长度显著压缩（最高达65%），伴随自我验证和不确定性管理行为减少，虽不影响简单任务但可能损害复杂任务表现，而针对性的监督微调可部分缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: 推理型LLM在长程推理任务中表现出色，但其推理行为的鲁棒性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 对多个推理模型进行系统评估，涵盖三种场景：添加冗长无关上下文的问题、多轮对话中的独立任务、作为复杂子任务的问题；通过对比推理链长度和微观行为（自我验证、不确定性管理）进行分析。
AI.result: 不同上下文条件下，模型对同一问题的推理链长度最多压缩65%，自我验证和双重检查等行为减少；简单任务性能不受影响，但复杂任务可能受损；监督微调可部分缓解无关上下文的负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 推理模型的推理行为在上下文变化时表现出显著不鲁棒性，需关注推理模型鲁棒性及LLM/智能体的上下文管理问题。

title: Adalina: Adaptive Linear Approximation for the Shapley Value and Beyond
summary: The Shapley value, and its broader family of semi-values, has received much attention in various attribution problems. A fundamental and long-standing challenge is their efficient approximation, since exact computation generally requires an exponential number of utility queries in the number of players $n$. To meet the challenges of large-scale applications, we explore the limits of efficiently approximating semi-values under a $Θ(n)$ space constraint. Building upon a vector concentration inequality, we establish a theoretical framework that enables sharper query complexities for existing unbiased randomized algorithms. Within this framework, we systematically develop a linear-space algorithm that requires $O(\frac{n}{ε^{2}}\log\frac{1}δ)$ utility queries to ensure $P(\|\hat{\boldsymbolφ}-\boldsymbolφ\|_{2}\geqε)\leq δ$ for all commonly used semi-values. In particular, our framework naturally bridges OFA, unbiased kernelSHAP, SHAP-IQ and the regression-adjusted approach, and definitively characterizes when paired sampling is beneficial. Moreover, our algorithm allows explicit minimization of the mean squared error $\mathbb{E}[\|\hat{\boldsymbolφ}-\boldsymbolφ\|_{2}^{2}]$ for each specific utility function. Accordingly, we introduce the first adaptive, linear-time, linear-space randomized algorithm, Adalina, that theoretically achieves improved mean squared error. All of our theoretical findings are experimentally validated. Our code is available at https://github.com/watml/adalina.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效近似半值（Semi-values）的线性空间随机算法Adalina，在Θ(n)空间约束下实现了O(n/ε² log(1/δ))的查询复杂度，并建立了统一理论框架桥接了OFA、unbiased kernelSHAP、SHAP-IQ和回归调整方法，首次明确了配对采样的优势条件。
AI.motivation: Shapley值及其广义半值族在归因问题中备受关注，但精确计算需要指数级效用查询，大规模应用面临巨大挑战。现有方法在有限空间约束下的近似效率仍不明确，亟需建立理论框架来系统分析和优化查询复杂度。
AI.method: 基于向量浓度不等式建立理论框架，开发线性空间算法，通过O(n/ε² log(1/δ))次效用查询保证所有常用半值的L₂误差概率界。引入自适应算法Adalina，显式最小化均方误差。
AI.result: 查询复杂度为O(n/ε² log(1/δ))；统一了OFA、unbiased kernelSHAP、SHAP-IQ和回归调整方法；明确了配对采样的受益条件；Adalina在理论上实现了更优的均方误差。
AI.conclusion: 提出首个自适应、线性时间、线性空间的随机算法Adalina，理论分析和实验验证均表明其优越性，为大规模归因问题提供了高效近似方案。

title: Generative Augmented Inference
summary: Large language models enable inexpensive AI-generated annotations, but using them reliably for causal inference remains challenging. Naively pooling AI and human data induces bias, while existing methods such as Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI; Angelopoulos et al., 2023a) treat AI outputs as proxies of true labels -- an assumption often violated for generative model outputs in practice. We propose Generative Augmented Inference (GAI), a framework that treats AI outputs as general, potentially high-dimensional informative features for learning human labels rather than as surrogates. GAI flexibly models this relationship using nonparametric methods, enabling consistent estimation and valid inference from combined human and AI data. We establish asymptotic normality and show that, under random labeling, GAI strictly improves asymptotic efficiency over human-data-only estimation whenever AI outputs are informative for true labels. Empirical studies on real-world datasets demonstrate that GAI significantly reduces estimation error and improves confidence interval quality across diverse generative data sources relative to human-only and PPI-based estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出生成增强推断（GAI）框架，将AI输出视为预测人类标签的高维特征而非代理变量，结合非参数方法实现因果推断的一致估计和有效推断，在AI信息时严格优于仅用人类数据的方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可低成本生成AI标注，但直接混合AI与人类数据会产生偏差；现有方法（如PPI）将AI输出视为真实标签的代理变量，这一假设在实际生成模型输出中常被违反，亟需更鲁棒的框架来可靠地利用AI标注进行因果推断。
AI.method: 提出生成增强推断（GAI）框架：将AI输出视为预测人类标签的通用、可能高维的信息特征（而非代理变量），采用非参数方法灵活建模AI输出与真实标签的关系，实现结合人类与AI数据的联合估计，并推导了渐近正态性。
AI.result: 理论上证明在随机标注下，只要AI输出对真实标签具有信息量，GAI渐近效率严格优于仅用人类数据的估计；在真实数据集上的实验表明，相比纯人类数据方法和PPI方法，GAI显著降低了估计误差并改善了置信区间质量。
AI.conclusion: GAI框架为利用生成式AI输出进行可靠因果推断提供了理论基础和实用方法，通过非参数建模避免了代理变量假设的缺陷，在多种生成数据源上均展现出更优的统计性能。

title: Adaptive Head Budgeting for Efficient Multi-Head Attention
summary: Multi-head attention enables Transformers to capture diverse representations, but all attention heads are typically activated for every input, regardless of task complexity. For coarse-grained tasks such as text classification, where relevant information is often global, this fixed allocation can introduce unnecessary computation. We propose BudgetFormer, a Transformer architecture that dynamically allocates attention heads on a per-input basis. The model learns both a head budget and a relevance distribution to select the most informative heads. To support effective head selection, we introduce a training strategy that balances exploration and exploitation. Experiments on text classification tasks show that BudgetFormer reduces FLOPs and memory usage while matching or surpassing the performance of standard multi-head attention. These results highlight adaptive head allocation as an effective approach to improving Transformer efficiency and performance.

AI.tldr: BudgetFormer提出了一种动态注意力头分配机制，根据输入复杂度自适应选择最相关的注意力头，在文本分类任务中减少计算量和内存占用，同时保持或提升性能。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer中所有注意力头对每个输入都被激活，忽略了任务复杂度的差异；对于粗粒度任务（如文本分类），这种固定分配引入了不必要的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出BudgetFormer架构，学习每个输入的"头预算"（head budget）和相关性分布（relevance distribution），动态选择最具信息量的注意力头；引入平衡探索与利用的训练策略以支持有效的头选择。
AI.result: 在文本分类任务上，BudgetFormer减少了FLOPs和内存使用，同时匹配或超越了标准多头注意力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应注意力头分配是提升Transformer效率和性能的有效方法。

title: Towards interpretable AI with quantum annealing feature selection
comment: Text improvement and extra tests in v2. 15 pages, 10 figures, 1 table, including appendices
summary: Deep learning models are used in critical applications, in which mistakes can have serious consequences. Therefore, it is crucial to understand how and why models generate predictions. This understanding provides useful information to check whether the model is learning the right patterns, detect biases in the data, improve model design, and build systems that can be trusted. This work proposes a new method for interpreting Convolutional Neural Networks in image classification tasks. The approach works by selecting the most representative feature maps that contribute to each prediction. To solve this combinatorial problem, we encode it into a quantum constrained optimization problem and propose to solve it using quantum annealing. We evaluate our method against the state-of-the-art explainable AI techniques, specifically GradCAM and GradCAM++, and observe an improved class disentanglement, i.e. the model's decision boundaries become more distinct and its reasoning more transparent. This demonstrates that our approach enhances the quality of explanations, making it easier to understand which features the model relies on for specific predictions. In addition, we study the computational behavior of the quantum annealing algorithm. Specifically, we analyze the minimum energy gap of the system during computation and the probability that the algorithm finds the correct solution. These analyses provide theoretical insight into why the method works effectively in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于量子退火的方法，通过选择最具代表性的特征图来解释卷积神经网络（CNN）的图像分类结果，相比GradCAM和GradCAM++方法，实现了更好的类别解缠与解释质量。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在关键应用中的错误可能造成严重后果，因此理解模型如何及为何生成预测至关重要，有助于检查模型是否学到正确模式、检测数据偏差、改进模型设计并建立可信系统。
AI.method: 将选择对每个预测贡献最大的特征图的组合优化问题编码为量子约束优化问题，并利用量子退火求解。
AI.result: 与GradCAM和GradCAM++相比，该方法在类别解缠方面表现更优，即模型决策边界更清晰、推理更透明；同时分析了量子退火算法的最小能隙和找到正确解的概率，提供了理论洞见。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了解释质量，使模型依赖的特征更易理解，并揭示了量子退火在实际中有效工作的理论原因。

title: Towards A Generative Protein Evolution Machine with DPLM-Evo
comment: A peer-reviewed version was accepted to ICML 2026
summary: Proteins are shaped by gradual evolution under biophysical and functional constraints. Protein language models learn rich evolutionary constraints from large-scale sequences, and discrete diffusion-based protein language models~(\eg, DPLMs) are promising for both understanding and generation. However, existing DPLMs typically rely on masked diffusion that contradicts a simple biological intuition: proteins evolve through accumulated edits, not by emerging from masks. Consequently, these frameworks lack explicit pretraining objectives for substitution and insertion/deletion (indel) operations, limiting both optimization-style post-editing and flexible guided generation. To address these limitations, we present DPLM-Evo, an evolutionary discrete diffusion framework that explicitly predicts substitution, insertion, and deletion operations during denoising. DPLM-Evo decouples an upsampled-length latent alignment space from the variable-length observed sequence space, which makes indel-aware generation tractable. To better align substitutions with real evolution, we further introduce a contextualized evolutionary noising kernel that produces biologically informed, context-dependent mutation patterns. Across tasks, DPLM-Evo improves sequence understanding and achieves state-of-the-art mutation effect prediction performance on ProteinGym in the single-sequence setting. It also enables variable-length simulated evolution, and post-editing/optimization of existing proteins via explicit edit trajectories.

AI.tldr: DPLM-Evo是一种进化离散扩散框架，通过显式建模替换、插入和删除操作，改进了蛋白质语言模型的序列理解和生成能力，在突变效应预测上达到SOTA，并支持变长模拟进化。
AI.motivation: 现有DPLM依赖掩码扩散，违背了蛋白质通过累积编辑（而非从掩码中浮现）进化的生物学直觉，且缺乏对替换、插入/删除操作的显式预训练目标，限制了后编辑和灵活引导生成。
AI.method: 提出DPLM-Evo框架：1) 解耦上采样长度的潜在对齐空间与变长观测序列空间，实现indel感知生成；2) 引入上下文感知的进化噪声核，产生生物信息指导的上下文相关突变模式。
AI.result: 在ProteinGym突变效应预测任务上达到单序列SOTA；支持变长模拟进化；可通过显式编辑轨迹对现有蛋白质进行后编辑/优化。
AI.conclusion: DPLM-Evo通过将进化编辑操作显式融入扩散框架，同时提升了序列理解与生成能力，更符合蛋白质进化的生物学直觉。

title: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
summary: Autoregressive decoding becomes bandwidth-limited at long contexts, as generating each token requires reading all $n_k$ key and value vectors from KV cache. We present Stochastic Additive No-mulT Attention (SANTA), a method that sparsifies value-cache access by sampling $S \ll n_k$ indices from the post-softmax distribution and aggregates only those value rows. This yields an unbiased estimator of the post-softmax value aggregation while replacing value-stage multiply-accumulates with gather-and-add. We introduce stratified and systematic sampling to design variance-reduced, GPU-friendly variants. Evaluated on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at 32k-token contexts, S$^2$ANTA matches baseline accuracy while achieving up to $1.5\times$ decode-step attention-kernel speedup over FlashInfer and FlashDecoding on an NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada. In batched long-context generation, these kernel gains translate to up to $1.25\times$ end-to-end decode-latency speedup. Finally, we propose Bernoulli $qK^\mathsf{T}$ sampling as a complementary technique to sparsify the score stage, reducing key-feature access through stochastic ternary queries. Both methods are complementary to upstream quantization, low-rank projection, KV-cache compression, and KV-cache selection methods. Together, they point toward sparse, multiplier-free, and energy-efficient inference. We open-source our kernels at: https://github.com/OPUSLab/SANTA.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出SANTA方法，通过从后softmax分布中采样少量值索引来稀疏化值缓存访问，实现无乘法的高效注意力机制；进一步提出伯努利qK^T采样稀疏化分数阶段。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型32k上下文下，S²ANTA在保持精度的同时实现1.5倍注意力核加速和1.25倍端到端解码加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文自回归解码中，每个token生成需读取KV缓存中所有键值向量，导致带宽瓶颈。现有方法虽可通过量化、低秩投影等压缩KV缓存，但值阶段的全量乘累加操作仍是性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) SANTA：从后softmax分布中采样S个索引（S≪n_k），仅聚合这些值行，用gather-add替代乘累加，得到无偏估计；2) 引入分层采样和系统采样设计方差缩减的GPU友好变体S²ANTA；3) 提出伯努利qK^T采样，用随机三元查询稀疏化分数阶段的关键特征访问。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、32k上下文下，S²ANTA保持基线精度；注意力核相较FlashInfer和FlashDecoding实现1.5倍加速；批处理长上下文生成中端到端解码延迟加速1.25倍。
AI.conclusion: SANTA和伯努利qK^T采样是互补的方法，可与量化、低秩投影、KV缓存压缩和选择等方法协同使用，共同指向稀疏、无乘法、高能效的推理方向。

title: Efficiently Aligning Language Models with Online Natural Language Feedback
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has been used to elicit impressive performance from language models in many domains. But, broadly beneficial deployments of AI may require us to train models with strong capabilities in "fuzzy", hard-to-supervise domains. In this paper, we develop methods to align language models in fuzzy domains where human experts are still able to provide high-quality supervision signal, but only for a small number of model outputs, using online natural language feedback. Specifically, we train models by iteratively optimizing against proxy reward signals, stopping at the point of over-optimization, collecting fresh expert supervision, and updating the proxy reward. We construct proxy reward models from language models using in-context learning (ICL) and fine-tuning. We test our methods by eliciting creative writing and alignment research capabilities in Qwen3-8B and Haiku 4.5 respectively. For Qwen3-8B, ICL methods recover up to 35% of performance with 50x fewer expert samples, while fine-tuning methods recover 80% with up to 20x fewer samples and 100% with 3x fewer samples. For Haiku 4.5, ICL methods recover up to 35% of performance with 30x fewer samples, and fine-tuning methods recover 100% with 10x fewer samples. Our results suggest that online natural language feedback can substantially improve the data efficiency of expert supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在模糊难监督领域中使用在线自然语言反馈来迭代优化代理奖励模型，从而高效利用少量专家监督信号对齐语言模型。在Qwen3-8B和Haiku 4.5上的实验表明，该方法能以显著更少的专家样本恢复大量性能。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习依赖可验证奖励，但在模糊、难以监督的领域（如创意写作、对齐研究）中，奖励信号难以定义。需要一种方法，在只有少量专家在线自然语言反馈的情况下，仍然能够有效对齐语言模型。
AI.method: 通过迭代优化代理奖励模型，在过度优化点停止并收集新的专家反馈来更新代理模型。代理奖励模型通过上下文学习（ICL）或微调从语言模型构建。在Qwen3-8B（创意写作）和Haiku 4.5（对齐研究）上评估。
AI.result: Qwen3-8B：ICL方法以50倍更少样本恢复35%性能，微调方法以20倍更少样本恢复80%、以3倍更少样本恢复100%。Haiku 4.5：ICL以30倍更少样本恢复35%，微调以10倍更少样本恢复100%。
AI.conclusion: 在线自然语言反馈能显著提升专家监督的数据效率，为在模糊领域中高效对齐语言模型提供了可行路径。

title: A Systematic Investigation of RL-Jailbreaking in LLMs
comment: Warning: This paper may contain unfiltered and potentially offensive jailbreaking examples. Accepted at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
summary: The evolution of generative models from next-token predictors to autonomous engines of complex systems necessitates rigorous safety hardening. Adversarial jailbreaking, the strategic manipulation of models to elicit harmful output, remains a primary threat to safe deployment. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) frames jailbreaking as a multi-step attack through sequential optimization, a mechanistic understanding of why the framework succeeds remains incomplete. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic decomposition of RL jailbreaking. We deconstruct the framework into problem formalization (reward function, action space, episode length), and algorithmic measures (RL algorithm, training data, reward-shaping) to identify the structural determinants of adversarial success. Our results reveal that the RL-jailbreaker successfully compromised all targeted models and safeguards. Through this first-of-its-kind analysis, we demonstrate that environment formalization, specifically dense rewards and extended episode lengths, is the primary driver of jailbreaking success. This work provides a tool for improving RL-jailbreaker efficiency and, ultimately, harden generative models resistant to RL-based attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分解了强化学习（RL）对抗越狱攻击的机制，发现环境形式化（密集奖励和延长回合长度）是攻击成功的主要驱动因素，并验证了该方法能攻破所有目标模型和安全防护。
AI.motivation: 尽管强化学习已被用于框架化对抗越狱为多步顺序优化攻击，但对其成功原因的机制性理解尚不完整，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将RL越狱框架分解为问题形式化（奖励函数、动作空间、回合长度）和算法措施（RL算法、训练数据、奖励塑造）两大维度，系统识别对抗成功的结构性决定因素。
AI.result: RL越狱攻击成功攻破了所有目标模型和安全防护；环境形式化（尤其是密集奖励和延长回合长度）是攻击成功的主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 该分析为提升RL越狱攻击效率提供了工具，最终目标是通过理解攻击机制来强化生成模型，使其对RL攻击具有更强的鲁棒性。

title: Curated Synthetic Data Doesn't Have to Collapse: A Theoretical Study of Generative Retraining with Pluralistic Preferences
comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
summary: Recursive retraining of generative models poses a critical representation challenge: when synthetic outputs are curated based on a fixed reward signal, the model tends to collapse onto a narrow set of outputs that over-optimize that objective. Prior work suggests that such collapse is unavoidable without adding real data into the mix. We revisit this conclusion from an alignment perspective and show that collapse can be mitigated through curation based on multiple reward functions. We formalize the dynamics of recursive training under heterogeneous preferences and prove that, under certain conditions, the model converges to a stable distribution that allocates probability mass across competing high-reward regions. The limiting distribution preserves diversity and provably satisfies a weighted Nash bargaining solution, offering a formal interpretation of value aggregation in synthetic retraining loops.

AI.tldr: 本文从对齐角度重新审视生成模型的递归训练问题，证明通过基于多奖励函数的筛选可以缓解模型崩溃，模型会收敛到满足加权纳什谈判解的稳定分布，从而在无真实数据条件下保持多样性。
AI.motivation: 递归训练生成模型时，基于单一固定奖励信号筛选合成输出会导致模型崩溃到狭窄的输出集上，之前认为不加入真实数据就无法避免。本文旨在探索是否可以通过对齐方法缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 形式化建模了异构偏好下的递归训练动态，证明了在基于多个奖励函数进行筛选的条件下，模型会收敛到一个稳定的分布，该分布将概率质量分配给相互竞争的高奖励区域。
AI.result: 递归训练的极限分布保持了多样性，并且满足加权纳什谈判解，为合成数据递归训练中的价值聚合提供了形式化的解释。
AI.conclusion: 基于多奖励函数的筛选可以有效缓解模型崩溃，无需引入真实数据。这为递归训练中如何保持输出多样性提供了理论依据和可操作的方案。

title: FactoryNet: A Large-Scale Dataset toward Industrial Time-Series Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at AI4Physics and FMSD, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/Forgis-Labs/FactoryNet
summary: We introduce the first universal pretraining corpus for industrial time-series data: FactoryNet. 51M datapoints across 23k end-to-end task executions (13.3k real, 9.8k synthetic) on six embodiments, unified by a shared schema that enables robust zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer and highly parameter-efficient anomaly detection. We introduce a novel schema: Setpoint, Effort, Feedback, Context (S-E-F-C) underlying the whole pipeline that maps any actuated system into a common representational frame. The corpus spans 27 annotated anomaly types alongside healthy baselines and counterfactual pairs across robotic manipulation and machining domains. Cross-embodiment transfer experiments yield positive results: under bias-aware metrics our model demonstrates fair cross-embodiment transfer capabilities on the evaluated source-target pair, while 24 schema-aligned signals achieves competitive anomaly detection performance compared to high-dimensional baselines. We release FactoryNet as a growing, multi-embodiment dataset to drive progress toward industrial foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出了FactoryNet，首个面向工业时间序列数据的通用预训练语料库，包含5100万数据点、23k任务执行记录（含真实与合成数据），覆盖6种实体，采用S-E-F-C统一模式实现跨实体零样本迁移和高参数效率异常检测。
AI.motivation: 工业时间序列数据缺乏统一的预训练语料库，现有数据集分散在不同实体和任务上，无法支持跨实体迁移学习和工业基础模型的构建。
AI.method: 构建了包含Setpoint（设定值）、Effort（作用力）、Feedback（反馈）、Context（上下文）四要素的S-E-F-C模式，将任意驱动系统映射到统一表示空间；整合27种异常类型标注及健康基线、反事实对数据。
AI.result: 跨实体迁移实验在偏置感知指标下表现出公平的迁移能力；仅用24个模态对齐信号即可实现与高维基线相当的异常检测性能。
AI.conclusion: FactoryNet作为可增长的多实体数据集发布，旨在推动工业基础模型的发展。

title: HEPA: A Self-Supervised Horizon-Conditioned Event Predictive Architecture for Time Series
comment: Spotlight at FMSD, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/Forgis-Labs/HEPA
summary: Critical events in multivariate time series, from turbine failures to cardiac arrhythmias, demand accurate prediction, yet labeled data is scarce because such events are rare and costly to annotate. We introduce HEPA (Horizon-conditioned Event Predictive Architecture), built on two key principles. First, a causal Transformer encoder is pretrained via a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA): a horizon-conditioned predictor learns to forecast future representations rather than future values, forcing the encoder to capture predictable temporal dynamics from unlabeled data alone. Second, we freeze the encoder and finetune only the predictor toward the target event, producing a monotonic survival cumulative distribution function (CDF) over horizons. With fixed architecture and optimiser hyperparameters across all benchmarks, HEPA handles water contamination, cyberattack detection, volatility regimes, and eight further event types across 11 domains, exceeding leading time-series architectures including PatchTST, iTransformer, MAE, and Chronos-2 on at least 10 of 14 benchmarks, with an order of magnitude fewer tuned parameters and, on lifecycle datasets, an order of magnitude less labeled data.

AI.tldr: HEPA是一种基于地平线条件事件预测架构的多元时间序列关键事件预测方法，通过JEPA预训练编码器+冻结编码器微调预测器的方式，在14个基准测试中超过PatchTST、iTransformer等模型，且参数和标注数据需求减少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 多元时间序列中的关键事件（如涡轮机故障、心律失常）预测至关重要，但标注数据稀缺，因为此类事件罕见且标注成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出HEPA架构，包含两个核心原则：(1) 使用因果Transformer编码器通过联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA)进行预训练，地平线条件预测器学习预测未来表示而非未来值，使编码器从无标注数据中捕捉可预测的时间动态；(2) 冻结编码器，仅微调预测器以预测目标事件，生成单调的生存累积分布函数(CDF)。
AI.result: 在固定架构和超参数下，HEPA处理了11个领域的14种事件类型（包括水污染、网络攻击检测、波动率体制等），在至少10个基准测试中超越PatchTST、iTransformer、MAE、Chronos-2等领先模型，调优参数和标注数据需求均减少一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: HEPA在标注数据稀缺的多元时间序列关键事件预测任务上展现了显著优势，验证了JEPA预训练+冻结编码器策略的有效性。

title: Widening the Gap: Exploiting LLM Quantization via Outlier Injection
summary: LLM quantization has become essential for memory-efficient deployment. Recent work has shown that quantization schemes can pose critical security risks: an adversary may release a model that appears benign in full precision but exhibits malicious behavior once quantized by users. However, existing quantization-conditioned attacks have been limited to relatively simple quantization methods, where the attacker can estimate weight regions that remain invariant under the target quantization. Notably, prior attacks have consistently failed to compromise more popular and sophisticated schemes, limiting their practical impact. In this work, we introduce the first quantization-conditioned attack that consistently induces malicious behavior that can be triggered by a broad range of advanced quantization techniques, including AWQ, GPTQ, and GGUF I-quants. Our attack exploits a simple property shared by many modern quantization methods: large outliers can cause other weights to be rounded to zero. Consequently, by injecting outliers into specific weight blocks, an adversary can induce a targeted, predictable weight collapse in the model. This effect can be used to craft seemingly benign full-precision models that exhibit a wide range of malicious behaviors after quantization. Through extensive evaluation across three attack scenarios and LLMs, we show that our attack achieves high success rates against a broad range of quantization methods on which prior attacks fail. Our results demonstrate, for the first time, that the security risks of quantization are not restricted to simpler schemes but are broadly relevant across complex, widely-used quantization methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个能够针对主流高级量化方法（AWQ、GPTQ、GGUF I-quants）的条件性量化后门攻击，利用量化中异常值导致邻近权重被舍入为零的特性，成功在量化后模型中触发恶意行为。
AI.motivation: 现有量化条件攻击仅对简单量化方法有效，无法攻破更流行和复杂的量化方案（如AWQ、GPTQ等），限制了实际安全风险认知。
AI.method: 利用现代量化方法的共同性质——大异常值会导致其他权重被舍入为零，通过向特定权重块注入异常值，诱导目标性、可预测的权重坍塌，从而构造表面上正常的全精度模型，在量化后表现出恶意行为。
AI.result: 在多种攻击场景和LLM上的大量评估表明，该方法对一系列先前攻击失败的量化方法实现了高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 首次证明量化安全风险不仅限于简单量化方案，而是广泛存在于复杂且广泛使用的量化方法中。

title: FedMental: Evaluating Federated Learning for Mental Health Detection from Social Media Data
comment: Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL) 2026 Main Conference
summary: Social media text data are often used to train Machine Learning (ML) models to identify users exhibiting high-risk mental health behaviors. However, sharing this sensitive data poses privacy risks and limits the growth of benchmark datasets. We comprehensively evaluate whether privacy-preserving ML techniques can enable safer data sharing while preserving performance. Specifically, we apply federated learning (FL) and Differentially Private FL for two widely-studied mental health prediction tasks: depression detection on X (Twitter) and suicide crisis detection on Reddit. We simulate realistic data-sharing scenarios by treating each user as a client in a non-IID setting, evaluating across different client fractions, aggregation strategies, and privacy budgets. While FL achieves comparable performance to centralized training (centralized F1 = 85.63; best FL model F1 = 83.16) on depression identification, we find that Differentially Private FL has a large performance-privacy trade-off (up to F1 = 27.01 drop) even with low levels of noise (epsilon = 50). This is due to the distortion of highly informative yet sparse mental health linguistic markers related to mental health, like health topics and emotion words. This research empirically demonstrates the potential and limitations of current privacy preservation techniques for mental health inference tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了联邦学习(FL)和差分隐私联邦学习(DP-FL)在心理健康预测任务(抑郁症检测和自杀危机检测)中的隐私-性能权衡。结果显示FL在抑郁症检测上接近集中式训练性能(F1=83.16 vs 85.63)，但DP-FL即使低噪声(ε=50)也会导致显著性能下降(F1下降27.01)，原因是隐私噪声扭曲了稀疏但信息丰富的心理健康语言标记(如健康主题和情感词汇)。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体文本数据虽可用于训练心理健康风险识别模型，但分享这些敏感数据存在隐私风险，限制了基准数据集的发展。本文旨在评估隐私保护机器学习技术能否在保障性能的同时实现更安全的数据共享。
AI.method: 在X(推特)的抑郁症检测和Reddit的自杀危机检测两个任务上，将每个用户作为非独立同分布(non-IID)场景下的客户端，模拟真实数据共享情景。对比集中式训练、联邦学习(FL)和差分隐私联邦学习(DP-FL)，评估不同客户端比例、聚合策略和隐私预算下的性能差异。
AI.result: FL在抑郁症检测上性能接近集中式训练(FL F1=83.16 vs 集中式F1=85.63)；但DP-FL存在显著的性能-隐私权衡，即使在低噪声水平(ε=50)下F1也下降27.01。性能下降的原因是差分隐私噪声扭曲了与心理健康高度相关但稀疏的语言标记(健康话题和情感词)。
AI.conclusion: 当前隐私保护技术在心理健康推理任务中既有潜力也有局限性：联邦学习可在一定程度上替代集中式训练，但差分隐私联邦学习在心理健康这类依赖稀疏信息标记的任务中面临严峻性能-隐私权衡挑战。

title: REFLECTOR: Internalizing Step-wise Reflection against Indirect Jailbreak
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities, they remain susceptible to sophisticated, multi-step jailbreak attacks that circumvent conventional surface-level safety alignment by exploiting the internal generation process. To address these vulnerabilities, we propose Reflector, a principled two-stage framework that internalizes self-reflection within the generation trajectory. Reflector first leverages teacher-guided generation to produce high-quality reflection data for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), establishing structured reflection patterns. It subsequently uses Reinforcement Learning (RL) with outcome-driven and reward-validity supervision to instill robust, autonomous self-reflection capabilities. Empirical results show that Reflector achieves Defense Success Rates (DSR) exceeding 90% against complex indirect attacks while generalizing robustly across diverse threat scenarios. Notably, the framework enhances both task-specific and general utility, yielding a 5.85% gain on GSM8K alongside improved performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks. By internalizing trajectory-level safety, Reflector overcomes the fundamental limitations of surface alignment without significant computational overhead, offering an efficient and scalable solution for the development of safe and capable LLMs.

AI.tldr: Reflector是一种两阶段框架，通过内化生成轨迹中的自我反思机制，使LLM能够抵御复杂的多步越狱攻击，在防御成功率超过90%的同时提升任务效用（如GSM8K提升5.85%）。
AI.motivation: LLM虽然能力强大，但容易受到复杂的多步越狱攻击，这些攻击通过利用内部生成过程绕过常规的表面安全对齐，亟需更深层次的防御机制。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用教师引导生成高质量反思数据，通过监督微调建立结构化反思模式；第二阶段使用强化学习，结合结果驱动和奖励有效性监督，训练模型形成自主的自我反思能力。
AI.result: 在复杂间接攻击下防御成功率超过90%；GSM8K性能提升5.85%；在知识密集型基准测试上也有改进；泛化能力强，计算开销小。
AI.conclusion: 通过在轨迹层面内化安全机制，Reflector克服了表面对齐的根本局限，为开发安全且高性能的LLM提供了一种高效可扩展的解决方案。

title: Trust Region On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is a fundamental technique for efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), with broad applications in agent learning, multi-task enhancement, and model compression. However, OPD training becomes unstable when the teacher and student distributions differ substantially, as teacher supervision on student-generated tokens may yield unreliable policy gradients and even cause optimization failure. This work addresses reliable on-policy token-level supervision through credit assignment strategies, and proposes Trust Region On-Policy Distillation, TrOPD. It features the following characteristics: 1) Trust-Region On-Policy Learning: TrOPD performs OPD only in regions where the teacher provides reliable supervision, mitigating the optimization difficulty of the K1 reverse-KL estimator under distribution mismatch. 2) Outlier Estimation: For outlier regions, we explore gradient clipping, masking, and forward-KL estimation to reduce the adverse effects of unreliable supervision. 3) Off-Policy Guidance: The student continues generation from teacher prefixes and uses forward KL to imitate off-policy guidance, encouraging on-policy exploration toward reliable regions. Experiments show that TrOPD consistently outperforms SoTA OPD baselines, including OPD, EOPD, and REOPOLD, across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and general-domain benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TrOPD通过信任区域策略蒸馏、异常值估计和离策略引导三种策略，解决教师与学生分布差异导致的策略蒸馏不稳定问题，在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统同策略蒸馏（OPD）在教师与学生分布差异较大时，教师对学生生成token的监督会产生不可靠的策略梯度，导致优化失败。本文旨在通过合理的信用分配策略，实现可靠的同策略token级监督。
AI.method: 1) 信任区域同策略学习：仅在教师提供可靠监督的区域执行OPD，缓解分布不匹配下K1反向KL估计的优化困难。2) 异常值估计：对异常区域使用梯度裁剪、掩码和前向KL估计减少不可靠监督的负面影响。3) 离策略引导：学生从教师前缀继续生成，使用前向KL模仿离策略引导，鼓励向可靠区域探索。
AI.result: 在数学推理、代码生成和通用基准上，TrOPD一致优于现有最优同策略蒸馏方法（OPD、EOPD、REOPOLD）。
AI.conclusion: TrOPD通过信任区域策略蒸馏有效解决了分布不匹配下的优化不稳定问题，为同策略蒸馏提供了一种更可靠的训练框架。

title: Flicker-DDPM: Accelerating Denoising Diffusion via 1/f Colored Noise Injection
summary: We propose a novel diffusion model, Flicker-DDPM, which incorporates flicker (1/f) noise inspired by self-organized criticality (SOC), a widely observed phenomenon in natural systems. Unlike denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs), which employ isotropic white noise in the forward process, Flicker-DDPM adopts colored noise with power-law spectra to better match the spectral statistics of natural images, whose power spectra typically follow P(k) proportional to 1/k^α. To this end, we develop a colored-noise module based on a spatial correlation kernel, σ(d) = (d + 1)^{-η}, and theoretically establish that adjusting η controls the spectral exponent α of the generated 1/fα noise, enabling adaptation to datasets with diverse spectral characteristics. On CIFAR-10, Flicker DDPM matches or surpasses the generation quality of a standard DDPM baseline using 3.33 times fewer sampling steps, with negligible additional computational cost per step. We further develop a frequency-domain linear theory demonstrating that spectrally matched colored noise linearizes the reverse trajectory, theoretically explaining the observed sampling acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出Flicker-DDPM，一种采用1/fα彩色噪声替代白噪声的扩散模型，通过空间相关核σ(d)=(d+1)^{-η}控制噪声谱指数，在CIFAR-10上以3.33倍更少采样步骤达到或超越标准DDPM质量，并理论上解释了彩色噪声线性化反向轨迹的加速机制。
AI.motivation: 标准DDPM使用各向同性白噪声，其频谱特性与自然图像功率谱（通常服从P(k)∝1/k^α）不匹配，导致采样效率低下。受自组织临界性（SOC）中闪烁（1/f）噪声启发，提出更符合自然图像频谱统计的彩色噪声扩散模型。
AI.method: 1) 设计基于空间相关核σ(d)=(d+1)^{-η}的彩色噪声模块，通过调节η控制生成1/f^α噪声的频谱指数α；2) 建立频域线性理论，证明频谱匹配的彩色噪声可线性化反向扩散轨迹。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上，Flicker-DDPM使用标准DDPM 30%的采样步骤（3.33倍减少）即可达到匹配或更优的生成质量，且每步额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 彩色噪声扩散模型通过频谱匹配实现了采样加速，理论分析解释了其线性化反向轨迹的机制，为高效生成模型提供了新范式。

title: Denoise First, Orthogonalize Later: Understanding Momentum in Muon via Spectral Filtering
summary: Muon has recently demonstrated strong empirical performance in large language model training, but the theoretical role of momentum in Muon remains unclear. Existing analyses of Muon either remove momentum to study spectral updates in isolation, or retain momentum without explaining why it improves empirical performance. Our work bridges this gap by showing momentum in Muon acts as a spectral filter. Under a structured signal-plus-perturbation gradient model, we prove that momentum suppresses perturbations while preserving the dominant signal, thereby enlarging the spectral gap between them. This enlarged gap stabilizes the singular subspaces of the matrix passed to Muon's orthogonalization step, making the resulting update more reliable. We further show that applying momentum before orthogonalization achieves provably stronger alignment with the signal component of the gradient than either reversing this order or simply removing momentum. Experiments across diverse tasks, including LLM pretraining, support our theoretical analysis. More broadly, our theory offers a starting point for understanding the benefits of momentum in other matrix-based optimizers.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了Muon优化器中的动量机制充当谱滤波器：在信号-扰动梯度模型下，动量抑制扰动并放大谱间隙，从而稳定正交化步骤的奇异子空间，提升优化效果。理论分析与LLM预训练等实验一致。
AI.motivation: Muon在大语言模型训练中表现优异，但动量在其中扮演的理论角色尚不明确。现有研究要么移除动量孤立研究谱更新，要么保留动量却无法解释其有效性。本文旨在弥合这一理论空白。
AI.method: 建立结构化信号-扰动梯度模型，从理论上证明动量作为谱滤波器的作用：抑制扰动、保留主导信号、放大谱间隙；证明先动量化再正交化比相反顺序或移除动量具有更强的信号对齐能力；通过LLM预训练等多任务实验验证。
AI.result: 动量在Muon中通过放大谱间隙稳定了正交化步骤的奇异子空间，使得更新更可靠；先动量化再正交化的顺序优于其他变体；实验结果支持理论分析。
AI.conclusion: 动量在Muon中起谱滤波器作用，这一理论发现不仅解释了Muon的经验成功，也为理解其他基于矩阵的优化器中动量的作用提供了起点。

title: q0: Primitives for Hyper-Epoch Pretraining
summary: Multi-epoch training is becoming the standard now that compute is growing faster than the supply of high-quality text. But pretraining a single model saturates within a few passes, long before the compute budget is exhausted. We argue this calls for a conceptual shift from training a single model toward exploring a population of models and aggregating their predictions. We introduce hyper-epoch pretraining (q0), which turns a multi-epoch budget into a population of diverse models whose combined predictions reach a lower validation loss than a single refined model. q0 reduces to three core primitives. A cyclic schedule with anti-correlated learning rate and weight decay collects diverse models from a few parallel trajectories. Chain distillation trains each model against its predecessor so that model quality compounds across the population. A learned prior, fit on a held out set, selects and weights members for any inference budget. On a 1.8B-parameter model trained on 100M FineWeb tokens, q0 matches a strong 256-epoch ensemble baseline using only ~56 epochs (~4.6x fewer), or ~67 epochs (~3.8x fewer) when matched to the baseline's ensemble size, and continues to improve beyond it. These gains reach cumulative ~12.9x data efficiency under the Slowrun setting and transfer to downstream benchmarks. Crucially, the optimal allocation shifts with the budget, so we give prescriptive recipes for how to spend a given epoch budget to maximize generalization, from a single epoch up to the largest budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出超周期预训练（q0），将多周期训练预算转化为多样化模型种群，通过反相关学习率/权重衰减的循环调度、链式蒸馏和学习先验，在1.8B参数模型上实现约3.8-4.6倍数据效率提升，并给出不同预算下的最优分配策略。
AI.motivation: 随着计算增长超过高质量文本供给，多周期训练成为标准，但单模型在少数周期后即饱和，无法充分利用计算预算。因此需要从训练单一模型转向探索模型种群并聚合其预测。
AI.method: q0包含三个核心原语：(1) 反相关学习率与权重衰减的循环调度，从并行轨迹收集多样化模型；(2) 链式蒸馏，每个模型向其前驱学习，使种群质量递增；(3) 在留出集上拟合学习先验，为任意推理预算选择和加权成员。
AI.result: 在1.8B参数模型/100M FineWeb token上，q0使用约56 epoch（~4.6x更少）匹配256 epoch集成基线，约67 epoch（~3.8x更少）匹配基线集成大小，并在Slowrun设置下达到累积~12.9倍数据效率，且迁移至下游基准。
AI.conclusion: 最优分配随预算变化，因此给出了从单周期到最大预算下最大化泛化的处方性策略。

title: Reducing the Filtering Effect in Public School Admissions: A Bias-aware Analysis for Targeted Interventions
summary:
Problem definition: Traditionally, New York City's top 8 public schools have selected candidates solely based on their scores in the Specialized High School Admissions Test (SHSAT). These scores are known to be impacted by socioeconomic status of students and test preparation received in middle schools, leading to a massive filtering effect in the education pipeline. The classical mechanisms for assigning students to schools do not naturally address problems like school segregation and class diversity, which have worsened over the years. The scientific community, including policymakers, have reacted by incorporating group-specific quotas and proportionality constraints, with mixed results. The problem of finding effective and fair methods for broadening access to top-notch education is still unsolved.
  Methodology/results: We take an operations approach to the problem different from most established literature, with the goal of increasing opportunities for students with high economic needs. Using data from the Department of Education (DOE) in New York City, we show that there is a shift in the distribution of scores obtained by students that the DOE classifies as "disadvantaged" (following criteria mostly based on economic factors). We model this shift as a "bias" that results from an underestimation of the true potential of disadvantaged students. We analyze the impact this bias has on an assortative matching market. We show that centrally planned interventions can significantly reduce the impact of bias through scholarships or training, when they target the segment of disadvantaged students with average performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纽约市顶尖公立学校的招生机制，指出基于SHSAT考试分数的选拔方式因社会经济地位和备考资源差异而产生偏差，导致教育管道中的过滤效应和学校隔离问题加剧。作者采用运筹学方法，利用纽约市教育局数据，将弱势学生分数分布偏移建模为"偏差"，并证明针对中等表现弱势学生的集中干预（奖学金或培训）能显著降低该偏差对匹配市场的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统基于SHSAT分数选拔的机制加剧了学校隔离和阶级分化，现有配额制等干预措施效果参差不齐，亟需更有效且公平的方法来扩大弱势学生获得优质教育的机会。
AI.method: 采用运筹学方法，利用纽约市教育局数据，将弱势学生分数分布偏移建模为"偏差"，在排序匹配市场框架下分析偏差影响，并通过集中干预（奖学金/培训）对中等表现弱势学生群体进行仿真干预评估。
AI.result: 存在系统性的分数分布偏移（偏差），且这种偏差源于对弱势学生真实潜力的低估；针对中等表现弱势学生的集中干预能显著减少偏差对匹配结果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对性的奖学金或培训等集中干预，可以有效降低社会经济偏差对教育匹配市场的影响，为拓宽弱势学生接受优质教育的途径提供了可操作的解决方案。

title: Local Clustering on Complex Graphs and Complex Hypergraphs
summary: Local/seeded clustering aims to find a compact cluster near the given starting instances. While most existing studies on graph clustering assume a discrete graph setting (i.e., unweighted, undirected graphs without self-loops), real-world graphs can be more complex. In this paper, we extend the classic non-approximating Andersen-Chung-Lang (ACL) clustering algorithm beyond discrete graphs and generalize its quadratic optimality to a wider range of complex graphs, including weighted, directed, and self-looped graphs and hypergraphs with edge-dependent vertex weights. Specifically, by leveraging PageRank, we propose two algorithms: GeneralACL for graphs and HyperACL for hypergraphs. We prove that, under two mild conditions, both algorithms can identify a quadratically optimal cluster in terms of conductance. Additionally, we provide experiments to validate our theoretical findings. Our code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/HyperACL.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了经典的ACL聚类算法，将其适用范围从离散图推广到加权图、有向图、带自环图以及具有边依赖顶点权重的超图，并证明了在温和条件下算法能找到二次最优的簇。
AI.motivation: 现有局部/种子聚类研究大多假设离散图环境（无权重、无向、无自环），但真实图结构更为复杂，需要将经典算法推广到更通用的图类型。
AI.method: 基于PageRank，提出两种算法：GeneralACL（适用于一般图）和HyperACL（适用于超图），并通过理论分析证明它们在两个温和条件下能识别出关于conductance的二次最优簇。
AI.result: 两种算法在加权图、有向图、带自环图和边依赖顶点权重的超图上均能实现二次最优性，实验验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 成功将ACL算法的二次最优性保证从离散图扩展到更广泛的复杂图结构，拓展了局部聚类的理论适用范围。
